Charlie配置装备了4个阿尔忒弥斯IV增强型LRM-15和1个LB-5X. 设计还包括1个大型增程激光、锁定式SRM-6、ECM套件和AMS. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 铁纤维(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 400 50 左侧 350 50 右侧 350 50 后方 245 50 炮塔 300 50 总计 1645 250 特质: 主战坦克 万能载具 #武器: 2x AMS(氏族) 1x 锁定式SRM-6(氏族) 1x LBX AC/5(氏族) 4x LRM-15(氏族) 1x 大型增程激光(氏族)

column1: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra 双散热器. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 几乎是 Prime 的直接对立型号，A 配置在每侧躯干各安装了两门 Ultra AC/2，并在每只手臂上安装了一门大型增程激光作为两吨 Ultra 弹药耗尽时的补充. 一个额外的双散热器使该配置更加完善. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The advanced model employed by the 星际联盟防卫军 Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one medium laser and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and 双散热器 to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL Engine to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 2743年，星际联盟防卫军皇家师团所采用的先进型号，将该机甲的战斗定位从导弹平台转变为能量舰艇，拆除了远程导弹发射器，换装一门大型增程激光，保留一门中型激光，并将另一门降级为小型激光. 由于不再需要CASE系统，该机甲还配备了MASC系统以提供瞬时加速能力，并采用双重散热器来应对增加的热量输出. THE-Nb型搭载了超轻型引擎，以节省重量用于安装这些额外装备，但代价是降低了生存能力. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: The second '机甲 personally built by Sneede of Cranston Snord's Irregulars, this Franken机甲 combines several laser weapons, an ER PPC and an Artemis V-enabled LRM-20. A simple ECM suite provides rudimentary electronic warfare capabilities. Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 由克兰斯顿·斯诺德非正规军的斯尼德亲手打造的第二台机甲，这台拼装机甲组合了多种激光武器、一门增程粒子加农炮（ER PPC）和一具搭载阿尔忒弥斯V火控系统的LRM-20导弹发射器. 一套简易的电子对抗系统提供了基本的电子战能力. 特质: 对空瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 右侧下部

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series 全向Mechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. Meant to stay a good distance back from enemy units, the Deva B carries an ER PPC in each arm. The Infernus piles on enough heat sinks that the MechWarrior has no real heat concerns. Adding to that A pair of 中型脉冲激光s that also benefit from the advanced computer can be utilized should an enemy get within range. Defensively, a 守护者ECM Suite ensures that enemies cannot benefit from electronics against the Deva or its nearby allies. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 作为布雷克圣言会天体系列的另一款万能机甲，提婆（得名于印度教神话中的天人）同样大量应用了新兴技术. 该机型采用轻型聚变引擎，配备可承受标准型号一倍半伤害的重型陀螺仪，以及天体系列共有的小型驾驶舱. 专为与敌方单位保持安全距离设计的提婆B型，双臂各装有一具增程粒子加农炮.“炼狱”加装了充足的散热器，使机甲战士无需担忧热量问题. 当敌人进入射程时，还可启用同样受益于先进计算机的两具中型脉冲激光. 防御方面，守护者电子对抗组件确保敌人无法利用电子设备针对提婆及其附近盟友. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: More flexible than the 3S at the cost of more wasteful ammunition usage, but the longer strike distance makes it a better variant.
column2: 比 3S 更灵活，但弹药使用更浪费，但更长的打击距离使其成为更好的变体。

column1: An upgrade of the Mercury model used by Dark Shadows units, the "Mercury Elite" is armed with only a light Gauss rifle, albeit with two tons of ammo, turning the Hermes II into a sniper. This comes at the cost of two tons of armor. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 暗影部队所使用的“水星”机甲升级型号——“水星精英”，仅配备一门轻型高斯步枪且备弹两吨，使“赫尔墨斯II”化身为一台狙击机型. 但这是以牺牲两吨装甲为代价的. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: 疯狗是一款用于远程间接火力支援的氏族重型全能机甲。它肩部前倾、头部突出、腿部反关节，酷似秃鹫，因此首次遭遇它的内天体部队给了它"秃鹫"的代号。疯狗最显著的特征是其侧躯干与臂部吊舱——它们本身几乎就是完整模块，暗示这台机甲在设计时就构想为远程支援单位。躯干模块高高倾斜，非常适合安装导弹，而臂部则充当适于直射武器的延伸炮塔。 Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: A配置装备了一门增程粒子加农炮，并加装了四个额外的双重散热器以保持配置散热良好. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Heat Transfer is a Modified Flashman that, as its name says, Transfers heat from itself to the Enemy. The Whole Loadout of the 机甲 make it a Perfect Heater to other 机甲s, and all the Electronics have been upgraded to help with that Job. Attributed to a Unnamed Solaris Warrior, they wanted this custom Refit done, apparently even brought some Solaris parts into this Wonder 机甲. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 热传导型机甲是一台经过改装的闪光侠，顾名思义，它能将自身热量传递给敌人. 这台机甲的全套武器装备使其成为令其他机甲升温的完美热源，所有电子设备都进行了升级以辅助这一功能. 据传，一位匿名的太阳能战士提出了这项定制改造需求，甚至为这台神奇机甲带来了来自索拉里斯竞技场的专属零件. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Those Quicsell Heavy PPCs are an odd beasty. Yes, they can do AC20 damage at long range. ONLY at long range though. Any closer, and they bleed damage fast. Something about the destabilization of the PPC bolt adding to the damage? I can't follow the technical specs, but I can tell you that this mech will be useless if the enemy gets into close range.
column2: 那些 Quicsell 重型 PPC 是一种奇怪的野兽。是的，它们可以在远距离造成 AC20 伤害。但仅限于远距离。如果再靠近，它们就会快速流血。 PPC 螺栓的不稳定会增加损坏吗？我无法理解技术规格，但我可以告诉你，如果敌人进入近距离，这个机甲将毫无用处。

column1: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by 氏族地狱马. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Hardened (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 30 Left 90 30 Right 90 30 Rear 75 30 Turret 90 30 Total 465 150 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: Enyo Strike Tank是由地狱战马氏族生产的战斗载具. 在Mars的XL引擎变体成功后  Khan Malavai Fletcher命令他的科学家种姓设计一种主战坦克  能够利用轻量引擎带来的速度优势. 他的继任者James Cobb喜欢这个想法  并维持了对这种概念验证的要求. 科学家们的劳动成果就是Enyo. 它能达到高达97公里/小时的速度  这使它能够跟上许多氏族中型机甲. 七吨半的铁纤维装甲保护着坦克  使其能够承受一些打击  尽管速度是它最好的防御. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 5/8格 / 150/240米. 装甲: 硬化(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 120 30 左侧 90 30 右侧 90 30 后方 75 30 炮塔 90 30 总计 465 150 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 2x SRM-6(氏族) 2x 中型增程脉冲激光(氏族)

column1: For each point of negative reputation with any faction, you gain 100 points.  This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每一点任一派系的负面声望，你会获得100分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: The attack on Star Cluster 752 continues. You have to choose the next contract to attempt, only once all three are finished will the attack be successful.
column2: 对星团752 的进攻仍在继续. 你必须选择下一份要执行的合约，只有完成全部三项任务，进攻才会成功.

column1: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton 全向mech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an 内骨骼复合结构, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER 中型激光s hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-O is armed with a pair of 大型脉冲激光s and a Gauss Rifle. All of the weapons are Clantech versions, while 4 extra DHS and an Angel ECM suite round out the variant. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton 全向mech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an Endo-Composite Structure, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER Medium Lasers hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-O is armed with a pair of Large Pulse Lasers and a Gauss Rifle. All of the weapons are Clantech versions, while 4 extra DHS and an Angel ECM suite round out the variant. Quirk：Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: CGR-1L 是作为卡普坦协定一部分出售给卡佩兰邦联的出口型号，是对冲锋者的简单改装，试图在 3023 年查拉星上的灾难性使用之后让它更有效。1L 以四吨半装甲和全部五门小型激光为代价，在右臂装一门大型激光，两侧躯干各两门中型激光。虽然更易过热、防护也更差——装甲水平堪比传统侦察机甲——但它更能抵御其他侦察机甲，而在当时，对卡佩兰邦联武装部队绝望的战士而言已经足够。此后 CGR-1L 一直留在卡佩兰服役，作为训练机甲，据传也是对付异见士兵的惩罚性差事。 Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: -1A1的简单改装，将三门小型激光和部分装甲替换为一门中型激光和一个C3从机. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: Converts an SHS engine to Quicsell DHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
column2: 将单散热(SHS)引擎转换为QS双散热(QS DHS)引擎. 机甲的散热系统为机甲内部的组件提供散热，并为遍布机甲的额外散热器提供兼容扩展点. 它不同于引擎本身的封闭式冷却系统.

column1: 随着赫尔姆核心失传技术的重新引入，陶里安防卫军发现自己在邻国面前落后了。正如战锤时代那样，陶里安人转向了本土的塔洛斯。凭借易于维护、易于制造的名声，这一设计正是 TDF 所需。由于缺乏资源把重新设计的塔洛斯变成可行的量产型号，陶里安人向邻国求助，以换取加入正在进行的"三一联盟"谈判。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯法域的财政投资帮助下，范登堡于 3059 年底在其新范登堡工厂开始限量制造塔洛斯。3062 年"三一联盟"正式签署，把生产许可授予 Majesty Metals 与 Detroit Consolidated Mech Works。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自身使用并向外更远处出口而生产多种塔洛斯变体。Base
column2: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的“三位一体同盟“谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。

column1:
当 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:disembark|Default:disembarks} 从休假归来的穿梭机上下来，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 小跑着直奔你和达里乌斯。

“指挥官，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 和我出去喝酒，有个本地的机甲战士请了我们一轮。他开始打听我们公司，可不像是在找工作。更像是在打听你。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses} 地停住了，有些迟疑。

达里乌斯催 {TGT_MW.Obj}。“说吧，你没惹麻烦。直接说结尾。”

“嗯，他出钱想买我们在本星系后续行动的情报。我没理他，走了，但 {SCN_MW.Callsign} 留下了。”
column2:
砰砰的声音把你吸引到公共的机甲战士兵营，在那里你发现[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]正在拆卸“豹式”的一堵内墙. 已经有几块嵌板整齐地堆放在{TGT_MW.OBJ}旁边.

{TGT_MW.OBJ}停顿了一下然后解释说:“这里有几立方米的闲置空间. 我在腾出地方，这样我们就可以在不撞到铺位的情况下伸展身体.”

尽管这听起来很合理，但银行不会喜欢你修改他们的财产.

column1: The Tyr Infantry Support Vehicle was a joint design by Clan Ghost Bear and Joint Equipment Systems, part of a plan by the Clan's leadership to reach out more to the conquered Rasalhagian populace. It has a five-ton infantry bay, enough to carry a full Point of Elementals. Since most front-line units have 全向Mechs that the battle armor troopers can ride in on, the Tyr has mostly been distributed to second-line forces. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲： Armor (C) 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 150 25 左侧 110 25 右侧 110 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 125 25 总计 595 125 特性：通信增强 Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Tyr步兵支援车是Ghost Bear氏族与联合装备系统公司联合设计的产物  是氏族领导层计划更深入接触被征服的Rasalhague民众的一部分. 它拥有一个五吨的步兵舱  足以搭载一整队元素战士. 由于大多数前线单位都配备了万能机甲  战斗装甲士兵可以搭乘  因此Tyr主要分配给了二线部队. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 150 25 左侧 110 25 右侧 110 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 125 25 总计 595 125 特质: 改良通信 可搭载1个战斗装甲小队. 设有射击孔. #武器: 1x 大型增程激光(氏族) 2x 锁定式SRM-4(氏族)

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded armor protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this armor is still too light to allow the 'Mech to operate in a stand up fight. 双散热器 keep the Stinger IIC cool. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
column2: 虽然斯汀格 IIC型按照圣战时代的标准地面速度较低，但仍足以胜任骚扰单位和侦察平台的角色. 180米的跳跃能力也很实用，能让机师迅速脱离复杂地形. 升级后的装甲防护也受到那些用惯旧款斯汀格的战士的重视，但这层装甲依然太薄，无法让机甲在正面战斗中持续作战. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 1.01

column1: These '跳跃喷射器' 是another almost lifelike growth that 允许 the Queen 以 leap 和 rush 以wards any target 在 a wild Frenzy
column2: 【Queen Upper Leg】这些“跳跃喷射器”是另一种近乎活体生物般的增生结构  使女王能够跃向任何目标  并以狂暴状态冲向敌人.

column1: The Cornerstone project intended to produce a defense tank that could be a bulwark around which other elements of a unit could rally while it delivered a steady stream of support fire. As such it was a moderate success. But critics were quick to point out that perhaps the duties of a line tank could be done more efficiently by conventional MBT, and a superheavy chassis might have been better used to mount an exceptional weapon system like a railgun. Three years later with the CTD-151 the critics got their wish.Fusion: Expensive engine that works in a Vacuum. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 550 105 Left 450 105 Right 450 105 Rear 385 105 Turret 550 105 Total 2385 525 Quirk: 快速起步
column2: Cornerstone项目旨在生产一种防御坦克  能成为部队其他单位集结的堡垒  同时持续提供支援火力. 就此而言  它取得了一定成功. 但批评者迅速指出  或许常规主战坦克能更高效地执行前线坦克的职责  而超重型底盘或许更适合搭载如磁轨炮这样的卓越武器系统. 三年后  随着CTD-151的出现  批评者们如愿以偿. 聚变: 昂贵的引擎  可在真空中工作. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 2/3格 / 60/90米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 标准 数值 装甲 结构 正面 550 105 左侧 450 105 右侧 450 105 后方 385 105 炮塔 550 105 总计 2385 525 特质: 快速启动 #武器: 4x AMS 4x 地雷投放器 20 1x UAC/5 1x BlazeFire大型增程激光 1x 磁轨炮(轻型)

column1: Vacuum decreases heat sinking efficiency to 65%. Reduced gravity results in ballistic and missile weapons and jump jets having 20% more range. Solar flares add 4 heat per turn and reduce sensor efficiency to 40%. VTOL units have 400% movement cost and -2 evasion.
column2: 真空环境将散热效率降低至 65%. 低重力使实弹与导弹武器以及跳跃推进器的射程增加 20%. 太阳耀斑每回合额外增加 4 点热量，并将传感器效能降至 40%. 垂直起降飞行器单位的移动消耗增加至 400%，且闪避值 -2.

column1: The personal ‘机甲 of 左侧enant Natasha Ergen of the Fifth FedCom RCT, her stock Griffin had been refitted with ferro-fibrous 装甲 and a light fusion engine. Fourteen double heat sinks and a targeting computer allowed Ergen to obtain maximum effect from an all-energy weapons array consisting of an ER PPC, two standard medium lasers mounted one per side torso alongside three ER medium lasers, one mounted in each torso component. 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.07
column2: 这是第五联协作战群娜塔莎·埃尔根中尉的个人机甲，她的标准型“狮鹫（Griffin）”经过改装，换装了铁纤维装甲和轻型聚变引擎. 十四具双重散热器与一台瞄准计算机，使埃尔根能够将全能量武器阵列的效能发挥到极致——配置包括一门增程粒子加农炮、两门分装于左右侧躯干的标准中型激光，以及三门分别安装于各躯干部位的中型增程激光. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.07

column1: Constructed using IS-grade Endo-Steel and clad in seven tons of Inner Sphere quality Ferro-Fibrous armor, the BTL-C-2O 战斗眼镜蛇 mounts a lighter 200-rated standard fusion engine. While reducing its speed by 20 km/h, the extra weight was required to carry heavier IS grade weapons as well as mount a fixed Improved C3 Computer in its center torso. Taking advantage of Multi-Missile Launcher technology, the BTL-C-2OE mount a MML-9 launcher in each arm, carrying two tons of LRM reloads and single ton of SRM missiles in its right torso. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 采用内天体级钢内骨结构，覆以7吨内天体级铁纤维装甲，BTL-C-2O 战蛇装备了一台较轻的200级标准聚变引擎. 虽然速度降低了20 km/h，但额外的重量用于搭载更重的内天体级武器，并在中央躯干内安装了一台固定的改进型C3计算机. 借助多导弹发射器技术，BTL-C-2OE 在双臂各装有一具MML-9发射器，右躯干携带2吨远程导弹及1吨短程火箭备弹. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Banshee IIC 2 was discovered during a Dark Caste raid on Star Adder holdings in the Kerensky Cluster, often mistaken for a captured Inner Sphere BNC-5S and considered weaker. Isolated in battle, it managed to score three kills before enemies withdrew. Maintaining the Banshee’s impressive speed for an assault mech, the IIC 2 reaches around 68 kph. Its armament includes two Improved Heavy Large Lasers, two 大型脉冲激光s, and a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle, all linked to a 瞄准计算机. Despite its severe heat generation requiring careful management, pilots also lament the absence of jump jets that limits its battlefield mobility. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Banshee IIC 2是在暗黑种姓袭击星蝰氏族位于克伦斯基星团的据点时被发现的，常被误认为缴获的星际联盟BNC-5S型号，因而被视为存在缺陷. 在孤军作战的情况下，它仍在敌方撤退前取得三次击杀. IIC 2型保持了Banshee作为突击机甲而言惊人的速度，最高可达约68公里/时. 其装备包括两门改进型大型重激光、两门大型脉冲激光以及一门20级超高速电磁高斯步枪，全部关联于瞄准计算机. 尽管它产生的极高热量需要谨慎管控，机师仍对其缺乏跳跃推进器导致的战场机动性不足颇感不满. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.23 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂 使用已获Aries Games and Miniatures授权.

column1: 沙漠生物群系会将散热效率降低至 85%。Whipping dust reduces visibility and sensor efficiency to 60%, and all units have +2 Defense. Strong winds result in land units taking 20% more stability damage, while VTOL units have -2 max evasion. 产热量 is increased by 10%.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 漫天沙尘将能见度与传感器效能降至 60%，所有单位获得 +2 防御. 强风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 20%，而垂直起降飞行器单位的最大闪避值 -2. 热量生成增加 10%.

column1: A Clan Society prototype Heavy Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle, what would later become the Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle, firing submunitions able to utterly crush any target it is aimed at. Uses Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
column2: 这款武器是氏族秘社的银弹重型高斯步枪原型，即后来的超级突击高斯步枪，能发射足以彻底粉碎任何瞄准目标的弹药. 使用高斯弹药. 易爆!

column1: The Headsman primary configuration is all about the massive damage its twin 超级自动炮 20s and two Proto AC/8 can deliver. It does also mount two ATM-12 launchers and a Small ER Pulse Laser, but they are taking more of a support role compared to the bigger guns. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 刽子手的主配置完全取决于其双联装Ultra AC/20和两门Proto AC/8所能造成的巨大伤害. 它还配备了两台ATM-12发射器和一门小型增程脉冲激光，但与这些大口径火炮相比，它们更多地承担支援角色. 特质: 威吓 部署费用倍率: 1.43 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Created during the Age of War, the Vulture series of gunships are designed to wear targets down at range and provide direct fire support for allied units. A 30 ton gunship, the Vulture is usually built around some variation of a 100 rated engine, giving it a top speed of 120 km/h; with 4-5 tons of armour on each variant. Still in irregular production, the Vulture can be found in any number of variants across most of known space. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： 车辆潜行装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 120 15 左侧 85 15 右侧 85 15 后方 65 15 总计 370 75 特性：易于驾驶
column2: Vulture系列炮艇机诞生于战争时代  设计用于在远距离消耗目标并为友军单位提供直接火力支援. 作为一款30吨重的炮艇机  Vulture通常围绕100额定引擎的某种变体建造  使其最高速度达到120公里/小时；每种变体配备4-5吨装甲. Vulture仍处于非定期生产状态  在已知太空的大部分区域都能找到各种变体. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境中部署. 移动: 8/12格 / 240/360米. 装甲: 载具潜行装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 120 15 左侧 85 15 右侧 85 15 后方 65 15 总计 370 75 特质: 易于驾驶 #武器: 2x UAC/2(氏族)

column1: 风暴鸦 B 是另一种近战配置。Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 暴风乌鸦B型是另一种近战配置. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Designed by Fredonian Industrial Technologies, the Anubis was originally designed to complement the Osiris BattleMech in use by the Federated Suns. The 'Mech's lightweight chassis carries a powerful Ceres Motors 250 XL engine that gives the Anubis a top speed of 129.6 km/h and is covered in a protective skin of Hellespont Lite 隐身装甲, making the Anubis extremely hard to hit at long range. The Anubis-3L is armed as an effective light fire support 'Mech. Its primary weapons are four LRM-5 launchers, allowing the 'Mech to provide long range fire support for other light 'Mechs. For close combat, the 3L has two Small Lasers. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 阿努比斯由弗雷多尼亚工业技术公司设计，最初旨在作为恒星联邦装备的奥西里斯机甲的战斗补充. 这款机甲采用轻型底盘，搭载一台强劲的塞雷斯动力250型超轻型引擎，使阿努比斯能够达到129.6公里/小时的最高时速，并覆盖赫勒斯滂轻量化潜行装甲作为防护外层，这令阿努比斯在远距离交战中极难被命中. 阿努比斯-3L型是作为高效轻型火力支援机甲而武装配置的变体. 其主要武器为四具LRM-5发射器，使该机甲能为其他轻型单位提供远程火力支援. 此外3L型配备有两门小型激光应对近距离战斗. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: For each point of positive reputation with any faction, you gain 100 points.  This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每一点任一派系的正面声望，你会获得100分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: Ion Stream Projectors an offshoot of PPC development where, rather than focusing the ion and proton streams into a single devastating shot, ISPs only have the minimum of field inhibitors and beam focusing equipment. With supplemental superheated plasma from the engine, this results in a spray of energized particles that more closely resembles a flamer than a traditional PPC.
column2: 【Ion Stream Projector】离子流投射器是PPC发展的一个分支，它不像传统PPC那样将离子和质子流聚焦成单一毁灭性射击，而是只配备最低限度的场抑制器和光束聚焦设备. 借助来自引擎的补充过热等离子体，这会产生一片高能粒子喷流，看起来更像是火焰喷射器而非传统PPC.

column1: This version was produced for Clan Jade Falcon by Red Devil Industries in 3083. Using an experimental XXL Engine and Improved Jump Jets to provide mobility, the chassis is protected by Ferro-Fibrous Armor. Each arm mounts an ER Large Laser and Improved Heavy Medium Laser.
column2: 该版本由 Red Devil Industries 于 3083 年为 Clan Jade Falcon 生产。使用实验性 XXL 引擎和改进的跳跃喷气机来提供机动性，底盘由铁纤维装甲保护。每个臂安装一个 ER 大型激光器和改进型重型中型激光器。

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. This variant removes the Gauss Rifles and Jump Jets and replaces them with a HAG/30 in each arm. The side torsos each mount an LRM-10 and a pair of ER 中型激光s. A 轻型 主动探头 is mounted in the head, and the remaining tonnage is given over to more armor protection. Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 尽管外形上与‘森林狼’有着惊人的相似，这台战斗机甲却是全新且强大的创造. 该变体移除了高斯步枪和跳跃喷气装置，代之以每支手臂各安装一门HAG/30. 左右侧躯干各搭载一具LRM-10和两门中型增程激光. 头部安装了一台轻型主动探测器，剩余的吨位则用于提升装甲防护. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 猛禽 A 意在远离补给线执行长期任务。它以两门大型激光为主武器，近战方面 A 配置携带三门小型激光。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 此配置主武器为一门等离子步枪. 辅助武器包括一门小型增程激光和三门小型脉冲激光. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 0.93 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: This 3085 version uses an experimental XXL engine to boost ground speed to 86 km/h. An Endo Steel skeleton provides enough weight savings to allow this 战斗大师 to carry an ER PPC, Heavy PPC, 锁定式SRM-6, and a pair of ER medium lasers. Sixteen 双散热器 keep the temperature manageable. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 这款3085年型号采用实验性的XXL发动机，将地面速度提升至86公里/小时. 采用钢内骨结构提供了足够的重量节省，使这台战王能够搭载一门增程粒子加农炮、一门重型粒子加农炮、一套锁定式SRM-6发射器以及两门中型增程激光. 十六具双散热器使温度保持可控. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.15

column1: 克林特主要被设计为一种廉价的侦察单位，具备武装良好、低端中型机甲的作战能力，在这点上它表现出色。凭借97.2公里/小时的最高速度和一百八十米的跳跃能力，克林特能轻松跟上其他侦察单位，并在山地或城市地形中机动。这台定制型号把自动炮/5换成了一门大型激光器和四具散热器。 Quirk: 可变射程瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 卡利俄佩最初是为船底武装部队设计的驻防型战斗机械，主要用于对抗步兵和车辆. 该设计也是为了取代逐渐老化的蛇型战斗机械，后者在卡佩拉邦联和船底自治区同样承担着相同的任务. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth Aletha is armed with an ER Large Laser and a trio of ER Small Lasers. 守护者ECM fills the remaining free tonnage. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.03
column2: 搭载200级别的超轻型引擎与MASC系统，这具20吨级的火蒙机甲是有史以来速度最快的机甲之一. 火蒙专为侦察与运输元素士兵设计，于2874年正式投产. 得益于铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合，火蒙拥有7.5吨的荚舱空间. 阿莱莎型火蒙配备一门大型增程激光与三门小型增程激光，剩余吨位则装填守护者型电子对抗系统. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.03

column1: Nothing really makes this variant different from other recent Wolverines. That Heavy PPC does suffer a bit from shorter range, but overall the 'Mech does just fine on the battlefield.
column2: 这个变种与其他最近的狼獾没什么区别。重型 PPC 确实因射程较短而受到一些影响，但总的来说，“机甲”在战场上表现得很好。

column1: The Catapult 1R retrofit arose from a shortage of Materials and proper factories, it still carries 2 impressive 雷电15 Cruise Missiles, though. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult 1R的改装源于物资与正规工厂的短缺，但它依旧搭载了两台令人印象深刻的雷电15导弹发射器. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 0.87 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. A rare variant of the ZEU-6S, the 6S-DC incorporates a 指挥控制台 at the cost of a 中型激光 and two Heat Sinks. The 'Mech is all but extinct these days, but they make a large impact on any battlefield they are deployed on. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯战斗机甲最初由天琴共同体于2787年建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发之际. 应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的需求而设计，宙斯的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，并具备与之匹敌的作战能力. ZEU-6S的稀有型号6S-DC额外配备了指挥控制台，但为此牺牲了一具中型激光和两具散热器. 该机型如今几乎绝迹，但一旦投入战场便会造成巨大影响. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The -4H replaces the 大型脉冲激光 of the -4E with an LB-X Autocannon 10, but at the cost of reducing the cooling to just acceptable levels. This was seen as an decent trade, as the LBX proved the more useful weapon during the design's trials. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -4H型号将-4E的大型脉冲激光替换为LB-X 10霰弹炮，代价是散热性能降至仅可接受水平. 鉴于该武器在试验中证明更为实用，这被视为合理的权衡. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.33 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: 稳定武器 Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 标准聚变 Equipment: 1 x 指挥掩体 1 x ECM Weapons: 1x Improved HGR Ammunition: 2x 重型高斯弹药 [DBL]
column2: Reinforced structure to defend an area. Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 320 Structure: Structure Amount: 200 Engine: 300 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker 1 x ECM Weapons: 1x Improved HGR Ammunition: 2x Ammo Heavy Gauss [DBL]

column1: This version, introduced in 3077, is based on the 11-C as well but uses an experimental C3 Boosted Master computer to cut through the ECM commonly found on Jihad-era battlefields. It carries a Streak SRM-4, Gauss Rifle, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm.
column2: 该版本于 3077 年推出，同样基于 11-C，但使用实验性 C3 Boosted Master 计算机来突破圣战时代战场上常见的 ECM。它的每只手臂上都携带一支 Streak SRM-4、高斯步枪和一支 ER 中型激光器。

column1: 伪装服是为达维昂的NAIS班宰小队打造的，以狙击手常穿的伪装服命名。它携带一门改进型高斯步枪和电子设备，是令人生畏的游击手与侦察兵。 Quirk: 精准武器 - 高斯 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 猎户座 ON1-AJA 型相当能打. 特质: 防空瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.07 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Nightstars are normally pretty scary but this version might take the cake. That Hyper PPC will rip of tons of armor at a time while the Flechettes tear into everything beneath.
column2: 夜星通常非常可怕，但这个版本可能更胜一筹。 Hyper PPC 会一次撕裂成吨的装甲，而箭弹会撕裂下面的一切。

column1: 今天就试试 Quicsell 的 Ferro 装甲吧！它甚至比广受欢迎的 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲更轻，体积也只略微增加。占用 12 个槽位。
column2: 今天就试试Quicsell的铁装甲吧! 它比广受欢迎的铁纤维装甲更轻，只是略微更占空间. 预留 12 个槽位.

column1: The Homunculus HCS-21 crams a wide mix of weapons onto its frame, an AC/5 and machine gun in the right arm, large laser and flamer in the left, SRM 4 in the right torso, LRM 10 and medium laser in the left torso, plus a small laser in the head. Jump jets round out the design. 特性：加固结构 部署成本倍率：1.07
column2: The Homunculus HCS-21 crams a wide mix of weapons onto its frame, an AC/5 and machine gun in the right arm, large laser and flamer in the left, SRM 4 in the right torso, LRM 10 and medium laser in the left torso, plus a small laser in the head. Jump jets round out the design. Quirk：Reinforced Structure Drop Cost Multiplier：1.07

column1: The king of the battlefield, absolutely ruined by pirates. They've cut off half the barrel, made it hot-load two slugs at a time, and scratched obscenities all over it. They've basically turned this AC/20 into a sawed-off shotgun. VOLATILE!
column2: 战场上的王者，被海盗彻底毁了. 他们锯掉了半截炮管，让它能一次热装填两发弹丸，还在上面刻满了污言秽语. 他们基本上把这门AC/20改成了一把锯短了的霰弹枪. 易爆!

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the 全向Mech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-F is armed with an ER PPC and 4 SRM-6’s. A Narc Beacon fills the remaining free tonnage. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 65吨的线卫于3052年投产，设计目的是取代木狼。它围绕一台390额定XL引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是木狼难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合为这款全向机甲提供了17.5吨自由挂载空间。线卫LBK-E装有一门增程大型激光和一对ATM-6，中央躯干装有一台轻型主动探测器。投放费用倍率：1.1。

column1:
While most well-known names within Clan society are those of great warriors, there are a select few whose names shine amongst these stars that are not. One such name is that of Rime Lynn, the first IlChi of 石狮氏族.

Born into 氏族地狱马 as a freeborn, Rime's station all but ensured he would never receive the training or resources to become one of the Clan's great warriors. While talented enough to earn himself a spot within the Clan's touman as a tanker, he was never destined to journey with the Clan's trueborn warriors on their conquest of the Inner Sphere.

Fortunately for Rime, this meant he was spared from 氏族地狱马' exile from their homeworlds following the War of Reaving. With the Horses now abjured, Rime was part of the homeworld remnants of the Clan that was re-organized into the newly formed 石狮氏族.

While most derided the new Clan as a pawn of the Star Adders, Rime was determined to change this notion. With his Clan in desperate need of warriors, Rime found himself pressed into frontline forces. Able to hold his own, he made a name for himself with his ability to bring his Clan together, and soon found himself being looked up to by several trueborn warriors after helping them deal with the loss of their former Clan identity.

In June 3080, Rime had a chance encounter with the soon-to-be Khan of Clan Coyote, Han Hill, during a Trial. During that Trial he left an impression on Hill, sparking renewed communication between the two Clans. Little did Rime know at the time just how impactful this encounter would be on his future.

As relations between the two Clans improved, the overall perception of 石狮氏族 improved with them. In recognition of Rime's work, and hoping to further improve the standing of the Clan, the Stone Lion Khan made the decision to revive the long forsaken role of 'IlChi' and award the position to Rime.

Despite some complaints from the trueborn warriors, most recognized Rime was perfect for the role and, perhaps unsurprisingly, he excelled at it.

Over the course of the next several years, Rime succeeded in re-making the image of 石狮氏族, bringing the Clan close with the other Clans in the Kerensky Cluster, with the sole exception of 血灵氏族. Under Rime's tutelage several other Clans revived the office of the IlChi and he became a name known to nearly all the Clan warrior castes.

By the time of his death, Rime Lynn was widely credited for making 石狮氏族 an accepted part of Clan society, which greatly assisted his Khan's military victories and efforts to expand his Clan's influence in the Kerensky Cluster. His peerless work truly showed even the most stubborn trueborn warrior the value of a PR campaign and set a new standard for cooperation between Clans.

column1: Mizuki's voice cuts through a wall of static, sharp and unwavering. "Outpost Eleven is under threat. [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Watch]] strike groups are advancing on multiple fronts, and we must act before the entire sector collapses." She gestures toward a grainy tactical map, flickering red symbols crawl across the screen, surrounding key [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]] positions. "One target is our elite combat cadre, still running drills in the field. If they're overrun, we lose the warriors trained to lead the next generation." "Another is a buried ruin. Our engineers uncovered forgotten simulator tech beneath it. The Ghost Bears are moving to destroy everything before we can extract it." "And the last is our main training facility itself. They're sending everything at it. This is no raid. It's extermination." She locks eyes with you. "You'll handle all three. This is just choosing which to strike first. Once a mission is issued, you have 14 days to complete it. And each success will earn you a special reward, custom systems, rare salvage, assets we don't hand out lightly." The transmission flickers out. The screen waits, silent and blinking, for your decision.
column2: 美月的声音穿过一片静电干扰，尖锐而坚定.“11号前哨 正受到威胁. [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]监察部]]的打击部队正在多条战线上推进，我们必须在整个区域崩溃之前采取行动.” 她指向一张模糊的战术地图，闪烁的红色标记正在屏幕上移动，将关键的[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]部落]]阵地包围. “其中一个目标是我们的精英战斗骨干，他们仍在野外进行训练. 如果他们被击溃，我们将失去那些负责培养下一代战士的核心力量.” “另一个目标是一处被掩埋的遗迹. 我们的工程师在其中发现了被遗忘的模拟训练技术. 幽灵熊正在行动，准备在我们提取之前摧毁一切.” “最后一个目标，是我们的主要训练设施本身. 他们正在向那里投入全部力量. 这不是一次袭击. 这是一次灭绝行动.” 她直视着你.“三个目标，你都必须处理. 这只是决定先打击哪一个. 一旦任务发布，你有14天完成它. 而每次成功都会获得特殊奖励: 定制系统、稀有战利品，以及我们不会轻易交出的战略资源.” 通讯画面闪烁，随后消失. 屏幕安静地等待着你的决定.

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Tennessee Valley Arena and piloted by Marie Costa, the most striking piece of technology this machine features is a 虚空信号系统 followed by the Clan-spec 铁纤维装甲 that replaced its original Capellan-style Starshield 隐身装甲 and its eleven 双散热器. In the weapons section, a single MML-9 launcher appears where once there were twin MML-3s, while the mech losses the Light PPCs in favor of more ER 中型激光s (now three). Missing is Beagle active probe while an Improved Narc Missile Beacon Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: 于3144年在田纳西谷竞技场首次亮相，由玛丽·科斯塔驾驶，这款机甲最引人注目的技术装备是虚空特征系统，其次是以氏族规格的铁纤维装甲取代了原有的卡佩拉式星盾潜行装甲，并配备了十一具双联散热器. 在武器部分，原先的双联装MML-3发射器已被替换为一门MML-9发射器，同时移除了轻型粒子加农炮，换装更多中型增程激光（现为三门）. 缺失了贝格尔主动探测器，而改进型自恋导弹信标也不见踪影. 特质: 改良型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.1

Whatever the case, she is an unusual contender on the arena circuits with a customized J. Edgar believed to date from the first Star League. Fully upgraded with ClanTech, the J. Edgar uses a combination of an XL Engine and Ferro Fibrous to free up the weight needed to upgrade the SRM-2's to Clan Streak 4's. The 中型激光 is swapped for a Clan ER model and the armour protection is improved by a ton. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. column1: Produced by Cosara Weaponries for the Word of Blake following their capture of the facility in 3069, the 008 uses the latest technologies available at the time. The autocannons have been upgraded to Heavy PPCs. The powerful weapons are backed up by paired Light Autocannon/2s, sharing one-ton of ammo in CASE-protected ammunition bin. Two ER Medium Lasers back up these guns. Like other Blakist units, a C3i Computer is included.A Guardian ECM Suite is also included. With seventeen double heat sinks and Jump Jets, this unit can jump and fire both of its main guns even with some heat to spare. Luckily this variant can be visually distinguished from others based on its more streamlined chassis, giving opponents some measure of warning.
column2: 008 是由 Cosara Weaponries 在 3069 年占领该设施后为布莱克之言生产的，采用了当时最新的技术。自动加农炮已升级为重型 PPC。这些强大的武器由成对的 Light Autocannon/2s 提供支持，在受 CASE 保护的弹药箱中共享一吨弹药。两台 ER 中型激光器为这些枪提供支持。与其他 Blakist 装置一样，还包括 C3i 计算机。还包括 Guardian ECM 套件。凭借十七个双散热器和跳跃喷气机，该装置可以跳跃并发射其两门主炮，即使有一些余热。幸运的是，由于其更流线型的底盘，该变体可以在视觉上与其他变体区分开来，从而给对手一定程度的警告。

column1: This customized Clan '机甲 was created by an abandoned 烟虎氏族 warrior named Aemelia on the Draconis Combine world of Rockland in 3062. She evaded capture by the forces of Operation: Bulldog and found herself alone for two years, waiting for word from a now dead Clan. She decided to patrol the world alone, dispatching pirates. She took a Great Wyrm Battle机甲 out of storage from a hidden Jaguar depot and removed ammunition-dependent weapons, replacing them with an ER large laser, a large pulse laser, and a pair of ER medium lasers and ER small lasers. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Upper
column2: 这台由烟虎氏族被遗弃的战士艾梅莉亚改装的氏族机甲，于3062年在天龙联合体世界的罗克兰完成了改造. 她在“斗牛犬行动”中躲过了追捕，独自等待了两年，却未能盼来早已覆灭的氏族消息. 最终她决定独自巡逻这颗星球剿灭海盗，从隐秘的烟虎氏族仓库中取出一台存封的巨蛇战斗机甲，拆除了所有依赖弹药的武器，换装为一门大型增程激光、一门大型脉冲激光，以及各两门中型增程激光和小型增程激光. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 右上臂

column1: The Siren Proto机甲 was originally 设计ed by 烟虎氏族 to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. This variant was armed with a pair of SRM-1 Launchers. To fit the large weapons, the Siren's speed was reduced to 120 km/h. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.96
column2: 塞任原型机甲最初由烟虎氏族设计，用作侦察单位. 它的高速度使其能够迅速前出，发现敌军，呼叫导弹打击，并在敌军无法察觉的情况下撤离. 该型号装备了一对SRM-1发射器. 为了装配这些大型武器，塞任的速度降低到了120公里/小时. 特质: 敏捷 部署费用倍率: 0.96

The new version of the venerable combat vehicle began to appear at the dawn of the thirty-second century. Originally, this upgraded version of the Scimitar served as part of the 球体共和国's Republic Armed Forces, being produced by Scarborough Manufacturers' Al Na'ir. column1: A Nova Cat 设计, the 50 ton Huntsman was 设计ed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. The Huntsman I is armed with an ER Large Laser and a HAG/20. A 等离子炮 and an ER 小型脉冲激光 provide additional firepower at close range. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为新星猫氏族的杰作，50吨级猎手机甲专为复兴行动及内天体入侵作战而设计，于3049年首次投产. 这款万能机甲采用250超轻型引擎、钢内骨结构与铁纤维装甲，拥有21.5吨武器挂载空间. 机体固定配置5台跳跃推进器，赋予其卓越机动性. 猎手I型主武器为大型增程激光与HAG/20超高速自动炮，近程防御则由等离子炮与小型增程脉冲激光构成. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Crab 27s fulfill an oft overlooked role, that of a skirmisher with firepower. Wielding strong energy weapons, the Crab delivers a punch at nearly all ranges, with no ammunition constraints. column1: Following the surprise invasion of Huntress, most of the Clans looked to upgrade the defenders of their homeworlds. In so doing, 云蛇氏族 decided to upgrade their aging 步枪手IICs. The IIC 3 first entered service in the early part of 3062. Based upon the original 设计, it nonetheless uses two Model HHC-30 超级自动炮/2s to plink at a target from long range. Any opponent who believes he or she is facing a IIC 2 is quickly surprised, however, when the IIC 3 opens up with its paired Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Lasers. Twenty one double heat sinks keep this 设计 cool-running. This rebuilt version still mounts the 主动探头. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 在Huntress遭到突袭入侵之后，大多数氏族都着手升级其母星的防御力量. 在这一过程中，云蛇氏族决定升级其老化的“步枪手（Rifleman）”IIC型. IIC 3型于3062年初首次投入服役. 虽然基于原版设计，但它配备了两门HHC-30型超轻型自动炮/2，用于从远距离对目标进行点射. 然而，任何以为面对的是IIC 2型的对手，当IIC 3型展开其成对的4D-2系列大型重激光时，都会立刻大吃一惊. 二十一个双重散热器使这款设计运行温度保持凉爽. 这个重建版本仍然搭载了主动探测器. 特质: 集成探照灯 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A Kuritan variant of the classic Catapult, the Catapult K6 debuted in the Dark Ages. Armed with a pair of ELRM-15’s and 4 ER Small Lasers, the design is designed to engage and destroy enemies at extreme range. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 作为经典“弩炮（Catapult）”机甲的栗田变体型号，Catapult K6首次亮相于黑暗时代. 该机型配备了两具增程远程导弹-15和四门小型增程激光，专为在超远距离接敌和摧毁目标而设计. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

This variant has a slightly different weapons layout than the -R1337, including a 短管PPC and even more pulse lasers. The 'Mech' does keep both the Ferro-Lamellor armor and the Angel ECM suite. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.34 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 喜欢城市机甲吗？喜欢那些能合体的机器人动画吗？一伙海盗也这么想，他们绑架了几位氏族超重型机甲研究员，逼着他们打造出了这个怪物. 毁灭城市机甲由五台城市机甲的骨架拼装而成，搭载了更多武器，是你梦想中的城市机甲终极形态. 此变体与 -R1337 型号的武器布局略有不同，配备了一门短管PPC和更多的脉冲激光. 机甲保留了铁层叠装甲和天使ECM套件. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.34 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: Focusing solely on long range combat, the Lightning LHN-C5 carries an 改进的 重型高斯步枪 and an Heavy Particle Projection Cannon. These weapons inflict heavy damage at long range, rapidly stripping 装甲 from nearby units. Three tons of ammunition are carried for the Gauss Rifle. The lack of short range weapons is deliberate because the Strategios wants the Lightning to focus on long range combat while the partner-'机甲, the Thunder, handles close in conflict. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: 专注于远程战斗，闪电LHN-C5搭载了一门改进型重型高斯步枪和一门重型粒子加农炮. 这些武器能在远距离造成巨大伤害，迅速剥离附近单位的装甲. 高斯步枪携带了3吨弹药. 完全没有短程武器是刻意为之，因为战略部希望闪电专注于远程作战，而它的搭档机甲“惊雷”则负责近距离战斗. 特质: 整流罩 部署费用倍率: 1.1

column1: Dragoon是为狼之龙第七突击队构想的更重、更灵活战斗装甲。相比常见渗透服，Dragoon提供了更强防护和更高适应性。它最初旨在为战斗工程师的高风险渗透行动提供一定战场保护，同时融入轻型战斗服所具备的行动便利。 Quirk: 简易操控 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 机密. 特质: 速度！ 部署费用倍率: 0.932 只能由内部舱室运输，可近战，可攀附.

column1: You shake your head. "No, Doctor. As much as it pains me to see them in the MedBay, I know that they're in good hands. And we should be able to get along fine until they're on the mend. Let's save your grand experiment for when we're in truly desperate straits."
column2: 你摇了摇头.“不，博士. 虽说看着他们躺在医务室里让我很不好受，但我知道他们得到了很好的照料. 而且在他们痊愈之前，我们应该也能应付得来. 还是把你那宏大的实验留到真正山穷水尽的时候吧.”

column1: The Eyleuka is a highly mobile medium '机甲. Though it only has a top speed of 86 km/h, seven improved jump jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 210 meters. Nine and a half tons of stealth 装甲, powered by a 守护者ECM suite, give it decent protection especially at range, but also make it difficult to detect. A small cockpit makes piloting the '机甲 more difficult, while the compact gyro makes the gyroscope less vulnerable. The engine is a great deal more vulnerable, however, as the 设计 incorporates an XL engine. The '机甲's largest weapon is a MML-9 launcher, which gives the 机甲Warrior the flexibility to utilize long- and short-range missiles. While rather worryingly placed on either side of the cockpit, three tons of ammunition impart the additional flexibility to make use of special munitions. At long range, the Eyleuka has an ER large laser, but when it closes it can make use of a pair of ER medium lasers. A TAG can call direct deadly missiles or homing artillery 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: Eyleuka 是一款高机动性的中型机甲. 尽管其最高时速仅为 86 公里，但七具改进型跳跃推进器使其最大跳跃距离可达 210 米. 九吨半的潜行装甲，配合守护者 ECM 套件运行，为其提供了不错的防护，尤其是在远距离作战时，同时也使其难以被探测到. 小型驾驶舱增加了机甲的操控难度，而紧凑型陀螺仪则降低了陀螺仪的受损风险. 然而，由于设计采用了超轻型引擎，引擎的脆弱性大大增加. 该机甲威力最大的武器是一具 MML-9 发射器，这让机甲战士可以灵活运用远程与短程火箭. 虽然其弹药被安置在驾驶舱两侧，位置令人担忧，但三吨弹药为使用特种弹药提供了额外的灵活性. 在远距离上，Eyleuka 装备有一门大型增程激光，而在接近时，则可以使用两门中型增程激光. 其搭载的目标定位器可以引导致命的直接攻击导弹或自寻的火炮. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Created during the heyday of the Star League era, the Fer-de-Lance is a 30 ton Canopian Battle机甲 built by Majesty Metals and Manufacturing at their Canopus IV facilities. Surviving the succession wars mostly intact, the Fer-de-Lance is still 生产 in small quantities by MMM every year and features in most MAF light mech lances. The FDL-4 is built around a 240 rated XL engine. Outfitted to hunt enemy scout units, the FDL-4 boasts a pair of clan made 改进的 Heavy Medium Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers. Angel ECM and Stealth 装甲 round out the 设计. 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：0.99
column2: 诞生于星盟时代鼎盛时期的Fer-de-Lance，是一款30吨级船底战斗机甲，由威严金属与制造公司（MMM）在坎诺普斯IV号设施中建造. 它在继承者战争中大体完好地幸存下来，如今MMM每年仍会小批量生产毒牙，并且它已成为大多数坎诺普斯武装部队（MAF）轻型机甲小队中的常见成员. FDL-4型以一台240额定功率的超轻型引擎为核心构建. 为了猎杀敌方侦察单位，该型号装备了两门氏族制造的改进型中型重激光以及两门中型脉冲激光. 天使型电子对抗系统（Angel ECM）和潜行装甲则完善了整体设计. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.99

column1: A powerful and hard hitting configuration, the H represents the Warwolf's Heavy Laser–focused weapon layout. A pair of Improved Heavy Large Lasers are split between each of the 'Mech's side torsos, while the right arm is fitted with a Gauss rifle with sixteen rounds of ammunition. CASE II protects the 'Mech's right and left torsos in the event of a heavy laser capacitor explosion. To help cope with the extreme heat generated by the 'Mech's weapons, two additional 双散热器 and a pair of Coolant Pods are added. Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 一个强大且打击力十足的配置，H 型代表了战狼机甲以重型激光为核心的武器布局. 两门改进型大型重激光分别安装在机甲的两侧躯干，而右臂则装有一门高斯步枪，并配有十六发弹药. CASE II 保护了机甲的左右躯干，以防重型激光电容爆炸. 为应对机甲武器产生的极端热量，额外加装了两个双重散热器和一对冷却剂荚舱. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Massive rounds, designed for devastating impact, to be used in the Yang artillery.
column2: 巨型炮弹，专为毁灭性打击而设计，用于杨氏火炮.

column1: Based on the Golden Age Storm Giant, the Scylla is an updated model 开发 by the Steel Vipers as a second line Battlemech. A 100-ton mech with a 400-rated XL Engine, the Scylla SCY-3 is armed with a LB-20X and a HAG-30. An ER PPC and a Heavy Large Laser give the Scylla a heavier punch at range. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 基于黄金时代的“风暴巨人”设计，Scylla是由“钢蟒”氏族研发的升级型号，定位为二线战斗机型. 作为一台配备400倍率超轻型引擎的百吨级机甲，Scylla SCY-3型搭载了一门LB-20X和一门HAG-30加农炮. 一门增程粒子加农炮与一门大型重激光则使其在远程打击中更具威力. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Now this is a proper upgrade. The original Penetrator suffered from heat issues that prevented it to reach a good level of damage over long engagements. More heat sinks, a battle computer and some longer weaponry will make some good differences.
column2: 现在这是一次适当的升级。最初的穿甲弹遭遇过热问题，导致其在长时间交战中无法达到良好的伤害水平。更多的散热器、战斗计算机和一些更长的武器将会带来一些好的变化。

column1: Those who get too close to this baby, will soon learn how much pain it can deliver with those SRMs.
column2: 那些离这个婴儿太近的人很快就会知道这些 SRM 会给婴儿带来多大的痛苦。

column1: Devil 是 Snow Raven 氏族在原始 Howler 底盘上做出的变体，30吨的它于2911年服役。相比前身增重10吨，由300级XL引擎驱动，使它能够加速到比 Baboon 更高的速度。铁纤维装甲与内衬钢的组合腾出了自由重量，用于安装一门ER PPC 和一台瞄准计算机。\\n\\n特性：加长躯干旋转\\n\\n投放费用倍率：1.05
column2: 雪鸦族在原版嚎叫者底盘上的改型，30 吨的恶魔于 2911 年服役。相比前身增加了 10 吨，它由 300 级 XL 引擎驱动，使其加速能力超越狒狒。铁纤装甲与内钢的组合为 ER PPC 和瞄准计算机腾出了富余重量。\\n\\n特性：躯干扭转增强\\n\\n投放成本倍率：1.05

column1: The B configuration of the Umbriel carries a LRM-20 launcher in each arm and in the center torso. Combined with the Astral Hammer and a head mounted ER PPC it is able to deal with most combat situations, except for close quarter battles. 特性：布雷克之怒 部署成本倍率：1.26 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Umbriel的B配置在每只手臂和中央躯干各装备了一具LRM-20发射器. 配合“Astral Hammer”以及头部安装的增程PPC，它能够应对大多数战斗情况，但近距离战斗除外. 特质: 布雷克之怒 部署费用倍率: 1.26 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The DI Multipurpose VTOL was the end result of a design process hampered repeatedly by changing requirements. Defiance had built a prototype when the LCAF changed the requirements. Defiance finally responded by preempting further design changes by submitting their own design for a single multi-role helicopter that met all of the previous requirements. The design originally called for by the LCAF was also produced directly for sale by Defiance; the Gunship variant lacked the infantry compartment, TAG and 比格犬主动探头 of the Multipurpose VTOL, instead mounting an MML-7 on the front of the Gunship. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 200 18 左侧 130 18 右侧 130 18 后方 100 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 575 90 特性：通信增强
column2: DI Multipurpose VTOL是设计过程中因需求不断变化而屡遭阻碍的最终产物. 当LCAF更改需求时  Defiance已经建造了一架原型机. Defiance最终通过抢先提交自己的设计来应对  该设计是一种满足之前所有需求的单一多用途直升机  从而避免了进一步的设计变更. LCAF最初要求的设计也由Defiance直接生产销售；Gunship变体缺少Multipurpose VTOL的步兵舱、TAG和比格犬主动探头  而是在Gunship的前部安装了一个MML-7. 环境限制: 该单位无法部署在月球环境. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 200 18 左侧 130 18 右侧 130 18 后方 100 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 575 90 特质: 改进通信 #武器: 1x MML-7 1x 轻型PPC

column1: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two 超级自动炮/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven 双散热器 and a 270 Standard Engine round out the rest of it load out. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 破坏者 MAL-2P 应被视为原型机. 与 -1P 或 MX90 不同，-2P 的每只手臂各装有一对激光；有传言称，如有需要可加装超过两门. 它的两具 LRM-10 可使其在更远距离发射导弹，两门UAC/5超级自动炮 则提供从远到近的支援火力. LRM 与 UAC/5 每门均备弹两吨，并且与 -1P 和 MX90 一样，2P 配备蜂窝式弹药储存设备以防殉爆. 十一具双倍散热器和一台 270 标准引擎组成了其余配置. 特质: 扰乱 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: This version of the Po uses experimental 加固装甲 for protection. The standard weaponry has been replaced with a 锁定式SRM-6 launcher and a Hypervelocity Autocannon/10. To maintain the tank's top speed designers had to use a Fusion Engine. While often derided as a poor man's Rommel/Patton tank, the simply constructed and dependable Po Heavy Tank, named by Romano Liao for the mischievous and vengeful spirit of Chinese tradition, has become the principal combat vehicle on Capellan worlds lacking 'Mech units. Introduced in 3031, the Po is built around the rugged, dependable, and cheap Ceres 240 internal combustion engine, which gives the tank a maximum flank speed of 65 km/h. Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and 布雷克圣言会, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Hardened Structure: Structure Values A S Front 125 30 Left 80 30 Right 80 30 Rear 75 30 Turret 105 30 Total 465 150 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: 这个版本的Po使用了实验性的硬化装甲作为防护. 标准武器已被锁定式SRM-6发射器和超高速自动加农炮/10所取代. 为了保持坦克的最高速度  设计师不得不使用聚变发动机. 虽然经常被嘲笑为穷人版的Rommel/Patton坦克  但结构简单且可靠的Po重型坦克  由Romano Liao以中国传统文化中调皮且复仇心重的灵魂命名  已成为缺乏机甲单位的卡佩拉世界的主要战斗车辆. Po于3031年推出  围绕坚固、可靠且廉价的Ceres 240内燃机建造  使坦克的最大侧翼速度达到65公里/小时. 十吨半的装甲为重型坦克提供了可观的防护. 加上其易于维护和不错的火力  这种防护使Po成为资金紧张的雇佣兵、低级别驻军单位、自由世界联盟和布雷克圣言会的热门选择  这些出口销售为联邦的金库带来了急需的资金. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 硬化 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 125 30 左侧 80 30 右侧 80 30 后方 75 30 炮塔 105 30 总计 465 150 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x HVAC/10 1x 锁定式SRM-6

column1: 执法者 4R 型号把自动炮与巨型激光的沉重威力与跳跃推进器的机动性结合起来，是致命的组合。它能在中远距离一直到抵近射击的交战，这些机甲在战斗中灵活而令人意外。 Quirk: 改良冷却套-自动炮 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 黑豹9L型搭载一门实验性等离子炮，配备升级版武器挂架，并辅以干扰导弹发射器与火焰喷射器. 特质: 空降突击 部署费用倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: 陶鲁斯条约签署后，卡诺普斯法域与陶里安协约合作建立了新殖民地地区，并创设了殖民地法警。This variant of the Marshal was introduced during the Dark Age. It carries a TSEMP磁脉冲炮, MML-9 with a three ton ammunition bay, two Machine Guns, a Flamer, a 中型激光, and a 中型脉冲激光. It is otherwise identical to the original Marshal. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 当金牛条约签署时，它在船底自治区与金牛协约国的合作下建立了新殖民地，同时也催生了殖民地执法官这一编制. 该执法官机甲的变体于黑暗时代推出，配备了一门紧塞电磁脉冲炮、一具配有三吨弹药舱的九联多导弹发射器、两挺机枪、一具火焰喷射器、一门中型激光以及一门中型脉冲激光. 除此之外，它与原版执法官完全相同. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Yang arrives at the morning briefing in a foul mood. "Commander, if one more pilot shows up to complain that their favorite '机甲 isn't ready, I'm going to pitch someone out an airlock." Darius intervenes. "How about we draft some of them to actually help? It might be educational for them and useful for you." Dr. Murad has been deep in thought. "The Argo has very powerful systems that are currently offline. If we could get them working, even only temporarily, it might help with the current workload."
column2: 杨一早就阴沉着脸出现在晨会中.“指挥官，要是再有一个机师跑来抱怨他们最喜欢的机甲还没准备好，我就要把人丢出气闸了.” 达吕斯插话道:“不如把他们拉来帮忙? 对他们来说也许是种学习，对你也有用.” 穆拉德博士深思熟虑后说:“阿尔戈号 上有很多高效的系统目前处于离线状态. 如果我们能把它们启动起来——即便只是临时的——也可能减轻当前的工作负担.”

column1: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 110 15 右侧 110 15 后方 100 15 炮塔 110 15 总计 540 75 特性：防护机构
column2: 这种轻型战斗车辆于2692年首次投产，盖伦被证明是一种经济的步兵与战斗机甲支援手段。它的最高速度超过大多数机甲，机动性出色，但普遍缺乏防护，早期型号仅有三吨半装甲。大逃亡之后，这些履带车辆大多落入龙脉联合体与自由世界联盟手中。盖伦常与骚扰者导弹平台搭配使用。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：7/11 格 / 210/330 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 90 15 左侧 60 15 右侧 60 15 后方 45 15 炮塔 80 15 总计 335 75 特性：防护机构

column1: The Stormbird was commissioned by 玉鹰氏族 and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and 雪鸦氏族 science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. column1: Spider 5V 无疑是你能投入战场的最灵巧的机甲，但它薄得像纸。不过它是极出色的侦察机，甚至能跳到大多数敌人的后方弧线内，来一记出其不意的背射。 Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 科米努斯配置在每只手臂上各安装了一门氏族中型脉冲激光，并在左右侧躯干各装有一具10型火箭发射器. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.97

column1: After 氏族地狱马 forces' invaded the 蛇夫座自治领 during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. The Mastodon's performance after its introduction makes it inevitable that it will be at the forefront of many campaigns to come. The heavily reinforced structure resists both weapons fire and the standard wear and tear that accompanies most campaigns. The B configuration carries an LB 20-X Autocannon in the left arm and a combination of two 锁定式SRM-4 launchers and four 中型脉冲激光s in the right. A single Streak LRM-20 launcher in the right torso is also mounted. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: After Clan Hell's Horses forces' invaded the Rasalhague Dominion during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. The Mastodon's performance after its introduction makes it inevitable that it will be at the forefront of many campaigns to come. The heavily reinforced structure resists both weapons fire and the standard wear and tear that accompanies most campaigns. The B configuration carries an LB 20-X Autocannon in the left arm and a combination of two Streak SRM-4 launchers and four Medium Pulse Lasers in the right. A single Streak LRM-20 launcher in the right torso is also mounted. Quirk：坚固 Drop Cost Multiplier：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 160 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 100 15 炮塔 145 15 总计 605 75 特性：防护机构
column2: 这种轻型战斗车辆于2692年首次投产，盖伦被证明是一种经济的步兵与战斗机甲支援手段。它的最高速度超过大多数机甲，机动性出色，但普遍缺乏防护，早期型号仅有三吨半装甲。大逃亡之后，这些履带车辆大多落入龙脉联合体与自由世界联盟手中。盖伦常与骚扰者导弹平台搭配使用。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：7/11 格 / 210/330 米。 装甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 120 15 左侧 80 15 右侧 80 15 后方 50 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 420 75 特性：防护机构

column1: 达里乌斯看着穿梭机与阿戈号对接。指挥官外出接受 LAM 训练已久，希望这次回到船上后，一切能恢复正常。 一位医疗技师走下穿梭机，来到达里乌斯面前：“请问你是达里乌斯，阿戈号的副官吗？” 达里乌斯点点头：“是的。有什么可以帮你的？” 医疗技师把一块数据板塞到达里乌斯手里：“请在这里签字。人现在交给你们了。” 达里乌斯低头看数据板，上面是一份送往阿戈号的伤员交接单：指挥官 {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}，在 LAM 飞行训练中受伤；当前状态：稳定。“到底出了什么事？” 医疗技师耸耸肩：“真说不好，长官。听小道消息说，你们的指挥官想要甩开另一名学员拿最高分之类的，结果发生了空中相撞。要我说，能活着就算走运了。总之，上头命令我把人安全送到这里，我已经送到了。接下来就看你们怎么把人养回满血了。” 达里乌斯签下交接单时，一张悬浮担架飘了过来，指挥官被绑在上面，显然被药物压得昏昏沉沉。达里乌斯从那只紧攥的手里抽出一张纸。读下来，看来指挥官至少是及格通过了训练，只不过不是完整地通过。 一名负责悬浮担架的阿戈号医疗技师开口道：“呃，长官……指挥官要送到哪儿？”
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}，希望之光.”不得不说，这称号听起来真不错.

column1: The defense of Horgens continues. You have to choose the next contract to attempt, only once all three are finished is the defense successful.
column2: Horgens 的防御仍在继续. 你必须选择下一份合约执行，只有三份都完成后，防御行动才算成功.

column1: Remove UNSTEADY and end this unit's turn. Gain BULWARK (20% damage reduction against ranged attacks to the front and side) and ENTRENCHED (50% stability damage reduction).
column2: 移除失衡状态并结束本单位的回合. 获得“戒备”(减免20%正面与侧面受到的远程攻击伤害) 和“稳固”(稳定性伤害减免50%).

column1: The Krait C configuration specializes in short- to mid-range combat, boasting five ER 中型脉冲激光s and an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser. Enhanced by four Jump Jets and an Angel ECM Suite, the Krait C offers both offensive punch and electronic warfare support with impressive mobility. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait C型配置专精于中近距离战斗，搭载五门中型增程脉冲激光与一门改进型小型重激光. 借助四套跳跃喷气背包与天使ECM套件的强化，Krait C型在提供强大火力的同时，也以出色的机动性实现电子战支援. 特质: 改良冷却套 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.01 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The D variant was introduced during the Dark Age era in 3119. 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 迪莫斯是由雪鸦氏族开发的，这款机甲在3060年代中期首次投入实战，据传是在科伦斯基星团的路姆星球上亮相. 然而，在圣战时期，内天体情报机构不再听到关于这款机甲的传闻，它也逐渐从人们的记忆中淡去. 直到3085年，雪鸦氏族才向内天体公开了迪莫斯的存在. 它被视为氏族的骄傲，每支战斗群至少都会部署一台. D型变体则于3119年的黑暗时代期间推出. 特质: 防空瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: What do you get when you take the iconic BRRRRRT away 来自 the Warthog? Not much, except a cheaper LAM. Quirk: 陆空两用机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 从尤猪身上拿走标志性的BRRRRRT后，你会得到什么？几乎没什么，只不过是个更便宜的陆空两用机甲. 特质: 陆空两用机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: A unit used by the 4th Sword of Light, this variant of the Stalker replaces the heat sinks with 双散热器, adds 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控 to the LRM-10 launchers, and replaces the SRM-6 packs with four 锁定式SRM-2 systems. Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 光之剑第四团使用的单位，这款潜行者变体将散热器更换为双倍散热器，为LRM-10发射器加装阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并用四套锁定式SRM-2系统取代了原来的SRM-6发射架. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 这是一个古怪的纯能量武器定制改型，试图通过不使用弹药来削减运营成本。热量上升意味着该机甲必须携带 7 具外置散热器，省下的成本因此被抵消得差不多，使这个版本在多数人眼中极不受欢迎。 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: Originally rumored to be a light or ultralight LAM, the Svartalfa was a well-kept secret until its live-fire test against Clan Wolf where it saw great success. At first confusing the Wolves as to what it was -- too small to be a '机甲, too large to be a Proto or battle 装甲 -- the defending Wolf warriors were forced into deploying medium and heavy '机甲s to deal with even a single Svartalfa. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.986
column2: 最初传闻斯瓦特阿尔法是一种轻型或超轻型陆空两用机甲，这个秘密一直被牢牢保守，直到在对阵狼氏族时进行了实弹测试并大获成功. 起初狼氏族搞不清它究竟是什么——太小不像是机甲，太大又不像是原型机甲或战斗装甲——防守的狼氏族战士被迫派出中型和重型机甲来对付哪怕只有一台的斯瓦特阿尔法. 特质: 坚韧 部署费用倍率: 0.986

column1: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton 全向mech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an 内骨骼复合结构, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER 中型激光s hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-OB is armed with a pair of ER PPC’s and a RAC/5; all of which are Clan spec. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 为共和国武装部队在3121年设计的Doloire，是一款80吨级万能机甲，融合了氏族科技与内天体科技. 该机甲采用320等级氏族XL引擎与内复合材料结构，拥有32吨的模块化装备容量，在机甲中央躯干部位固定搭载有一对氏族中型增程激光. Doloire DLR-OB型号则配备了两台增程粒子加农炮与一门RAC/5火炮，均为氏族规格. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column2: Valois星系在星际联盟时代得到殖民，直到第三次继承战争期间被废弃. 几个世纪前，一支战斗机甲师为了使其目标免遭核毁灭而牺牲，因而赢得了“阿拉莫师”的称号.

column1: Balkan was always listed in early Lyran charts as "Marginally Habitable".  When the Combine captured it during the 3rd succession war, they soon discovered what a drain on resources it was, and abandoned it shortly thereafter.
column2: Balkan在早期的天琴星图中一直被列为“勉强宜居”. 当天龙联合体在第三次继承战争期间夺取它时，他们很快发现它有多么消耗资源，并在此后不久放弃了它.

column1: The Flawless FLW-3C fits not only the experimental Ion Cannon, but also three Large and four 中型激光s. To keep the heat in check a total of 25 double heat sinks are used but even so the design is not fully heat neutral. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 完美型 FLW-3C 不仅配备了实验性离子炮，还装备了三门大型激光和四门中型激光. 为了控制热量，总共使用了25个双散热器，但即便如此，该设计仍不是完全热中性的. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.32 手臂驱动器限制: 右侧下部

column1: A soft hum echoes through the Argo's bridge as the transmission from Galaxy Commander Gurdel fades to static. No follow-up. No closure. Just silence. The crew drifts in uneasy reflection. No more Watch contracts. No more battle orders. The Armageddon prototype is gone, but so is Arelle. No message. No signal. No trace. Somewhere in the void, "Mizuki Bekker" still watches, her words echoing like a ghost: "You can maybe stop it, but you can't stop the others." But who, or what, are 'the others'? And if the Tribe lost its greatest weapon… what could they possibly be planning next? Across the Deep Periphery, systems once swarming with Tribe activity fall silent. No strikes. No transmissions. Just quiet. Too quiet. You know they are still out there, preparing. As the Argo charts a slow course back to civilized space, one question lingers in every mind aboard: Was this a victory… or just the opening act? What happened to Arelle Jorgensson? What is Mizuki Bekker's next move? Is the 明尼苏达部落 truly broken, or simply regrouping for something worse? Is this really over?

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for a low altitude circuit of the moon, relaying her findings back to the Argo's computers. Over the course of the week she works with the collected data, then delivers her report.\\n\\n"Commander, the scientists I've been talking with are really excited about the data we've acquired. Apparently, it contains proof of a rare ore of scholastic interest." She shrugs. "Not my wheelhouse. In any case, I've negotiated an excellent price for the full scans, so everybody can celebrate."
column2: 堇带着 Leopard 进行了月球低空环游，将她的发现传回 Argo 的计算机。 在一周的时间里，她处理收集到的数据，然后提交报告。\\n\\n“指挥官，与我交谈的科学家们对我们获得的数据非常兴奋。显然，它包含了学术界感兴趣的稀有矿石的证据。”她耸耸肩。 “不是我的驾驶室。无论如何，我已经为全面扫描协商了一个优惠的价格，所以每个人都可以庆祝。”

column1: The Stormbird was commissioned by 玉鹰氏族 and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and 雪鸦氏族 science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. For the Snow Ravens however, the Stormbird proved to be an immense success providing them with fire-resistant armor that had thus far proved impossible to produce. 特性：鼓舞人心之姿 部署成本倍率：0.935 Can mount any unit, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 暴风鸟由玉鹰氏族委托研发，旨在填补现役元素与铁堡战斗装甲之间的空缺，是猎鹰资源与雪鸦氏族科学力量合作的产物. 暴风鸟预想中的反步兵定位引起了雪鸦氏族的兴趣，他们希望获得一种尺寸相近、战斗定位类似的战斗装甲. 最终成果并未达到猎鹰期望的多功能平台，其设计高度接近已列装的火焰蜥型. 然而对雪鸦而言，暴风鸟却取得了巨大成功，为他们提供了此前一直无法生产的防火装甲. 特质: 鼓舞人心的外观 部署费用倍率: 0.935 可搭乘任何单位，可近战，但不能攀附.

column1: 这是天琴联盟的凯撒·施泰纳将军的座机，他是 Furilo 公爵，也是边疆伯爵 Iris Steiner 之子。该机甲的正式编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称之为“Dämmerung（黄昏）”。凭借先进的XL引擎，它搭载了庞大的武器阵列。利用节省下来的重量，曾位于前臂的中型激光被替换为大型脉冲激光，悬挂安装在前臂下方。鉴于高斯步枪被视为大口径弹道武器的下一步演进，大公要求以一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代 Atlas 的 AC/20。SRM弹药仓被完全拆除，LRM弹药仓也缩小，以便沿机甲中线安装一门ER大型激光，而髋部安装的中型激光则使武器库更为完整。如此广泛的武器配置，使该设计在任何距离上都能发挥其大部分武器的威力\\n\\n特性：战斗铁拳\\n\\n投放费用倍率：1.2

column2: “十字锯（Crosscut）”是广受欢迎的伐木机甲，因其在林地环境中的高效作业能力而备受赞誉，在商业林业领域占据主导地位. X5M是对X2M的轻微改进，因为它同时升级了引擎和武器. 对于那些不得不驾驶伐木机甲投入战斗的倒霉蛋来说，这门炮尤其受欢迎，因为新的轻型AC/2让他们的工业装甲能够在远离战斗的位置进行支援. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 0.72 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

The Argo has suffered major damage to a number of the propulsion systems and some of them are quite rare, especially considering where we are." You toss the datapad onto your desk, "And if we opt to NOT do the repairs?" "Darius, I know you're trying to help us make ends meet here, but I don't want to go back to how things were."\\n\\nYou grab a berry from Darius's basket and pop it into your mouth. column2: 这款定制版的“索拉里斯”变体于3128年在诺瓦西耶首次亮相，最初由娜塔莉亚·波特驾驶，随后由其女卡罗琳·费舍尔接手，这型克林特 IIC升级版彻底颠覆了氏族改装内天体机型的常规思路. 基于氏族制造的机体框架，该变体移除了跳跃喷口以更换武器配置. 它保留了两门氏族中型增程激光，同时将氏族LB 10-X霰弹炮替换为一门大型变速脉冲激光与一门中型再设计激光，并全部搭载至氏族目标定位计算机联动. 标准复合装甲亦被替换为防弹强化装甲. 特质: 变距瞄准系统 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: Sargeant Devin Chaste, callsign "Bugaboo", woke up one day in his barracks and realized he had grown weary of leading brash, young MechWarriors to their doom under the uncaring gaze of his commanding officer in the Steiner army. After finally receiving his discharge paperwork for a decorated career in service, he used his connections, along with his pension, to escape into mercenary life. Bugaboo has since proven himself a respectable addition to any mercenary company looking for a lance leader capable of coordinating tactical alpha strikes to the his employer's enemies.\\n\\n
column2: 德文·查斯特中士（呼号“Bugaboo”）有一天在军营中醒来，意识到自己已经厌倦了在施泰纳军队指挥官漠不关心的目光下带领傲慢的年轻机甲战士走向灭亡。在最终收到光荣服役生涯的退役文件后，他利用自己的关系和养老金，逃入了雇佣兵生活。自此，Bugaboo 证明了自己是任何雇佣兵公司中值得尊敬的新成员，他们正在寻找一位能够协调对雇主的敌人进行战术性阿尔法打击的长矛领袖。\\n\\n

column1: Not designed for traditional combat, the Carrier is a force multiplier. Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of armor isn't a concern. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 90 30 左侧 90 30 右侧 90 30 后方 65 30 炮塔 65 30 总计 400 150 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 运输车并非为传统战斗而设计，它是一种战力倍增器。它被设计为从远处支援友军，可以退居友方阵线之后，在那里它缺乏装甲的弱点便不成问题。生态限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 100 30 左侧 100 30 右侧 100 30 后方 100 30 总计 400 120 特性：狭小/低矮外形

column1: The -2E was trialed as a medium range juggernaut, using an all energy loadout of four 短管PPC and four 大型脉冲激光s. A single head mounted Small Laser provide anti-infantry defenses. The Pulse Lasers are mounted with 激光绝缘体s, lowering their heat generation considerably. Quirk: 超重型原型 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.39
column2: -2E型曾作为中距离突击机甲进行测试，采用全能量武器配置，装备四门短管粒子加农炮和四门大型脉冲激光. 头部安装的一门小型激光用于反步兵防御. 脉冲激光均配备激光绝缘体，显著降低其发热量. 特质: 超重型原型机 部署费用倍率: 1.39

column1: 降世神 G 是专职机甲杀手，每臂各携带一门高斯步枪，配两吨弹药。 Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: X配置将左臂的一门TSEMP加农炮与六门中型增程激光相结合. 总共八个双散热器帮助冷却机甲. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: A peculiar fusion of design philosophies, the Stealth Engine developed by 明尼苏达部落 engineers directly ties the signature reduction properties of the 虚无信号系统 into an engine core. Despite incorporating some weight saving technologies, the added sinks, baffles, and conduits make up for any savings that could be had. These engines are favored over a NSS for their ability to vent extra heat when not active.
column2: A peculiar fusion of design philosophies, the Stealth Engine developed by Minnesota Tribe engineers directly ties the signature reduction properties of the Null Signature System into an engine core. Despite incorporating some weight saving technologies, the added sinks, baffles, and conduits make up for any savings that could be had. These engines are favored over a NSS for their ability to vent extra heat when not active.

column1: Developed and commissioned New Hessen 机甲Works during the Jihad, the 1A used primitive and obsolete components to produce a RetroTech success story. Mounting primitive 装甲, a 200 primitive engine, jump jets, and a standard chassis, the 1A carried weaponry that was modern if not cutting edge: a PPC for long range combat, supported by six medium lasers, two of which are rear-mounted, and a small laser. Fourteen single heat sinks required fire discipline from its 机甲Warrior. The top speed was a substandard 54 km/h. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.83
column2: 新赫森机甲工坊在圣战期间开发并列装部队的1A型号，运用原始而老旧的部件谱写了复古科技的成功篇章. 这款机甲配备原始装甲、200型原始引擎、跳跃推进器与标准骨架，搭载的武器系统即使不算尖端也称得上现代: 一门用于远程作战的粒子加农炮，辅以六门中型激光，其中两门后向安装，外加一门小型激光. 十四具单散热器要求驾驶它的机甲战士严格掌控开火节奏. 其最高时速仅为不合格的54公里/时. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 0.83

column1: Jointly 开发 by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the customised Gunslinger 1ERD-Jared is armed with a pair of LRM-15’s. 4 中型激光s, a pair of 锁定式SRM-4’s and a Small Laser add additional firepower at close ranges. A 守护者ECM Suite and a 比格犬主动探头 enhance the 机甲s capabilities. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由联邦共同体与天龙联合体共同开发的85吨级“枪手”于3053年投入生产. 这台定制型枪手1ERD-Jared搭载一台255级超轻型引擎，配备一对LRM-15. 4门中型激光、一对锁定式SRM-4和一门小型激光为近距离提供额外火力. 守护者电子对抗套件与小猎犬主动探测器进一步强化了机甲的作战能力. 特质: 整流罩 部署费用倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: You shake your head. "Not this time, Yang. Unfortunately, we can't spare the resources, despite the AgroMechs." Yang sighs. He lets the argument drop, but spends a few days wistfully looking at Technical Readouts with his crew.
column2: 你摇了摇头.“这次不行，杨. 虽然那些农业机甲挺诱人的，但我们眼下实在腾不出资源.”杨叹了口气. 他没再争辩，但接下来好几天，他总跟手下的技术员们一起翻着各种技术参数图册，眼神里全是心驰神往.

column1: With the B configuration the Sojourner gets more of a support role, carrying an ECM suite and 2 ER Large Pulse lasers combined with a single 锁定式SRM-6. Four Jump Jets together with a Supercharger ensures the mobility of the configuration. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 在B型配置中，旅居者更多地承担支援角色，搭载了一套电子对抗系统、两门大型增程脉冲激光以及一门改进型锁定式SRM-6. 四台跳跃推进器搭配超级增压器确保了该配置的机动性. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: First appearing in 3056, the Palisade Defense Tank is a 60-ton defensive 坦克 found throughout the wealthier parts of the Periphery. Based on an older 坦克 设计 dating back to the Succession Wars, the Palisade is 设计ed as a multi-role 坦克 capable of engaging 机甲s or Vehicles. Capable of speeds of 60 km/h, the Palisade (Upgrade) is powered by a 240-rated Fuel Cell and carries 11.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous 装甲. The main gun is an LB-10X, with an LRM-15 supporting this at longer ranges. An MG provides some limited anti-infantry capabilities and CASE mitigates crew danger should an ammo explosion happen. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. 装甲: Ferro-Fibrous 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 250 30 左侧 200 30 右侧 200 30 后方 190 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 1040 150 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 首次出现在3056年的Palisade防御坦克是一种60吨的防御坦克  遍布于边陲星域的富裕地区. 基于可追溯至继承战争的旧坦克设计  Palisade被设计为一种能够对抗机甲或车辆的多用途坦克. Palisade（升级版）的速度可达60公里/小时  由240级燃料电池驱动  并携带11.5吨的铁纤维装甲. 主炮是一门LB-10X  LRM-15在更远距离上提供支援. 一挺机枪提供有限的反步兵能力  而CASE在发生弹药爆炸时减轻乘员危险. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 250 30 左侧 200 30 右侧 200 30 后方 190 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 1040 150 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x LBX AC/10 1x LRM-15 1x Blackwell机枪

column1: 步枪兵的第一个量产版本重五十吨，采用原始技术。每条手臂各装一门大型激光与一门中型激光。它由十一吨半的原始装甲防护，并使用原始引擎，最高时速达到 64 公里/小时。虽然该版本步枪兵曾在统一战争中服役，但此后通常装备民兵与二线部队。 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Dreka 1S原型机专为展示两门巨大的“Defiance Hammerfist”重型高斯步枪而设计，同时也是日后演变为Fafnir的测试平台. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.2 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: In an attempt to make the Onryo cheaper, the X2 variant design drops the C.A.S.E. and 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控, instead adding a Medium and a Small Laser. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: In an attempt to make the Onryo cheaper, the X2 variant design drops the C.A.S.E. and Artemis IV FCS, instead adding a Medium and a Small Laser. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

column1: Darius mentions that the ship's galley 是low on provisions at the daily brief在g. "We need 以 make a supply run, but the question 是when? Putt在g the crew on reduced rations could w或k 在 the sh或t term if th在gs 是以o tight." Everybody else at the brief在g groans as they look at you.
column2: 达吕斯在每日简报中提到，船上厨房的补给已经所剩不多.“我们需要进行一次补给采购，但问题是什么时候去? 如果情况实在紧张，短期内让船员降低配给标准也许可以应付.”会议中的所有其他参与者都看着你，发出一阵抱怨声.

column1: 该Y在 是an experimental Rotary PPC, capable 的 fir在g one, two 或 three shots. To not overload the circuitry 的 the 'Mech when fir在g 在 the multi-shot modes, the Rotary PPC pre-loads a large amount 的 capacit或s 配备 the energy needed. As a result the Y在 是a very large 武器 that can only be mounted on superheavy 'Mechs.
column2: 【Yin Rotary PPC】Yin是一种实验型转管PPC  可发射一发、两发或三发射击. 为了避免机甲在多重射击模式下开火时使电路过载  转管PPC会预先为大量电容器充入所需的能量. 因此  Yin是一种体积非常庞大的武器  只能安装在超重型机甲上.

column1: 一阵通讯提示音把你吵醒。达里乌斯有一条来自星球表面的信息。“您不会相信的，指挥官。是阿雅莎·哈德利。” “{COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官！上次那样收场，我心里很过意不去，不过没什么芥蒂，对吧？我真的不想进监狱。” 见你面无表情，她继续说：“我喜欢您，指挥官。您一定知道。所以我非得把这个对我们双方都有利的机会带给您不可。” 她像是得到了你的同意一样继续往下说：“您的雇员里有一名机甲战士，呼号是 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:He's|Female:She's|NonBinary:They're} 和一位戴维恩官员长得一模一样——那位官员有权进入我非常想进去看看的迈德隆研究设施。” “把 {TGT_MW.OBJ} 借我几周。只要您配合，我会把在里面找到的东西分您一份。怎么样？合作愉快？”
column2: 这是个小小的举动，但即使是一点点关注也会有所帮助. 很快，船员们就纷纷提出请求，希望获得来自外围和内天体各星系的书籍和期刊.\n\n[[SCN_MW{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]甚至捐出了一套个人收藏的芯片，是{SCN_MW.Det}自被雇佣以来一直随身携带的.

column1: The defense of Star Cluster 752 continues. You have to choose the next contract to attempt, only once all three are finished is the defense successful.
column2: 星团752 的防御仍在继续. 你必须选择下一份合约执行，只有三份都完成后，防御行动才算成功.

column1: Despite the Wolf Trap no longer being 生产, Luthien 装甲 Works authorized an upgrade program during the Jihad at their new plant on Abiy Adi. Though the Wolf Trap is unpopular, there were storehouses that abounded with the discarded '机甲, giving the DCMS an upgraded machine in desperate times. The autocannon is replaced with a plasma rifle, while the missile launcher is upgraded to an MML 9. These changes give the -2 increased flexibility at the cost of range. It also upgrades the lasers to ER medium lasers and adds a third. In addition, three light machine guns are added and linked in a machine gun array. Finally, the heat sinks are upgraded to doubles and 装甲 is redistributed. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Upper
column2: 尽管狼阱机甲已停产，但卢西恩装甲厂在圣战期间授权其位于阿比阿迪的新工厂实施升级改造计划. 虽然狼阱机甲并不受欢迎，但仓库中仍堆积着大量被弃置的该型机甲，这使天龙联合军在危急时刻得以获得升级机型. 其自动炮被替换为等离子步枪，导弹发射器升级为MML-9型，这些改动以牺牲射程为代价提升了-2型的作战灵活性. 该机型还将普通激光升级为中型增程激光并增设第三门，同时加装三挺联入机枪阵列的轻机枪. 最终，散热系统升级为双散热器，装甲布局亦经重新调配. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 右上臂

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth M is armed with an LRM-15 and 4 ER Small Lasers. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.98
column2: 由一台200额定XL引擎驱动并搭载MASC系统，这台20吨重的火蛾是有史以来速度最快的机甲之一. 火蛾专为侦察和元素装甲兵运输而设计，于2874年投入生产. 结合铁纤维装甲和钢内骨结构，火蛾拥有7.5吨的挂载空间. 火蛾M型配备了一具LRM-15型远程导弹发射器和4门小型增程激光. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.98

column1: The -5D mounts an optimized M9 Gauss Rifle in addition the four fixed Rotary LRM launchers. This change from the -5B was introduced to handle larger enemy 'Mechs and heavily armed vehicles. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.33 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -5D 搭载了一门优化的 M9 高斯步枪，外加四具固定式转管 LRM 发射器. 这一从 -5B 型变体引入的改动，旨在应对更大型的敌方机甲与重装甲车辆. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.33 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for a low altitude circuit of the moon, relaying her findings back to the Argo's computers. Over the course of the week she works with the collected data, then delivers her report.\\n\\n"Commander, we aren't the only ones who were curious about this moon. I identified an abandoned facility, completely destroyed and then buried. Whoever it was, I wonder what they were doing."
column2: 堇带着 Leopard 进行了月球低空环游，将她的发现传回 Argo 的计算机。在这一周的时间里，她处理收集到的数据，然后提交报告。\\n\\n“指挥官，我们并不是唯一对这颗卫星感到好奇的人。我发现了一个废弃的设施，被完全摧毁，然后被掩埋。无论是谁，我想知道他们在做什么。”

column1: A further adaptation of the Hardened Ferro-Fibrous armor by RISC, manage to increase the armor thickness even further at just a small increase in weight by using a special alloy of Ferro-Fibrous material and a extremely rare metal known has Wavehandium. However, due to the extensive space needs only superheavy 'Mechs can mount it and the exotic material can release energy outwards vigorously during a rapid expansion in volume upon heavy damage.
column2: 【Superheavy Ferro-Alloy】这是RISC对硬化铁纤维装甲的进一步改进版本，采用铁纤维材料与一种名为Wavehandium的极稀有金属制成的特殊合金，仅增加少量重量便进一步提升了装甲厚度. 然而，由于占用空间极大，只有超重型机甲才能安装. 此外，这种奇异材料在遭受重创时会迅速膨胀，并向外猛烈释放能量.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. After heating up for most of the day, the warm sand increases heat by an additional 4 per turn.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 经过大半天的高温炙烤，滚烫的沙地每回合额外增加 4 点热量.

column1: A Star League era fire support platform, the 长bow is an 85 ton Assault 机甲 and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence. The LGB-12R is armed with a quartet of LRM-15 launchers, supported by a ER Large Laser and an ER Medium. A 255-rated 轻型引擎, DHS and 14 tons of armor round out the design. Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 星际联盟时代的火力支援平台，长弓是一款85吨级突击机甲，也是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一. LGB-12R型配备了四具LRM-15发射器，并辅以一门大型增程激光和一门中型增程激光. 255型轻量化引擎、双散热系统与14吨装甲共同构成了该机型的设计基础. 特质: 防空瞄准系统 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Named for an ancient Nordic kenning meaning wave-swine, the Unnsvin was designed from the ground up to carry 战斗装甲 into combat. Equipped with a large specialized battle armor bay capable of carrying two full squads, the Unnsvin is the ideal design for carrying BA. It is decently fast and moderately well armored, ensuring the BA reach their destination in good time and shape. The one weakness of the Unnsvin is that its personal armament is weak and it is not a very capable combat unit in its own right. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. column1: A Capellan variant of the Ebony introduced in 3081, this one swaps out its snub-nose PPC for an ER large laser, while also arming it with a dao-style sword in its left arm. The MEB-10 was given additional armor to round out its improvements. 特性：瞄准增强—中程 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 这是黑木机甲在3081年推出的一个卡佩拉变种型号，它将原先的短管粒子加农炮替换为一门大型增程激光，并在左臂配备了一把道式剑. MEB-10型号还增加了额外装甲，以完善整体改进. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: 战线守护者是克雷斯利兵工厂出品的第一款战斗机甲设计。它围绕一套"机甲设计常识规则"构建。这一思路造就了一台地面速度良好、装甲与火力都相当可观的机甲。它最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，除最快的轻中型机甲外都能跟上。战线守护者还携带十吨装甲防护并有十四台散热器。它采用的现货武器与装备组合使其成为易于修理、作战可靠的机甲。然而其终极卖点——尤其对小型单位与末等贵族这类目标客户——是性价比。在销售第一年，战线守护者的业绩与其他 55 吨战斗机甲相比堪称历史性成功。对买得起全新战斗机甲的小势力而言，它已成为驻防机型的首选。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Bushwacker S2c是一款前线机型，将其反导弹系统（AMS）升级为主动防护系统（APD），并搭配电子对抗系统（ECM），为单位提供高级掩护. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The Z variant  is a Society refit that replaces the engine with a 200SL engine and replaces the weapons payload with 6 Small Supra Lasers and a Nova CEWS.
column2: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产和运营成本而成为内层界最知名的战机之一，在氏族中也广为人知。 2832 年，猫鼬氏族释放了古老的氏族机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。 Z 变体是协会改装的，将发动机替换为 200SL 发动机，并将武器有效载荷替换为 6 个小型 Supra 激光器和一个 Nova CEWS。

column1: Limited to three chassis, this Banshee model was a thought experiment by 迪法恩斯工业 engineers at Kwangjong-ni. Seeking to maximize protection, these engineers installed 装甲ed Shoulder and 装甲ed Hip actuators to prevent the '机甲 from losing a limb. The 机甲Warrior is protected by an 装甲ed Cockpit. They also maximized protection by adding a ton of Modular 装甲 to each arm, leg, and forward torso. To make room for this equipment, they used an Endo Steel chassis and a Clan-spec XL Engine. For weapons, the engineers installed a 银弹高斯 Rifle and a pair of 浮夸激光s, while an ER Small Laser fills the head as an afterthought. Though not particularly quick (max speed 54 km/h) this Banshee variant can take massive amounts of damage before it falls. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.19
column2: 该型号限制使用三种机体，是反抗工业公司光州尼工厂的工程师们进行的一次思想实验. 为了追求最大化防护，这些工程师安装了装甲肩部驱动器和装甲髋部驱动器，以防止机甲失去肢体. 机甲战士由一座装甲驾驶舱保护. 他们还通过为每条手臂、腿部和前躯干各增加一吨模块化装甲来进一步强化防护. 为腾出空间容纳这些设备，他们使用了钢内骨结构和氏族规格的XL引擎. 武器方面，工程师安装了一门银弹高斯步枪和一对夸示激光，而一门小型增程激光则作为事后填补，安装在头部. 尽管速度不算快（最大时速54公里），这款女妖变体在倒下前能够承受巨额伤害. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.19

column1: After 氏族地狱马 forces' invaded the 蛇夫座自治领 during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. The Mastodon's performance after its introduction makes it inevitable that it will be at the forefront of many campaigns to come. The heavily reinforced structure resists both weapons fire and the standard wear and tear that accompanies most campaigns. The C configuration tends to overheat easily due to its four ER 中型激光s, three 等离子炮s and ER PPC. The 'Mech also sports a Gauss Rifle for longer range engagements. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

The MAD-BR-O is armed with a pair of Clan ER PPC’s, a pair of Clan ER 中型激光s and a Clan HAG/30. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
