column1: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike '机甲 that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the 球体共和国. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A 比格犬主动探头 allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while Stealth 装甲 and a 守护者ECM Suite allows the '机甲 to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins.Another variant introduced in 3133 removes the SRM-6 rack from the standard Dark Age Ghost and replaces it with a Chainsaw to minimize logistical needs, or potentially to disguise it as an Industrial机甲. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: 幽灵机甲是在圣战后期作为“狮鹫（Griffin）”机甲的补充而开发的，是一款中型打击机甲，在球体共和国建立后的数年间得到了广泛使用. 它由天琴共同体和前自由世界联盟的残余势力共同研发，在战斗中配备了大量电子战设备. 猎犬主动探测器让幽灵机甲能够发现敌方单位，而潜行装甲和守护者电子对抗系统则赋予其名副其实的隐蔽能力. 凭借出色的地面速度和强大的中程武器，幽灵机甲非常适合猎杀和重装突击任务，尤其与狮鹫机甲协同作战时效果更佳. 另一款在3133年推出的变体移除了标准暗黑时代幽灵机甲的SRM-6导弹架，换用电锯以降低后勤需求，或有可能将其伪装成工业机甲. 特质: 改良感应器 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: Normally I'd say that the Royal BattleMaster is about as quintessential a BattleMech as you'll ever see. Guess the Clans didn't see it that way and felt they could improve on it. Well ... they tried, I suppose. This thing'd run hot as hell if not for all this extra gear, but I suppose they were limited on space, too. This baby is crammed to the gills.
column2: 通常我会说皇家战斗大师是您所见过的最典型的战斗机甲。我想族群并不这么认为，并认为他们可以改进。嗯……我想他们尝试过。如果没有这些额外的装备，这东西会热得要命，但我想它们的空间也有限。这个宝贝是crammed到腮帮子的。

The tank shares a name with the ancient SLDF 神射手自行火炮, a fact the RAF anticipates being able to exploit against opponents. Unlike the older vehicle, this vehicle was created as a main battle tank for the 球体共和国. Introduced during the Dark Age, the Marksman M1J is armed like the standard Marksman M1, but upgrades the MRM-10s for MRM-20s, and slightly increases armor. column1: Recently taken from the Combine, Asta is a world that refuses to die, in spite of being ravaged by WMD in the days of the Amaris Empire, and being a battleground recently.  It is a highly agrarian "breadbasket" planet.
column2: Asta最近刚从联合体手中被夺取，它是一个拒绝死亡的世界，尽管在阿马里斯帝国时期曾遭到大规模杀伤性武器的揉躏，并且最近还成为了战场. 它是一颗高度农业化的“粮仓”行星.

Originally developed to rapidly relocate heavy armor under battlefield conditions, the design has since spawned a host of imitators and copy cats with almost every developed world in the Inner Sphere and the Periphery possessing at least one Igor or Igor derived clone. An FWL combat model of the 60 ton VTOL, the Igor (L-Gauss) mounts a pair of 轻型高斯步枪s and a C3 Slave unit, complemented by three tons of additional ordnance on the wings. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 175 30 左侧 125 30 右侧 125 30 后方 100 30 总计 550 150 特性：坚固

column1: In the morning briefing, Darius presents an unexpected opportunity. "[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s family has informed us that their grand-matriarch is getting married again. They've requested {TGT_MW.Callsign} be given leave to attend the ceremony on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} would be gone for a month, but the family is willing to compensate us to the tune of ¢50,000."
column2: 晨间简报时，达里乌斯提出一个意外的机会。“[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]的家族通知我们，他们的女族长又要结婚了。他们请求准予{TGT_MW.Callsign}休假前往{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}参加仪式。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}会离开一个月，但家族愿意补偿我们5万C币。“

column1:
You and Darius are networking in a planetside bar. As Darius fetches the first round, you overhear the too-loud whispers from a nearby table. "I'm telling you, those two are MechWarriors!" 

A hissed response: "What would you know? It's not like on the Holovids."

Out of the corner your eye, you scan the group, and it's like you're gazing into your own past. Three young nobles casually stare in your direction, pampered and comfortable. Written all over their eager faces is a feeling you remember too well: looking for an escape from their safe, predictable lives.
column2:
你和达吕斯正在行星地表的一家酒吧里拓展人脉. 趁达吕斯去拿第一轮酒时，你无意间听到了邻桌过于大声的悄悄话.“我告诉你，那俩绝对是机甲战士！”

紧接着是一声压低了嗓门的反驳:“你知道什么? 这跟全息剧里演的可不一样.”

你用眼角的余光扫过那群人，仿佛瞬间望进了自己的过往. 三个养尊处优、舒适安逸的年轻贵族，正漫不经心地朝你这边张望. 他们热切的脸庞上写满了一种你太过熟悉的心情: 渴望着从安全而乏味的人生中逃离.

column1: The population of Borghese was self-sustaining, providing its own food crops and famed for its exotic fish export known as the "mermaid" fish. The planet's capital was named Houston, which was also its largest city.
column2: Borghese的人口自给自足，自行种植粮食作物，并因出口一种名为“美人鱼”的奇异鱼类而闻名. 该行星的首府名为休斯顿，同时也是其最大的城市.

column1: The 5R variant was created by the Taurian Concordat with assistance from 布雷克圣言会. This upgrade of the Stinger used three tons of Durallex Light Ferro-Fibrous 装甲, carried a 多元光学 ER medium laser in the right arm and two Death Blossom RL-15s split between the side torsos. Perhaps the most important change, as far as pilot comfort was concerned, was replacing the cramped cockpit with a new head assembly which included a Full-Head Ejection System. The chassis and electronics remained unchanged so that refits of existing Stingers could be carried out in a matter of months. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 0.97
column2: 5R型号由金牛协约国在布雷克圣言会的协助下打造. 这款“蜂鸟”的升级型号配备了三吨杜拉莱斯轻型铁纤维装甲，右臂搭载一门Diverse Optics中型增程激光，两具“死亡之花”RL-15型火箭发射器分置于左右躯干. 对机师舒适度而言最重要的改进，是将狭小的驾驶舱替换为包含全头式弹射系统的新型头部组件. 底盘与电子系统维持原状，因此对现有蜂鸟机甲的改装仅需数月即可完成. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 0.97

column1: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a 中型激光, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental 短管PPC, 比格犬主动探头, and an additional half ton of armor. Quirk: 陆空两用机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 该版本在PHX-HK2于2695年推出之前设计完成. 它移除了大型增程激光、一具中型激光和两个散热器，替换为一门试验型短管粒子加农炮、一个“猎犬”主动探测器，以及额外半吨装甲. 特质: 陆空两用机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.06

column1: Designed by Fredonian Industrial Technologies, the Anubis was originally designed to compliment the Osiris BattleMech in use by the Federated Suns. The 'Mech's lightweight chassis carries a powerful Ceres Motors 250 XL engine that gives the Anubis a top speed of 129.6 km/h and is covered in a protective skin of Hellespont Lite 隐身装甲, making the Anubis extremely hard to hit at long range. The MC variant of the Anubis uses twin ER 中型激光s and twin 增强型LRM-5 launchers for its offensive firepower. An experimental Angel ECM Suite powers the stealth armor and disrupts enemy electronics. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：1.01
column2: 阿努比斯机甲由弗雷多尼亚工业技术公司设计，最初旨在为恒星联邦使用的奥西里斯战斗装甲提供补充. 这款机甲采用轻型骨架，搭载强劲的赛瑞斯动力250型超轻型引擎，使其最高时速可达129.6公里，并覆盖一层赫勒斯滂轻量型潜行装甲作为防护外壳，使阿努比斯极难被远程火力命中. MC型号的阿努比斯以两门中型增程激光和两具增强型远程导弹5联装发射器构成主要攻击火力，并配备实验型天使电子对抗系统为潜行装甲供能并干扰敌方电子设备. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 1.01

column1: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. Techs removed the standard weaponry from a Marauder and replaced the arm mounted weapons with a 二元激光 Cannon in each arm, while the torso mounted autocannon was replaced by twin SRM-6 launchers backed by one ton of ammunition. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype 双散热器. Quirk: 超伸展驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 该实验型号于3039年在罗宁公司位于沃利斯的工厂制造. 技术人员移除了劫掠者机甲的标准武装，将双臂武器替换为各一门二元激光，躯干部分的自动炮则被两具SRM-6导弹发射器取代，备弹一吨. 劫掠者-4X的另一个显著特点是采用了原型钢内骨结构. 为控制热量，技术人员为其配备了十二具标准散热器和六具原型双联散热器. 特质: 超伸展型驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. An experiment in logistical support, the Zeus 6Y retains the AC/5, but downgrades the LRM15 to a LRM10. This allowed for the Large Laser to be 'upgraded' to a 二元激光 Cannon. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯机甲最初由天琴共同体于2787年首次继承战争爆发之际建造. 应联邦武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的需求而生，宙斯机甲的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，并具备同等击败它们的能力. 作为后勤支援方面的试验型号，宙斯6Y保留了AC/5自动炮，但将LRM15导弹发射器降级为LRM10，从而将大型激光'升级'为双管激光. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: 火神装甲轻薄，仅五吨，不过面对步兵部队时通常够用，其狭窄轮廓也使它更难被击中。64.8 公里/小时的巡航速度由六具装在火神躯干后部的跳跃推进器增强，这些喷射器经特殊排气设计以减少后部积热，赋予它 180 米的跳跃距离。 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: WTH-1的简单改装，将其跳跃推进器替换为一台C3从机和为LRM弹药提供的C.A.S.E.防护. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. Using a pair of 二元激光 Cannons mated to an advanced 瞄准计算机, this configuration of the Deva is a deadly sniper. For close in protection the Caelestis mounts an ER Small Laser. A 激光反导系统 defends against warheads, while a Supercharger allows it to temporarily boost its speed to nearly 84 km/h. Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为布雷克圣言会圣体系列的又一款万能机甲，提婆（名称源自印度教信仰中的天人）同样大量采用了新技术. 该机体搭载了轻型核融合引擎、耐久度较标准型号提升五成的重型陀螺仪，并配备了圣体系列通用的小型驾驶舱. 通过将两门双管雷射炮与先进瞄准计算机组合配置，这款提婆机甲堪称致命狙击手. 其近身防御则依靠天体系列专属的小型增程激光，雷射反飞弹系统提供全方位防护，而超级增压器可让机体瞬时加速至近84公里/小时的冲刺速度. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Cephalus was developed by The Society as an escort unit for their Septicemia series 全向Mech. This light 'Mech was designed to carry the 诺瓦综合电子战系统 (CEWS) onto the battlefield. To insure that the Cephalus would survive, the designers used a 250-rated XXL Engine alongside a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. As its role is limited to electronic targeting support and occasional reconnaissance, the Cephalus wasn't often equipped with weaponry. The primary configuration of the Cephalus carried twin Laser AMS systems, one in each side torso. To further protect the 'Mech, it mounted three 模块化装甲 units on the front torsos. 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 头足纲机甲由秘社开发，作为其败血症系列万能机甲的护航单位. 这款轻型机甲的设计目的是将新星综合电子战系统投入战场. 为确保头足纲机甲的生存能力，设计师为其配备了250级XXL引擎与变色龙光学偏转护盾. 由于它的职责仅限于电子瞄准支援与间歇性侦察任务，头足纲机甲通常不配备武器系统. 其主战配置在左右躯干部各装有一台激光反导系统，为进一步强化防护，前躯干还加装了三套模块化装甲单元. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.01 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series 全向Mechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. The Invictus model makes good use of its C3i Computer with a Gauss Rifle and a trio of Light PPCs. Obviously meant as a direct-fire support model, the inclusion of the 可伸缩刀刃 is somewhat confusing to outsiders, as is the paltry ton of ammunition devoted to the design's main gun. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 德瓦机甲是布雷克圣言会天体系列的另一款万能机甲（其名称源自印度教信仰体系中的天人），同样大量运用了新型技术. 该机型采用轻型聚变引擎，搭载了抗损能力比标准型号强出一半的重型陀螺仪，并配备了天体系共有的小型驾驶舱. 无敌构型充分发挥了C3i计算机的效能，装备一门高斯步枪与三门轻型粒子加农炮. 虽然该机型明显定位为直射火力支援单位，但加装可收放刀刃的设计让外界颇感困惑，而为其主炮仅配备一吨弹药的配置更令人费解. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

Manufactured primarily at the Corean Enterprises' site on New Avalon and weighing in at 50 tons, the Centurion mounted a Magna 250 XL engine, allowing it to run at 86 km/h, and mounts nine and a half tons of standard armor. With ten fixed double heat sinks, the Centurion has 24 tons of pod space available, almost half the total weight of the 'Mech, and the most common variants of the Centurion echo the various variants of the original Centurion BattleMech developed over the centuries. 特性：Yen Lo Wang 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: “百夫长（Centurion）”万能机甲源于柯瑞安企业拓展市场份额的意愿. 这款50吨级机甲主要由柯瑞安设在新阿瓦隆的工厂生产，搭载麦格纳250超轻型引擎，时速可达86公里，并配备九吨半标准装甲. 通过十具固定式双联散热器，百夫长拥有24吨武器挂载空间——几乎达到机体总重的一半. 其最常见的衍生型号延续了数个世纪以来原始百夫长战斗机甲各型变体的发展脉络. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Developed prior to Gray Monday, the Hel is a Heavy Class Omni机甲, which was originally created for the touman of 玉鹰氏族. Also known as the Hel internally among the Clans, the Loki is an upgraded version of the venerable Hellbringer 开发 by 氏族地狱马 in 2926. The new '机甲 differs from its thirtieth century originator by having heavier equipment capacity and improved 装甲 protection but a lower top speed. The '机甲 would become primarily used by Clans Jade Falcon and 地狱马 in 3145, where the '机甲 would see action during those Clans' invasions of the Inner Sphere powers such as the 球体共和国 and Lyran Commonwealth. A noted action that utilized the Loki was during the Jade Falcon's occupation of Sargasso in 3142. The 9th Talon deployed a binary of Lokis to suppress resistance in the city of Salicastrum. The Cluster's Lokis (fitted with B Configurations) used their 长 Tom Cannons to blast rebel forces. However, a Nova of Wolf-In-Exiles forces ambushed the binary, and the ensuing battle rendered half the Jade Falcon Lokis destroyed, however the survivors would withdraw temporarily. A Star's worth of survivors from the 9th would return to force a Clan Wolf retreat and prevent the world from falling back into Commonwealth hands. 怪癖: Experimental TC 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 在灰星期一之前开发的Hel是一款重型万能机甲，最初是为玉鹰氏族的军事力量而设计. 这款在氏族内部被称为洛基的机甲，是地狱战马氏族于2926年开发的经典地狱使者升级版. 新型机甲与三十世纪的原型机不同之处在于拥有更强的装备承载能力和改进的装甲防护，但最高速度有所降低. 到3145年，这款机甲主要由玉鹰氏族和地狱战马氏族使用，并在这些氏族入侵内天体势力（如球体共和国和天琴共同体）期间投入实战. 3142年玉鹰氏族占领萨尔加索时，洛基的使用尤为引人注目. 第九利爪部队部署了一支由洛基组成的双元编队以镇压萨利卡斯特鲁姆城的抵抗力量. 该集群的洛基（装配B型配置）使用长汤姆加农炮轰击叛军. 然而，一支狼之流亡者部队的新星编队伏击了这支双元编队，随后的战斗摧毁了半数玉鹰氏族的洛基，不过幸存者暂时撤退. 第九部队的一星幸存者随后返回，迫使狼氏族撤退，阻止了这颗星球重新落入联邦之手. 特质: 实验型目标计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: This pilot has a collapsed lung and has a penalty to Guts.

column1: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched 锁定式SRM-6 and ER 中型激光s in each arm. An 反导系统 and a 轻型 主动探头 in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 太阳蜘蛛B型是一款混合距离作战机甲，其核心武器为右躯干安装的高斯步枪，辅以左躯干的大型增程激光以及各手臂配备的锁定式SRM-6和中型增程激光. 左躯干搭载的反导弹系统与轻型主动探测器使其难以被偷袭，配备两吨高斯步枪弹药和精确打击导弹弹药，另有一吨反导弹系统弹药及一台额外的双散热器. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of 全向Mechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion engine and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. The Seraph features an array of weapons that is useful at long to medium ranges, but becomes very strong at close range. Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 天体系列万能机甲中的轻型突击机甲炽天使，就其重量而言速度较慢，但它试图通过配备三重强度肌纤维来弥补这一点，使机甲在过热时能够加速到64公里/小时. 与其他天体系列机甲一样，炽天使采用了轻型核聚变引擎和小型驾驶舱，不过其他较新的技术仅体现在其武器装备中. 与其他天体系列机甲一样，它也配备了一台C3i计算机. 炽天使的武器配置在中远程距离上很有用，但在近距离会变得非常强大. 特质: 改进型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Catapult K9 is a refit of the venerable K2 variant, carrying twin Gauss rifles in place of PPCs, and featuring enhanced 装甲. Quirk: 精准武器 - 弹道 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Catapult K9是对久负盛名的K2型号的改型，以双联装高斯步枪取代了粒子加农炮，并配备了增强型装甲. 特质: 精准武器 - 弹道 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A RISC redesign of recovered early Savage Wolf prototypes, the PR-RISC was often used for false-flag operations or traps behind enemy lines. With one Hyper laser in each arm, the 'Mech has to carry extra coolant pods to handle the immense heat build up. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: PR-RISC是早期回收的野蛮狼原型机经过RISC重新设计的版本，常被用于假旗行动或敌后陷阱. 其双臂各装有一门Hyper激光，这台机甲必须携带额外的冷却荚舱以应对巨大的热量积聚. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 作为侦察机甲，萤火虫凭借其偏能量武器的配置表现平平，但在侦察与游击作战中都颇为有用。 Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 专为城市近距离战斗设计，R61L与其价格较低的R60L系列机甲均换装了潜行装备，并搭载AC20. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: One of the most notable attributes of the Night Stalker NSR-K3 is its speed. Powered by its 320 XL extralight engine, the 40 ton 设计 can quickly close distance between it and its objective. In its role as a recon and pursuit '机甲, the Night Stalker is fitted with a Beagle active probe to find hidden units. Other 设计 features include a torso-mounted cockpit and TAG - the latter of which can be used to call in artillery support. Protecting the '机甲's hull are six and a half tons of ferro-fibrous 装甲. The Night Stalker's arsenal is meant for intermediate and close-in fighting, with a pair of right arm-mounted ER medium lasers and an SRM-6 in the left torso. Upon entering close range, the '机甲 can bring its ER small laser and small pulse laser to bear on a potential target. In combination with the Night Stalker' speed, a 机甲Warrior can use its unusually-shaped left arm-mounted lance to pierce an enemy's 装甲. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: 夜行者NSR-K3最显著的属性之一是其速度. 凭借320超轻型XL引擎，这台40吨级机体能迅速拉近与目标之间的距离. 作为侦察追击型机甲，夜行者配备了贝格尔主动探测器用于侦测隐藏单位. 其设计特点还包括躯干驾驶舱和TAG激光指示器——后者可召唤炮火支援. 保护机身的是六吨半铁纤维装甲. 夜行者的武器配置专为中近距离战斗设计，右臂装有两门中型增程激光，左躯干配有一具SRM-6导弹发射器. 进入近战范围后，这台机甲还能用小型增程激光和小型脉冲激光瞄准潜在目标. 配合其高机动性，机甲战士可利用造型独特的左臂骑枪刺穿敌方装甲. 特质: 扰敌 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: Manufactured by Jalastar Aerospace from their plant on Panpour, the Gunsmith entered service shortly before the Blackout. Armed with 4 medium X-Pulses lasers,the Gunsmith quickly earned a fearsome reputation as a pursuit Battle机甲 and raider. Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96
column2: 由贾拉斯特航空航天公司在潘普尔的工厂制造，枪匠在黑暗时代前夕投入使用. 装备4门中型X脉冲激光，枪匠迅速赢得了作为追击型战斗机和突袭者的可怕声誉. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 0.96

column1: The Cave Lion is a Heavy-class Battle机甲 that features a combination of Clan and Inner Sphere technology. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 洞穴狮是一款重型级战斗机甲，融合了氏族与内天体的技术. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.15

With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 120 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 95 15 炮塔 100 15 总计 515 75 特性：防护机构

column1: These Prototype 双散热器 were created by House Davion researchers. Unlike the 双散热器 used by the Star League and after the War of 3039 these prototype units were smaller. As an experiment, they worked adequately, but their use of liquid heavy metals instead of the safer (if larger) radiators used in SLDF double heat sinks meant that they have been highly unstable. VOLATILE!
column2: 这些原型双散热器由戴维恩家族的研究人员制造. 与星盟及3039年战争之后使用的双散热器不同，这些原型装置体积更小. 作为实验性技术，它们表现尚可，但由于使用了液态重金属，而非SLDF双散热器所用更安全(但体积更大)的散热装置，导致它们极不稳定. 易爆!

column1: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a 大型脉冲激光 and 超级自动炮/5 in each arm, supported by an ER 中型激光 in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the A is fitted with sixteen 双散热器 and four tons of UAC ammo. Quirk: 集成探照灯 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是氏族对经典继承战争时期RFL-3N型“步枪手（Rifleman）”的现代诠释，A型号的双臂各搭载一门大型脉冲激光和超轻型自动炮/5，并由两侧躯干各配备一门中型增程激光提供辅助火力. 基于260级的超轻型引擎、钢内骨结构和十吨铁纤维装甲构建，A型号装备了十六具双重散热器和四吨超轻型自动炮弹药. 特质: 集成探照灯 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Pack Hunter Intelligence Suite allows units carrying the devices to use each other in order to triangulate enemy units to form more effective firing solutions. The P.H.I. Suite’s sensor hardware package is largely specialized for use against fast moving targets, including aircraft, and much of its benefits are lost against lumbering behemoths.
column2: 【PHI Suite】携带群猎智能套件（Pack Hunter Intelligence Suite）的单位可以利用彼此的设备，对敌方单位进行三角定位，从而形成更有效的射击解算方案. P.H.I.套件的传感器硬件组件主要针对包括飞行器在内的高速移动目标进行优化，而面对行动迟缓的庞然大物时，其大部分优势都会大打折扣.

column1: This version of the Roc was developed by The Society. It maintains the same ground speed, but carries a Medium 化学激光 with 30 reloads. It's also equipped with a Magnetic Clamp system. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.972
column2: 这个版本的Roc由秘社开发. 它保持相同的地面速度，但携带了一门中型化学激光，备弹30发. 它还装备了磁力夹持系统. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 0.972

column1: Another derivative of the Royal -C1b, the -M5 variant exchanges the twin LRM15s with a pair of Fire and Forget missile systems with eight tubes a piece. Unlike the -M2, the -M5 retains all four lasers of the C1b. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: The screen flares to life with a burst of static, then clears to reveal Mizuki Bekker once again. Her tone is direct, sharpened by urgency. "Star Cluster 752 is now on the front line. We have three key objectives that must be completed in sequence. I will not mince words, each of these tasks is vital to preserving our hold on this world, and all of them will fall to you. First, we must intercept [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear]] raiders on the way to our desert forward operations camp. Then, we need to recover sensitive data buried beneath the sands, data the Ghost Bears would use to overwhelm our defenses. Finally, the planet's main logistics redoubt must be defended at all costs. If it falls, our operational reach collapses." She pauses, gaze intense. "You choose the order. But know this: once issued, each contract must be launched within two weeks. Delay, and the opportunity, and the advantage, is lost. After each success, a small cache will be provided. Weapons, custom tech, ammunition, tools to keep you in the fight." She leans forward slightly. "This is where we make our stand. Choose your next strike."
column2: 屏幕伴随着一阵静电爆响亮起，随后画面稳定下来，再次显示出美月·贝克的身影. 她的语气直接而坚定，紧迫感更加明显. “星团752 现在已经成为前线. 我们有三个关键目标必须依次完成. 我不会拐弯抹角，这些任务每一个都关系到我们能否守住这颗星球，而它们全部都将交给你们完成. 首先，我们必须拦截前往沙漠前线行动营地途中的[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]幽灵熊]]突袭部队. 然后，我们需要回收埋藏在沙海之下的敏感数据，那些数据一旦落入幽灵熊手中，将足以让他们突破我们的防御. 最后，必须不惜一切代价守住行星主要后勤堡垒. 如果它失守，我们的行动范围将全面崩溃.” 她停顿片刻，目光变得更加锐利. “你来选择执行顺序. 但记住: 一旦任务发布，每份合约都必须在两周内启动. 拖延，就意味着机会和优势都会消失. 每次成功后，我们都会提供一份小型补给. 武器、定制科技、弹药、以及帮助你们继续战斗的工具.” 她微微向前倾身.“这里，就是我们要坚守的地方. 选择你的下一次打击.”

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the Warhammer WHM-6Rk is armed with a pair of PPC’s. A pair of 中型激光s, Small Lasers, Machine Guns and an SRM-6 deter opponents from closing in. 双散热器 round out the variant. Quirk: 集成探照灯 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 战锤机甲闻名整个内天体乃至更远星系，是卓越的重型机甲代表. 这款70吨级机甲于2515年首次亮相，完美融合了火力与机动性，旨在击败几乎所有对手. 战锤WHM-6Rk型号搭载一台350超轻重引擎，主武器为两门粒子加农炮. 副武器包括两门中型激光、两门小型激光、两挺机枪及一部六联装短程火箭发射器，有效阻止敌人近身. 双散热系统完善了该型号的配置. 特质: 集成探照灯 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

Classic styling combined with greater combat impact made this attractive to both House and mercenary markets. The use of the 设计ation 'Mirage II' put Defiance into a legal case with Coventry Metal Works, since Coventry had originally dubbed the -M model the 'Mirage' and therefore took great offense of the nickname of the FS9-N. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 戴法恩斯工业公司的新款“火种”机甲FS9-N，采用了自产的氏族级XL引擎和增程激光，以及核心的等离子炮. 经典造型结合更强的战斗效能，使其在家族势力和雇佣兵市场都很受欢迎. 使用了“幻影II”这个代号，导致戴法恩斯与考文垂金属公司陷入了法律纠纷，因为考文垂曾将-M型号称为“幻影”，因此对FS9-N的这个绰号极为不满. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Tora 3, developed after another year of operational feedback, takes a sharp turn from its predecessor’s loadout. It mounts twin ATM-9s and a single ER PPC, giving it effective coverage at all ranges. A 瞄准计算机 enhances accuracy, while 120 meters of jump capability and the continued use of a Supercharger ensure strong mobility and tactical flexibility. Quirk: 易于驾驶 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 经过又一年实战反馈研发而成的Tora 3型，在武备配置上与其前代机型大相径庭. 该机型搭载了双联ATM-9导弹系统与一门增程粒子加农炮，使其具备全距离有效打击能力. 目标计算机提升了射击精度，而120米的跳跃距离配合持续使用的超级增压器，确保了卓越的机动性与战术灵活性. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: The ND-RR3 is the close-range specialist of the original trio, carrying a Sword as its primary physical threat alongside a 短管PPC. An ER Large Laser and two 中型脉冲激光s give it solid ranged capability at short and medium distances. Four Machine Guns spread across the center torso and left arm handle anti-infantry duties and can threaten lightly armored targets. Thirteen and a half tons of armor supports the aggressive close-range doctrine. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: ND-RR3是原始三机编队中的近战专家，主要物理威胁为一柄剑，并搭配一门短管粒子加农炮. 一门大型增程激光与两门中型脉冲激光赋予其在短至中距离上可靠的射击能力. 中央躯干与左臂共分布有四挺机枪，用于反步兵任务并可威胁轻装甲目标. 十三吨半的装甲为这种激进的近战策略提供支撑. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.11

column1: To call it the deadliest Locust ever built is probably an exaggeration. But all that custom equipment does make it quite impressive and will surprise most that meet it on the 'field.
column2: 将其称为有史以来最致命的蝗虫可能有些夸张。但所有这些定制设备确实让它令人印象深刻，并且会让大多数在“现场”遇到它的人感到惊讶。

It is further backed by an Improved Heavy 中型激光, an Improved Heavy Small Laser, and an extra 双散热器 for better thermal efficiency. column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series 全向Mechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. This configuration has enough weapons to feel at home at range or up close. Like the Comminus variant, it mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 120 meters at a time. For long-range combat, the Deva D mounts a Heavy PPC. In close, two ER Mediums and four 中型脉冲激光s can quickly disable an opponent. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 作为布雷克圣言会的另一款Celestial系列万能机甲，德瓦（名称源自印度教信仰中的天神）同样广泛应用了新技术. 它采用轻型聚变引擎、耐久度比标准型号多出一半的重型陀螺仪，以及所有Celestial机甲通用的小型驾驶舱. 本配置拥有足以在远程或近战中应付自如的武器，与Comminus变体相同，它安装了充足的跳跃喷口，每次可跃至120米. 远程战斗中，德瓦 D装有一门重型PPC；近距离则可凭借两门中型增程激光与四门中型脉冲激光迅速瘫痪敌手. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: [This version has Standard Arrows] The Hadur Fast Support Vehicle was 开发 by 氏族地狱马 and introduced in 3102. column1: Ubiquitous across the Inner Sphere, the Igor is a name given to a generic super heavy lift platform. column1: A rivalry between two lesser Solaris stables begot the prototype 休伦战士 nicknamed the ’Thunderchief.’ While the original was made almost entirely from, illegibly, stolen parts; the few knock-offs and reproductions that have filtered throughout the Inner Sphere have solidified this unusual design. The Thunderchief is primarily built around a 重击者火炮 piece, which is used to pummel targets at range, and a hatchet used for in-close work. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.06
column2: 索拉里斯竞技场中两个小战队之间的竞争，催生了绰号为“雷霆酋长”的休伦战士原型机. 尽管其原型几乎完全由来源不明的盗取零件拼凑而成，但少数仿制品与复制品在内天体各处的流传，已让这一独特设计得以确立. 雷霆酋长主要围绕一门重击者火炮打造，用于在远距离轰击目标，并配有一把用于近身搏杀的手斧. 特质: 改进型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.06

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded armor protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this armor is still too light to allow the 'Mech to operate in a stand up fight. Double Heat Sinks keep the Stinger IIC cool.
column2: 尽管按照圣战时代的标准，毒刺 IIC 的地面速度相对较低，但它仍然足够快，可以充当骚扰单位和侦察平台。 180 米的跳跃能力也很有用，可以让飞行员快速脱离狭窄的地形。升级后的装甲保护也受到那些使用旧毒刺的战士的重视，但这种装甲仍然太轻，无法让“机甲”在站立战斗中操作。双散热器让 Stinger IIC 保持凉爽。

column1: A secure burst-transmission from Arelle arrives, brief and to the point as usual. "Commander. The situation is shifting. With the [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]]'s logistics disrupted at Landrum, they're falling back toward stronger defensive positions. We can't give them the space to dig in." A digital overlay highlights the system of Fröislandis, spinning slowly in the Argo's tactical holosphere. "We've located one of the Tribe's primary manufacturing complexes on Fröislandis VII. Our analysis confirms the site is producing a steady stream of combat units. If left unchecked, it will tip the balance. Your next objective is to eliminate the facility before production scales further. You are to depart immediately. There is no time left to waste." Darius frowns as the data packet finishes decrypting. "One of their main plants? That's not a strike, that's a decapitation." Farah mutters, "If they built that on Fröislandis, then we've been underestimating how much they've dug in out there." Sumire glances toward the nav console, already prepping the next jump. "Hope our MechWarriors are well rested. This won't be a soft drop." The next move is clear. The Tribe's machines must be silenced, at the source.
column2: 阿蕾尔发来一段安全突发传输，和往常一样简短直接. “指挥官. 局势正在变化. 随着[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]部落]]在Landrum 的后勤遭到破坏，他们正在撤退，向更强大的防御阵地转移. 我们不能给他们时间巩固防线.” 一个数字投影标出了Fröislandis 星系，在阿尔戈号 的战术全息空间中缓缓旋转. “我们已经定位到部落在Fröislandis VII 上的一处主要制造设施. 分析确认，该设施正在持续生产战斗单位. 如果不加以控制，它将改变战局平衡. 你的下一项任务是在生产规模进一步扩大前摧毁该设施. 立即出发. 已经没有时间可以浪费了.” 数据包完成解密后，达吕斯皱起眉头.“他们的主要工厂? 这可不是一次普通打击，而是斩首行动.” 法拉低声说道:“如果他们能在Fröislandis建立这种规模的设施，那我们一直低估了他们在那里的部署程度.” 苏米尔看向导航控制台，已经开始准备下一次跳跃.“希望我们的机甲战士已经充分休息. 这次可不会是轻松的部署.” 下一步行动已经明确. 必须从源头上让部落的战争机器彻底沉默.

column1: Micheal Coleman, a Periphery Militia Captain, was able to beat a Clanner in a Batchall and Won this Jaguar out of it. Looking at the Mech, and at the Available Resources, he Created this. On first Looks, the Mech itself seems very Archaic, yet it Still Works. Coleman Reportedly Blasted Multiple Enemies to Pieces in this Jaguar, untill one day the Knockback from the Howitzers Proved too much, Knocked the Mech over and Hurt Coleman Fatally.
column2: 外围民兵队长迈克尔·科尔曼 (Micheal Coleman) 在一场批量比赛中击败了一名部落成员，并赢得了这辆美洲虎。看着机甲和可用资源，他创造了这个。乍一看，机甲本身看起来非常古老，但它仍然有效。据报道，科尔曼驾驶这辆美洲虎将多个敌人炸成碎片，直到有一天，榴弹炮的击退效果实在太严重，将机甲撞翻，科尔曼身受重伤。

column1: This Republic Trebaruna has been turned into some slow walking Monster. The 加固装甲 is still on it, but they reinforced the Structure as well. Ripping out anything and everything that has to do with speed, don't expect this to move very far. The Armaments have been replaced with various Pirate and Periphery Weapons, some of which are either Genius Engineering or Insanity. They even crammed a 工业级三倍强度人造肌 in there to mount all of these Weapons on the Mech. Looking at what this thing was supposed to do, I nearly think they made a Wannabie Urbanmech. Pirates, Boss, I tell you. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 这台共和国特拉巴鲁纳被改造成了一个行走缓慢的怪物. 硬化装甲仍保留在上面，但他们也强化了结构. 撕掉了所有与速度有关的一切，别指望这家伙能走多远. 武器换成了各种海盗和外围星域的装备，有些堪称天才工程，有些则纯属疯狂. 他们甚至塞进了一台工业级TSM，就为了把所有武器都装到机甲上. 看着这玩意儿本应发挥的作用，我差点以为他们搞出了个想当城市机甲的货色. 告诉你，老板，这些海盗啊. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.17

column1: This Legendary variant is barely spoken of for fear it might appear, bringing 4 massive Thumper Cannons to the field on a very very slow platform.
column2: 这个传奇变体几乎没有被提及，因为担心它可能会出现，在一个非常非常慢的平台上将 4 门巨大的重击炮带到战场上。

column1: The Sköll B configuration serves as a dedicated fire support platform, featuring twin ATM-12s with ample ammunition. It stays on the field longer than expected, delivering consistent missile barrages from the rear line. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 斯库尔B型配置作为专用火力支援平台，搭载两具ATM-12型导弹发射器并配备充足弹药. 其战场续航力超越常规预期，能在后方战线持续倾泻密集导弹弹幕. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.05 本内容经白羊座游戏与微缩模型授权使用.

column1: Shakush means 'Hammer' in Arabic. The Ifrit VTOL Strike Craft was designed to intercept and delay armored advances. Reactive armor, a Jet Booster and AMS increase its chances of getting close enough to deploy its pylon-mounted primary payload. The Shakush takes a different approach to hard hitting short range firepower, mounting a LAC/20 rather than SRM. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 20 Left 115 20 Right 115 20 Rear 95 20 Total 500 100 Quirk: 快速起步
column2: Shakush在阿拉伯语中意为“锤子”. 伊弗利特垂直起降攻击机被设计用于拦截和延缓装甲推进. 反应装甲、喷气助推器和AMS增加了它足够接近以部署其挂架主要载荷的机会. Shakush对强力短程火力采取了不同的方法  安装了一门LAC/20而非SRM. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境部署. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 反应装甲板 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 155 20 左侧 115 20 右侧 115 20 后方 95 20 总计 500 100 特质: 快速起步 #武器: 1x AMS MK2 1x 轻型AC/20 2x 布雷炸弹x2[翼挂] 2x 布雷炸弹[翼挂]

column1: A Jihad-era variant, the 2X retains the LB 10-X and 中型脉冲激光 of the 1X while carrying a larger MRM-40 rack enhanced by an experimental Apollo FCS. The remaining weaponry is replaced with a Heavy PPC and a C3 slave. A 紧凑型陀螺仪 increases survivability. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: A Jihad-era variant, the 2X retains the LB 10-X and Medium Pulse Laser of the 1X while carrying a larger MRM-40 rack enhanced by an experimental Apollo FCS. The remaining weaponry is replaced with a Heavy PPC and a C3 slave. A Compact Gyro increases survivability. Quirk：Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower

column1: Mostly a Museum piece was this Shadow Hawk rebuild on request for a Paladins 'Special Associate', sporting upgrades sourced from basically everywhere is it able to strike unseen basically anywhere at anytime even during Planet wide Engagements.
column2: 主要是博物馆的一件作品，是根据圣骑士“特别助理”的要求重建的暗影鹰，其运动升级基本上来自任何地方，即使在全球范围内的交战中，它也能够基本上随时随地进行看不见的攻击。

column1: 这曾经是一台克林特机甲，但现在浑身是尖刺，武器不是开火就是炸你一脸。 Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这个共和国时代的变体采用复合内部结构，以减轻重量来安装一门超级自动炮. 若干小型武器被替换为CASE II和天使ECM套件. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: (Minimum Score: 480,000) You're one of the best mercenary commanders around, and employers compete with each other to hire you.
column2: (最低分数: 480，000) 你已经成为顶级佣兵指挥官的一员，雇主们争相雇佣你.

column1: With great effort, RISC Engineers upgraded the Catapult II chassis to an Omnimech level of technology. Employing the most advanced equipment at their disposal, this venerable 设计's weight was reduced to 55 tons without sacrificing any firepower. This configuration relies on a pair of highly accurate streak MRM launchers, backed by 装甲-stripping medium lasers. As with most of this line, it is protected by a laser anti-missile system built directly into the 装甲 plating. 怪癖: Experimental TC 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 经过不懈努力，RISC工程师将Catapult II底盘升级至万能机甲技术水平. 通过采用最先进的装备，这款经典机型的重量在不牺牲任何火力的情况下被缩减至55吨. 该配置依赖一对高精度锁定式MRM发射器作为主武器，并辅以穿甲型中型激光. 与同系列多数机型一样，其装甲层直接嵌入了激光反导系统提供防护. 特质: 试验型目标计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: A variant of the Griffin 6S, introduced in 3071; the 5K is a nimble sniper, sporting enough improved jump jets for it to vault up to 240 meters in a single bound. Built around a 迪法恩斯轻型 Engine and a Heavy Duty Gyro, the 5K has 10 tons of 轻型 铁纤维装甲 with a CASE added to protect the ammunition bay. Carrying a Light PPC, an LRM-10 and a ER 中型激光, the Griffin is equipped to handle combat at any range. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: “狮鹫（Griffin）”6S的一个变体，于3071年推出；5K型是一款敏捷的狙击机甲，配备了足够的改进型跳跃推进器，使其单次跳跃即可跃至240米. 该机甲基于迪法恩斯轻量化引擎与重型陀螺仪打造，拥有10吨轻型铁纤维装甲，并加装了CASE以保护弹药舱. 5K型搭载一门轻型粒子加农炮、一具LRM-10及一门中型增程激光，这只狮鹫能在任何距离下应对战斗. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Hiisi 3 carries a diverse arsenal: a Flechette 20 for versatile electromagnetic attacks, a Hyper PPC and 短管PPC both enhanced with TEMPEST manifolds to boost plasma weapon output, a Mech-Scale 榴弹发射器 for area suppression, plus an Improved Large Laser and Early Clan Extended Range Medium and Small Lasers for reliable energy support. Equipped with the PHI Suite for shared targeting data within the lance, Hiisi 3 excels in flexible multi-role combat, balancing precision, heavy firepower, and indirect fire capabilities. Quirk: 令人胆怯 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: Hiisi 3 搭载了多样化的武器配置: 一门 Flechette 20 用于多用途电磁攻击，一门 超级PPC 和一门 Snub-Nose PPC 均加装了暴风歧管以提升等离子武器输出，一具机甲级榴弹发射器用于区域压制，此外还配备了一门改进型大型激光以及早期氏族中型增程和小型激光，提供可靠的定向能支援. 借助 PHI 套件可在小队内共享目标数据，Hiisi 3 擅长灵活的多用途作战，在精准打击、重火力与间接火力之间取得平衡. 特质: 威慑 部署费用倍率: 1.4

column1: An experimental variant intended for command and training, 开发 by the Draconis Combine. The TFT-C3 variant removes the light Gauss rifle for a Cockpit 指挥控制台 and a C3 command unit, the ER small laser for an ER medium laser, and then adds a medium X-pulse laser instead of the 锁定式SRM-4. The variant also trades the A9's jump jets for mechanical jump boosters for each leg. All of these changes have been made possible by replacing the standard Fusion engine of the A9 variant with a light fusion engine. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 天龙联合体开发的一款实验性变体，主要用于指挥和训练. TFT-C3型移除了轻型高斯步枪，换装驾驶舱指挥控制台和C3指挥单元；将小型增程激光升级为中型增程激光，并以中型X射线脉冲激光替代了锁定式SRM-4型短程火箭系统. 该型号还将A9型的跳跃喷气装置替换为每条腿配备的机械跳跃助推器. 所有这些改装得以实现，源于将A9型的标准核聚变引擎更换为轻型核聚变引擎. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: The Marten Light Scout VTOL was produced by Cal-Boeing of Dorwinion on the world of Belladonna. It was preceded by a combat-oriented version of the company's Ferret VTOL in 2967. However, the 'Wild Weasel' was too fragile for customers and was discontinued. Cal-Boeing attempted to introduce a less daring design in form of the Marten in 3021. Billing the Marten in the role of a light transport VTOL and recon unit. Performance-wise, the craft was effective, however the shadow of Cal-Boeing's early Wild Weasel and the Marten's high cost caused sales to falter. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 70 10 Left 35 10 Right 35 10 Rear 30 10 Total 180 50 Quirk: 易于驾驶
column2: Marten轻型侦察VTOL由Belladonna星球上的Dorwinion的Cal-Boeing生产. 其前身是该公司在2967年推出的Ferret VTOL的战斗型版本. 然而  ‘野鼬鼠’对客户来说过于脆弱  因此停产. Cal-Boeing在3021年尝试推出一种较为保守的设计  即Marten. 将Marten定位为轻型运输VTOL和侦察单位. 在性能方面  该飞行器很有效  但Cal-Boeing早期野鼬鼠的阴影以及Marten的高成本导致销售不振. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境中部署. 移动: 13/20格 / 390/600米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 70 10 左侧 35 10 右侧 35 10 后方 30 10 总计 180 50 特质: 易于驾驶 #武器: 1x 锁定式SRM-4

column1: This 2956 variant is similar to the LRM-10 variant, but does not include the medium lasers, equipping a larger launcher and machine guns. The Hunter Light Support Tank is popular with planetary militias and second-line units. It was designed by 迪法恩斯工业 as a cheap, reliable and effective combat vehicle to provide covering fire support for combat units withdrawing from the front lines. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 20 Left 120 20 Right 120 20 Rear 80 20 Total 500 80 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹
column2: 这个2956年的变体与LRM-10变体相似  但不包含中型激光  而是装备了更大的发射器和机枪. Hunter轻型支援坦克在行星民兵和二线部队中很受欢迎. 它由Defiance Industries设计  作为一种廉价、可靠且有效的战斗车辆  为从前线撤退的战斗单位提供掩护火力支援. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 5/8格 / 150/240米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 180 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 80 20 总计 500 80 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 #武器: 1x LRM-15 4x 机枪 1x 火焰喷射器

column2: 最初于2400年前后由狂热的穆斯林定居，Camlann近来曾数次从天琴人手中转入联合体手中. 如今再次“安全地”落入天龙联合体手中，Camlann是一个典型的边境世界，充斥着好战的宗教狂热分子……有趣.

column1: The final Jenner IIC variant debuted just prior to the Nova Cat rebellion, but it now stands to make the largest profit. Mounting four improved heavy medium lasers in the arms, it represents a modern-day reincarnation of the original Jenner. 怪癖: 改进的 Lifesupport 掉落成本乘数: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 最后一款詹纳IIC变体在 诺瓦猫叛乱前夕首次登场，但如今却有望创造最大利润. 它在臂部搭载了四门改良型中型重激光，成为原版詹纳在现代的重生之作. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The JES III Missile Carrier was originally built in the 3130s prior to the fall of the HPG Communication grid. The JES III was designed to be faster and better armored than its two predecessors. The vehicle's main armaments consist of four LRM-15 launchers mounted in the turret. For self-defense against regular infantry the vehicle also mounts two machine guns. The machine guns share a half ton of ammunition, while the LRM-15s can draw from a six-ton ammunition bay. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 200 30 Left 110 30 Right 110 30 Rear 100 30 Turret 135 30 Total 655 150 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹
column2: JES III导弹运载车最初于3130年代建造  那时正值HPG通信网崩溃之前. JES III的设计目标是比它的两个前辈更快、装甲更优. 该载具的主要武器包括安装在炮塔上的四具LRM-15发射器. 为了自卫对抗普通步兵  该载具还装备了两挺机枪. 机枪共用半吨弹药  而LRM-15则可从六吨的弹药舱中取用. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 200 30 左侧 110 30 右侧 110 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 135 30 总计 655 150 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 #武器: 2x 机枪 4x LRM-15

column1: The Tora 2 was developed after a single year of feedback from Spirit Cat MechWarriors. By removing the original's main weaponry and jump jets—but retaining the Supercharger and 瞄准计算机—designers were able to install a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle and twin Improved Heavy Large Lasers. While the design presents potential heat issues, any experienced MechWarrior can effectively manage the heat buildup. Quirk: 易于驾驶 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 虎式2型机甲是在听取灵猫氏族机甲战士整整一年的反馈意见后开发的. 通过移除原型机的主武器系统和跳跃喷气装置，同时保留超级增压器和瞄准计算机，工程师们得以安装一门20级超突击高斯步枪和两门改进型大型重激光. 虽然该设计存在潜在的热量问题，但任何经验丰富的机甲战士都能有效控制热量积聚. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂 经白羊座游戏与微缩模型公司授权使用.

column1: Intorduced during the Jihad, the 4F exchanges the Mechs 铁纤维装甲 for Light Ferro-Fibrous and the standard Gyro for a XL Gyro. This allows for the addition of Jump Jets, a 瞄准计算机, a C3 Slave Computer, and a Heavy PPC. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 于圣战期间推出的4F型号，将机甲的“铁纤维装甲”更换为“轻型铁纤维装甲”，并将标准陀螺仪替换为“超轻型陀螺仪”. 这一改动使其得以加装跳跃喷气器、目标计算机、C3从属计算机以及一门重型粒子加农炮. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Built by the same company that made the Saracen and Scimitar, the Saladin was Scarborough's last medium hover tank. It is unlike its brothers in that the Saladin does not mount a turret, and its only weapon is a heavy, short-range AC/20. Since it's vastly different from the company's other hovercraft, buyers were quite skeptical about purchasing it; Scarborough had to offer incentives like free training and transportation. Soon it became as cheap as the Saracen and spread throughout the whole Inner Sphere. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 120 20 左侧 80 20 右侧 80 20 后方 60 20 总计 340 80 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for what is supposed to be no more than a low altitude fly-by of the ruins, though some of her photos seem suspiciously close to the ground. After the trip, she spends a week cataloging the collected data and then delivers her report.\\n\\n"Commander, look at this! See those shadows? And this indentation? That's an underground complex nobody's ever found before! And there's a symposium of historians willing to pay a mint to preempt the general release of our findings.\\n\\nYou whistle at the sum and say, "Are you leaving us to become an archaeologist now?"\\n\\nShe only grins at you before returning to her work.
column2: 堇拍摄的豹子本应只是低空飞越废墟，但她的一些照片看起来离地面很近，令人怀疑。旅行结束后，她花了一周的时间对收集到的数据进行编目，然后提交报告。\\n\\n“指挥官，看看这个！看到那些阴影了吗？还有这个凹痕？那是一个以前没有人发现过的地下建筑群！还有一个历史学家研讨会愿意花点钱抢先公布我们的发现。\\n\\n你看着这个数字，吹口哨说：“你要离开我们去当考古学家吗？现在？”\\n\\n她只是对你笑了笑，然后就继续工作了。

column1: Piloted by Haley 'Hail Storm' Flannigan, this custom variant strode onto the Solaris arenas in the 3072 season. Built off of the Cyclone C1 variant, Flannigan’s Cyclone replaces the ER PPC with an advanced Ceres Arms Crusher 等离子步枪, much to the pyrotechnic enjoyment of the crowd. This variant also drops the ER 中型激光s and ECM Suite entirely in favor of a pair of repurposed 可伸缩刀刃s for close-in knife fighting. 特性：灵巧 部署成本倍率：1.01
column2: 由黑莉·'冰雹风暴'·弗兰尼根驾驶的这款定制机甲在3072赛季的索拉里斯竞技场上大放异彩. 基于Cyclone C1型号改造，弗兰尼根的Cyclone用先进的Ceres Arms粉碎者等离子步枪替换了增程粒子加农炮，为观众带来了精彩火爆的视觉盛宴. 该型号还完全舍弃了中型增程激光和电子战套件，换装一对改装后的可伸缩刀刃，专用于近身近战. 特质: 迅捷 部署费用倍率: 1.01

column1: 你正在 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 上往豹式运输机里装货时，一个留着背头、穿着定制西装的陌生人把一块掌上电脑塞到达里乌斯面前。副官大步走来，把你和 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 拉到一边。"简直难以置信！今天，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 在一个犯罪集团的赌局里欠下了巨额债务——两百万星币——还胆敢跑路。" "你在说什么，我完全不知道。"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 的目光朝那个陌生人飘去。 达里乌斯指向陌生人掌上电脑上的一段视频。画面中，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 从一栋破败的工业建筑窗户里爬出来。"他们想要回自己的钱，但也接受用 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 本人抵债。他向我保证，这'完全是生意'。" "我还不起那笔钱。我们起飞吧！"{TGT_MW.Callsign} 脱口而出。"别管这个怪人。" 达里乌斯抓着 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 的胳膊。"闭嘴吧，牌场鲨鱼。这得指挥官来定。这些先生们跟外围区各地的海盗都有联系。我们要是跑掉，可能会一下子惹上一大群狠角色。"
column2: 不还清{TGT_MW.Callsign}的债务就离开{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.

column1: An encrypted packet arrives quickly after the call with Arelle ended. Coordinates, mission tags, and a name that sent an immediate ripple through the crew: [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMajestyMetals],Majesty Metals and Manufacturing]]. It's another major corporation, will this be [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreVicore],Vicore]] all over? The crew gathers around the holotable as jump preparation alerts begin to echo through the Argo's corridors. Yang leans in, expression wary. "Dunianshire VI. That's no fringe outpost. Majesty Metals is one of the biggest industrial players in the Inner Sphere, even out here on the edge. They make everything. 'Mech chassis, armored plating, weapon frameworks, even bulk atmospheric components. If they've got a vault hidden there, it's not just valuable. It's probably cutting-edge." Farah taps a readout, frowning. "The vault's buried under one of their older prototype facilities, tied into Factory Circumference Alpha right outside [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGiggleswick],Giggleswick]]. That's an R&D spine for their assault mech division. Might be weapon schematics, maybe structural enhancements... but definitely something the [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]] wants intact." Sumire raises an eyebrow. "Wait, does [[DM.SystemDefs[starsystemdef_Dunianshire].OwnerValue.FactionDef,{DM.SystemDefs[starsystemdef_Dunianshire].OwnerValue.FactionDef.Name}]] even know we're coming? Dunianshire is their space. And what about Majesty's own security teams? If they see our 'Mechs stomping toward one of their black sites, are we sure they won't open fire?" Silence follows, no one answers. You all glance at one another. Darius shrugs. "We've got coordinates, authorization tags, and a job. We'll have to trust Arelle squared things on her end." Sumire mutters, "Right. Trust the Watch. Never goes wrong." You nod. The decision's made. The Argo's course is locked. Majesty's vault waits on Dunianshire VI, and whatever's inside, the 明尼苏达部落 is already on the move.
column2: 与阿蕾尔结束通话后不久，一份加密数据包迅速抵达。里面包含坐标、任务标记，以及一个让全体船员瞬间警觉的名字：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMajestyMetals]Majesty Metals and Manufacturing]]。又一家大型企业。难道这会重演[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreVicore]Vicore]]事件吗？ 随着跃迁准备警报开始在阿尔戈号 的走廊中回响，船员们聚集在全息桌周围。 杨俯身查看数据，神情警惕。“Dunianshire VI。那可不是什么边缘哨站。即便位于内层星域边缘，威严金属 也是最大的工业企业之一。他们什么都制造。机甲机体框架、装甲板、武器结构，甚至大型大气处理设备。如果他们在那里藏了一个秘库，那里面的不只是有价值。很可能是尖端技术。” 法拉点开一份数据记录，皱着眉头。“秘库埋在他们的一处旧原型设施下面，与[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGiggleswick]Giggleswick]]附近的Factory Circumference Alpha相连。那里是他们突击机甲部门的研发核心。可能是武器设计图，也可能是结构强化技术……但可以确定，[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]部落]]想要完整获取它。” 苏米尔挑起眉毛。“等等，[[DM.SystemDefs[starsystemdef_Dunianshire].OwnerValue.FactionDef{DM.SystemDefs[starsystemdef_Dunianshire].OwnerValue.FactionDef.Name}]]知道我们要来吗？Dunianshire 可是他们的领地。而且威严公司自己的安保部队怎么办？如果他们看到我们的机甲朝着他们的黑色项目地点推进，我们确定他们不会直接开火吗？” 沉默降临，没有人回答。你们彼此对视。 达吕斯耸了耸肩。“我们有坐标，有授权标记，还有任务。只能相信阿蕾尔已经处理好了她那边的事情。” 苏米尔低声嘀咕：“对。相信监察部。绝对不会出问题。” 你点了点头。决定已经做出。阿尔戈号 的航向锁定。威严公司的秘库正在Dunianshire VI 等待，而无论里面藏着什么，明尼苏达部落已经开始行动。

column1: Carath Prime looms dry and red below, its surface scorched by sun and scarred by collapsed bunkers from a long-failed dream. Once a remote military project of the [[DM.Factions[faction_RimWorldsRepublic],Rim Worlds Republic]], the planet is now being repurposed by the [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]] as a crucible for training and recovery. A forge hidden beneath centuries of sand and silence. A secure Hyperpulse transmission arrives. 星上校 Arelle Jorgensson appears at the holotable, composed but unflinching. "The Tribe's presence here is no accident. They're shaping officers, digging through Star League wreckage, and preparing for something far larger. We will deny them that future." She motions to a set of tactical readouts, each one blinking with target designations. "There are three primary objectives." "First, they've established a cadet training range. The recruits are active, and instructors are on-site. Eliminate them before they can be deployed." "Second, a salvage team has uncovered a buried [[DM.Factions[faction_SLDF],SLDF]] installation. Recover the tech before the Tribe extracts or destroys it." "Third, a permanent training facility is under their control. Capture it. We need the infrastructure and whatever intelligence is inside." Her tone hardens. "All three operations are mandatory. Choose your first, but once selected, you'll have fourteen days to deploy. Delay, and we risk losing the advantage." The channel cuts. Below, Carath Prime waits, harsh, ancient, and once again a battlefield.
column2: Carath Prime 在下方显现，干燥而赤红. 它的地表被烈日灼烧，遍布因一场早已失败的梦想而遗留下来的废弃掩体. 这里曾是[[DM.Factions[faction_RimWorldsRepublic]Rim Worlds Republic]]的一项偏远军事计划所在地，如今正被[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]Minnesota Tribe]]重新利用，作为训练与恢复基地. 一座埋藏在数百年沙尘与沉寂之下的熔炉. 一条安全超脉冲通讯接入. 星上校阿蕾尔·约根森出现在全息桌前，神情镇定，却毫不动摇. “部落在这里的存在并非偶然. 他们正在培养军官，挖掘星盟遗迹，并为某个规模更大的计划做准备. 我们不会让他们拥有那个未来.” 她示意一组战术数据，每一项都闪烁着目标标识. “这里有三个主要目标.” “首先，他们建立了一处学员训练场. 新兵正在训练，教官也驻扎在那里. 在他们能够被部署之前消灭他们.” “其次，一支回收小队发现了一处埋藏的[[DM.Factions[faction_SLDF]SLDF]]设施. 在部落转移或摧毁其中科技之前，夺取这些技术.” “第三，一座永久训练设施目前处于他们控制之下. 夺取它. 我们需要那里的基础设施，以及其中保存的任何情报.” 她的语气变得更加严厉. “三项行动全部必须完成. 选择你的第一个目标，但一旦选定，你将有十四天时间进行部署. 拖延行动，我们可能会失去优势.” 通讯中断. 下方，Carath Prime 等待着——残酷、古老，并再次成为战场.

column1: Developed by Majesty M&M from battle data gathered in engagements with the 布雷克圣言会's patterns of 凤鹰 Battle机甲s, the Agrotera is a fast, hard-hitting Medium '机甲 packed with some of the most cutting-edge technology available. An XL 300 fusion engine and 240-meter jump capacity give the Agrotera excellent agility for it's weight class, while 9.5 tons of 装甲 keep it reasonably safe against the hits that do land. The Agrotera is no slouch giving hits back, sporting an ERPPC linked to an advanced 驱动器增强系统, backed by a Medium VSPL. A single normal 中型脉冲激光 and a pair of 小型脉冲激光s round out the Agrotera's arsenal and leave it well equipped to handle virtually any battlefield threat, entirely independent from supply line restrictions. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: Agrotera由Majesty M&M根据与布雷克圣言会的Phoenix Hawk战斗机甲作战收集的战斗数据开发而成，是一款快速且火力凶猛的中型机甲，搭载了多项最前沿技术. XL 300核聚变引擎与240米的跳跃能力赋予了Agrotera在其重量级别中出色的机动性，而9.5吨装甲则能在遭受攻击时提供合理的防护. Agrotera在还击方面也毫不逊色，装备有一门与先进手臂驱动器增强系统联动的增程PPC，并辅以一门中型VSPL. 此外，还配备了一门普通中型脉冲激光和两门小型脉冲激光，构成了Agrotera完整的武器系统，使其完全不受补给线限制，能够应对几乎所有战场威胁. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 1.02

Its extra 10 tons allow for an Angel ECM suite and CASE II 装甲 integrated into Light Ferro-Fibrous plating. Though slightly hotter running, the Hai carries more 装甲 and retains similar mobility. column1: Several days have passed since Liberation Day. The three Ghost Bear civilians are gone, transferred to Joanna's custody along with the two rescued Tribe operatives who kept talking about purges and blood debts. The crew hasn't spoken much about any of it since the transfer, but the atmosphere aboard the Argo remains tense and uncertain. Everyone's working, performing their duties with professional efficiency, but the easy camaraderie that used to fill the corridors has been replaced by something more strained. The HPG relay activates with an incoming transmission using Tribe encryption protocols. Joanna McEvedy appears on the viewscreen, her expression focused and professional, all business today with no trace of the zealotry that colored her previous communications. Her tone is tactical, efficient, matter-of-fact. "Commander [[COMMANDER.LastName,{COMMANDER.LastName}]]. We've identified a high-value target that requires immediate action. The [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] maintains a forward intelligence post in a remote region of St. Andreas that coordinates surveillance of [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]] movements across the entire Periphery sector. This installation has been tracking our cell locations, monitoring our communications, and feeding precise targeting data to Watch strike teams for months." She transmits tactical data to the main display, showing facility schematics and regional maps. "Our intelligence network has identified a narrow operational window where the garrison will be at reduced strength due to a scheduled rotation cycle. Your objective is to capture the facility intact and extract all intelligence data from their computer systems before Watch command can initiate remote purge protocols. We need to know the full scope of their surveillance operations against our people. The data inside those servers could reveal Watch operational plans against dozens of our cells across the sector and potentially save hundreds of lives." "Expected opposition includes standard garrison forces protecting the installation, nothing beyond typical military resistance. The location is remote and isolated from major population centers, which means minimal risk of third-party interference or civilian complications during the operation." She pauses, meeting the camera directly with an expression of professional concern. "This intelligence could save lives, Commander. Our people are being hunted systematically because Watch intelligence knows where they are, who they talk to, how they move. This data tells us exactly how they know all of that. It's a defensive operation, not an offensive strike. We need this information to protect our cells from future raids." The transmission ends, leaving silence filling the briefing room as the crew processes what they just heard. Darius pulls up the mission data on his console and reviews it methodically. "This looks like a standard base capture on paper. Military intelligence post, isolated location, and with clear objectives. It's really textbook stuff." He looks up from the display with visible caution in his expression. "But after what we've learned in recent operations, I want independent verification before we commit. Farah, can you cross-reference the facility coordinates against known Watch deployment records and civilian databases during transit? I want to confirm this installation is actually what Joanna says it is." Farah nods slowly, her expression thoughtful and careful. "I can access civilian databases and compare satellite imagery if we have it available. See if the installation profile matches what Joanna's describing in her briefing. It'll take some time to compile everything, but we should have solid answers before we arrive." "The operation itself sounds legitimate from a military standpoint. Capturing enemy intelligence installations is standard warfare doctrine. But given recent discrepancies, I want to verify what we can independently." Yang leans against the wall with his arms crossed, his skepticism plain on his face. "Mission makes sense on paper, I'll give her that. Intelligence post, surveillance data, defensive objective to protect your own people from enemy strikes. That's all textbook legitimate military operations." "But I don't trust anything Joanna sends us anymore without checking it twice, maybe three times. We verify everything before we pull triggers from now on." Sumire brings up navigation data and regional analysis on her console. "Remote location confirmed by independent stellar cartography. Population density in the target region is extremely low, with the nearest civilian settlement located approximately eighty kilometers from the facility coordinates." "The isolation factor works in our favor from a tactical perspective. Limited reinforcement potential for the garrison means we can control the engagement envelope more effectively." Darius reviews the mission parameters one final time before looking up at you. "Boss, this looks clean from every angle I can see. Military target, clear objective, isolated location with minimal civilian risk. Nothing in the briefing suggests questionable targeting or the kind of intelligence problems we've encountered before." "But we verify everything during transit anyway. Farah checks the databases for inconsistencies. I cross-reference Watch deployment patterns against historical records. Sumire analyzes whatever satellite data we can access. We go into this operation with full information this time, not blind trust." The crew exchanges glances around the briefing room, and the tension is palpable despite the apparently legitimate mission parameters. No one is enthusiastic about working for Joanna anymore. No one is eager to accept her intelligence at face value. But no one can identify an obvious problem with this particular operation either. The target appears to be exactly what she claims it is.
column2: 解放日之后，数日已经过去。三名幽灵熊平民已经离开，被转交给Joanna照管，连同那两名获救的部落行动人员一起，他们一直在谈论清洗和血债。自从交接之后，船员们很少再提起这些事，但阿尔戈号上的气氛依旧紧张而不安。每个人都在工作，以专业的效率履行自己的职责，但曾经充斥走廊的轻松友好氛围，已经被一种更加紧绷的感觉所取代。 HPG中继器启动，接收到一条使用部落加密协议的传输。Joanna McEvedy出现在视屏上，她的表情专注而专业，今天完全是一副公事公办的模样，之前通讯中那种狂热的色彩已经不复存在。她的语气冷静、精准、直接。 “指挥官[[COMMANDER.LastName{COMMANDER.LastName}]]。我们已经确认了一个需要立即行动的高价值目标。[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]Ghost Bear Watch]]在St. Andreas 的一处偏远区域设有前沿情报哨站，负责协调对整个边垂区域[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]部落]]行动的监视。这个设施一直在追踪我们的据点位置，监控我们的通讯，并且数月来持续向监察队打击小队提供精确的目标数据。” 她将战术数据传输到主显示屏上，展示设施结构图和区域地图。 “我们的情报网络发现了一个狭窄的行动窗口，在预定轮换周期期间，该驻军的兵力将会减少。你的任务是完整夺取该设施，并在监察队指挥部启动远程清除协议之前，从他们的计算机系统中提取所有情报数据。我们需要知道他们针对我们人员的监视行动究竟达到何种规模。那些服务器中的数据可能会揭示监察部针对该区域数十个我们据点的行动计划，并有可能挽救数百人的生命。” “预计敌方抵抗力量包括保护设施的标准驻军部队，不会超出常规军事抵抗范围。该地点偏远且远离主要人口中心，这意味着行动期间第三方干涉或平民问题的风险极低。” 她停顿片刻，直视镜头，脸上带着专业而关切的神情。 “这份情报可以拯救生命，指挥官。我们的人员正在被系统性猎杀，因为监察部的情报掌握着他们的位置、他们交谈的对象以及他们的行动方式。这些数据会告诉我们，他们究竟是如何掌握这些信息的。这是一场防御行动，而不是进攻行动。我们需要这些情报来保护我们的据点免受未来袭击。” 通讯结束，沉默充满了简报室，船员们都在消化刚刚听到的信息。 达吕斯在控制台上调出任务数据，仔细地进行审查。“从表面上看，这就是一次标准的基地夺取行动。军事情报设施，偏远位置，而且目标明确。说真的，这就是教科书式的任务。” 他抬头看向显示屏，脸上明显带着谨慎。“但在我们从最近几次行动中了解到那些事情之后，我希望在投入行动前进行独立验证。法拉，你能在航行途中将设施坐标与已知监察部部署记录以及民用数据库进行交叉比对吗？我想确认这个设施确实如Joanna所说的那样。” 法拉缓缓点头，表情沉思而谨慎。“我可以访问民用数据库，并在有可用资料的情况下对比卫星图像。看看设施特征是否符合Joanna简报中的描述。整理这些信息需要一些时间，但我们抵达之前应该能得到可靠答案。” “从军事角度来看，这个行动本身听起来是合理的。夺取敌方情报设施属于标准战争准则。但考虑到最近出现的那些偏差，我希望能独立验证我们能够确认的信息。” 杨靠在墙边，双臂交叉，脸上的怀疑毫不掩饰。“这个任务从表面上看确实合理，我承认。情报哨站，监视数据，为保护己方人员免受敌方打击而进行的防御目标。这些都是标准且合理的军事行动。” “但现在Joanna发送的任何东西，我都不会再不加验证地相信。以后我们会检查两遍，甚至三遍。每次扣下扳机之前，都必须确认一切。” 苏米尔在控制台上调出导航数据和区域分析。“通过独立恒星测绘确认了目标地点的偏远性。目标区域人口密度极低，最近的平民定居点距离设施坐标约八十公里。” “从战术角度来看，孤立因素对我们有利。驻军增援能力有限，这意味着我们能够更有效地控制交战范围。” 达吕斯最后一次检查任务参数，然后抬头看向你。“老板，从我能看到的所有角度来看，这个任务都很干净。军事目标，明确目标，偏远地点，以及最低程度的平民风险。简报里没有任何迹象表明目标选择存在问题，也没有出现我们之前遇到的那类情报问题。” “不过，我们还是会在航行途中完成所有验证。法拉检查数据库中的异常。我将监察部部署模式与历史记录进行交叉比对。苏米尔分析我们能获取的所有卫星数据。这一次，我们会掌握完整信息再行动，而不是盲目信任。” 简报室里的船员们互相交换目光，尽管任务参数看起来完全合理，但紧张感依旧明显。没有人再热衷于为Joanna工作。没有人愿意直接接受她提供的情报。但也没有人能够指出这次行动存在明显的问题。目标看起来确实就是她所描述的那个目标。

column1:
You and Darius are networking in a planetside bar when a familiar voice cuts through the din. An impossible voice. Rance was a family bodyguard who'd abandoned his post on that fateful night, long ago, when your family was betrayed. You killed him for it.

But that's Rance stumbling into your table. "Hey," he slurs. "Can you spare any C-bills? I have to get offworld. I need to stay a step ahead of the devil!"

Amused, Darius prompts the drunk with, "What does the devil want with you?"

Rance freezes like a prey animal. "Revenge! {COMMANDER.Callsign} wants revenge!"
column2:
你和达吕斯正在行星地表的一家酒吧里拓展人脉，突然一个熟悉的声音穿透了嘈杂. 那是一个你认为绝不可能再响起的声音. 兰斯曾是家族保镖，在多年前那个宿命之夜，当你的家族惨遭背叛时，他擅离职守了. 你为此亲手杀了他.

可此刻，兰斯却踉踉跄跄地撞上了你们的桌子.“嘿”他口齿不清地嘟囔道.“能匀几块星币吗? 我得离开这颗星球. 我得跑在魔鬼前头，快他一步才行！”

达吕斯明显被逗乐了，故意逗弄这个醉汉:“那魔鬼找你干什么?”

兰斯像只受惊的猎物般僵住了.“复仇！{COMMANDER.Callsign}要找我复仇！”

column2: 这个新版本移除了小型激光器，并将中型激光器升级为一对 ER 中型激光器。重量减轻使得可以包含 C3i 计算机。

column1: Too slow for a melee mech, if you ask me. Mostly the fault of that hardwired internal combustion engine. At least it deals with most overheating problems without issue. Good 'baby's first melee mech' for the rookies, since it's very survivable, but don't expect to spend much time in the thick of things.
column2: 如果你问我的话，对于近战机甲来说太慢了。主要是硬连线内燃机的故障。至少它可以毫无问题地处理大多数过热问题。对于新手来说，这是一个很好的“宝宝的第一个近战机甲”，因为它的生存能力很强，但不要指望在最激烈的情况下花费太多时间。

column1: Built by the same company that made the Saracen and Scimitar, the Saladin was Scarborough's last medium hover tank. It is unlike its brothers in that the Saladin does not mount a turret, and its only weapon is a heavy, short-range AC/20. Since it's vastly different from the company's other hovercraft, buyers were quite skeptical about purchasing it; Scarborough had to offer incentives like free training and transportation. Soon it became as cheap as the Saracen and spread throughout the whole Inner Sphere. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 90 20 左侧 45 20 右侧 45 20 后方 25 20 总计 205 80 特性：坚固
column2: 萨拉丁由制造萨拉森和弯刀的同一家公司出品，是斯卡伯勒最后一款中型悬浮坦克。它与其他兄弟型号不同——萨拉丁没有炮塔，唯一的武器是一门重型近程AC/20。由于与该公司其他悬浮车差异极大，买家对采购颇有疑虑；斯卡伯勒不得不提供免费培训与运输等优惠。不久它便与萨拉森一样便宜，并传遍整个内层星域。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 装甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 135 20 左侧 90 20 右侧 90 20 后方 65 20 总计 380 80 特性：坚固

column1: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by 氏族地狱马. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 30 Left 170 30 Right 170 30 Rear 125 30 Turret 150 30 Total 795 150 Quirk: 主战坦克

column1: The first custom configuration used by the infamous Bounty Hunter of the time of the initial 氏族入侵, it mounted a 大型脉冲激光 and a 中型脉冲激光 in each arm. It also had a 中型脉冲激光 in both the left and right torso with a Clan Light TAG in the center torso. A 轻型 主动探头, ECM suite, and a 瞄准计算机 provided stealth and increased accuracy. Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: The first custom configuration used by the infamous Bounty Hunter of the time of the initial Clan Invasion, it mounted a Large Pulse Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser in each arm. It also had a Medium Pulse Laser in both the left and right torso with a Clan Light TAG in the center torso. A 轻型 Active Probe, ECM suite, and a Targeting Computer provided stealth and increased accuracy. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: Someone thought the Hatchetman couldn't kill well enough at arm's length and came up with the -3X. It's brimming with as many short range weapon systems as its well-armored chassis can take. This is truly death at point blank range, Boss. Just watch the heat on this one.
column2: 有人认为，”刽子手“在近战战中不够致命. 所以3X诞生了. 该机甲配备了尽可能多的短程武器，装甲有精良的底盘. 如果那东西靠得太近，就是那个，老板. 你应该只关注热量的发展.

column1: The Ajax Assault Tank is an Omni-capable combat vehicle that is the follow-up to GM's Challenger X MBT. The Ajax follows on the heels of the successful Manteuffel OmniVehicle. The Ajax is slow, only capable of attaining speeds up to 54 km/h. Since speed is not its defense, the designers gave the Ajax nineteen tons of armor. The room for all of this armor comes from the XL Engine the Ajax uses for power. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 370 45 Left 310 45 Right 310 45 Rear 220 45 Turret 360 45 Total 1570 225 Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 万能车辆

column2: 在黑暗中，视野范围显著缩短. 然而，满月将能见度提升了 10%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: 猎手机甲 X 型装备异常厚重的装甲以及 2 门 LBX5 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 静止使用强大的虚空签名系统，这款猛禽II型是在早期RISC试验期间设计的，旨在将更先进的作战套件和战术弹药投入战场 特质: 改良冷却套 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 又一次紧急会议。达里乌斯说："指挥官，我们又遇到一波'外围痘'疫情。目前只有 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 出现症状。" 苏米蕾说："好吧，那 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:get|Default:gets} {TGT_MW.Det} 专属的医疗舱，直到 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers} 为止。我们之前投资采购的痘病抗病毒药还能用，但星系当局建议我们再配合针对当地病毒株的药物，这要花我们 ¢40,000。" 苏米蕾的目光变得悠远。"有了医院级的设施、抗病毒研究，再加上足够的时间和资金，我们就能研制出能预防所有当地病毒株的血清。"
column2: 命令{TGT_MW.Callsign}在{TGT_MW.OBJ}恢复的时候进行练习.

column1: 战狼以原始类地上有史以来建造过的最大投石机命名，它搭载重型近距离武器：成对的SRM、连发SRM和脉冲激光器。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 在共和国晚期问世的此变体，在每个侧躯各安装了五支小型增程激光，用于支援右臂搭载的一门 TSEMP 炮. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: 莫迪斯是由星际军团工业公司在卡佩拉联邦和自由世界联盟的分支机构设计的. 作为一型快速重型机甲，莫迪斯拥有十三吨装甲、150米的跳跃距离和86公里/小时的最高速度. 莫迪斯将其主要武器配置在双臂上. 右臂搭载的五吨战斧非常适合在近身搏斗中造成粉碎性打击，而左臂的重型粒子加农炮则能有效洞穿敌方装甲. 为了在接近莫迪斯机师偏好的近距离时袭扰敌军，右躯干装有一具MML-5并配有两吨弹药. 为了提供更多火力，中央躯干还安装了一具火箭发射器10. 特质: 近战驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂
column2: 火焰行者(150): 热量伤害抗性 +10%:\n\n

column1: 这款皇帝由卡佩兰工程师在氏族入侵前夕开发，是标准 5A 的改装型。它装备新推出的箭矢 IV 发射器和两门大型激光，5B 旨在提供远程火力支援。 Quirk: 改良冷却套-激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 梅林1D型是圣战时期对梅林机甲进行的战场改装，它移除了1C型配备的粒子加农炮和反步兵武器，替换为一门高斯步枪和两吨弹药. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The Zeus 5T is an original model Zeus and makes use of Star League technology to make a much more deadly mech. Just as fast as the -6S, the -5T switches the autocannon for a devastating array of energy weapons which combined with the -5T's double heat sinks is a brutal combination. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯机甲最初由天琴共同体于2787年建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发之际. 应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官对新锐轻型突击机甲的需求而研发，宙斯的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，并且同样有能力击败它们. 宙斯 5T 是宙斯的原始型号，利用了星际联盟技术，打造成一台更为致命的机甲. 与-6S型一样迅捷，-5T型将自动炮替换为毁灭性的能量武器阵列，配合双散热器，构成了一种凶残的搭配. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: No surprise pirates got their Hands on a Trashcan, it is a surprise how they managed to 'repair' the mangled and broken Autocannon and welded 2 RocketLauncher onto the poor thing.
column2: 毫不奇怪，海盗们拿到了一个垃圾桶，令人惊讶的是他们如何设法“修复”受损和破损的自动加农炮，并将 2 个火箭发射器焊接到这个可怜的东西上。

column1: The Thunder Fox TFT-F11 is protected by over twenty tons of 加固装甲. The head carries a Clan-built ER PPC and a targeting computer in a head turret. To make room for the turret, this Thunder Fox uses a torso-mounted cockpit. To make room for the torso cockpit, it uses a compact gyro and a larger XXL engine allows it walk at 58 km/h while reaching a top speed of 74 km/h. It also has five standard jump jets, allowing it to cover 150 meters in a single jump. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2:
雷狐TFT-F11型披覆逾二十吨硬化装甲，其头部炮塔搭载一具氏族制造增程粒子加农炮与火控系统. 为容纳炮塔结构，本机采用躯干驾驶舱设计，配合紧凑型陀螺仪与大型XXL引擎，使其能以时速58公里行进且极速可达74公里. 五具标准跳跃推进器令其单次跳跃跨越150米距离.

column1: The primary configuration of the Bee can deal decent amounts of damage if left uncontested with its 大型脉冲激光 in each arm and LRM-5 launcher in the left torso. A 守护者ECM suite and 主动探头 ensures that the Bee even can handle basic Electronic Warfare. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: The primary configuration of the Bee can deal decent amounts of damage if left uncontested with its Large Pulse Laser in each arm and LRM-5 launcher in the left torso. A Guardian ECM suite and Active Probe ensures that the Bee even can handle basic Electronic Warfare. Quirk：Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The 'Mech's most prominent weapon is the 短管PPC augmented with a PPC Capacitor. The SNPPC is backed up by a MML-3 and a pair of ER medium lasers. The 'Mech is powered by a GM 210-rated extralight fusion engine, which gives it enough speed to keep up with most combat vehicles. The 'Mech's hull is protected by six and a half tons of standard armor and CASE II protects ammunition stored in the left torso. Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 该机甲最突出的武器是加装PPC电容器的短管粒子加农炮. 短管粒子加农炮由一座MML-3导弹发射器和两门中型增程激光提供火力支援. 机甲搭载一台通用210型超轻型聚变引擎，使其拥有足以跟上大多数战斗车辆的速度. 机身由六吨半标准装甲提供防护，左躯干弹药库采用CASE II防护系统. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 左上肢

column1: Brocchi's Cluster contains what appears to be the remnants of a large planet in the "green zone" of this Class M star, which at some point has exploded into a large asteroid belt.  Over 40 inhabited planetoids and constructs exist in the area.
column2: Brocchi's Cluster中似乎包含一颗位于这颗M型恒星“绿区”内的大型行星的残骸，这颗行星在某时爆炸，形成了一条巨大的小行星带. 该区域内存在 40 多个有人居住的小行星体和构造物.

column1: The Kontio is a clawed melee monstrosity, able to charge foes at a staggering 172 km/h with both the TSM and Supercharger activated. The fact that the '机甲 is also shrouded in cutting edge Stealth 装甲, making it even harder to detected before it strikes its target has given the Kontio a reputation of being a pilot killer. It offers a poor death on the end of its claws. Enemy pilots either avoid Kontios or target them, for fear of a messy end. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.08
column2: Kontio是一台利爪杀戮机器，在TSM和增压器同时激活时能以惊人的172公里/小时速度冲向敌人. 这台机甲还覆盖着尖端潜行装甲，使其在攻击前更难被探测到，因此Kontio赢得了“机师杀手”的称号. 在其利爪之下，死亡将是无比惨烈的. 敌方机师要么避之不及，要么就将其视为首要目标，唯恐落得个支离破碎的下场. 特质: 扰敌 部署费用倍率: 1.08

column1: This Republic variant uses the failed Condor Trans-Track as a base chassis. It removes the lift skirts and other hover-related components in favor of a fifty ton tracked chassis. Equipped with an LB 5-X autocannon, LRM-15, and two machine guns, it serves in the Republic Standing Guard. It can reach a top speed of 96 km/h thanks to an XL Fusion engine. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 200 25 Left 120 25 Right 120 25 Rear 80 25 Turret 125 25 Total 645 125 Quirk: 主战坦克

column1: Once the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat found out about the Urbiestator, they immediately acquired a number of them and created the UMS-R9999 experimental variant. Even though filled with a lot of the cutting edge technology, such as Superheavy Ferro-Alloy Armor, the design was never seen as of any real value due to its huge issues with heat management, but the existing copies can still be found on the battlefield.
column2: 共和国战略作战研究所发现Urbiestator后，立即购买了一批并创建了UMS-R9999实验变体。尽管充满了许多尖端技术，例如超重型铁合金装甲，但由于其热管理方面的巨大问题，该设计从未被视为具有任何实际价值，但现有的副本仍然可以在战场上找到。

column1: Converts an SHS engine to Radical CHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
column2: 将单散热(SHS)引擎转换为激进型紧凑散热(激进型CHS)引擎. 机甲的散热系统为机甲内部的组件提供散热，并为遍布机甲的额外散热器提供兼容扩展点. 它不同于引擎本身的封闭式冷却系统.

column1: The REDMIC, or REmote Delivery Magnetic Inhibitor Cannon, is a cutting edge experimental prototype weapon focused on delivering highly magnetically charged soft slugs onto enemy mechs. Upon impact the slug deforms and attaches itself to the target unit, causing their gyros to overload with resulting large stability issues. Developed by a former RISC team for the Scorpion Empire, the only currently known platform is specially modified Tercio Superheavy 'Mechs.
column2: REDMIC，即远程投送磁力抑阻加农炮，是一种尖端的实验性原型武器，专注于将高磁性软质弹丸发射到敌方机甲上. 命中时弹丸会变形并附着于目标单位，导致其陀螺仪过载，从而引发严重的稳定性问题. 该武器由前RISC团队为天蝎帝国研发，目前已知的唯一搭载平台是经过特殊改装的Tercio超重型机甲.

The removal of the standard weapons systems allows for the installation of an AC/2 and a PPC, inverting the usual Urbanmech load out. Deployed as a fire support and AA mech alongside infantry and 装甲 units, the UM-R62’s range more than makes up for its slow speed and lack of heavy firepower. 怪癖: 360° Torso Twist 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The personal 'Mech of Lamenkov's Liability MechWarrior Syngman Seong-Hwan, Syngman was gifted the heavily damaged 'Mech after its original pilot died. While he was able to maintain its Clantech base chassis, he was forced to use Inner Sphere technology 全向Pods, mounting a 可伸缩刀刃 and Inner-Sphere-grade plasma rifle in the right arm, and a Heavy PPC and IS-tech ER 中型激光 in the left arm. Carrying two tons of reloads for the plasma rifle, to enhance his effectiveness with the rest of his Lance, Syngman's 'Mech also mounted an IS-standard 比格犬主动探头, 守护者ECM Suite and C3 slave. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 拉门科夫责任有限公司的专属机甲，由机甲战士成焕·成万驾驶. 原机师阵亡后，成万获赠了这台严重受损的机甲. 虽然他成功保留了其氏族科技的基础底盘，但被迫使用内天体科技的万能荚，右臂装备了一把可伸缩刀刃和内天体级别的等离子步枪，左臂则配备了一门重型粒子加农炮和一具内天体技术的中型增程激光. 为提升等离子步枪的续航能力并增强与其余小队的协同作战效能，成万的机甲还携带了两吨弹药，同时搭载了内天体标准的猎犬主动探测器、守护者电子对抗套件以及C3从机. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Ostsol OTL-4DR was an attempt by Ostmann Industries to create a version of the 'Mech that could be built faster and handled hot environments better. Replacing all weapons with a pair of ER PPCs, switching to 双散热器 and adding a C3 Slave unit did not meet the goals and the variant was never built in any larger volumes. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Ostsol OTL-4DR是奥斯特曼工业公司试图打造的一款能更快生产且更适应高温环境的机甲型号. 他们移除了所有武器，换装两门增程粒子加农炮，改用双倍散热器并加装C3从机，但这一方案未能达成预期目标，该型号从未进行过大规模量产. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Developed by both ComStar and the 布雷克圣言会, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less armor than the KTO-19. Retaining only the two SRM launchers, the LRM launcher was dropped and the standard medium lasers were upgraded to more advanced ER 中型激光s, enhanced by a switch to 双散热器. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 由通讯之星和布雷克圣言会共同开发的KTO-21，是首台同时搭载新型改进纳克导弹信标（简称iNarc）与改进型C3计算机系统的机甲. 为了容纳这些新系统，KTO-21换装了钢内骨结构，并比KTO-19减少了半吨装甲. 仅保留两具短程火箭发射器，移除了远程导弹发射器，并将标准中型激光升级为更先进的中型增程激光，同时通过改用双重散热器来提升散热能力. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Ubiquitous across the Inner Sphere, the Igor is a name given to a generic super heavy lift platform. Originally developed to rapidly relocate heavy armor under battlefield conditions, the design has since spawned a host of imitators and copy cats with almost every developed world in the Inner Sphere and the Periphery possessing at least one Igor or Igor derived clone. An FWL combat model of the 60 ton VTOL, the Igor (L-Gauss) mounts a pair of 轻型高斯步枪s and a C3 Slave unit. A combination of an XL Engine and 重型铁纤维装甲 armor boosts the VTOL’s speed and protection. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 175 30 左侧 125 30 右侧 125 30 后方 100 30 总计 550 150 特性：坚固

column1: The Marksman M1 Tank series first began field trials in 3088 for the 球体共和国 on Terra. The tank shares a name with the ancient SLDF 神射手自行火炮, a fact the RAF anticipates being able to exploit against opponents. Unlike the older vehicle, this vehicle was created as a main battle tank for the 球体共和国. All of the vehicle's weaponry is mounted on the tank's turret. The tank's long range armament consists of its M-7 Gauss Rifle with two tons of ammunition and two MRM10 packs with a ton of ammunition. For short-range weaponry the vehicle has two Streak SRM4s with a ton of ammo, and two SRM6s with a ton of ammo. For use against infantry, it has four Bulldog miniguns with a half ton of ammunition. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters.
