column1: Quizel Narf has been described as either one of the greatest or one of the worst pirate lords to have ever graced the history books.\\n\\nBorn on a backwater world in the Circinus Federation, Narf grew up hearing stories of daring raids, buried treasure, and fortunes won and lost. Enthralled by these tales, even if most weren't true, Narf quickly decided the pirate's life was for him and, at the young age of 17, joined his first pirate crew.\\n\\nThere Narf stood above his peers, proving to be both cunning, fearless, and a natural at finding hidden 'booty'. These qualities soon found Narf rising through the ranks of command until the age of 26, when the entire crew he was serving under was wiped out in a Lyran sting operation.\\n\\nBarely escaping himself, Narf decided to start his own crew instead of joining someone else's. It was here that Narf's true talent was discovered: his ability to recruit people to his cause. Such was his talent that before his 30th birthday, Narf found himself a pirate lord, having recruited enough people to create and run no less than a dozen different crews - all under his command.\\n\\nDespite his disdain for politics, Narf's power meant he was a household name within the loosely governed Federation, and he soon found himself a central figure of it. It is here that the Federation's craze with raccoons is said to have come from, as Narf was so fond of the Terran raccoon that he underwent numerous surgeries in the nearby Magistracy of Canopus until he outwardly looked like one.\\n\\nUpon learning of the Clan invasion of the Inner Sphere, Narf fantasized of leading the Federation to become a Clan itself, less out of a desire to be recognized as a member of a warrior-people and more because he thought it would be funny and would annoy other Clans to no end. A mere five years later, taking full advantage of the Word of Blake's Jihad, Narf and his crews manged to pull off one of the greatest feats any pirate ever has: not only landing on - but sacking - Strana Mechty itself. While Clan reinforcements drove the pirates off-world within hours and years later altered their histories to state the sacking never happened, it did not stop Narf from proclaiming himself Khan of a new Clan known as "Skull-Squid". While no Clan would ever recognize the claim - in fact, some actively attempted to kill the now infamous pirate lord - it did not stop Narf or his crews from using the term whenever possible.\\n\\nThat is not to say all of Narf's plans went off without a hitch, and one of his greatest failures came with his alliance to Hans O'Reilly and his attempt to help place him on the throne of the Marian Hegemony. When the Circinus invasion badly backfired, Narf's legendary status within the Federation was dimmed for several years.\\n\\nNarf's final fate is not clear. What is known is that the Republic of the Sphere attacked and tried to murder him during his own wedding, successfully assassinating his bride-to-be. Reports from the time are hazy, and it is not clear one way or another if Narf himself was killed. For years after the incident, sightings of the famous Raccoon-Pirate continued to occur, and the Federation itself grew fat off the pirate activity as it preyed on the helpless Free Worlds League. However, none of these sightings could ever be confirmed, nor could the enrichment of the Federation be directly tied to Narf.\\n\\nIn the end however, perhaps it doesn't matter if Narf died that day or lived to plunder for years more. His stories were already out there, his exploits both real and made up inspiring new generations of pirates. And after we are gone, our stories are what remain.\\n\\n
column2: 奎泽尔·纳尔夫被描述为历史书上最伟大的海盗领主之一，或者是最糟糕的海盗领主之一。\\n\\n纳尔夫出生在马戏努斯联邦的一个偏僻世界，他从小就听着大胆的袭击、埋藏的宝藏以及财富得失的故事长大。纳尔夫被这些故事所吸引，尽管大多数故事都不是真的，但他很快就决定海盗的生活适合他，并在 17 岁时加入了他的第一批海盗船队。\\n\\n在那里，纳尔夫站在同龄人之上，事实证明他既狡猾、无所畏惧，又天生擅长寻找隐藏的“战利品”。这些品质很快让纳夫在指挥队伍中不断晋升，直到 26 岁，他手下的所有船员都在一次天琴星诱捕行动中被消灭。\\n\\n勉强逃脱的纳夫决定组建自己的船员，而不是加入别人的队伍。正是在这里，纳尔夫的真正才能被发现了：他招募人才加入他的事业的能力。纳夫的天赋如此之高，以至于在他的 30th 生日之前，纳夫发现自己是一名海盗领主，招募了足够多的人来创建和管理至少十几个不同的船员 - 全部都在他的指挥之下。\\n\\n尽管他蔑视政治，纳夫的权力意味着他在管理松散的联邦中是家喻户晓的人物，他很快就发现自己成为了联邦的核心人物。据说联邦对浣熊的狂热正是源于这里，因为纳夫非常喜欢人族浣熊，以至于他在附近的卡诺普斯裁判官接受了无数次手术，直到他外表看起来像浣熊。\\n\\n在得知族群入侵内层后，纳夫幻想着领导联邦本身成为一个族群，更多的是因为他认为这会很有趣，而且会永远惹恼其他族群。仅仅五年后，纳尔夫和他的船员充分利用了布莱克圣战的话语，成功地完成了海盗有史以来最伟大的壮举之一：不仅登陆，而且洗劫了斯特拉纳·梅赫蒂本身。虽然部落增援部队在数小时内将海盗赶出了世界，几年后又改变了他们的历史，声称这次劫掠从未发生过，但这并没有阻止纳夫宣称自己是一个名为“骷髅乌贼”的新部落的可汗。虽然没有一个氏族会承认这一说法——事实上，有些氏族积极试图杀死这位现在臭名昭著的海盗领主——但这并没有阻止纳尔夫或他的船员们尽可能地使用这个词。\\n\\n这并不是说纳尔夫的所有计划都顺利进行，他最大的失败之一是他与汉斯·奥莱利结盟，并试图帮助他登上玛丽安霸权的王座。当Circinus入侵严重适得其反后，纳尔夫在联邦中的传奇地位被暗淡了好几年。\\n\\n纳尔夫的最终命运尚不清楚。已知的是，球体共和国在他自己的婚礼上袭击并试图谋杀他，成功刺杀了他的准新娘。当时的报道很模糊，也不清楚纳尔夫本人是否被杀。事件发生后的许多年里，著名的浣熊海盗的目击事件不断发生，而联邦本身也因海盗活动而发财，因为它掠夺了无助的自由世界联盟。然而，这些目击事件都无法得到证实，联邦的富裕也不能与纳尔夫直接联系起来。 \\n\\n然而，最终，也许纳尔夫是在那一天去世还是继续掠夺多年并不重要。他的故事已经广为人知，他的功绩既真实又鼓舞了新一代的海盗。当我们离开后，我们的故事仍然存在。\\n\\n

column2: “北极狼（Arctic Wolf）”的设计理念很简单: 快速接近，倾泻导弹风暴，然后迅速撤离. 与猎群者一样，设计中使用的部分材料来自凯尔猎犬，但就核心技术而言，这完全是氏族科技的设计. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

The Capellans added a third medium laser, making this variant of the Raven an effective scout hunter. It can set easy ambushes because its 隐身装甲 gives it an advantage against scouts. column1: The 布雷克圣言会 re设计ed the Firestarter to produce a new variant in 3070, that could be better integrated into their units. An additional ton of 装甲 is added when compared to the S and it is upgraded to Light Ferro-Fibrous. The chassis has been replaced with an Endo Steel model, and a Light Fusion Engine provides power. Three Flamers are devastating to conventional units, while an ER 中型激光 provides firepower against hardened targets. A C3i Computer allows it to share targeting data from other units. The use of single heat sinks is confusing in such a unit, and it means that the -B can build heat quickly. It uses eight 改进的 Jump Jets to cover 240 meters in a jump. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 布雷克圣言会在3070年重新设计了纵火者，制造出一种新型号，以更好地融入其部队. 与S型相比，它增加了一吨装甲，并升级为轻型铁纤维材质. 底盘被更换为钢内骨结构型号，由一台轻型聚变引擎提供动力. 三门火焰喷射器对常规部队能造成毁灭性打击，而一门中型增程激光则提供对抗硬目标的火力. C3i计算机使其能共享其他部队的瞄准数据. 使用单散热器在这种单位中令人困惑，这意味着-B型会迅速积累热量. 它使用八台改进型跳跃推进器，单次跳跃可覆盖240米距离. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Battle Hawk was originally 设计ed and built at a time when 迪法恩斯工业 felt threatened by the large amount of equipment being 生产 by, and imported from, the Free Worlds League. It was built to prove that 迪法恩斯工业 was still an industry leader in Battle机甲s. This came from a '机甲 that, while slow for its weight class, is a force to be reckoned with on the modern battlefield. The Battle Hawk has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, which puts it on par with '机甲s fifteen to twenty tons heavier than itself, but it also carries a powerful arsenal for its size. Its five and a half tons of 装甲 give it good protection for a light '机甲. Additionally, to make the Battle Hawk more maneuverable on the battlefield, it can jump up to one hundred and fifty meters. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: 战斗鹰最初设计并制造之时，正是迪法恩斯工业感受到来自自由世界联盟大量生产并进口装备的威胁之际. 它的诞生是为了证明迪法恩斯工业依然是战斗机甲领域的行业领导者. 这一成果体现为一台虽在同重量级中速度较慢，但在现代战场上却不可小觑的机甲. 战斗鹰的最高时速为86.4公里，与比自己重十五到二十吨的机甲持平，同时就其体型而言，它还搭载了强大的武器系统. 其五吨半的装甲为一台轻型机甲提供了良好的防护. 此外，为在战场上更加灵活，战斗鹰能够跳跃高达一百五十米. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 0.99

This leads to four 短管PPC, two ATM-12 launchers, two Re-engineered Large Lasers, two Pepperbox Rifles and a even a Laser AMS for anti-missile defense. Like the other Ettins, it also has a foot mounted weapon in form of a 中型激光. Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: DX是一种奇特的机械兽. 它将大量不同类型的疯狂海盗技术与一些相当先进的内天体装备结合在一起，这意味着制造商必定能够接触到多种不同的供应来源. 这造就了其搭载的四门短管PPC、两具ATM-12发射器、两门改造型大型激光、两把多管步枪，甚至还有一套用于反导防御的激光反导系统. 和其他埃廷机甲一样，它的脚部也安装了一门中型激光作为武器. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.4

column1: Hardened Armor is a thicker armor type that uses multiple overlapping plates to provide additional protection against enemy fire. Though capable of diverting more damage than standard armor, the increased number of armor plates and their lack of flexibility makes any unit employing it more difficult to pilot, and can affect the speed as well. Activatable: DEALS DAMAGE AND CRIT TO CENTER TORSO ON FAILURE
column2: 加固装甲是一种更厚的装甲类型，使用多层重叠的装甲板来提供额外的防护以抵御敌方火力. 尽管它能比标准装甲偏转更多伤害，但增加的装甲板数量及其缺乏灵活性使得使用它的任何单位更难以驾驶，并且也会影响速度. 可激活: 失败时对中央躯干造成伤害和暴击

column1: The Bounty Hunter and his Associates have near-perfect Called Shots and deal [AMT] more damage with all attacks.
column2: 赏金猎人及其伙伴的精准射击近乎完美，并且所有攻击会多造成[AMT]伤害.

column1: Spider I1 是边疆世界推出的廉价改装型，配备一具等离子切割器和一具流体枪，装甲也有所小幅改善。 Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
column2: 科米努斯配置在每只手臂上各安装了一门氏族中型脉冲激光，并在左右侧躯干各装有一具10型火箭发射器. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.97

column1: Now this I can work with, boss. No finicky pulse lasers or high tech missile launchers to babysit, just honest guns even a Periphery wrench-turner can keep running. Cheap, tough, and it still hides behind that big shield. VEST knew their market.
column2: 现在我可以合作了，老板。没有挑剔的脉冲激光器或高科技导弹发射器来照顾，只有诚实的枪支，即使是外围扳手也可以继续运行。便宜、坚固，而且它仍然隐藏在那个大盾牌后面。 VEST 了解他们的市场。

column1: The Fulcrum Hover Tank was first brought into production by Cyclops Incorporation of Skye in 3057. The vehicle was initially stationed along the Lyran Alliance's Periphery and Free Worlds League borders, where its low maintenance needs were a boon for worlds that had not seen much of the newest technological advances. The vehicle had continued to perform well during the FedCom Civil War and during the early Jihad. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 275 25 左侧 180 25 右侧 180 25 后方 150 25 炮塔 210 25 总计 995 125 特性：Agile
column2: 支点悬浮坦克于3057年由斯凯的独眼巨人公司首次投产。该车最初驻扎在莱兰联盟的外围与自由世界联盟边界一带，其低维护需求对那些少见最新技术进展的星球而言是件好事。在联邦共和内战与圣战初期，该车持续表现良好。生态限制：无。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 250 25 左侧 135 25 右侧 135 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 210 25 总计 830 125 特性：敏捷

column1: For completing every Argo upgrade, you gain a bonus of 25,000 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 完成阿尔戈号所有升级后，你会获得25，000分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: For each contract completion, you gain 50 points per point of difficulty of the contract. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每个已完成的合约，每一级合约难度你会获得50分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: Not designed for traditional combat, the Carrier is a force multiplier. Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of armor isn't a concern. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 30 Left 100 30 Right 100 30 Rear 80 30 Total 380 120 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 并非为传统战斗设计  Carrier是力量倍增器. Carrier设计用于从远处支援友军  可以留在友军战线后方  在那里它缺乏装甲的问题并不令人担忧. 生态限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 30 左侧 100 30 右侧 100 30 后方 80 30 总计 380 120 特质: 狭窄/低矮轮廓 #武器: 3x LRM-20

column1: The Blizzard Hover Transport was designed by Kressly Warworks and was first produced in 3054. While the Blizzard was intended for use against the Clans, it gained notoriety in the Chaos March and its effectiveness was realized in the Capellan-St. Ives War. The only weaponry integral to the Blizzard is a turret-mounted LongFire V LRM-5. This enables the speedy vehicle to remain out of range for most weapons, yet still contribute to the fight once its infantry bays are debarked. It can even hide behind cover and rely on infantry units to spot so it can fire indirectly. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 60 15 Left 50 15 Right 50 15 Rear 45 15 Turret 45 15 Total 250 75 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Can Resupply/Repair Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Blizzard Hover Transport由Kressly Warworks设计  并于3054年首次生产. 虽然Blizzard原本是为了对抗氏族而设计  但它在混沌三月中声名狼藉  其有效性在卡佩兰-圣艾夫斯战争中得到了体现. Blizzard唯一的集成武器是安装在炮塔上的LongFire V LRM-5. 这使得这种高速载具能够保持在大多数武器的射程之外  同时一旦其步兵舱卸载后仍能参与战斗. 它甚至可以隐藏在掩体后面  依靠步兵单位进行侦察  从而间接开火. 环境限制: 由于使用内燃机  该单位无法部署在月球或火星环境. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 60 15 左侧 50 15 右侧 50 15 后方 45 15 炮塔 45 15 总计 250 75 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 可补给/维修 可搭载1个战斗装甲小队. 有射击孔. #武器: 1x LRM-5

column1: Converts an SHS engine to Radical PDHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
column2: 将单散热(SHS)引擎转换为激进型原型双散热(激进型PDHS)引擎. 机甲的散热系统为机甲内部的组件提供散热，并为遍布机甲的额外散热器提供兼容扩展点. 它不同于引擎本身的封闭式冷却系统.

column1: It's a small gesture, but even a little attention helps. Soon requests come pouring in from the crew for books and periodicals originating in systems all across the Periphery and the Inner Sphere.
column2: 这虽是个小举动，但即使一点点关注也会有所帮助. 很快，船员对产自外围和内天体各个星系的书籍和期刊的需求就蜂拥而至.

column1: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 195 30 Left 160 30 Right 160 30 Rear 125 30 Turret 160 30 Total 800 150 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: Manticore是有史以来设计最精良、最强大的重型坦克之一  专为支援步兵编队对抗战斗机甲而打造. 尽管Manticore配备了多种武器以应对各种战斗角色和射程  并且对于其重量的载具来说装甲厚重  但它并未装备足以应对诸如Demolisher或Behemoth等突击级载具的原始火力. 尽管如此  Manticore的受欢迎程度一直居高不下  即使在继承战争时代  尽管其使用了昂贵且稀有的聚变引擎. 最初由TechniCorp在统一战争期间开发  在阿马里斯政变期间该公司位于泰拉的总部被摧毁后  随着其他制造商吸收其设施  Manticore扩散至内天体各处. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 195 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后方 125 30 炮塔 160 30 总计 800 150 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x AMS 1x MML-7 1x 重型PPC

column1: The Björn Prime configuration balances versatility and range by pairing an ER PPC with an ATM-9, allowing it to serve as a capable harasser from long to close range. This combination makes the Prime effective in flexible combat roles. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Björn Prime 配置通过将一门增程PPC 与一台 ATM-9 搭配，在多功能与射程之间取得了平衡，使其能在远距离到近距离范围内胜任袭扰者的角色. 这一组合令 Prime 在灵活多变的战斗角色中表现出色. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.03 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用.

column1: Sorry everyone, we just have too much on our plates right now. Let someone else handle the Raptors.
column2: “抱歉大家，我们现在手头的事实在太多了。让别的什么人去对付猛禽吧。”

column1: One of three Command versions of the Shieldmaiden, the OC has an heavily 装甲ed 指挥控制台, C3 Master computer and Angel ECM to aid the battlefield commander. A combination of five different 反导系统s ensures the '机甲 can still fulfill its defensive duties, while two Light AC/5 and four ER Large Laser provide some self-defense capabilities. Fur further protection a 13 ton Shield is carried in the left arm. 怪癖: 防御职责 掉落成本乘数: 1.39 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 女盾卫的三种指挥型之一，OC型配备了重装甲指挥控制台、C3主计算机和天使ECM系统，为战场指挥官提供辅助. 五种不同反导系统的组合确保该机能继续履行其防御职责，而两门轻型AC/5和四门大型增程激光则提供了一定的自卫能力. 为进一步防护，左臂还携带了一面重达13吨的盾牌. 特质: 防御职责 部署费用倍率: 1.39 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: This mech is terrifying. Oh, sure it can produce a lot of firepower, but I'm mostly scared because of how damn much ammo is in the side torsos. That knock-off Quicsell CASE II is the only thing keeping you from a very impressive death if you so much as look at the internals of the mech. Oh, and did I mention that Quicsell CASE can be destroyed with a good shot? Suddenly, there goes seven tons of high explosives; and that's just in the one torso!
column2: 这机甲太恐怖了哦，当然它可以产生大量的火力，但我最害怕的是因为侧面躯干有那么多该死的弹药。如果你仔细看看机甲的内部结构，那件山寨版的 Quicsell CASE II 是唯一能让你避免令人印象深刻的死亡的东西。哦，我有没有提到过，Quicsell CASE 可以用一枪摧毁？突然，七吨烈性炸药飞了出去；那只是在一个躯干中！

column1: The -4S variant, that first saw use during the FedCom Civil War, is intended for close-range combat. The vulnerable XL Engine has been replaced with a sturdier Light Fusion Engine, and has been re设计ed to use an Endo Steel internal structure. The '机甲 is armed with a 重型高斯步枪 as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a 大型脉冲激光, two 中型脉冲激光s, and a pair of ER 中型激光s. 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: The -4S variant, that first saw use during the FedCom Civil War, is intended for close-range combat. The vulnerable XL Engine has been replaced with a sturdier Light Fusion Engine, and has been re设计ed to use an Endo Steel internal structure. The '机甲 is armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Large Pulse Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a pair of ER Medium Lasers. 怪癖: Hyper-Extending Actuators 掉落成本乘数: 1.1

column1: While the chassis of this UrbanMech may be a stock -R60 from the now-destroyed Orgus Industries factories, almost nothing of the original loadout remains. Two 短管PPCs occupy the weapon mount previously housing the AC/10, and a 变色龙偏振护盾 system has been installed. Eleven double heat sinks keep the 'Mech barely cool. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 尽管这台城市机甲的底盘可能来自现已毁坏的Orgus工业工厂的标准型-R60，但原始装备几乎荡然无存. 两门短管粒子加农炮占据了原先AC/10的武器挂点，并安装了变色龙轻型偏振盾系统. 十一部双散热器勉强让这台机甲保持低温. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The TNS-7D refines the TNS-4S, keeping proven systems and upgrading weaknesses. A ClanTech pulse laser and missile launcher extend range and precision, while an advanced electronics suite boosts accuracy and shields the ’Mech from targeting. Critics note its conventional C³ slave instead of a boosted model, but consider this a minor drawback. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: TNS-7D 对 TNS-4S 进行了精炼优化，保留了成熟的系统并改进了薄弱环节. 一门氏族科技的脉冲激光与导弹发射器拓展了射程并提升了精度，而先进的电子设备套件则增强了命中率，同时使这台机甲免受敌方锁定的困扰. 评论者指出其仅搭载了常规型号的 C³ 从机，而非增强型号，但这被视为一个微不足道的缺陷. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: A jack of all trades, the Medium tank is the generic stereotype of a tank. Trading speed or weapons for armor, the Medium Tank can soak up a surprisingly heavy level of fire power. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 185 25 左侧 145 25 右侧 145 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 735 125 特性：主战坦克
column2: 多面手中的多面手，中型坦克就是坦克的典型刻板印象。它用速度或武器换取装甲，能够承受出乎意料之多的火力。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 170 25 左侧 120 25 右侧 120 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 150 25 总计 660 125 特性：可变距离瞄准

column1:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 和你一起去 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 的一座主要城市采购补给。行程接近尾声时，你发现有人在跟踪你们。没过多久，一个满身脏污、笑容阴狠的男人挡在 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 面前。“我们找你很久了，{TGT_MW.Firstname}。”他说着，又有几个人影围了上来。

你打量了一下那个男人。“{TGT_MW.Callsign}，这是怎么回事？”

“啊，这是我以前认识的一个小混混，指挥官。那是在我跟着你之前的事了。我觉得他现在不太喜欢我。”
column2: 不还清{TGT_MW.Callsign}的债务就离开{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.

column1: The Improved Railgun is a recent creation of the Clans, using the latest Clan technology to further lower its weight. The result is a smaller and lighter weapon, that still manages to retain or even improve upon the typical characteristics of the original except for its range. To compensate for the shorter range, a new special firing mode has been developed that increases the range considerably at the cost of less damage by undercharging the firing rail. Uses Railgun Ammo. VOLATILE!
column2: 【Improved Railgun (C)】改进型磁轨炮是氏族近期研发的成果  采用最新的氏族科技进一步降低了重量. 其成果是一种体积更小、重量更轻的武器  同时除了射程之外  依然保留甚至强化了原版磁轨炮的典型特性. 为了弥补射程缩短的问题  他们开发了一种新的特殊射击模式  通过降低磁轨炮的充能强度来减少伤害  从而大幅提高射程. 使用磁轨炮弹药. 易爆！

column1: Darius stolls in to begin the morning briefing with a less than happy look on his face, "Does anyone want to take a wild guess as to what we found opening our latest shipment of machine tools? Anyone? Well, let me tell you what we found..." Yang, trying hard to keep a straight face, blurts out, 'frozen [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTacoTruck],Taco Truck Mince]]'..." Darius looks straight at Yang, "You arranged this, didn't you!?" Yang is now grinning like a Canopian Cat Girl, "That stuff is more gold than even [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F Burger]] meat! Do you know how rare this stuff is to acquire?" Dr. Murad sits up, an interested look on her face, "Please tell me that you know what to do with this stuff. We do not need another MedBay incident." "Shouldn't be a problem Doc. Taco Truck franchises are all mobile, so their mince is designed to be moved about all the time. As long as the galley has all the spices, we will be in Taco Heaven! — my team will take care of the goods and [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] wants to help me." Yang flashes you a winning smile. "In fact, I know someone else who's family actually started Taco Truck. If we can convice [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] to help in the galley, we'll have the best tacos you have ever tasted! What do you say, Commander? You want some tacos on the menu?"
column2: 达吕斯一脸不悦地走进来开始早晨简报，“有人想猜猜看，我们打开最新一批机床货运箱时发现了什么吗? 有人吗? 好吧，让我告诉你们我们发现了什么……” 杨努力保持严肃的表情，却脱口而出:“冷冻的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTacoTruck]Taco Truck Mince]]……” 达吕斯直直盯着杨，“这是你安排的，对吧!?” 杨现在笑得像一只坎诺普斯猫女，“那东西比[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger]Triple-F Burger]]的肉还要珍贵 ! 你知道这东西有多难弄到吗?” 穆拉德博士坐起身，脸上露出感兴趣的表情，“请告诉我你知道该怎么处理这些东西. 我们可不需要再发生一次医疗舱事故.” “应该没问题，博士. 塔可餐车连锁店都是移动式的，所以他们的肉馅设计之初就是为了经常搬运. 只要厨房里有所有香料，我们就能进入塔可天堂!——我的团队会负责处理这些货物，而[[TRT_MW{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]也想帮我.”杨向你露出一个胜券在握的笑容.“事实上，我还认识另一个人，他的家族就是塔可餐车的创始人. 如果我们能说服[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]来帮忙管理厨房，我们就能拥有你吃过的最好吃的塔可! 怎么样，指挥官? 要不要把塔可加入菜单？”

column1: Ashkum is a minor planet on the Fed/Capellan border.  Recently conquered by the Feds, it remains a typical "border world" - under开发 and over garrisoned.
column2: Ashkum是联邦与卡佩拉边界上的一颗次要星球. 最近被联邦征服后，它仍是一个典型的“边境世界”——欠发达且驻军过多.

column1: Fast and versatile, the Light Tank is poorly suited to direct combat but has a variety of other uses. Intended as a scout or vanguard unit, the Light Tank is constantly on the move, probing ahead of the rest of the troops. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. column1: Darius stolls in to begin the morning briefing with a less than happy look on his face, "Does anyone want to take a wild guess as to what we found opening our latest shipment of machine tools? Anyone? Well, let me tell you what we found..." Yang, trying hard to keep a straight face, blurts out, 'frozen [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTacoTruck],Taco Truck Mince]]'..." Darius looks straight at Yang, "You arranged this, didn't you!?" Yang is now grinning like a Canopian Cat Girl, "That stuff is more gold than even [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F Burger]] meat! Do you know how rare this stuff is to acquire?" Dr. Murad sits up, an interested look on her face, "Please tell me that you know what to do with this stuff. We do not need another MedBay incident." "Shouldn't be a problem Doc. Taco Truck franchises are all mobile, so their mince is designed to be moved about all the time. As long as the galley has all the spices, we will be in Taco Heaven! — my team will take care of the goods and [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] wants to help me." Yang flashes you a winning smile. "In fact, I know someone else who's family actually started Taco Truck. If we ever bump into him, do not hesitate to employ him as we'll then have the best tacos you have ever tasted! What do you say, Commander? You want some tacos on the menu?"
column2: 达吕斯一脸不悦地走进来开始早晨简报， “有人想猜猜看，我们打开最新一批机床货运箱时发现了什么吗? 有人吗? 好吧，让我告诉你们我们发现了什么……” 杨努力保持严肃的表情，却脱口而出:“冷冻的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTacoTruck]Taco Truck Mince]]……” 达吕斯直直盯着杨，“这是你安排的，对吧!?” 杨现在笑得像一只坎诺普斯猫女，“那东西比[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger]Triple-F Burger]]的肉还要珍贵 ! 你知道这玩意有多难弄到吗?” 穆拉德博士坐起身，脸上露出感兴趣的表情，“请告诉我你知道该怎么处理这些东西. 我们可不需要再发生一次医疗舱事故.” “应该没问题，博士. 塔可餐车连锁店都是移动式的，所以他们的肉馅设计之初就是为了经常搬运. 只要厨房里有所有香料，我们就能进入塔可天堂!——我的团队会负责处理这些货物，而[[TRT_MW{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]也想帮我.”杨向你露出一个胜券在握的笑容.“事实上，我还认识另一个人，他的家族实际上就是塔可餐车的创始人. 如果我们哪天遇到他，千万不要犹豫，直接雇佣他，这样我们就能拥有你吃过的最好吃的塔可! 怎么样，指挥官? 要不要把塔可加入菜单?”

column1: The 黄蜂 was built around the Poland Model C Gauss rifle. Subsequent version mounted other system, but it remained centered around as single heavy weapon. Though not as fast as most VTOLs, the 黄蜂 still has greater speed than most BattleMechs and OmniMechs. The long range weapons, respectable speed and relatively heavy armor keep the vehicle safer than many of it's peers. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 15 Left 75 15 Right 75 15 Rear 55 15 Total 320 75 Quirk: 突破一击
column2: Yellow Jacket围绕Poland Model C高斯步枪建造. 后续版本安装了其他系统  但它仍然以单一重型武器为核心. 虽然不如大多数VTOL快  但Yellow Jacket的速度仍然超过大多数战斗机甲和万能机甲. 远程武器、可观的速度和相对厚重的装甲使该载具比许多同类更安全. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境部署. 移动: 6/9格 / 180/270米. 装甲: 反应式装甲板 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 15 左侧 75 15 右侧 75 15 后方 55 15 总计 320 75 特质: 突破一击 #武器: 1x 短管重型高斯步枪

column1: Named for an ancient Nordic kenning meaning wave-swine, the Unnsvin was designed from the ground up to carry 战斗装甲 into combat. However this example has had the bay stripped and replaced with bomb racks. It is decently fast and moderately well armored. The one weakness of the Unnsvin is that its personal armament is weak and it is not a very capable combat unit in its own right. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 250 10 Left 250 10 Right 250 10 Rear 250 10 Total 1000 40 Quirk: Distracting
column2: Unnsvin的名字来源于古北欧语  意为“波浪之猪”  它从设计之初就是为了将战斗装甲带入战场. 然而  这个型号已经移除了搭载舱  取而代之的是炸弹架. 它速度不错  装甲也还算可以. Unnsvin的一个弱点是其个人武装较弱  单独作为战斗单位能力有限. 环境限制: 此单位无法在月球环境部署. 移动: 6/9格 / 180/270米. 装甲: 反应装甲 结构: 标准结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 250 10 左侧 250 10 右侧 250 10 后方 250 10 总计 1000 40 特质: 干扰 #武器: 4x 中型激光 3x 炸弹舱

Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 14/21 hexes / 420/630 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 95 15 Left 55 15 Right 55 15 Rear 50 15 Total 270 75 Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光

column1: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast Omni机甲 that has respectable firepower. This light '机甲 is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous 装甲. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The E configuration carries four Flamers, two AP Gauss Rifles, and for heavier enemies it carries a pair of Heavy 中型激光s and an SRM-4 launcher. An ECM Suite is mounted in the head. It also has enough jump jets to cover 150 meters in a jump. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 地狱犬是冰狱氏族的产物，体现了他们崇尚速度高于一切的哲学. 基于雾森猁的设计，地狱犬是一款兼具可观火力的快速万能机甲. 这台轻型机甲相当难以击杀，采用了五吨半的铁纤维装甲. 为减轻重量，地狱犬还使用了钢内骨结构. 虽然就其体型而言它并不算特别快，但它确实配备了MASC，能提供额外的爆发速度. 地狱犬的机身上没有固定武器. E型配置搭载了四门火焰喷射器、两门AP高斯步枪，为对付更重型的敌人则携有一对中型重激光和一具SRM-4发射器. 头部装有ECM套装. 它还拥有足够的跳跃喷口，一次跳跃可覆盖150米. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: A Star League era fire support platform, the 长bow is an 85 ton Assault 机甲 and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence. The LGB-13C is armed with a sextet of LAC-5’s, supported by a pair of ER 中型激光s and an ER Small. 2 B-Pods are installed in the legs with a C3 Slave and a 守护者ECM Suite also installed. A 255-rated Engine, DHS and an Endo Steel chassis round out the design. Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 星际联盟时代的火力支援平台，长弓是一款85吨的突击型机甲，也是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一. LGB-13C型配备了六联装LAC-5轻型自动炮，并辅以两门中型增程激光和一门小型增程激光. 腿部装有两具B型荚舱，同时还搭载了C3从机和守护者ECM套件. 255级引擎、双散热系统及钢内骨结构完善了整体设计. 特质: 防空锁定 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

This loadout trades the earlier variants' balanced ranged options for concentrated bombardment, letting it batter targets with sustained mortar fire while the pulse lasers handle closer threats. Quirk: 防护驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

column1: A proposed Dark Age overhaul of the classic 凤鹰, the PHX-99 is a unique take on the standard 凤鹰. Emphasizing armor over mobility, the PHX-99 is coated in 加固装甲, reinforced by a Heavy Duty Gyro and 模块化装甲. To fit this in, the engine has been downgraded to a 50-rated Fusion Core, forcing the Mech to rely on a pair of 改进型跳跃推进器 for mobility. Armed with a 大型X脉冲激光 Laser, a pair of ER 中型激光s and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the PHX-99 is considered a failed prototype for a reason. Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: A proposed Dark Age overhaul of the classic Phoenix Hawk, the PHX-99 is a unique take on the standard Phoenix Hawk. Emphasizing armor over mobility, the PHX-99 is coated in Hardened Armor, reinforced by a Heavy Duty Gyro and Modular Armor. To fit this in, the engine has been downgraded to a 50-rated Fusion Core, forcing the Mech to rely on a pair of Improved Jump Jets for mobility. Armed with a Large X-Pulse Laser, a pair of ER Medium Lasers and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the PHX-99 is considered a failed prototype for a reason. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

column1: Developed by 伯洛克氏族 to augment second line units, the Dervish IIC is a rebuild of a number of Star League Dervishes found in a Brian Cache. Eventually spreading to other Clans, the 设计 would prove to be a dependable and tough 机甲, with a production line opening in 3000 to meet the Burrocks needs. Armed with a pair of LRM-15's and an ER Large Laser for ranged combat; the 55 ton Dervish IIC-2 is powered by a 275 rated Fusion Core. 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 由穴熊氏族为增强二线部队而开发的德维什IIC型，是对一系列在布莱恩遗存中发现的星际联盟时代德维什机甲的再设计. 该机型最终流传至其他氏族，被证明是一种可靠且坚固的机甲，并于3000年开设生产线以满足穴熊氏族的需求. 55吨级的德维什IIC-2型配备一对LRM-15导弹发射器与一门大型增程激光用于远程作战，其动力核心为一台275级核聚变引擎. 特质: 超伸展型驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Someone over at Quicsell decided to see how fast they could make an Assault mech run. The answer is exactly this fast. If you take out the shitty Quicsell ammo, and those useless light machineguns, this actually stands to do some good work. You know, as the worlds largest Medium mech, since that's the role it'll fill on the battlefield.
column2: Quisell 的某人决定看看他们能让突击机甲跑多快。答案就是这么快。如果你拿出那些糟糕的Quicsell弹药和那些无用的轻机枪，这实际上可以起到一些很好的作用。你知道，作为世界上最大的中型机甲，因为这就是它将在战场上扮演的角色。

column1: A prototype that only ever entered limited development, the 2G swaps the standard HAG-20 for a Gauss rifle. An XL engine freed up the tonnage needed to mount the rifle and allowed for the incorporation of a light active probe. Needless to say, this wasn’t popular with most the warriors assigned to it. Production was eventually cancelled in 3074, due to unacceptably high losses under combat conditions. 怪癖: 360° Torso Twist 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 一种仅进行有限开发的原型机，2G型号将标准的HAG-20换装为一门高斯步枪. 一台超轻型引擎腾出了安装该步枪所需的吨位，并允许集成轻型主动探测器. 不必多说，这种配置在多数被分配到该机型的战士中并不受欢迎. 由于在战斗条件下损失率高得难以接受，该机型最终于3074年停止生产. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: This variant takes the primary configuration, downgrades the pulse laser to an ER Medium and replaces the Machine Guns with three Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles.
column2: 该变体采用主要配置，将脉冲激光降级为 ER 中型，并用三支杀伤人员高斯步枪取代机枪。

column1: The K config is equipped with a Rotary AC/2 and ton of ammunition in the right arm while the left arm carries a single ER 大型脉冲激光. Additional protection comes from a 激光反导系统. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: The K config is equipped with a Rotary AC/2 and ton of ammunition in the right arm while the left arm carries a single ER Large Pulse Laser. Additional protection comes from a Laser Anti Missile System. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The Sköll C configuration is a close-combat bruiser with a 150-meter jump capacity, an ATM-6, and five 中型脉冲激光s tied to a 定位 Computer. Its accuracy and agility make it extremely deadly in urban or close terrain. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sköll C型配置是一种近战搏斗者，拥有150米跳跃能力，配备一台ATM-6和五门连接目标计算机的中型脉冲激光. 其精准度和敏捷性使其在城市或近距离地形中极为致命. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.05 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用.

column1: The Particle Recycler Module is an extra component that can be added to most types of IS or CE Particle Projector Cannons. The module captures excess energy and reuses it for follow-up shots; effectively, lowering weapon heat generation per shot.
column2: 【Particle Recycler Module】粒子回收模块是一种额外组件，可加装到大多数类型的内天体或氏族粒子加农炮上. 该模块捕获多余能量并将其用于后续射击; 实际上降低了每次射击的武器热量产生.

column1: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by 氏族地狱马. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 30 Left 145 30 Right 145 30 Rear 145 30 Turret 145 30 Total 735 150 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: Enyo Strike Tank是由地狱战马氏族生产的战斗载具. 在Mars的XL引擎变体成功后  Khan Malavai Fletcher命令他的科学家种姓设计一种主战坦克  能够利用轻量引擎带来的速度优势. 他的继任者James Cobb喜欢这个想法  并维持了这种概念验证的要求. 科学家们的劳动成果就是Enyo. 它能够达到97公里/小时的速度  这使它能够跟上许多氏族中型机甲. 七吨半的铁纤维装甲保护着坦克  使其能够承受一些打击  尽管速度是它最好的防御. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 10/15格 / 300/450米. 装甲: 铁纤维(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 155 30 左侧 145 30 右侧 145 30 后方 145 30 炮塔 145 30 总计 735 150 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x 大型增程脉冲激光(氏族)

column1: After 氏族地狱马 forces' invaded the 蛇夫座自治领 during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. The Mastodon's performance after its introduction makes it inevitable that it will be at the forefront of many campaigns to come. The heavily reinforced structure resists both weapons fire and the standard wear and tear that accompanies most campaigns. The D configuration serves as the long range, indirect configuration of the Mastodon designs. To achieve this a total of four LRM-15 and two LRM-20 launchers were added to the 'Mech. Two 中型脉冲激光s are also mounted for additional defense. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 3147年，地狱战马氏族在“诺言行动”中入侵蛇夫座自治领后，巨象型机甲应运而生，标志着其军队主力从依赖多种处刑者变体的组合模式发生了重大转变. 巨象型机甲问世后的卓越表现，使其注定将成为未来诸多战役中的先锋力量. 其经过大幅强化的机体结构既能抵御炮火轰击，又能承受多数战役伴随的常规损耗. D配置作为巨象型设计的远程间接火力型号，为此在机体上加装了四具LRM-15和两具LRM-20发射器，另配备两门中型脉冲激光用以增强防御. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, 氏族地狱马 began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry vehicle, which they called the Bellona. Designed as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the vehicle cited that 'speed is armor', which led to the Bellona being redesigned as a hovertank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 25 Left 105 25 Right 105 25 Rear 105 25 Turret 135 25 Total 605 125 Quirk: Nimble
column2: 在3060年代末  在可汗詹姆斯·科布的指挥下  地狱之马氏族开始准备在内层领域重新建立存在. 科学家种姓将此视为创建一种新型骑兵载具的机会  他们将其命名为Bellona. 作为打击者和侧翼包抄者设计的Bellona  在足够灵活的车架上携带足够的火力  以跟上甚至最快的推进线. 最初的规格要求使用履带  但该载具的试飞员指出“速度就是装甲”  这导致Bellona被重新设计为悬浮坦克. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 155 25 左侧 105 25 右侧 105 25 后方 105 25 炮塔 135 25 总计 605 125 特质: 灵巧 #武器: 4x 轻机枪(氏族) 1x 火焰喷射器(氏族) 1x LRM-10(氏族) 1x 大型增程激光(氏族)

column1: An 3074 advanced tech variant developed during the Jihad by NAIS. The standard armor is switched for Light Ferro-Fibrous, which slightly reduced the 'Mech's armor protection. column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>Darius's voice cuts through the intercom, urgent and strained.</color>

"Commander, get to the conference room. You've got a call coming in, and trust me, this one's unexpected."

<color=#BFBFBF>He's already waiting when you arrive, arms crossed, tension clear on his face.</color>

"It's about those mechs. The ones from the convoy op. Someone claims they've got information."

<color=#BFBFBF>The comm panel blinks, waiting to be answered. Whoever's on the line might be the first real lead you've had since this whole mess began.</color>
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>达吕斯的声音从对讲机中传来，急促而紧绷。</color>

“指挥官，快到会议室来。您有一通来电，而且相信我，这通电话出乎意料。”

<color=#BFBFBF>当你抵达时，他已经等在那里，双臂交叉，脸上明显带着紧张。</color>

“是关于那些机甲。车队行动里的那些。有人声称他们有情报。”

<color=#BFBFBF>通讯面板闪烁着，等待应答。无论在线那头是谁，都可能是自这堆烂摊子开始以来，你遇到的第一个真正线索。</color>

column1:
Just got a power spike in MedBay, Sumire announces. "Must've fried something. The power is out down there."

A few minutes later, Darius and Dr. Murad are discussing options. "It's a major relay; to replace it, I'll need to shut down everything connected to it for several hours. You'll have life support and not much else."

Darius asks, "Can we just repair the relay, without shutting everything down?"

Dr. Murad frowns. "Possibly, but I wouldn't recommend that approach. We'd likely just be putting MedBay's problem off to deal with later."
column2:
“医务室刚刚出现电力尖峰”苏米尔告知.“一定烧坏了什么，那里的电全没了.”

几分钟后，达吕斯和穆拉德博士在讨论应对方案.“这是一个主继电器. 要更换它，我需要关闭所有与之相连的设备好几个小时. 你们只能有生命维持系统，其它几乎全部无法运行.”

达吕斯问道，“我们能不能只修复中继器，而不关闭所有设备?”

穆拉德博士皱起眉头.“可能可以，但我不建议这样做. 那样我们很可能只是把医务室的问题推迟到以后再处理.”

Pilots must use careful positioning and cover to ensure its survival, while making use of its Gauss rifles to strike at enemies from afar. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17
column2: 哈尔帕戈斯是地狱战马氏族的一款重型战斗机甲，专为远程作战而设计. 哈尔帕戈斯配备了两门高斯步枪，能在极限距离上造成毁灭性的精确打击伤害. 虽然没有装备跳跃推进器，但它拥有64公里/小时的最高速度，可用来重新部署位置并与敌人保持距离. 它的装甲也足够厚重，能够承受敌人的攻击，使其成为战场上的可怕对手. 不过，哈尔帕戈斯的轮廓较大，且与其他重型战斗机甲相比速度较慢. 机师必须谨慎利用走位和掩体来确保其生存，同时善用高斯步枪从远处打击敌人. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.17

column1: A unique Champion variant, the Invictus is a custom build 设计ed for the battlefields of the Jihad. Built around an Endo Steel frame and 300-rated XL engine; the mech is clad in Light Ferro-Fibrous 装甲. The Invictus is armed with a Large Laser and 锁定式SRM-4 in each arm, supported by a 锁定式SRM-6 in each side torso. Four tons of Streak SRM reloads, four jump jets and eleven double heat sinks give it surprising longevity and agility in battle. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 一款独特的冠军型号，无敌者是为圣战战场定制的特装型号. 该机甲采用钢内骨结构骨架和300级别超轻型引擎，外部覆盖轻型铁纤维装甲. 无敌者的每只手臂各装有一门大型激光和锁定式SRM-4，两侧躯干各配备一门锁定式SRM-6. 四吨锁定式弹药储备，四台跳跃推进器和十一具双重散热器使其在战场上具有惊人的续航力与机动性. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂控制机构限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox T is armed with an ER Large Laser and a PAC/4. An ER 中型激光 and a 锁定式SRM-4 make up the close range firepower, with a Supercharger and an 主动探头 filling the rest of the available pod space. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Ray Headley, or "Jockstrap", had it all - the fame, the fortune, and the love of the crowd. He's best known as the Star Gladiator for the Golden Suns, a Solaris team with an impressively high record of coring out 'Mech engines. He unceremoniously earned his nickname when, during a match against an opposing team of Urbanmechs, a bump on the cockpit of his Firestarter dislodged the MechWarrior from his seat right into his good-luck trophy. The object slammed between him and the cockpit, opening mic channels and breaking his communications relay as he yelled out to world those infamous words: "...Thank God I remembered my Jockstrap!"\\n\\n
column2: 雷·海德利（Ray Headley），又名“Jockstrap”，拥有一切——名声、财富和群众的喜爱。他最出名的身份是金太阳队的明星角斗士，这是一支索拉里斯队，在机甲引擎方面有着令人印象深刻的高记录。在与对方的 Urbanmechs 队的比赛中，他的 Firestarter 驾驶舱发生碰撞，将 MechWarrior 从座位上撞到了他的好运奖杯上，因此他毫不客气地赢得了这个绰号。该物体猛烈地撞击在他和驾驶舱之间，打开了麦克风通道并中断了他的通讯中继，同时他向世界喊出了那些臭名昭著的话语：“……感谢上帝，我记得我的护体裤！”\\n\\n

column1: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. column1: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike '机甲 that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the 球体共和国. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A 比格犬主动探头 allows the Ghost to find enemy units, while Stealth 装甲 and a 守护者ECM Suite allows the '机甲 to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins. This variant 开发 in 3087 replaces the standard weapons with a pair of 大型脉冲激光s, an ER Small Laser, and a single SRM-6. Built around an Endo Steel skeleton, this version uses a Defiance 300 Light Fusion Engine and standard 装甲 with CASE to protect itself. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: 幽灵是在圣战后期作为“狮鹫（Griffin）”的补充而开发的，是一种中型打击机甲，在球体共和国成立后的多年中被大量使用. 由天琴共同体和前自由世界联盟的残余势力研制，幽灵搭载了一系列广泛的电子战设备参与战斗. 一个小猎犬主动探测器让幽灵能够发现敌方单位，而潜行装甲和守护者ECM套件则使其名副其实. 凭借出色的地面速度与强大的中程武器，幽灵非常适合猎歼和重型突袭任务，尤其是在与狮鹫搭档时. 这一于3087年开发的变体将标准武器替换为两门大型脉冲激光、一门小型增程激光和一台SRM-6. 该版本以钢内骨结构为基础，采用一台Defiance 300轻型聚变引擎和带有CASE防护的标准装甲. 特质: 改进传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: After 氏族地狱马 forces' invaded the 蛇夫座自治领 during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. The Mastodon's performance after its introduction makes it inevitable that it will be at the forefront of many campaigns to come. The heavily reinforced structure resists both weapons fire and the standard wear and tear that accompanies most campaigns. The primary configuration mounts two 增程PPCs and two Streak LRM-20 launchers. Four tons of LRM ammunition is protected by a CASE II, and a total of 19 double heat sinks make sure there is no issues with heat build-up. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 在3147年“诺言行动”中地狱战马氏族部队入侵蛇夫座自治领后，Mastodon的诞生标志着其军队主力构成从依赖多种处刑者变体的重大转变. 这款机甲问世后的卓越表现，注定它将成为未来诸多战役的中坚力量. 其重型强化结构不仅能抵御炮火侵袭，更能承受各类战役中常见的常规损耗. 主要配置搭载两台增程粒子加农炮与两具锁定式LRM-20导弹发射器，四吨远程导弹弹药由CASE II防护系统妥善保存，总计十九台双散热器确保热量积聚无余. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: You return to your quarters late, expecting a few system reports and a half-charged sleep cycle. Instead, your personal datapad is flashing. A new message, with the Subject FOR YOUR EYES ONLY. No senders listed. No traceable headers. Just a single embedded file. Against your better judgment, you open it. It's text-only. No signature. No voice. But you recognize the cadence instantly, and the symbol at the bottom removes all doubt: the crest of the [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]]. "You didn't believe me when I told you what the Ghost Bears are willing to hide. But now you've seen it firsthand. Your handler has admitted to violating her own Clan's command structure. She has endangered your outfit, your reputation, and your future for her own crusade. And she never told you why. I would like to speak again. This time, I will bring you more of the truth. Things Arelle will never tell you. Speak to no one before deciding. This offer is only for you." You read it twice. Then a third time. She knows. About the call with Arelle. The 4 billion. The confession. You haven't spoken to anyone outside the crew. That message was buried in encrypted transmission layers. And yet... Mizuki knows. You consider your options.
column2: 你深夜回到自己的quarters，本以为只会看到几份系统报告，然后进入一次半充能状态的睡眠周期。但你的个人科技板正在闪烁。 一条新消息，标题为仅限您查看。 没有发送者信息。没有可追踪的信头。只有一个嵌入文件。尽管直觉告诉你应该谨慎，你还是打开了它。 文件只有文字。没有签名。没有语音。但你立刻认出了其中的语气，而底部的标志更是消除了所有疑问：[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]Minnesota Tribe]]的徽记。 “当我告诉你幽灵熊隐藏了什么时，你并不相信我。但现在，你已经亲眼见证了一切。 你的联络人已经承认，她违反了自己氏族的指挥体系。她为了自己的事业，将你的部队、你的声誉以及你的未来置于危险之中。而她从未告诉你原因。 我希望再次与你交谈。 这一次，我会告诉你更多真相。那些阿蕾尔永远不会告诉你的事情。 在做出决定之前，不要告诉任何人。这个邀请，只属于你。” 你读了一遍。然后第二遍。第三遍 她知道。她知道你与阿蕾尔的通话。知道那40亿。知道那次坦白。 你没有向船员之外的任何人透露过这些信息。那条消息应该被埋藏在加密通讯层之中。 然而……美月知道。 你开始考虑自己的选择。

The Teppō's creation was as a result of the hard lessons learned from nearly two decades of fighting the 布雷克圣言会 and the Black Dragon Society. Using the Ryuken's Combined-Arms command style as a model, the Teppō and its support trailers would attempt to replicate the elite brigade's command capabilities for other frontline Regiments. column1: 黄夹克 YJ-15 专注于近距离火力，在一门中型激光器之外还安装了六门小型激光器，为中距离作战提供支援。凭借 5.5 吨装甲和五具跳跃喷气机，它能够迅速接近敌人，释放不逊于 AC/20 的全弹齐射。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：0.96

column1: Developed to replace the various heavy battle tanks in use by the 地狱马, the Yama is a 65 ton OmniTank. Powered by a 325 rated XL Engine, the Yama can reach speeds of 80kph while carrying 9.5 tons of armour, an Armoured Motive System to protect it's vulnerable tracks and a pair of forward mounted LMG's. Primarily used by the 地狱战马, though Clan Wolf is known to make use of the vehicle with several stars worth in their second line units. The Charlie conflagration is armed with an LB-20X, 2 ER 中型激光s and an ECM suite. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 225 35 Left 190 35 Right 190 35 Rear 150 35 Turret 200 35 Total 955 175 Quirk: 主战坦克 万能车辆

column1: The Ostscout was 设计ed as a pure recon Battle机甲 by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other 设计s can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The OST-12R is a stealth version of the Ostscout, combining a clan ER Large Laser with a 守护者ECM suite, Stealth 装甲, a Light fusion engine and the classic 8 side-torso Jump Jets. To free the needed weight the OTT-12R further uses Endo-Composite internal structure. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 奥斯特侦察机甲是由奥斯特曼工业设计的纯粹侦察型战斗机甲. 为此，其构造完全围绕数据收集与脱离险境这两大核心任务打造，而它在这两方面的表现堪称卓越——奥斯特侦察机甲速度迅捷足以避开多数陷阱，在速度与机动性方面鲜有其他机型能与之匹敌. OST-12R是奥斯特侦察机甲的潜行版本，将氏族大型增程激光与守护者ECM套件、潜行装甲、轻型聚变引擎及经典的8具侧躯干跳跃喷气背包相结合. 为腾出所需重量，OTT-12R进一步采用了内复合材料内部结构. 特质: 改良型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: This version, 设计ed for battlefield use in 3132 under Jeremy Stuart, focuses on the Porcupine's specialization in charging. The PRC-3N includes impact-resistant 装甲 to withstand its own charges, a Null-Signature system and a laser anti-missile system to avoid fire before charging, and a MASC and supercharger combo to enhance speed. Space for this equipment is made through the use of a 180-rated XXL engine and the removal of all ranged weaponry. These changes resulted in an expensive combat '机甲 without ranged capabilities, which made had no sales by 3135. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: 该版本由杰里米·斯图尔特于3132年为战场使用设计，专注于发挥“箭猪”的冲锋专长. PRC-3N配备了抗冲击装甲以承受自身冲锋造成的撞击，搭载了零特征系统与激光反导系统以便在冲锋前闪避敌方火力，并结合了MASC与增压器来提升速度. 这些装备的空间通过使用180额定XXL引擎和移除所有远程武器得以实现. 这些改造造就了一台不具备远程能力的昂贵战斗型机甲，导致其在3135年前未能获得任何订单. 特质: 扰乱 部署费用倍率: 0.99

column1: The XT is the most popular variant of the Malice, and is equipped with four LB 5-X autocannons and four ER 中型激光s. Four tons of ammunition are provided to the warrior, so they can mix and match ammunition types as needed. These weapons are excellent against 车辆s, battle 装甲, and aerospace units, but lack the knockout punch of a heavier weapon. Despite this the Malice can inflict significant damage to enemy forces. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: XT 是 Malice 最受欢迎的型号，配备了四门LB 5-X霰弹炮和四门中型增程激光. 机甲为机师提供了四吨弹药，可根据需要混合搭配不同类型的弹药. 这些武器在对付车辆、战斗装甲和空中单位时表现出色，但缺乏重型武器的暴击能力. 尽管如此，Malice 仍能对敌军造成显著的伤害. 特质: 驱动器保护 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The F configuration groups together a lot of the best technology. A Rotary AC/5 with a dedicated 定位 Computer, a Laser AMS and a Supercharger makes the '机甲 a very deadly flanker. Three ER Medium lasers allow extra firepower as needed. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: F配置组合了大量顶尖技术. 一门配有专用瞄准计算机的RAC/5转管自动炮、一套激光反导系统以及一台超级增压器，使这台机甲成为极其致命的侧翼杀手. 三门中型增程激光可在需要时提供额外火力. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Bergan Industries has never ceased tinkering with its flagship product. Its latest variant, the -7V, harkens back to the original -1V, easing the transition for the many rookies who still pilot that venerable ’Mech as their trainer. Featuring a significant speed increase, a modestly improved weapons loadout, and a slight boost to its armor, it is best described as “the original, only more so.” 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 伯根工业从未停止对其旗舰产品的改进. 其最新改型-7V回归了最初的-1V风格，让许多仍将这款老牌机甲用作教练机的新手能够更轻松地过渡. 它在速度上显著提升，武器配置适度改进，装甲略微增强，最恰当的形容是“原版，更胜一筹”. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂，右上臂

column1: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: WTH-1的简单改装，将其跳跃推进器替换为一台C3从机和为LRM弹药提供的C.A.S.E.防护. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Michael Ubodo's Arrow is armed with a trio of Machine Guns in each arm supplied with two tons of ammo, supported by a 中型激光 in side torso and a 大型脉冲激光 mounted in the center torso. Mounting a 235 standard engine, its varation of the Arrow is clad in Ferro-Fibrous armor on an Endo Steel frame, carrying eleven 双散热器 and just two Jump Jets. Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 迈克尔·乌博多的箭式机甲每只手臂装有三挺机枪，并配有总重两吨的弹药，侧躯干装有一门中型激光作为辅助，中央躯干则安装了一门大型脉冲激光. 该型号的箭式搭载235型标准引擎，采用钢内骨结构并覆盖铁纤维装甲，配备十一个双散热器及仅两个跳跃喷气口. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Safely back on the Argo, Sumire watches the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} news feeds. "Looks like this particular pop-up shop is shut down. It's on all the networks. I give the cabal 24 hours before a new one opens, though."\\n\\nDarius is reading updates from less public information sources. "The pirate forums don't have much more information. Fortunately, no one is linking the raid back to us."\\n\\nYang crosses his arms over his chest. "Okay, okay, but Iron Beard doesn't feel good about playing both sides like this. It reflects poorly on his criminal character."
column2: 安全返回阿尔戈号后，堇观看了 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 新闻推送。 “看起来这个特定的快闪店被关闭了。它在所有网络上都有。不过，我给阴谋集团 24 小时时间，然后再开一家新店。”\\n\\nDarius 正在从不太公开的信息来源阅读更新。 “海盗论坛没有更多信息。幸运的是，没有人将这次袭击与我们联系起来。”\\n\\n杨双臂交叉在胸前。 “好吧好吧，但是铁胡子这样两边打的感觉不太好，这很不符合他的犯罪性格。”

column1: An experimental variant originating in the Federated Suns Outback in the 3070s eventually yielded the standardized refit MLN-1P. The main difference to the earlier models lies in the -1P's VSPL Lasers, replacing all the previous energy weapons. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 一种源自3060年代恒星联邦边远地区的实验型改型，最终催生了标准化改造型号 MLN-1P. 与此前型号的主要区别在于 -1P 配备了 VSPL 激光，替换了之前所有的能量武器. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Aleksandr Hazen: Arguably the Gyrfalcon’s most famous MechWarrior, he was Galaxy Commander of Zeta Galaxy during the Clan's desant into the 球体共和国 in 3134. Piloting his 'Mech which he named the White Lily, he would artfully cut through enemy forces in the Republic until reaching Prefecture IX's Capital of Skye. With his sibkin, Galaxy Commander Malvina Hazen, they would nearly take the world through his methods. However, he would be killed in action with Prefect Tara Campbell at the hands of her Hatchetman signature weapon. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 亚历山大·哈森: 可以说是白隼氏族最著名的机甲战士，他在3134年氏族入侵球体共和国时担任泽塔星系的星系指挥官. 他驾驶着自己命名为“白百合”的机甲，灵巧地撕开共和国防线一路推进，直至抵达第九行政区的首都斯凯星. 凭借其战术手段，他与同袍——星系指挥官马尔维娜·哈森几乎成功攻占该星球. 然而他最终在与长官塔拉·坎贝尔的交锋中阵亡，死于对方那柄标志性的短柄斧武器之下. 特质: 扰乱 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: This is the toughest Wasp I've ever seen, boss. Not that it's a high bar to surpass, mind you. It's only lightly armed, with most of it's firepower coming from the ultra-light rotary trash. Still, it would make a good training mech for rookie light mech pilots.
column2: 这是我见过的最难对付的黄蜂，老板。请注意，这并不是一个需要超越的高标准。它只是轻武装，大部分火力来自超轻型旋转垃圾车。尽管如此，对于新手轻型机甲飞行员来说，它仍然是一个很好的训练机甲。

column1: This mixed tech configuration carries a targeting computer to make best use of the weapons: a medium variable speed pulse laser in the right arm, and a pair of ER medium lasers in the left. Three heavy machine guns and a half ton of ammo is carried in the right torso, while the left torso carries a 锁定式SRM-4 and one ton of ammunition. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该混合科技配置搭载了瞄准计算机以发挥武器的最佳效能: 右臂装有一门中型变速脉冲激光，左臂则配备两门中型增程激光. 右躯干装有三挺重机枪及半吨弹药，而左躯干则搭载了一具锁定式SRM-4和一吨弹药. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Battle Armor Mechanical Jump Boosters share the advantages and limitations of their larger cousins. They offer a very limited jump capability and they're hard to steer when in flight. However, the Mechanical Jump Boosters used on Battle Armor offers one significant advantage over their 'Mech sized cousins: They allow the armored infantry soldier to replace the normal walking gait with a longer "bouncing" gait that allows the battle armored trooper to cover more ground.
column2: 战斗装甲机械跳跃助推器继承了其大型版本的优点与局限. 它们提供的跳跃能力非常有限，并且在飞行过程中难以操控. 然而，用于战斗装甲的机械跳跃助推器相比安装在机甲上的同类设备具有一个显著优势: 它们允许装甲步兵用更长距离的‘弹跳’步态替代正常行走步态，使战斗装甲士兵能够覆盖更大的移动范围.

column1: The Hermes III HER-6K is the first upgrade of the Hermes III by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, where they completely refreshed the original Hermes III HER-4K by Ostmann Industries with considerably more recent technology. Its two 短管PPCs are linked together through an advanced 瞄准计算机 for improved performance, and a 守护者ECM provide basic electronic warfare capabilities. A C3 Slave also ensures the 'Mech performs well in advanced lances. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Hermes III HER-6K是Luthien Armor Works对Hermes III的首次升级，他们用相当新的技术彻底翻新了Ostmann Industries的原版Hermes III HER-4K. 它装备的两门短管PPC通过先进的瞄准计算机联动以提升性能，一台守护者ECM提供基础电子战能力. 一个C3从属单元也确保了该机甲在先进小队中表现出色. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: 前去地表补给的达里乌斯发来一条讯息。“指挥官，我带了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 来帮忙，{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|NonBinary:they've} 跟当地黑市的一个经销商搭上了关系。”\r\n\r\n“这个人提出要卖给我们一具九成新的 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan],{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan].Description.Name}]]。条件相当不错……你想怎么办？”
column2: 达吕斯发来一条消息，他刚下到星球表面去补给物资.“指挥官，我带了[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]来帮忙，结果{TGT_MW.OBJ}跟本地黑市的一个商人搭上了关系.”\n\n“这个家伙愿意卖给我们一具轻度使用的[[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan]{DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_SRM_4_Streak_Clan].Description.Name}]]. 价格挺不错……您想怎么办?”

column1: One of the more uncommon loadouts, configuration T mounts a variety of weapons trying to cover all combat scenarios. The main weaponry consists of a 锁定式SRM-6, a Streak LRM-10, one 改进的 Heavy Large Laser and a 改进的 Heavy Small Laser. The loadout also brings 4 ER 中型激光s for emergency situations, but lack the cooling to include them in the general combat. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这是一种较为罕见的配置方案，T型搭载了多种武器，试图覆盖所有战斗场景. 主要武器包括一门锁定式SRM-6、一门锁定式LRM-10、一门改进型大型重激光和一门改进型小型重激光. 该配置还携带了4门中型增程激光以应对紧急情况，但因冷却能力不足，无法将其纳入常规战斗. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: 该型号在3075年的圣战纪元期间生产，运用了全新科技. 原本的UAC/10被一门20级超突击高斯步枪取代，并配备三吨弹药. 左臂上的中型脉冲激光同样被中型重激光替换. 通过在左躯干加装瞄准计算机，该机甲的命中精度得到了提升. 特质: 模块化武器 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: This custom-设计ed model is piloted by a Capellan bounty hunter, who goes by the moniker Dao. It has been rebuilt using Clan-technology heat sinks, Ferro-Fibrous 装甲, and Endo Steel. A Clan ER PPC is the primary weapon, and the '机甲 also carries a Battle机甲 Taser to aid in capturing targets alive. A Supercharger and an 驱动器增强系统 add to the Vindicator's speed and accuracy. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 这台定制机甲由一位绰号为“刀”的卡佩拉赏金猎人驾驶，经过克兰科技双散热器、铁纤维装甲和钢内骨结构的全面改造. 其主要武器是一门克兰增程粒子加农炮，同时配备一台战斗机甲电击枪以协助活捉目标. 超级增压器与驱动器增强系统的加装进一步提升了维护者的速度与精准度. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: The CHA-3's goal is to overwhelm any enemy with raw firepower from its railgun, Rotary AC/20 and improved heavy lasers. The somewhat moderate ammunition count for the RAC, only 4 tons, means it is somewhat limited in reaching its full potential. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.49 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: CHA-3 的目标是凭借其高斯步枪、RAC/20和改进型重型激光的纯粹火力压倒任何敌人. RAC的弹药数量略显有限，仅有 4 吨，这意味着它在发挥全部潜力方面受到一定限制. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.49 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Following the discovery of the Hegemony Memory Core, the Kyudo was re设计ed by Irian Battle机甲s Unlimited. The -03 variant of the '机甲 traded the LRM-20 for a pair of Artemis-Guided MML-7s with two tons of ammunition. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Upper
column2: 在发现霸权记忆核心后，Kyudo 被艾里安战斗机甲无限公司重新设计. 该机甲 -03 变体用一对带两吨弹药的阿尔忒弥斯引导 MML-7 替换了 LRM-20. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 右上臂

column1: A Nova Cat 设计, the 50 ton Huntsman was 设计ed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An Omni机甲, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous 装甲 giving the Omni机甲, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman T is armed with a UAC/2 and a pair of Streak LRM-5’s. 4 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, a ER Small Laser, a 微型 Pulse Laser, a 锁定式SRM-6 and a Flamer provide additional firepower at close range. Laser AMS improves the Huntsmans defensive capabilities while a 定位 Computer enhances the accuracy of 机甲s weapons. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为新星猫系列的设计产物，50吨级的享茨曼是为复兴行动及内天体入侵战而研发的，于3049年首次投入量产. 这款万能机甲采用250引擎超轻型引擎，搭载钢内骨结构与铁纤维装甲，拥有21.5吨装载空间. 底盘固定配备5台跳跃喷气装置，赋予该机型卓越的机动性. 享茨曼T型装备一门UAC/2火炮和两具锁定式LRM-5，另在近战距离部署有四门改进型中型重激光、一门小型增程激光、一具微型脉冲激光、锁定式SRM-6及一把火焰喷射器. 激光反导系统强化了防御能力，而目标锁定计算机则有效提升武器精准度. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced Technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
column2: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

column1: A typical deep Periphery derivative of 加固装甲 with a Lyran Solaris influence, the Spike Cladding bolts interlocking reinforced plating and spikes across the whole Mech, giving it an edge during the grittiest of infighting at the cost of decreased mobility.
column2: A typical deep Periphery derivative of Hardened Armor with a Lyran Solaris influence, the Spike Cladding bolts interlocking reinforced plating and spikes across the whole Mech, giving it an edge during the grittiest of infighting at the cost of decreased mobility.

column1: Safely back on the Argo, Sumire watches the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} news feeds. "Looks like this particular pop-up shop is shut down. It's on all the networks. I give the cabal 24 hours before a new one opens, though."\\n\\nDarius is reading updates from less public information sources. "Bad news, team. From the rumblings on the pirate forums, they're linking the raid back to us."\\n\\nYang crosses his arms over his chest. "Dammit people! Iron Beard will have to retire. This reflects poorly on his criminal character."
column2: 安全返回阿尔戈号后，堇观看了 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 新闻推送。 “看起来这个特定的快闪店被关闭了。它在所有网络上都有。不过，我给阴谋集团 24 小时时间，然后再开一家新店。”\\n\\nDarius 正在从不太公开的信息来源阅读更新。 “坏消息，团队。从海盗论坛上的传言来看，他们正在将这次袭击与我们联系起来。”\\n\\n杨将双臂交叉在胸前。 “可恶的人啊！铁胡子要退役了，这太不符合他的犯罪性格了。”

column1: A 300 rated Light Fusion Engine provides improved survivability. The -5P mounts an LB 10-X Autocannon with 2 tons of ammo in the left arm, an ER PPC in the right arm, and 3 LRM-5s split between the left arm and both torsos with 3 tons of ammo feeding them. The ECM and Jump-Jets remain, with 12 双散热器 dissipating the relatively cool weapons loadout. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 一台300评级轻型聚变引擎提供了更强的生存能力. -5P型号在左臂安装了一门LB 10-X霰弹炮并携带2吨弹药，右臂配置一门增程PPC，左臂与两侧躯干共装有三具LRM-5发射器，由3吨弹药供弹. 电子战设备和跳跃喷口得以保留，12台双重散热器可轻松应对这套相对低热的武器负载. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Bandit is a 50-ton Hover Combat Vehicle first seen in use by Wolf's Dragoons. Originally it was an old Clan design brought to the Inner Sphere by the Dragoons, who approached the Blackwell Corporation in January of 3007 to produce three vehicles for their exclusive use; along with the Bandit, the other vehicles were the Kestrel VTOL transport and the Badger APC. The Bandit is found in myriad configurations, but almost all feature an infantry bay. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲： 带刺束具 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 145 25 右侧 145 25 后方 110 25 炮塔 90 25 总计 650 125 特性：热成像瞄具 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Bandit是一种50吨的气垫战斗载具  最初由Wolf's Dragoons使用. 它原本是一种古老的血族设计  由Dragoons带入内天体  他们于3007年1月接触Blackwell Corporation  生产三种载具供其专用；除了Bandit之外  其他载具还有Kestrel VTOL运输机和Badger APC. Bandit有多种配置  但几乎所有配置都配备步兵舱. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 尖刺挽具 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 160 25 左侧 150 25 右侧 150 25 后方 120 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 680 125 特质: 导弹干扰器 万能载具 可搭载1个战斗装甲小队. 有射击孔. #武器: 2x 小型转管化学激光 2x 中型激光(海盗)

column1: Converts a Mech's Cooling System to Clan DHS. The Radical Heat Sink System increases the ability of the heat sink to flush excess heat, much like Coolant Pods. Radical Heat Sinks can fail through repeated use, especially if used continuously.
column2: 【Radical Heat Sink Kit (C)】将机甲的冷却系统转换为氏族双散热器. 激进散热系统可增强散热器排出多余热量的能力，其效果类似于冷却液舱. 激进散热器可能会因反复使用而失效，尤其是在持续使用时.

column1: 暴风鸦 C 装备了氏族所能获得的一些最精准的武器。Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 风暴乌鸦 C 装备了一些氏族最精准的武器. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Regardless of an AutoMech's design, it receives three CPU critical slots in its Head hit location. Two of these slots - replacing the Life Support Slots on a standard BattleMech cockpit - are identified as Secondary CPUs, while the third - replacing the Cockpit critical slot - is the Primary CPU. Collectively, these represent the AutoMech's brain.
column2: 无论 AutoMech 的设计如何，它的头部命中位置都会接收三个 CPU 关键插槽。其中两个插槽（替换标准 BattleMech 驾驶舱上的生命支持插槽）被识别为辅助 CPU，而第三个插槽（替换驾驶舱关键插槽）是主 CPU。总的来说，这些代表了 AutoMech 的大脑。

column1: The Sortek Assault Hover Craft is a thirty-second century combat hovercraft, originally produced by Corean Enterprises for the armed forces of the Federated Suns. Built on New Avalon, Corean Enterprises constructed the craft as a means to repeat its success with its last successful hovercraft, the Musketeer. The Sortek was used by many Armed Forces of the Federated Suns combat units by the 3140s to rebuild their devastated forces. Many AFFS commanders would mistakenly use the Sortek as a main combatant, which would cause heavy casualties due to the Sortek's lack of being able to deliver a killing blow to a heavier opponent. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 205 25 左侧 130 25 右侧 130 25 后方 110 25 总计 575 100 特性：改进型传感器
column2: Sortek Assault Hover Craft是32世纪的战斗气垫船  最初由Corean Enterprises为恒星联邦的武装部队生产. 在新阿瓦隆建造  Corean Enterprises制造这艘船是为了重现其上一款成功的气垫船Musketeer的成功. 到3140年代  许多恒星联邦武装部队的战斗单位使用Sortek来重建他们遭受重创的部队. 许多AFFS指挥官会错误地将Sortek用作主要战斗单位  这会导致重大伤亡  因为Sortek无法对更重的对手造成致命一击. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 205 25 左侧 130 25 右侧 130 25 后方 110 25 总计 575 100 特质: 改进传感器 #武器: 1x AMS 2x 轻型PPC

column1: 哈迪斯是狼之龙骑兵的专属设计，由洛基发展而来，试图在保留其进攻能力的同时纠正该设计装甲薄弱的缺陷。标准底盘换成内骨骼型号，装甲升级为铁纤维。哈迪斯保持与原版洛基相同的机动性。 Quirk: 集成探照灯 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 铁手套是一款为天琴共同体武装部队制造的中型万能机甲. 它的设计定位是快速骑兵单位，既能跟上轻型机甲的速度，又能发挥中型机甲的灵活性与火力. 特质: 先进M.A.S.C.系统 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Mech's Movement is reduced by 50% for 2 turns. Does not stack.
column2: 机甲的移动力降低 50%，持续 2 回合. 效果不可叠加.

column1: New 以day! Try Quicsell's Whisper Sens或s ECM system, 配备 advanced passive ECM technology!
column2: 今日新品! 试试Quicsell的低语者传感器ECM系统，配备先进的被动ECM技术!

column1: Rolling clouds of heavy pollution decrease heat sinking efficiency to 95%. Visibility and sensor efficiency is reduced to 80%. All units have +1 Defense.
column2: 滚滚而来的重度污染云雾将散热效率降低至 95%. 能见度与传感器效能降至 80%. 所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: 一座提供基础防御的简易武器炮位。 Quirk: 稳定武器 Armor: Armor Amount: 160 Structure: Structure Amount: 100 Engine: 100 标准聚变 Equipment: 1 x 指挥掩体 Weapons: 6x 中型化学激光 Ammunition: 3x 中型化学激光弹药 1x 中型化学激光弹药 [Half]
column2: 一座提供基础防御的简易武器炮位。 Quirk: Stable Weapons Armor: Armor Amount: 160 Structure: Structure Amount: 100 Engine: 100 Standard Fusion Equipment: 1 x Command Bunker Weapons: 6x Medium Chem Laser Ammunition: 3x Ammo Chemical Medium 1x Ammo Chemical Medium [Half]

column1: Intended as a scout, this Mixed Tech configuration carries an Inner Sphere plasma rifle with two tons of ammo in the right torso, and a Clan large pulse laser in the opposite torso. In addition, the left torso mounts a Clan 主动探头 for rooting out hidden targets. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该混合科技配置旨在用作侦察兵，其右躯干搭载一门内天体等离子步枪并配备两吨弹药，相对躯干安装一门氏族大型脉冲激光. 此外，左躯干还装备了氏族主动探测器，用于搜寻隐藏目标. 特质: 干扰 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Not Much is known about this Mech, It handles just like a Normal Ostscout. The Engine has been Upgraded, and it was up Armoured. According to the Onboard Logs, the Targeting System for the Laser is Advanced, but i cant see anything Special about it. Maybe it gets better if a Certain person Pilots it?
column2: 关于这个机甲我们知之甚少，它的操作方式就像普通的东侦察兵一样。发动机已升级，并且已加装装甲。根据机载日志，激光瞄准系统很先进，但我看不出有什么特别之处。如果由某个人来驾驶的话，也许情况会更好？

column1: Quicsell's innovative LBX laser series makes it much more likely to hit a moving target. The accusations from our competitors that we are simply looking for a way to use up cracked focusing chambers from sub-par construction techniques are slander, pure and simple.
column2: Quicsell 的创新 LBX 激光器系列使其更有可能击中移动目标。我们的竞争对手指责我们只是在寻找一种方法来利用低于标准的施工技术的破裂聚焦室，这是纯粹的诽谤。

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox I is armed with an ER PPC, an ER 中型激光 and an ER Small Laser. A 瞄准计算机, Supercharger and 模块化装甲 round out the variant. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox I is armed with an ER PPC, an ER Medium Laser and an ER Small Laser. A Targeting Computer, Supercharger and Modular Armor round out the variant. Quirk：Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This version introduced in 3074 is based on the 战斗大师 K3. Its top speed is the same as that variant, but it mounts five 改进型跳跃推进器 that allow it to cover 150 meters per jump. A Heavy-Duty Gyro allows it to stay in the fight, using its Gauss rifle, 短管PPC, 大型脉冲激光 and two ER medium lasers to great effect. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: This version introduced in 3074 is based on the BattleMaster K3. Its top speed is the same as that variant, but it mounts five Improved Jump Jets that allow it to cover 150 meters per jump. A Heavy-Duty Gyro allows it to stay in the fight, using its Gauss rifle, Snub-Nose PPC, Large Pulse Laser and two ER medium lasers to great effect. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

column1: Introduced in 3054, the 骑兵武装直升机 was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 100 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 65 15 总计 360 75 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads.
column2: Cavalry Attack Helicopter于3054年推出  是Michaelson Heavy Industries为对抗氏族而开发的众多VTOL之一. Cavalry适合打了就跑的交战  而非前线战斗  在正确使用时赢得了完美服务的声誉. 此后它在前FedCom国家和Chaos March中的小贵族中服役. 虽然速度可达162公里/小时  但Cavalry并不单靠此保护自己  并拥有3.5吨装甲. 该机可以承受氏族科技增程PPC对机首的直接命中并继续飞行. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境中部署. 移动: 10/15格 / 300/450米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 65 15 总计 360 75 特质: 狭窄/低矮轮廓 可携带1个战斗装甲小队. #武器: 3x 中型激光 3x 机枪

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of 全向Mechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion engine and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. The Seraph D is best at medium to long range, as it carries two Heavy PPCs and one Light PPC. Like the Dominus variant, the Luminos can jump up to 150 meters using improved jump jets that enable it to get into a good sniping position. Three 中型脉冲激光s and a Small Laser are used defensively in the event an enemy units gets inside the minimum range of the PPCs. A Flamer provides effective anti-infantry defense. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 作为Celestial系列万能机甲中的轻型突击机甲，Seraph对于其吨位而言速度稍慢，但它试图通过配备三重强度肌肉来弥补这一点，使其在高温运行时能加速至64公里/小时。与其他Celestial机甲一样，Seraph采用了轻型聚变引擎和小型驾驶舱，不过其他较新的技术仅体现在其武器装备上。与其他Celestial机甲一致，它也搭载了一台C3i计算机。Seraph D型最擅长中远距离作战，装备有两门重型粒子加农炮和一门轻型粒子加农炮。与主宰者型号类似，光辉者型号能够借助改进型跳跃喷口跳跃长达150米，使其能占据良好的狙击位置。三门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光用于防御，以防敌方单位进入粒子加农炮的最小射程之内。一具火焰喷射器则能提供有效的反步兵防御。 特质: 改良型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The D variant is a bit of jack of all trades, mounting a pair of Ultra AC/2, a pair of LBX AC/2, a pair of LRM-15 launchers and four 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s. Eight tons of C.A.S.E. II protected ammunition and only two extra heat sinks finishes the 设计, meaning the '机甲 suffers from severe overheat issues. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D型变体堪称万事通，配备了两门Ultra AC/2、两门LBX AC/2、两具LRM-15发射器以及四门改进型中型重激光. 仅靠八吨受C.A.S.E. II保护的弹药和额外两个散热器支撑整套配置，意味着这台机甲面临严重的过热问题. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: 加固装甲 is a thicker armor type that uses multiple overlapping plates to provide additional protection against enemy fire. In fact, 加固装甲 is so heavy that it cannot be mounted on hovercraft, VTOLs, or WiGE vehicles. Reduces incoming Critical Hits. CASE Enabled
column2: 加固装甲是一种更厚的装甲类型，使用多层重叠的装甲板来提供额外的防护以抵御敌方火力. 尽管它能比标准装甲偏转更多伤害，但增加的装甲板数量及其缺乏灵活性使得使用它的任何单位更难以驾驶，并且也会影响速度. 事实上，加固装甲非常重，无法安装在气垫船、VTOL或WiGE车辆上. 降低受到暴击的概率. 已启用CASE

column1: The Knox Battlesuite 900X is Mann Manufacturing’s ultimate cockpit system, built exclusively for the Minnesota Tribe’s superheavy command ’Mechs. An evolution of the 500X, it integrates command, electronic warfare, and survivability in a reinforced “ferro-fibrous vault.” Inside are advanced systems: high-bandwidth comms, sensor fusion, ECM/ECCM, and multi-target coordination, tailored to the Tribe’s mobile frontline leadership style. Compatible only with Tribe superheavies, its power and mass demands preclude use by lighter 'Mechs. For Tribe officers, it’s essential: more than a cockpit, the 900X is a hardened command hub that keeps leaders protected, connected, and in control amid the chaos of battle.
column2: 【Command Cockpit (SH-M)】Knox Battlesuite 900X是Mann制造公司打造的终极驾驶舱系统  专为明尼苏达部落的超重型指挥机甲设计. 作为500X的进化型  它将指挥、电子战与生存能力整合于强化的“铁纤维堡垒”之中. 内部配备先进系统  包括高带宽通信、传感器融合、ECM/ECCM以及多目标协调系统  专门适配部落机动前线指挥的作战方式. 它仅兼容部落超重型机甲  其功率和重量需求使其无法安装于较轻型机甲. 对于部落军官而言  它不可或缺: 900X不仅仅是一套驾驶舱  更是一座强化型指挥中枢  让指挥官在混乱的战场上得到保护、保持联络  并掌控全局.

column1: The Marsden II 主战坦克 was introduced by Arcturan Arms in 2463 to improve upon and replace its venerable predecessor after seventy years of frontline service. Improved technical and manufacturing knowledge allowed the company to improve the new tank's arms and armor while still making it five tons lighter. With its excellent firepower and thick armor, it was considered a cutting edge combat vehicle when it premiered during the Age of War. The durable Marsden II continued to soldier on in various planetary militias and private security force arsenals into the Succession Wars. column1: All '机甲s come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. The Heavy Cockpit is a common standard amongst Minnesota Tribe Battle机甲s; for most, the extra weight is worth it to have the added fire control gear and pilot in what is effectively an 装甲ed Ferro-Fibrous bathtub.
column2: 【Heavy Cockpit (M)】所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可升级以提升性能. 重型驾驶舱是明尼苏达部落战斗机甲的常见标准配置; 对大多数人来说，额外的重量是值得的，因为可以获得附加的火控设备，并且机师实际上置身于一个装甲化的铁纤维浴缸中.

column1: The Teppō artillery support vehicle is an experimental super heavy combat Vehicle which is designed to provide support to frontline combat units of the Draconis Combine. First produced just after the Jihad, this massive vehicle was designed to be a regiment's mobile artillery battery and also provide additional command and repair abilities through its pair of Support Trailers. The Teppō's creation was as a result of the hard lessons learned from nearly two decades of fighting the 布雷克圣言会 and the Black Dragon Society. Using the Ryuken's Combined-Arms command style as a model, the Teppō and its support trailers would attempt to replicate the elite brigade's command capabilities for other frontline Regiments. Built on Unity at Pesht Motors, the Teppō is noted for its high quality due to each vehicle being hand-built. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. column2: Teppō炮兵支援载具是一种实验性超重型战斗载具  旨在为天龙联合体的前线作战单位提供支援. 首次生产于圣战之后  这种庞大的载具被设计为一个团的机动炮兵连  并通过其一对支援拖车提供额外的指挥和维修能力. Teppō的诞生源于与布雷克圣言会和黑龙会近二十年战斗中所吸取的惨痛教训. 以Ryuken的合成兵种指挥风格为模板  Teppō及其支援拖车试图为其他前线团复制这支精锐旅的指挥能力. column1: 一个失眠的夜晚，你在机甲库里踱步时撞见了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 正在研究一台 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[BaseDesc_Locust],Locust LCT-1V]] 的图纸。{TGT_MW.Obj} 周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱糟糟的扳手、螺栓和写满涂鸦的散页纸。\r\n\r\n你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det} 脸上挂着不好意思的笑。“呃，你好，指挥官。我只是想琢磨出个办法，让库里那台 Locust 在战场上真正派上用场。我想我们可以把两条腿焊在一起，往底盘里塞满废铁，把它做成一根大棒，让那些更大的机甲抡着使！你能跟主管说说吗，这周他已经把我从这儿赶出去过一次了。”
column2: 你在走廊偶遇[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，注意到{TGT_MW.OBJ}心情异常好.“有什么好事?”，你问.\n\n{TGT_MW.Callsign}咧嘴笑着回答:“我不想太张扬，但是......今天是我的生日.”

column1: This mech is a solution in search of a problem, if you ask me. Quicsell got so wrapped up in making chem lasers stronger that they forgot to ask why people stopped using them. Aside from my gripes about the weapons, my main complaint is the speed. Thanks to that underweight fuel cell that's hardwired in, this mech is just never going to move above assault mech speeds, which is just embarrasing for a medium.
column2: 如果你问我的话，这个机械就是寻找问题的解决方案。奎塞尔如此专注于让化学激光器变得更强，以至于他们忘记了问为什么人们停止使用它们。除了我对武器的抱怨之外，我主要的抱怨是速度。由于内置了重量较轻的燃料电池，该机甲永远不会超过突击机甲的速度，这对于介质来说是令人尴尬的。

column1: Designed by Fredonian Industrial Technologies, the Anubis was originally designed to complement the Osiris BattleMech in use by the Federated Suns. The 'Mech's lightweight chassis carries a powerful Ceres Motors 250 XL engine that gives the Anubis a top speed of 129.6 km/h and is covered in a protective skin of Hellespont Lite 隐身装甲, making the Anubis extremely hard to hit at long range. The 3R variant is meant to increase its short term and short range firepower, the 3R removes two of the LRM-5 launchers and replaces them with two 火箭发射器 10s and two 火箭发射器 15s. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 由弗雷多尼亚工业科技设计的阿努比斯，最初旨在作为恒星联邦现役奥西里斯战斗装甲的补充型号. 这款轻型机甲搭载强劲的赛瑞斯动力250型超轻型引擎，最高时速可达129.6公里/小时，并覆盖赫勒斯滂轻量化潜行装甲层，使其在远程交战中极难被命中. 3R变体型号着重强化短期近程火力输出，该型号移除了两具LRM-5导弹发射器，替换为两具十联装火箭发射器与两具十五联装火箭发射器. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

The B configuration bears a 'Silver Bullet' Gauss Rifle on the right arm, backed up by a torso-mounted MML and the usual X-Pulse lasers on the left arm. An 'Iron Dome' AMS system and Angel ECM provide this loadout with ample long-range defenses. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The Alternate Configuration C of the Boreas Prime, 开发 by 氏族地狱马, is a versatile loadout 设计ed for multi-purpose combat situations. The 机甲 can engage from a long range with its advanced Tactical Missile System-12 (ATM-12) launcher or engage in closer combat with the missile launcher in combination with its two Extended Range 中型激光s (ER 中型激光s). The 机甲 carries up to three tons of ammunition to ensure a sustained offensive. This configuration offers a potent mix of precision, speed, and durability. It is perfect for various missions ranging from anti-infantry to anti-机甲 operations. With a top speed of 64 km/h, the Boreas Prime configuration C is a reliable and versatile combat unit. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 由地狱战马氏族开发的北风Prime替换配置C，是一种为多用途战斗情况而打造的多功能负载配置. 该机甲可通过其先进的战术导弹系统-12（ATM-12）发射器进行远程交战，也可结合导弹发射器和两门中型增程激光（中型增程激光）进行近距离战斗. 机甲最多可携带三吨弹药，确保持续的进攻能力. 此配置兼具精准度、速度与耐用性，非常适合从反步兵到反机甲作战的各种任务. 最高时速为64公里/小时，北风Prime配置C是一款可靠且多功能的作战单位. 特质: 集成探照灯 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: RISC engineers, deciding that the standard version of the Uziel just didn't shout loud enough, went to their glass drawing boards and completely reimagined the beast.  Now equipped with a pair of Light PPCs in the arms, and a total of 30 launch tubes of their now (in)famous MMLs, the UZL-RX was considered to be a premier skirmisher with it's capabilities to provide hell on earth at both short and long ranges.
column2: RISC 工程师认为 Uziel 的标准版本不够大声，于是他们走到玻璃绘图板上，完全重新想象了这头野兽。  现在，UZL-RX 的手臂上配备了一对轻型 PPC，以及总共 30 个现在（臭名昭著）的 MML 发射管，UZL-RX 被认为是顶级的散兵，具有在短距离和长距离提供人间地狱的能力。
