column1: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The 车辆 serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The 车辆 is lightly 装甲ed and a hit from nearly any kind of '机甲 weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动: 15/23 hexes / 450/690 meters. 装甲: Vehicle Stealth 装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 40 5 左侧 10 5 右侧 10 5 后方 10 5 总计 80 25 怪癖: 窄/低调

column1: A [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]] transport arrives at the Argo three days after the battle at Fröislandis VII. The DropShip docks without ceremony and begins offloading cargo under Darius's supervision. The first delivery is financial. Twenty million C-bills transferred directly to the company accounts. Darius watches the confirmation come through on his datapad and actually has to check the transaction twice to believe it. "Commander, Marcus was not exaggerating about the payment. Twenty million C-bills just hit our accounts. That is more than we have made on any six contracts combined." Yang is in the mech bay watching the second delivery. A 明尼苏达部落 assault mech rolls off the transport on its own power, escorted by Tribe technicians who hand over the authentication codes and technical documentation before departing without a word. "Boss, you really need to see this. Marcus sent us an assault mech. A Tribe assault mech. This thing is immaculate." The weapons package arrives next. Four crates marked with 明尼苏达部落 security seals. Three contain advanced weapon systems that make Yang actually stop and stare when he cracks them open. The fourth crate holds twelve large ammunition bins, enough to keep one of the weapons supplied through extended campaigns. Tribe military technology, the kind that does not circulate in the Inner Sphere. The final delivery is specialist equipment. Three sealed crates with components and systems that Farah immediately identifies as extremely rare, possibly prototype-grade hardware that would cost a fortune on the open market if it was even available for purchase. Darius reviews the manifest one more time. "Twenty million C-bills. An assault mech. Tribe weapons technology with ammunition stockpiles. Advanced equipment. Marcus called this compensation and an apology fee for the nuclear threat. I think he actually meant it." Yang runs his hand along the assault mech's armor plating. "We earned this. We stopped a genocide weapon and survived two consecutive battles on a frozen hell planet. If anything, this barely covers what we went through." The 明尼苏达部落 transport detaches from the Argo and begins its departure sequence. No further communications. No ceremonies. Just the delivery and departure. Darius closes the manifest file. "Well. Back to normal mercenary work. Except now we can actually afford to do it properly." Hours later, a final encrypted message arrives from Marcus Hammerick. No words. Just updated star charts showing the true location of 明尼苏达部落 settlements deep in the Periphery. A gesture of trust. Or perhaps a warning to never look for them. The other rewards sit in the cargo bay. Proof that the nightmare on Fröislandis VII actually happened and actually ended.
column2: Fröislandis VII 战斗结束三天后，一艘[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]Minnesota Tribe]]空投艇抵达阿尔戈号. 空投艇没有举行任何仪式便完成对接，并在达吕斯的监督下开始卸载货物. 第一批交付的是资金. 两千万C币直接转入公司账户. 达吕斯看着数据板上的确认信息，甚至不得不再次检查交易记录，才能相信这笔款项是真的. “指挥官，马库斯并没有夸大报酬. 两千万星币刚刚到账. 这比我们过去六份合约赚到的钱加起来还多.” 杨正在机甲库观察第二批交付. 一台明尼苏达部落袭击型机甲依靠自身动力驶下空投艇，部落技术人员随后交付认证代码和技术文档，然后一言不发地离开. “老大，你真的得来看看这个. 马库斯送给我们一台袭击型机甲. 一台部落袭击型机甲. 这东西状态完美.” 接下来送达的是武器装备. 四个箱子上印有明尼苏达部落安全标识. 其中三个装有先进武器系统，杨打开箱子时甚至停下来盯着它们看了好一会儿. 第四个箱子里装着十二个大型弹药箱，足以让其中一件武器在长期战役中持续使用. 部落军事科技——那种不会在内天体流通的技术. 最后一批交付的是专业设备. 三个密封箱内装有组件和系统，法拉立即确认这些都是极其稀有的设备，甚至可能是原型级硬件. 就算它们真的能在公开市场上买到，其价格也将高得惊人. 达吕斯再次查看了一遍清单.“两千万星币. 一台袭击型机甲. 带有弹药储备的部落武器技术. 先进设备. 马库斯称这些是对核威胁事件的补偿以及道歉费用. 我想……他是真的这么认为的.” 杨伸手抚过突击机甲的装甲板.“这是我们应得的. 我们阻止了一场灭绝级武器危机，并在那颗冰封地狱星球上连续经历两场战斗后活了下来. 如果要说，这些甚至只是勉强弥补我们的损失.” 明尼苏达部落空投艇脱离阿尔戈号，开始执行离开程序. 没有进一步通讯. 没有庆祝仪式. 只有交付，然后离去. 达吕斯关闭清单文件.“好了. 回归正常的雇佣兵工作. 不过现在，我们终于有能力真正做好它了. 数小时后，马库斯·哈默里克发送来最后一条加密信息. 没有文字. 只有更新后的星图，显示出明尼苏达部落定居点在深空外围的真实位置. 这是一种信任的表示. 又或者，是提醒你永远不要去寻找他们. 其他奖励静静存放在货舱中. 它们证明了Fröislandis VII 上的噩梦确实发生过，也确实已经结束.

column1: Trex "Kamea" Arano was the daughter of Kamea Arano. Trex was often simply called Kamea the Second due to her near identical looks to her mother, so much so that historians have difficulty figuring out which holo-images to attribute to either one. \\n\\nBorn only a few years after her mother's victory over Santiago Espinosa's Directorate, Trex grew up watching as her people struggled in the post-wars years to rebuild and became determined to help her people no matter the cost.\\n\\nTrex ascended to the throne at the age of 19 when her mother decided that she had ruled long enough and stepped down as High Lady of the Reach. Like her mother before her, Trex proved a natural leader, and she was able to inspire her people to not only make the Aurigan Reach prosperous for a Periphery state, but to successfully defend it and even launch a counteroffensive against the Capellan Confederation. It is said that Trex herself planned and led the campaign that seized chancellor Slippy's personal salt mine and drove him insane.\\n\\nAfter the war, Trex returned her focus on making her nation the best that it could be before handing down the throne to a new generation of leadership like her mother before her - setting a tradition within the Reach of voluntarily giving up power before old age and world-weariness caught up with the High Lord/Lady.\\n
column2: 特雷克斯·“卡米亚”·阿拉诺是卡米亚·阿拉诺的女儿。特雷克斯经常被简单地称为卡米亚二世，因为她的长相与她的母亲几乎一模一样，以至于历史学家很难弄清楚哪些全息图像应该归属于其中任何一个。 \\n\\n在她母亲战胜圣地亚哥·埃斯皮诺萨的理事会几年后出生，特雷克斯看着她的人民在战后的岁月中为重建而奋斗，并决心不惜一切代价帮助她的人民。\\n\\n特雷克斯在 19 岁时登上王位，当时她的母亲认为她已经统治了足够长的时间，并辞去了河湾高级女士的职务。就像她的母亲一样，特雷克斯证明了自己是一位天生的领导者，她不仅能够激励她的人民使阿里根河区成为外围国家的繁荣，而且能够成功保卫它，甚至对卡佩伦联邦发起反攻。据说，特雷克斯亲自策划并领导了一场夺取财政大臣斯利皮私人盐矿并把他逼疯的运动。\\n\\n战后，特雷克斯将注意力集中在让她的国家尽可能成为最好的国家，然后将王位交给像她母亲那样的新一代领导层 - 在高领主/女士年老和厌世之前，在范围内树立了自愿放弃权力的传统。\\n

Carrying an array of ranged weapons, the Light VTOL is designed to support allied units from range. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 80 10 左侧 55 10 右侧 55 10 后方 40 10 总计 245 50 特性：精准武器 - 机枪 Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads.
column2: 轻型VTOL速度极快，并非为持久战而设计。它搭载一系列远程武器，旨在从远处支援友军单位。生态限制：该单位无法部署在月球生态区。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 装甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 80 10 左侧 50 10 右侧 50 10 后方 50 10 总计 245 50 特性：导弹干扰器

column1: This version was introduced by House Kurita in 3077. A Heavy Duty Gyro allows it to stay in the fight longer, making good use of twin 短管PPCs and ER 中型激光s. Though it's slightly slower than the standard Ostroc, jump jets allow it to maneuver around the battlefield, striking where it will inflict the most damage. After the Jihad ended, this model went into factory production. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 该型号由栗田家族于3077年推出. 重型陀螺仪使其能在战斗中持续更久，充分发挥双管短鼻式粒子加农炮与中型增程激光的威力. 虽然速度略逊于标准型奥斯洛特，但跳跃推进器赋予其战场机动能力，可对最具杀伤价值的目标实施打击. 圣战结束后，该型号进入工厂量产阶段. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.08

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. A ClanTech redesign of the Zeus-X chassis replacing some of its electronics and all its 'Tech with Clan upgraded versions. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯由天琴共同体于2787年首次建造，恰逢第一次继承战争爆发. 应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官对新式轻型突击机甲的需求而生，宙斯的速度足以跟上多数重型机甲，并具备同等的压制能力. 基于宙斯-X底盘进行氏族科技改造的版本，将原有电子设备与全部科技部件升级为氏族改良型号. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants formed part of the Clans' Enhanced Imaging system and were useful only when combined with a Battle机甲, Proto机甲 or Battle 装甲 equipped with an Enhanced Imaging Display. The implants themselves consisted of electronic sensors, fiber-optic wires and contact points connected to a warrior's central nervous system. Implanted just below the skin they were visible as faintly luminous lines in colors such as red, blue or green.
column2: 增强成像神经植入物是氏族增强成像系统的一部分，只有在与配备增强成像显示器的战斗机甲、原型机甲或战斗装甲结合时才能发挥效用. 植入物本身由电子传感器、光纤导线和连接至战士中枢神经系统的接触点组成. 它们被植入皮下，外观呈现为淡红色、蓝色或绿色的微光纹路.

column1: The -6B is originally a custom order for ComStar, but with the Jihad the 布雷克圣言会 brought most of them into its folds. The combination of Heavy with attached capacitors and LRM-15 launchers keeps the '机甲 flexible in most engagements where its slow speed is not a major hindrance. Two ER PPCs, also using capacitors, provide extra firepower as needed, but are not recommended to be constantly used due to the increased heat build up. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 1.35 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: -6B型原本是通讯之星定制订单的产物，但随着圣战爆发，大部分该机型都被布雷克圣言会摄取入囊中. 重式粒子加农炮与蓄能电容、LRM-15发射器的组合配置，使这台机甲在移动迟缓不会构成致命缺陷的大多数交战中都能保持战术弹性. 两门同样配备蓄能电容的增程粒子加农炮可根据需要提供额外火力，但因会加剧热量积聚而不建议持续使用. 特质: 改良冷却套 - PPC 部署费用倍率: 1.35 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Once again it is proven that the best 'Mechs are created on the battlefield, not in the design lab. These changes are much more to my liking than the -6M variant.
column2: 事实再次证明，最好的机甲是在战场上制造的，而不是在设计实验室中制造的。这些更改比 -6M 变体更符合我的喜好。

column1: The Karnov UR Transport is a heavy lift VTOL which has been in service for hundreds of years. The tilt-rotor 设计 is one of the fastest of its type in use. A reliable and hardy machine, all of the Successor State armed forces and many mercenary units employ Karnovs for supply and logistics missions. Many commercial firms also use the machine for local transportation of cargo in its sizable 6-ton bay or as a flying crane. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 60 15 左侧 55 15 右侧 55 15 后方 55 15 总计 240 75 怪癖: 快速起步
column2: 卡诺夫UR运输机是一款已服役数百年的重型起重VTOL。其倾转旋翼设计是同类在用机型中最快者之一。作为可靠而皮实的机械，所有继承国武装部队以及许多雇佣兵单位都用卡诺夫执行补给与后勤任务。许多商业公司也用它进行本地货物运输——利用其宽裕的6吨货舱——或充当飞行吊车。此变型与AC变型相似，只是以一门带20发弹药的锤子火炮取代了自动炮。生态限制：该单位无法部署在月球生态区。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 40 15 左侧 35 15 右侧 35 15 后方 35 15 总计 160 75 特性：启动迅速

column1: You reread the message a few times before making up your mind and hitting the <color=#028A00>REQUEST ONSITE QUOTE</color> button. A few moments later you get a response stating a representative will arrive tomorrow to inspect and quote on the cost of upgrading the Gamma Pod.
column2: 你把这条消息反复读了几遍，最终下定决心，点击了<color=#028A00>申请现场报价</color>按钮。几分钟后，你收到回复，称一名代表将在明天到访，检查伽玛舱段并评估升级所需的费用。

column1: This version of the Lobo replaces the standard weaponry with a large pulse laser, two ER medium lasers, two AP Gauss rifles, and two plasma cannons. This makes it an effective anti-infantry and anti-battle armor 'Mech. It also adds one extra double heat sink to the configuration. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这款洛波改型用一门大型脉冲激光、两门中型增程激光、两门AP高斯步枪和两门等离子炮替换了标准武器配置，使其成为一款高效的反步兵与反战斗装甲机甲. 该配置还额外增加了一副双重散热器. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. Whipping dust reduces visibility and sensor efficiency to 60%, and all units have +2 Defense. Strong winds result in land units taking 20% more stability damage, while VTOL units have -2 max evasion. Heat generation is increased by 10%.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 漫天沙尘将能见度与传感器效能降至 60%，所有单位获得 +2 防御. 强风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 20%，而垂直起降飞行器单位的最大闪避值 -2. 热量生成增加 10%.

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. Ferro-fibrous armor and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.24
column2: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. Ferro-fibrous armor and integrated CASE round out the design. Quirk：扰乱 Drop Cost Multiplier：1.24

column1: 维克多 9S 以其本就不佳的装甲换取更多武器。看到这台机甲从山丘上疾冲而出倾泻可观火力，对敌军而言极为可怕，但它也必须认真地担心任何回击。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Victor 9S牺牲了部分本就差强人意的装甲，以搭载更多武器. 敌军看到这台机甲翻越山头倾泻凶猛火力时固然心惊胆战，但它也必须时刻提防任何回击. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 右上臂

column1: In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, 氏族地狱马 began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry vehicle, which they called the Bellona. Designed as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the vehicle cited that 'speed is armor', which led to the Bellona being redesigned as a hovertank. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Armor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 25 Left 115 25 Right 115 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 145 25 Total 655 125 Quirk: Nimble
column2: 在3060年代末  在可汗詹姆斯·科布的指挥下  地狱之马氏族开始准备重新在内层领域建立存在. 科学家种姓视此为创造新型骑兵载具的机会  他们将其命名为Bellona. 作为突击和侧翼单位设计  Bellona在足够灵活的车架上携带足够的火力  以跟上甚至最快速推进的战线. 最初的规格要求使用履带  但该载具的试飞员引用“速度即装甲”  这导致Bellona被重新设计为悬浮坦克. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 180 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 145 25 总计 655 125 特质: 灵活 #武器: 4x 轻机枪(氏族) 1x UAC/10(氏族) 2x 火焰喷射器(氏族)

column1: 玉鹰氏族's version of the Jade Hawk is purely Clan-spec and lacks the advanced myomers and claws of the DOA JHK-03 model, carrying four 锁定式SRM-6 launchers instead of the standard models and mounting a 轻型 主动探头 in its head. Four tons of ammo give the design excellent endurance despite the large number of launchers, while the addition of Ferro-Fibrous plating increases its protection. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 玉鹰氏族的翠鹰型号采用纯粹的氏族规格，没有DOA JHK-03型号的先进肌动体和爪，安装了四具锁定式SRM-6发射器替代标准型号，并在头部搭载了轻型主动探测器. 四吨弹药赋予该设计出色的持久力，尽管发射器数量众多，而铁纤维装甲板的加入则增强了其防护能力. 特质: 干扰 部署费用倍率: 1.15

column1: Partisan 在竞技场中并不常见；它速度慢、火力弱、装甲差。但 Ka-Lai Guo 驾驶的 Partisan 则不然。它装备成对的 AC/5 和氏族制造的 UAC/5——后者由一台大型氏族瞄准计算机确保精度——Ka-Lai 的 Partisan 能在大多数敌人逼近之前将其撕碎。混合使用不同武器系统可将一次致命的卡壳导致全部武器失效的风险降到最低，也便于为 AC/5 装填非标准弹药。车上使用了一台燃料电池，将坦克的装甲强化到更具生存能力的水平。\\n\\n生物群系限制：无。\\n\\n移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。\\n\\n装甲：重型铁纤维装甲\\n结构：标准结构\\n数值 A S \\n前部 160 40\\n左侧 140 40\\n右侧 140 40\\n后部 120 40\\n炮塔 160 40\\n\\n总计 720 200\\n\\n特性：防空瞄准
column2: 游击队在竞技场上并不常见；它缓慢、火力不足且装甲薄弱。而郭嘉莱驾驶的游击队则不然。装备着成对的 AC/5 和氏族制造的 UAC/5——其精度由一台巨大的氏族瞄准计算机保证——嘉莱的游击队能在大多数敌人靠近之前将其撕碎。混用武器系统把一次致命的卡壳导致全部武器失效的风险降到最低，也让 AC/5 可以装填非标准弹药。燃料电池被用来把坦克的装甲提升到更具生存性的水平。\\n\\n生物群系限制：无。\\n\\n移动力：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。\\n\\n装甲：重型铁纤装甲\\n结构：结构\\n数值 A S \\n正面 160 40\\n左侧 140 40\\n右侧 140 40\\n后方 120 40\\n炮塔 160 40\\n\\n总计 720 200\\n\\n特性：防空瞄准

column1: The attack on Horgens continues. You have to choose the next contract to attempt, only once all three are finished will the attack be successful.
column2: 对Horgens 的进攻仍在继续. 你必须选择下一份要执行的合约，只有完成全部三项任务，进攻才会成功.

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to it’s notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 2N is powered by a 330-rated Light Fusion Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A pair of MML-3's and a 等离子步枪 form the Mechs weapons load. TAG allows the Mech to designate targets for allied support units. Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 作为首批量产的四足机甲之一，55吨的“蝎子（Scorpion）”于2570年作为步兵支援单位投产. 尽管因臭名昭著的不稳定步态被多数机甲战士所摒弃，蝎子却在继承权战争及其后岁月中得以持续使用. 蝎子2N型由一台330级轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高时速可达97公里. 一对MML-3和一支等离子步枪构成了该机甲的武器配置. TAG可使机甲为友军支援单位标定目标. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Designed by the 马里安霸权 using the most cutting-edge gear available to them, the Marauder 战斗装甲 is patterned after the venerable Marauder BattleMech. Armed with a pair of Support PPCs and a Light Recoilless Rifle, the Marauder BA is one of the most heavily armed BA in existence. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armored, their extreme firepower load for battle armor makes them deadly on the field. 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.895 Can mount any unit, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: 由马里安霸权使用最尖端装备设计，劫掠者战斗装甲承袭了经典劫掠者战械的造型. 配备两门支援型PPC与一具轻型无后坐力步枪，劫掠者BA堪称现存火力最为凶悍的战斗装甲之一. 马里安人将其编为五人制小队「contubernium」投入作战，装甲也针对这种规模较大的部署模式进行了专门设计. 虽然装甲防护并不突出，但其极端强化的战斗装甲火力配置足以让它们成为战场上的死神. 特质: 标准部件 部署费用倍率: 0.895 可搭载任何单位，无法近战，无法攀附攻击.

column1: 龙蛇联合使用的黑暗时代型号；该型号移除了跳跃喷口，换成额外的 SRM-2。它的名字源于士兵尝试跳跃时，HUD 上会显示“Baka”一词。 Quirk: 标准部件 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 雷电 II 系列是基于标准雷电改进而来，其装甲被替换为反射装甲. 特质: 设计精良 部署费用倍率: 0.888 可挂载于万能单位，可以进行近战攻击，可以进行攀附攻击.

column1: The Attor D configuration is designed to wear down opponents steadily, armed with a Class 40 超重型突击高斯 Rifle and an ER Large Laser. A 轻型 主动探头 boosts battlefield awareness for the Attor, especially in urban terrain, while its 120-meter jump jets improve mobility greatly. Quirk: 强化腿部 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Attor D型配置旨在持续消耗对手，装备了一门40级超高速高斯步枪和一门大型增程激光. 轻型主动探测器增强了Attor的战场感知能力，尤其是在城市地形中，而120米的跳跃喷气装置则大幅提升了机动性. 特质: 强化腿部 部署费用倍率: 1.17 经Aries Games & Miniatures授权使用.

column1: Produced during the Jihad, this configuration employs pair of ER Medium Lasers in left torso, while fitting pair of Light PPCs in each arm actuator slot.
column2: 该配置是在圣战期间生产的，在左躯干中采用了一对 ER 中型激光器，同时在每个手臂致动器插槽中安装了一对轻型 PPC。

column1: The B configuration is made for urban warfare or heavy infantry engagements, two LB-X AC/20, six Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles, a 中型脉冲激光 and two Large 改进型重型激光 ensure both short and long range damage are at adequate levels. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.4 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: B配置专为城市作战或重装步兵交战而设计，两门LB-X型AC/20自动炮、六门反人员高斯步枪、一门中型脉冲激光和两门大型改进型重型激光确保中短距离和长距离伤害都保持在足够水平. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.4 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: 尼克斯 NX-80 在双臂各安装了一门中型增程激光，为其提供了适中的远程火力. 当这台机甲接近敌人时，便能发挥其SRM-6和小型增程激光的威力. 武器与其他设备产生的废热由 10 具双散热器进行处理. 该机甲配备了一具贝格尔主动探测器，以履行其侦察机甲的职责. 其机身受到 5 吨铁纤维装甲的防护，足以在敌军火力下坚持到完成任务. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂
column2: 瞄准膝盖!(80): 物理武器攻击精度 +1，物理武器伤害与稳定性伤害 +10%:\n\n

column1: 伏击者最初是一款失败的战斗机甲，设计初衷是缩小正面轮廓以使机甲更难被击中。但伏击者独特的设计导致引擎屏蔽出现问题，副作用表现为已部署原型机上各种机载电子设备的莫名故障。 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Bushwacker S2c是一款前线机型，将其反导弹系统（AMS）升级为主动防护系统（APD），并搭配电子对抗系统（ECM），为单位提供高级掩护. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The 4A was the original Canopian 设计. It could only jump 180 meters, though it had a top speed of 97 km/h which could be boosted through MASC. The decidedly lower-tech machine used standard medium lasers and two 机枪 Arrays consisting of four machine guns each instead of the missile launcher. It had standard 装甲, and used an active probe. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 4A 型是卡诺帕斯的原始设计. 它的跳跃距离仅为180米，但最高时速可达97公里，并可通过MASC系统进一步提升. 这款技术相对简单的机甲配备了标准中型激光和两组机枪阵列（每组由四挺机枪组成），用以替代导弹发射器. 它采用标准装甲，并搭载了一套主动探测器. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column2: E型配置与基本配置的唯一区别是用两门增程PPC取代了脉冲激光. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Saracen is a well-designed hovercraft: it is fast and decently armored. Its weapons are designed for maximum effect against other vehicles, using a mix of long and short-range missiles mounted in its turret. It has endeared itself to its crews due to its reliability and ruggedness and forms the backbone of many striker units. The Saracen was developed towards the end of the Third Succession War by Scarborough Limited. Shortly afterward Scarborough created two other vehicles based on the Saracen, the Scimitar and the Saladin. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 170 20 Left 125 20 Right 125 20 Rear 100 20 Turret 120 20 Total 640 100 Quirk: Rugged

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous armor giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman E is armed with a 大型脉冲激光 and an ATM-6. A pair of 中型脉冲激光s and an ER Small Laser provide additional firepower at close range. A combination of a Light TAG and a 轻型 主动探头 allow the Huntsman to scout or spot for allied units. AMS protects the Huntsman against incoming missiles. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为新星猫设计，50吨的猎人机甲是为复兴行动和内天体入侵而设计的；于3049年首次投产. 作为一种万能机甲，猎人机甲采用了250级超轻型引擎、钢内骨结构和铁纤维装甲，为其提供了21.5吨的载荷空间. 5个跳跃推进器固定在底盘上，赋予猎人机甲额外的灵活性. 猎人E型配备了一门大型脉冲激光和一台ATM-6，两门中型脉冲激光和一门扩展范围小型激光提供近距离额外火力. 轻型目标锁定器和轻型主动探针的组合使猎人机甲能够为友军单位进行侦察或目标指示. 反导系统保护猎人机甲免受来袭导弹的伤害. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column2: 凯尔·麦克格拉申对他的袋鼠从何而来非常讳莫如深，毕竟这种坦克理论上早已灭绝。但这并不妨碍这台博物馆藏品危险半分，今年它已经拿下 8 场胜利。为近身混战而装备，凯尔的袋鼠相比原版有了显著改装。改用燃料电池使主炮得以升级为 LB-10X 型号。导弹发射架同样换成了一对连环 SRM-2，一门小型激光取代了机枪。\\n\\n生物群系限制：无。\\n\\n移动力：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。\\n\\n装甲：装甲\\n结构：结构\\n数值 A S \\n正面 150 25\\n左侧 110 25\\n右侧 110 25\\n后方 110 25\\n\\n总计 480 100\\n\\n特性：受保护机构

column1: A binary star system, the fifth world is nicknamed "Brimstone" by the natives; it has a large satellite world called Fire. The temperature range at the polar capital of Port Erebus can vary over 70 degrees in one day.
column2: 这是一个双星系统，第五颗行星被当地人昵称为“硫磺”；它有一颗巨大的卫星世界，名为“火”. 位于极地首府厄瑞玻斯港的气温在一天内变化可超过70度.

column1: Triple Mixed Tech, Questionable at Best. This Primitive Helepolis was Picked up by a well Respected Mechwarrior Outfit, upgraded it with IS Gear to be Functional Atleast. Swapped Hands and then installed Clan Gear in its Interior, as a Test bed so to Speak. There are so many different Doohickeys just to have everything work together, im Amazed it doesnt Short circuit itself.
column2: 三重混合技术，充其量也值得怀疑。这个原始的赫勒波利斯被一个备受尊敬的机甲战士套装拾取，并用 IS 装备对其进行了升级，使其至少具有功能。交换了手，然后在其内部安装了氏族装备，可以说是作为测试台。有这么多不同的技巧只是为了让所有东西一起工作，我很惊讶它本身不会短路。

The variant never saw much success, mainly due to the increased cost of using an Endo-Steel frame. 特性：改良冷却套-PPC 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: The Lu Bu LB-182 updates the chassis of the Lu Bu to use Endo-Steel structure The extra space allows for adding a Guardian ECM as well as replacing the three Medium Lasers with two Medium Pulse Lasers. The variant never saw much success, mainly due to the increased cost of using an Endo-Steel frame. Quirk：Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The KGC-009 King Crab is notoriously difficult to put down, thanks to heavy 装甲 and a reinforced gyro that can keep the machine on its feet even when faced with withering fire. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: KGC-009“帝王蟹（King Crab）”机甲以其厚重的装甲和增强型陀螺仪而极难被击倒，即便面对猛烈的火力也能屹立不倒. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: This customized 'Mech is equipped with 270 XL engine, two ER Micro Lasers and Heavy Machine Guns in both torsos, Streak SRM 4 with it's one ton of ammo in central torso and two Streak SRM 2's in the right arm, along with 10 双散热器 to cope with the heat, half ton of HMG ammo in left torso and one full ton of HMG and Streak SRM 4 ammo bins in right torso. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 这架定制机甲配备了270 XL引擎，左右躯干各装有两门增程微型激光和重机枪，中央躯干安装了一具锁定式SRM-4及其一吨弹药，右臂安装了两具锁定式SRM-2，同时搭载了10个双散热器以应对热量，左躯干存放半吨重机枪弹药，右躯干存放各一吨的重机枪弹药和锁定式SRM 4弹药. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.07

column1: The Hunchback C is the antithesis of the 驼背 IIC used by other Clans, combining toughness and great ground speed with the heavy firepower of its autocannon. Piloted by Star Commander Matthew Wayne, of the Clan Ghost Bear's Seventh Phalanx. Disgraced after losing his 全向Mech and from an insignificant Bloodhouse, he saw it as his only resort to take charge of a Hunchback of Lyran origins. However, heavy modifications to the 'Mech and his unrelenting desire to redeem himself led to him eventually being adopted by Delta Galaxy's Seventy-Third Battle Cluster, before he finally was killed while clearing Blakists during a glorious charge at Fell's Fort. 特性：战斗拳套 部署成本倍率：1.1
column2: 驼背者C是其他氏族所使用的驼背者IIC的对立面，它兼具坚韧、出色的地面速度与自动炮的强大火力. 由幽灵熊氏族第七方阵的星指挥官马修·韦恩驾驶. 在失去自己的万能机甲后，加上出身于一个无足轻重的血统家族，他视接管一台天琴血统的驼背者为唯一的出路. 然而，对机甲的深度改造和他渴望自我救赎的执着，使他最终被德尔塔星系的第七十三战斗集群接纳，最后在向费尔堡发起光荣冲锋、扫荡布雷克时战死. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.1

column1: This is a....huge tree trunk. But it seems the tree is either extremely dense or was petrified at some point of its life.
column2: 这是一棵……巨大的树干。但这棵树似乎要么极其茂密，要么在其生命的某个阶段被石化了。

column1: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3A is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of one 大型脉冲激光 and four 中型脉冲激光s. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 基于费兰·凯尔的机甲“笑面者”设计，狼犬IIC 3A是狼犬的氏族科技版本. 该设计采用钢内骨结构、铁纤维装甲和超轻型引擎，并配备电子战套件. 武器系统完全以能量为基础，包括一门大型脉冲激光和四门中型脉冲激光. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column2: 对边缘世界共和国前哨站11号 的进攻仍在继续. 你必须选择下一份要执行的合约，只有完成全部三项任务，进攻才会成功.

column1: Louse 是外围各地行星政府钟爱的工具，专为镇压暴乱而设计。它能以致命与非致命手段驱散暴乱，对付平民和轻武装车辆效果良好，同时对真正的战斗机甲或军用车辆不构成明显威胁。两具榴弹发射器和一整套混合激光构成其主要火力，另有一对照明弹发射器提供额外的威慑，并可在战斗中转用于防御。防崩落衬层装甲提供了对步兵级武器的额外防护，一整套专为穿透杂乱城市环境而设计的传感器则为该机甲画上句号。它常被用作侦察与支援力量；在那些发现自己要在战场上面对它的海盗团伙中，这台机甲相当常见。它并非为战斗而生，却仍被缺乏真正战斗机甲的绝望民兵与政府强行投入使用。 Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这个版本用2支磁射步枪替换了原有的机枪，并加装了2门小型增程激光. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: When Angol was discovered by humans it was already a frozen planet, locked 在 或bit around a small, dy在g red star. Settled by prisoners 和 other "undesirables" 来自 nearby Tikonov, the society was modelled after Communism.
column2: 当人类发现Angol时，它已经是一颗冰冻星球，被锁定在一颗小而垂死的红星的轨道上. 来自附近Tikonov的囚犯和其他“不受欢迎者”在此定居，社会以共产主义为蓝本.

column1: First 生产 in 3092, this variant carries the paired ER large lasers of the standard, but mounts dual ATM-6s, each fed by three tons of ammunition. It also adds a ton of 装甲 protection. Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: 首先投产于3092年，该变体搭载了标准型号所配的成对大型增程激光，同时安装了两台ATM-6发射器，每台备弹三吨. 此外还增加了一吨的装甲防护. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.08

column1: Mech Grenade Launcher rounds are low-velocity, high-explosive projectiles able to damage several units on impact. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 机甲榴弹发射器子弹是低速、高爆炸弹，能够在撞击时损坏多个单位。受到致命一击后，弹药箱内储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E 可以降低风险。

column1: Like many designs lost during the Succession Wars, the Sorcerer design saw new life in the decades after the discovery of the Helm Memory Core. The Draconis Combine was the first to create a new variant of the aged SLDF design utilizing technologies at their disposal in 3058. The Sorcerer 2D retains the 380XL Engine, 守护者ECM Suite, one of the original PPCs, and thirteen of the original 双散热器 and adds a pair of Shigunga MRM40s fed by four tons of ammo. A Small Laser is also added to the right arm for anti-personnel work. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 就像继承战争期间遗失的许多设计一样，巫师型机甲在赫尔姆记忆核心被发现后的数十年间重获新生. 天龙联合体在3058年率先利用现有技术打造了这款老旧SLDF设计的全新变体. 巫师2D型保留了380XL引擎、守护者ECM套件、一门原装PPC以及13具原装双散热器，同时加装了两具由四吨弹药供弹的死贡MRM40发射器. 右臂还新增了一门小型激光用于反人员作战. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.15

column1: The F configuration carries a pair of 大型脉冲激光s and a single ER PPC, which are tied into a 定位 Computer. It also sports a Supercharger, which allows it to reach a top speed of 100 km/h when combined with the MASC system. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: F型配置搭载两门大型脉冲激光和一门增程粒子加农炮，并连接到瞄准计算机. 它还配备了增压器，结合驱动加速系统，能让机甲达到100公里/小时的最高速度. 特质: 威吓 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox D-EWR is s an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The standard NARC Pod and LRM-5 are removed. With the freed weight, the LRM-15's are upgraded to use the 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控 and a pair of ER 中型激光s added. A 小型脉冲激光 rounds out the configuration. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of fire power and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox D-EWR is s an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The standard NARC Pod and LRM-5 are removed. With the freed weight, the LRM-15's are upgraded to use the Artemis IV FCS and a pair of ER Medium Lasers added. A Small Pulse Laser rounds out the configuration. Quirk：Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This Mixed Tech variant focuses on combating DFA tactics. Spikes are added along with nine and a half additional tons of 加固装甲 to better protect the Amarok from 'Mechs attempting to conduct such an attack. The PPC is replaced with an LRM 20 with Artemis V and the RAC is replaced with a 超突击高斯 Rifle 20, both with two tons of ammo and protected by CASE II. Seven small pulse lasers are added, three in each arm and one in the center torso, intended for inflicting disruptive damage on oncoming enemies. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: 这种混合科技改型专注于对抗DFA战术. 该机甲增加了尖刺装甲以及额外九吨半的硬化装甲，以更好地保护Amarok免受试图实施此类攻击的机甲的伤害. PPC被替换为配备阿尔忒弥斯V的LRM 20，而RAC则被替换为超突击高斯步枪20，两者均配有两吨弹药并受CASE II保护. 新增了七门小型脉冲激光，每只手臂各三门，中央躯干一门，旨在对来袭敌人造成干扰性伤害. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.24

column1: The Saladin Mk II HCV is a redesigned version of the original Third Succession War-era Saladin combat vehicle prized for its hitting power and speed. This new version of the Scarborough Manufacturers' famous line of hovercrafts would be first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. While retaining the speed of the original model, the Saladin MK II is considerably better protected by Scarborough engineers using 5.5 tons of Heavy 铁纤维装甲. The tank's primary weapon is its front-mounted Magna Flarestar Snub-Nose Particle Projection Cannon. While this has less punch than the original's heavy Autocannon, the PPC has no ammunition needs, allowing it to keep fighting longer and at greater ranges. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 225 20 左侧 150 20 右侧 150 20 后方 100 20 总计 625 80 特性：灵巧
column2: Saladin Mk II HCV是第三次继承战争时期原版Saladin战斗车辆的重新设计版本  因其打击力和速度而备受赞誉. 这款Scarborough Manufacturers著名气垫船系列的新版本将在三十二世纪中期首次生产. 虽然保留了原版车型的速度  但Saladin MK II在Scarborough工程师使用5.5吨重型铁纤维装甲的保护下  防护能力大幅提升. 该坦克的主要武器是前置的Magna Flarestar短管粒子加农炮. 虽然其威力不如原版的重型自动炮  但PPC无需弹药  使其能够在更远的距离上持续作战更长时间. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 10/15格 / 300/450米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 225 20 左侧 150 20 右侧 150 20 后方 100 20 总计 625 80 特质: 灵巧 #武器: 2x 小型转管化学激光 1x 短管PPC(海盗)

column1: 这一"杂项"麦基系列用于指代以各种更现代组件改装的-6S。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这种改型的“灾星”1型只为一件事而配置: 使机甲装甲剧烈震颤，以至于内部结构开始崩裂. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这种变体主要用于远离补给线时. 它移除了导弹和大型增程激光，换装了一对增程粒子加农炮和额外的双重散热器. 特质: 受保护驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Siorc Wolf 4 acts as a versatile direct fire support unit, combining twin 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s for close combat and dual Class 40 超重型突击高斯 Rifles for long-range strikes. Equipped with an Angel ECM Suite, it can jam enemy sensors and disrupt targeting, improving survivability. This balance of powerful weapons and electronic warfare capabilities makes it a favorite in many toumans, able to adapt to a variety of combat roles effectively. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 西奥尔克狼4作为一款多功能直接火力支援单位，结合了两门改进型中型重激光用于近战，以及两门40型超突击高斯步枪用于远程打击. 它配备天使ECM套件，能够干扰敌方传感器并扰乱瞄准，提高生存能力. 这种强大武器与电子战能力的平衡，使其成为许多托曼中的青睐之选，能够有效适应多种战斗角色. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用.

column1: This redesigned variant removes all mounted weapons and replaces them with two Coventry Star Fire LRM-15 racks, each with their own Artemis IV fire control system and 2 tons of ammunition to provide even greater accuracy and firepower. To make room from the additional weapons the engine was downgraded to a Doorman 140 Fusion engine giving it a maximum speed of 64 km/h. The StarSlab/5.5 Standard armor was replaced with Star Slab/4 Ferro-Fibrous to save weight, but this also reduced its armor by a significant amount, making it a much easier target to destroy. The Hunter Light Support Tank is popular with planetary militias and second-line units. It was designed by 迪法恩斯工业 as a cheap, reliable and effective combat vehicle to provide covering fire support for combat units withdrawing from the front lines. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 115 20 Left 95 20 Right 95 20 Rear 75 20 Total 380 80 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹
column2: 这种重新设计的变体移除了所有安装的武器  并替换为两具Coventry Star Fire LRM-15发射器  每具都配备了自己的阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统和2吨弹药  以提供更高的精度和火力. 为了腾出空间安装额外武器  引擎被降级为Doorman 140聚变引擎  使其最大速度达到64公里/小时. StarSlab/5.5标准装甲被替换为Star Slab/4铁纤维装甲以节省重量  但这也大幅减少了其装甲  使其成为更容易被摧毁的目标. Hunter轻型支援坦克在行星民兵和二级部队中很受欢迎. 它由Defiance Industries设计  作为一种廉价、可靠且有效的战斗车辆  为从前线撤退的战斗单位提供掩护火力支援. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 115 20 左侧 95 20 右侧 95 20 后方 75 20 总计 380 80 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 #武器: 2x LRM-15

column1: As the -23K failed to capture the hearts of the DCMS, several units were converted to a more support and command role. Adding a 指挥控制台, 守护者ECM, 主动探头 and C3 Master for the price of dropping on of the 短管PPCs improved the importance of the 'Mech on the battlefield significantly thanks to it enhanced electronic warfare and command capabilities, turning the -23K-DC into a favoute of the officers of the DCMS. Quirk: 均衡 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3
column2: 由于-23K未能赢得DCMS的青睐，部分机体被改装为更偏向支援与指挥的角色. 通过拆除一门短管粒子加农炮，换装指挥控制台、守护者ECM、主动探测器和C3主控系统，凭借其增强的电子战与指挥能力，该机甲在战场上的重要性显著提升，使-23K-DC成为DCMS军官们的新宠. 特质: 良好平衡 部署费用倍率: 1.3

column1: Designed during the Amaris Civil War as a command Mech, the 95 ton Nightstar would not see production until the chaos of the First Succession War. The Nightstar ceased production a year after it first walked off the factory line and would not see production again until the late 3050’s. Powered by a 285-rated XL Engine, the Nightstar 10D is armed with a pair of 轻型高斯步枪s and a pair of Clan ER Large Lasers. A 中型X脉冲激光 Laser provides extra firepower at close quarters. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.17
column2: Designed during the Amaris Civil War as a command Mech, the 95 ton Nightstar would not see production until the chaos of the First Succession War. The Nightstar ceased production a year after it first walked off the factory line and would not see production again until the late 3050’s. Powered by a 285-rated XL Engine, the Nightstar 10D is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a pair of Clan ER Large Lasers. A Medium X-Pulse Laser provides extra firepower at close quarters. Quirk：Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier：1.17

column2: (最低分数: 0) 在这个级别，你才刚刚开始，没有什么重大成就.

column1: This started as a fairly normal Crosscut X5M, and then some crazy fool ripped out the nice light AC2 and put a hotwired PPC in it's place. The scary thing is that it can take the heat. Oh, and watch out for the downright terrifying missile pack they bolted on too. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.72 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 这原本是一台相当普通的“十字锯（Crosscut）”X5M，然后某个疯狂的家伙拆掉了那门轻便的AC2，在原位装上了一门非法改装的PPC. 可怕的是，它居然能承受住这门炮的热量. 哦，还得当心他们加挂的那个极其恐怖的导弹包. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 0.72

column1: RISC Engineers took a retake on the 'failed' NAIS 银弹高斯 Rifle and refit it to fire a extremely dense cluster of shots, showering the target area in a dense deadly shrapnel shroud. Uses 重型高斯弹药. VOLATILE!
column2: RISC Engineers took a retake on the 'failed' NAIS Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle and refit it to fire a extremely dense cluster of shots, showering the target area in a dense deadly shrapnel shroud. Uses Ammo Heavy Gauss. VOLATILE!

column1: This WAS an LRM20, they somehow managed to override any safeties, removed the guidance computer, and sped up the feeding mechanism. If this explodes and sends you after Kerensky don't ask me to fix it. \n\n Uses LRM Ammo.
column2: 这玩意儿原本是具LRM20，不知怎么被人把所有保险装置都拆了，移除了制导计算机，还把供弹机构调得飞快. 要是它炸了，把你送去见克伦斯基，可别指望我修.\n\n使用LRM弹药.

column1: The QD3 is an upgrade of the QD variant. While it retains most aspects of the QD1, the QD3 is instead powered by a 210 engine for a top speed of 119 km/h, sports ferro-fibrous 装甲, and carries two ER medium lasers and a LRM-5 launcher. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: 左侧 Lower
column2: QD3型是QD型号的升级版. 它在保留了QD1型大部分特性的同时，改用210型引擎驱动机体，最高时速可达119公里，配备铁纤维装甲，并搭载两门中型增程激光和一具LRM-5发射器. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: This Jihad-era field refit Vulcan carries two extra heat sinks and a Plasma Rifle while retaining the medium laser, machine gun and flamer. Outfitted with MASC, the 'Mech could escape with a short speed boost from a dangerous situation.
column2: 这辆圣战时代的野战改装火神配备了两个额外的散热器和一支等离子步枪，同时保留了中型激光、机枪和火焰喷射器。配备了 MASC 的“机甲”可以在危险情况下通过短暂的速度提升来逃脱。

column1: A post Jihad upgrade to the FC-LRM Partisan, the FC-ELRM Partisan swaps the quad LRM-15s and AMS of the original model for a quad of ELRM-10s; allowing the FC-ELRM to double as light artillery. 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 allows for the addition of CASE and extra LRM ammo while the original MG is retained with a larger magazine. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 200 40 左侧 120 40 右侧 120 40 后方 100 40 炮塔 150 40 总计 690 200 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位
column2: 作为圣战后对FC-LRM Partisan的升级  FC-ELRM Partisan将原型的四联LRM-15和AMS替换为四联ELRM-10  使FC-ELRM能够兼作轻型火炮. 重型铁纤维装甲允许添加CASE和额外的LRM弹药  同时保留原有的机枪并配备更大的弹匣. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 200 40 左侧 120 40 右侧 120 40 后方 100 40 炮塔 150 40 总计 690 200 特质: 防空瞄准 #武器: 2x 机枪 4x ELRM-10

column1: This is a production variant based on the AXM-6X. This version, introduced in 3083, uses an Inner Sphere–produced XL engine and lacks the supercharger of the 6X. The top speed of the 6T is 86 km/h. The armor protection and weapon configuration are identical to the Axman 6X, but the Thunderbolt launchers have two tons of ammunition each. It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. Instead, this carries a handheld unarmored NLRM-10 launcher. 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署成本倍率：1.09
column2: 这是基于AXM-6X的量产型号. 该版本于3083年推出，采用内天体生产的超轻型引擎，并取消了6X的增压器. 6T型号的最高时速为86公里. 其装甲防护与武器配置与斧神6X相同，但雷霆导弹发射器各配备两吨弹药. 这也是唯一不搭载标志性近战武器的斧神型号. 取而代之的是携带一具手持式无装甲NLRM-10发射器. 特质: 精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: Facing increased competition from a rising number of higher-quality assault 'Mechs, Maltex chose to apply the technologies developed for its innovative Hatamoto-Suna to its older and more reliable HatamotoChi, while replacing the older PPCs with heavy models. The resultant -30T — cheap, tough, and effective — has been a tremendous hit and is being produced in staggering numbers. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 面对数量日益增多、质量更优的突击型机甲带来的激烈竞争，马尔泰克斯公司选择将其为创新的旗本-砂型所研发的技术，应用到更老但更可靠的旗本-智型上，同时用重型型号替换了老旧的粒子加农炮. 由此诞生的-30T型——廉价、坚固且高效——取得了巨大成功，正以惊人的数量投入生产. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: [Society Version] The Hadur Fast Support Vehicle was 开发 by 氏族地狱马 and introduced in 3102. Capable of reaching a top speed of 151 km/h, the Hadur can quickly position itself to provide heavy missile artillery support. It performs best when paired with forward scouts like the Asshur scout. The crew is protected by six tons of standard plate 装甲. The primary weapon of the Hadur is the Class 16 Arrow IV launcher. This massive weapon provides missile artillery support to friendly forces. However, unlike the Naga Omni机甲, the Hadur has a single twenty round magazine instead of four smaller five round magazines. This means that switching ammunition types is a problem for Hadur crews. To remedy this, the Horses typically load the magazine with homing Arrow IV rounds. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲: 装甲 (C) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 125 25 左侧 100 25 右侧 100 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 505 125 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors
column2: [社会版本] Hadur快速支援车由地狱战马氏族研发  于3102年投入使用. Hadur最高时速可达151公里  能迅速定位自身以提供重型导弹炮火支援. 与Asshur侦察车等前线侦察单位协同作战时  其表现最佳. 乘员受到六吨标准板甲的保护. Hadur的主要武器是16型箭IV发射器. 这一巨型武器为友军提供导弹炮火支援. 然而  与Naga万能机甲不同  Hadur只有一个二十发的弹匣  而非四个五发的小弹匣. 这意味着更换弹药类型对Hadur车组来说是个问题. 为了解决这一问题  Horses通常会在弹匣中装填自导引箭IV弹药. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 125 25 左侧 100 25 右侧 100 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 505 125 特质: 改进型传感器 #武器: 2x AP高斯步枪 2x 小型超能激光(秘社) 1x 箭V(秘社)

column2: 不用怀疑，Quicsell的贝金探测器绝对是市面上最强的主动探头，没有之一. 过去你要是幻想过仅靠扫描就能把爆米花加热出来，现在你可以做到了.

column1: Introduced in 3054, the 骑兵武装直升机 was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 75 15 左侧 50 15 右侧 50 15 后方 30 15 总计 220 75 特性：导弹干扰器
column2: 骑兵攻击直升机于3054年列装，是迈克尔森重工业公司为对抗部族而研制的众多VTOL之一。骑兵适合打了就跑的交战，而非一线正面作战；使用得当时，它以表现完美而著称。此后它曾在前联邦共和诸国以及混沌三月地区的小贵族中服役。骑兵最高速度可达162公里/小时，但并不单靠速度自保——它拥有3.5吨装甲。机首硬吃一发部族技术增程粒子加农炮仍能继续飞行。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 75 15 左侧 50 15 右侧 50 15 后方 30 15 总计 220 75 特性：狭小/低矮外形

column1: The G configuration includes Advanced Technologies developed for ProtoMechs. The 'Mech includes three torso mounted Class 4 ProtoMech Autocannons, with 2 tons of ammunition split between the side torsos. A pair of ER 中型激光s have been installed in each arm. Two extra 双散热器 are provided for this configuration. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: G型配置采用了为原型机甲开发的先进技术. 该机甲在躯干部位装有三门四型原型机甲自动炮，两侧躯干各携一吨弹药. 每只手臂上安装了一对中型增程激光. 此配置额外配备了两个双散热器. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Marsden II 主战坦克 was introduced by Arcturan Arms in 2463 to improve upon and replace its venerable predecessor after seventy years of frontline service. Not only did it share the name of the Lyran Commonwealth's late founding father with the Marsden I, but also its mission profile and much of its general layout. Improved technical and manufacturing knowledge allowed the company to improve the new tank's arms and armor while still making it five tons lighter. With its excellent firepower and thick armor, it was considered a cutting edge combat vehicle when it premiered during the Age of War. The durable Marsden II continued to soldier on in various planetary militias and private security force arsenals into the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 280 30 Left 250 30 Right 250 30 Rear 185 30 Turret 260 30 Total 1225 150 Quirk: 精准武器 - 自动炮
column2: Marsden II主战坦克由Arcturan Arms于2463年推出  旨在改进并取代其服役七十年后已显老旧的前任型号. 它不仅与Marsden I一样  与天琴共同体已故的奠基人同名  其任务定位和大部分总体布局也一脉相承. 技术和制造知识的进步使该公司得以改进新坦克的武器与装甲  同时还让它轻了五吨. 凭借出色的火力和厚重的装甲  它在Age of War期间首次亮相时被视为尖端战斗车辆. 耐用的Marsden II在继承战争期间继续在各类行星民兵和私人安保部队的武器库中服役. 环境限制: 由于使用内燃机  该单位无法部署在月球或火星环境. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 280 30 左侧 250 30 右侧 250 30 后方 185 30 炮塔 260 30 总计 1225 150 特质: 精准武器 - AC #武器: 2x LRM-5(海盗) 1x RAC/2(海盗)

column1: A mild evolution of the GLT-5M, the -7M boosts the Guillotine’s long-range firepower with a capacitor-boosted ER PPC backed-up by twin light PPCs. A pair of ER medium lasers and an ammo efficient 锁定式SRM-6 round out the weaponry. Durability is enhanced with CASE II, which reputedly also corrects the intermittent missile arming problems that plagued the original system from its inception 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: GLT-7M是GLT-5M的温和进化版本，通过电容增强型增程粒子加农炮在双联轻型粒子加农炮的火力支援下，显著提升了断头台机甲的长程打击能力. 其武器系统还配备了两门中型增程激光和一具弹药高效型锁定式SRM-6导弹发射器. 通过配备CASE II防护系统，不仅增强了战场生存能力，据称还解决了自初代系统面世以来便困扰其的间歇性导弹保险失灵问题. 特质: 集成探照灯 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: With a wave of your hand, you quiet the room. "I feel dirty agreeing to this, but let's pay up. I don't see us getting into the good graces of the pirates any time soon."
column2: 你挥了挥手，让房间安静下来.“同意这事儿让我觉得心里膈应，但还是付钱吧. 我看咱们一时半会儿也讨不到海盗们的欢心.”

column1: The blizzard increases heat sinking efficiency by 20%, and by an additional 12 heat per turn. In the snow, visibility and sensor efficiency is reduced to 60%, and all units have +2 Defense. Due to the the high winds, stability damage for land units is increased by 15%, movement cost for '机甲s and wheeled 车辆s is increased by 20%, and VTOL units have -1 evasion.
column2: 暴风雪使散热效率提升 20%，且每回合额外降低 12 点热量. 在雪地中，能见度和传感器效率降至 60%，所有单位获得 +2 防御. 由于强风影响，地面单位的稳定性伤害增加 15%，机甲和轮式车辆的移动消耗增加 20%，垂直起降单位闪避 -1.

column1: This looks like it once was a CN9-A, but nothing is quite like where it needs to be, they somehow went overweight with reinforcing the shield.
column2: 看起来它曾经是 CN9-A，但一切都不像它需要的那样，他们不知何故在加固防护罩时变得超重了。

column1: A Nova Cat 设计, the 50 ton Huntsman was 设计ed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An Omni机甲, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL Engine with an Endo Steel Skeleton and Ferro-Fibrous 装甲 giving the Omni机甲, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman N is armed with an ATM-6, an ER PPC and an ER Large Laser. A Heavy 中型激光 provide additional firepower at close range. A 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of the weapons. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 一种新星猫设计，50吨级的享茨曼是为复兴行动及内天体入侵而研发的，于3049年首次投入生产. 作为万能机甲，享茨曼以250级超轻型引擎为核心，同时采用钢内骨结构与铁纤维装甲，为其提供了21.5吨的武器挂载空间. 机体固定安装了5个跳跃推进器，令享茨曼具备更强的机动性. 享茨曼 N型号配备了一台ATM-6发射器、一具增程粒子加农炮及一具大型增程激光，还有一具中型重激光提供额外的近距离火力支援. 目标计算机进一步提升了这些武器的命中精度. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: M 变体是 3049 年首次投入战场的星盟科技升级版。以赫尔墨斯 300 XL 引擎取代标准引擎，并削减半吨装甲，使机甲在保持相同速度的同时搭载多项升级。 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 6M是穿透者的一种变体，旨在通过移除两门中型脉冲激光并换装五个额外的双重散热器来缓解机甲的热量积累. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: An LRM-5 with a ton of ammo in the right torso provides long-range fire-support, while the right arm-mounted ER medium lasers remain. A 锁定式SRM-4 with a ton of ammo and an ER Small Laser provide close-range defense. 装甲 protection is increased to 5 tons. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 右躯干部位安装了一具LRM-5及一吨弹药，提供远程火力支援，右臂上的中型增程激光保留. 一具锁定式SRM-4及一吨弹药和一门小型增程激光提供近程防御. 装甲防护提升至5吨. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>The perimeter is breached. [[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell],Remembrance Cell]] defenders lie scattered across the frozen landscape. The 机甲Warriors are exhausted, but there is no time to rest.</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius pulls up damage assessments.</color> "Boss, we're in bad shape. 装甲 compromised, crew fatigued. We're going into the next fight far from ideal circumstances."

<color=#BFBFBF>The production facility looms ahead through the snowfall. Somewhere inside, Joanna McEvedy waits with the Armageddon weapon.</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>Marcus's voice comes through on the comm.</color> "Commander, let's finish this. It is time to destroy the prototype, or I will have to detonate the warhead. See you on the other side."

<color=#BFBFBF>The final battle begins now.</color>
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>外围防线已被突破. [[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell]Remembrance Cell]]的防御者散落在冰封大地上. 机甲战士们精疲力竭，但没有时间休息.</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>达吕斯调出损伤评估.</color>“老大，我们状况很糟. 装甲受损，船员疲惫. 我们将在远非理想的情况下进入下一场战斗.”

<color=#BFBFBF>生产设施在降雪中赫然耸立在前方. Joanna McEvedy和末日武器就在里面的某处等待着.</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>马库斯的声音从通讯中传来.</color>“指挥官，让我们了结这件事. 是时候摧毁原型机了，否则我将不得不引爆弹头. 另一边见.”

<color=#BFBFBF>最终战斗现在开始.</color>

column1: The Bounty Hunter and his Associates have near-perfect Called Shots and deal 20% more damage with all attacks.
column2: 赏金猎人及其伙伴的精准射击近乎完美，并且所有攻击会多造成20%的伤害.

column1: This is a rare variant of the Shiro, which is gifted to individuals by Gunji-no-Kanrei Matsuhari Toranaga. The 'Mech is armored with Ballistic-加固装甲 instead of the Hardened, and a Clan-Tech ER PPC replaces the LB-2X Autocannon. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11
column2: 这是Shiro的一种稀有变体机型，由军师管领松张虎永赠予特定个体. 该机甲装甲采用弹道强化装甲而非硬化装甲，并用一门氏族科技增程粒子加农炮取代了LB 2-X霰弹炮. 特质: 扰敌 部署费用倍率: 1.11

column1: This version uses enough Improved Jump Jets to vault up to 150 meters at a time. Nineteen double heat sinks keep the heat from three ER Large Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers in check. The IIC 5 is a capable mobile sniper.
column2: 该版本使用足够的改进型跳跃喷气机，一次跳高可达 150 米。十九个双散热器可控制来自三个 ER 大型激光器和两个中型脉冲激光器的热量。 IIC 5 是一款强大的移动狙击手。

column1: The Fulcrum Hover Tank was first brought into production by Cyclops Incorporation of Skye in 3057. The vehicle was initially stationed along the Lyran Alliance's Periphery and Free Worlds League borders, where its low maintenance needs were a boon for worlds that had not seen much of the newest technological advances. The vehicle had continued to perform well during the FedCom Civil War and during the early Jihad. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 225 25 Left 135 25 Right 135 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 205 25 Total 800 125 Quirk: Agile
column2: Fulcrum悬浮坦克最早由Skye的Cyclops Incorporation于3057年投入生产. 该载具最初部署在天琴联盟的外围和自由世界联盟边界沿线  其低维护需求对于那些尚未见到最新技术进步的星球来说是一大优势. 该载具在FedCom内战和圣战早期继续表现出色. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 10/15格 / 300/450米. 装甲: 反应式装甲板 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 225 25 左侧 135 25 右侧 135 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 205 25 总计 800 125 特质: 敏捷 #武器: 2x 磁射 2x 中型脉冲激光(氏族)

column1: This specially modified directional thruster modified for the special MAD-DER Marauder variant works in conjunction with the L.A.M. system strapped into the mech's chassis, while it wasn't possible to remove all the weight cost from the thruster, its lighter then its normal counterparts. But due to the procedure, it has been linked directly into the engine core, making it impossible to be removed without risking either destroying the engine enclosure or the thruster, but its destruction won't affect the engine core itself due to the extra bulk and safeguards.
column2: 这种专门修改的定向推进器是针对特殊的 MAD-DER Marauder 变型而修改的，与 L.A.M. 配合使用。系统绑在机甲的底盘上，虽然不可能消除推进器的所有重量成本，但它比普通推进器更轻。但由于该过程，它已直接连接到发动机核心，因此不可能在不损坏发动机外壳或推进器的情况下将其移除，但由于额外的体积和防护措施，其破坏不会影响发动机核心本身。

column1: Two Rotary AC/20 and two Heavy PPC ensures that you never want to stand in front of the 'Mech, its raw burst potential is truly intimidating. Two MML-20 launchers ensure that the 'Mech can add even more direct fire power or even indirect support fire as needed. 特性：360° Torso Twist 部署成本倍率：1.49 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 两门RAC/20和两门重型PPC确保你绝不想站在这台机甲正前方，其原始爆发力确实令人胆寒. 两座MML-20发射器使这台机甲还能根据需要补充更多直接火力，甚至提供间接支援火力. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.49 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: This mixed tech configuration has two ATM-3s with two tons of ammunition in the left torso. The left arm carries a pair of micro pulse lasers, while the right arm carries a medium re-engineered laser and small re-engineered laser. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该混装科技配置在左躯干装有两具ATM-3，备弹两吨. 左臂搭载一对微型脉冲激光，右臂则装有一门中型重制激光与一门小型重制激光. 特质: 改良传感器 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The personal '机甲 of a Taurian Sheriff with multiple connections, this upgrade was commissioned as a Marshal as beautiful as the Taurians might have never seen. Mixed Clan and Inner Sphere tech makes it a deadly enforcer. Paired Clantech UAC/2s, 改进的 中型激光s and LRM/15s give it enough firepower and range to brawl or snipe, whichever the Sheriff so chose. Clan electronics and prototype heatsinks make sure he wouldn't be sweating too hard, either. According to 'Officials' and the onboard computer though, this was more of a Parade '机甲 rather than a Combat '机甲. It looks like it could fight toe to toe with heavies, but the internal components are so hard to come by it would be sad to see it destroyed. The final log entry reads: 'This isn't about revenge. This is about justice.' 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.11
column2: 这是一台属于人脉广泛的金牛治安官的个人机甲，这次升级让它成为了一台金牛人前所未见的华丽元帅机型. 混合了氏族与内天体的科技，使其成为一台致命的执法者. 成对的氏族科技UAC/2、改进型中型激光以及LRM/15，赋予了它强大的火力与射程，无论是近战还是远距离狙击，都悉听该治安官之便. 再加上氏族电子设备和原型散热器，也确保他不会因战斗而汗流浃背. 不过，根据“官方”和机载电脑的记录，这台机甲更像是一台阅兵机甲而非实战机体. 它看起来虽然能与重型机甲正面交锋，但内部组件极其稀有，若被击毁实在令人惋惜. 最后的日志条目写道:“无关复仇，只为正义.” 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.11

column1: Built by the same company that made the Saracen and Scimitar, the Saladin was Scarborough's last medium hover tank. It is unlike its brothers in that the Saladin does not mount a turret, and its only weapon is a heavy, short-range AC/20. Since it's vastly different from the company's other hovercraft, buyers were quite skeptical about purchasing it; Scarborough had to offer incentives like free training and transportation. Soon it became as cheap as the Saracen and spread throughout the whole Inner Sphere. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 220 20 左侧 150 20 右侧 150 20 后方 100 20 总计 620 80 特性：坚固
column2: 由制造Saracen和Scimitar的同一家公司制造  Saladin是Scarborough的最后一款中型气垫坦克. 与它的兄弟们不同  Saladin没有炮塔  其唯一的武器是一门重型短程AC/20. 由于它与公司的其他气垫船大不相同  买家对购买它相当怀疑；Scarborough不得不提供免费培训和运输等激励措施. 很快  它变得和Saracen一样便宜  并遍布整个内天体. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 9/14格/270/420米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 220 20 左侧 150 20 右侧 150 20 后方 100 20 总计 620 80 特质: 坚固 #武器: 1x 短管PPC

column1: The Warlord carries its main damage dealers on the right side of the 'Mech, a Gauss rifle in the arm and an ER PPC in the side torso. A center torso mounted ER Large Laser is able to provide extra damage at range as needed, but needs to be overused due to the limited cooling from the 'Mechs twelve double heat sinks. At closer ranges the 'Mech can switch to use its seven 中型激光s, with an SRM-6 as an extra punch. The final weapon is an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20, able to provide accurate missile fire at most ranges. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 战神的主要武器集中在机甲右侧，手臂装备高斯步枪，侧躯干安装一门增程粒子加农炮. 躯干中央的大型增程激光可在远距离提供额外火力，但受限于该机甲仅有的十二个双重散热系统，需谨慎使用避免过热. 进入近距离交战时，机甲可切换使用七门中型激光，辅以六联装短程火箭增强打击力度. 最后配置的武器是搭载阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的廿联装远程导弹，能在多数射程内实施精准导弹打击. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.18

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of 全向Mechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion engine and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. This variant uses a Heavy PPC to deliver a strong punch, and a 等离子步枪 to deal both damage and heat. An ER 中型激光 and a 中型脉冲激光 provide close support, while the 目标捕获装置 threatens opponents with homing artillery. A 瞄准计算机 helps these weapons find their mark, and 改进型跳跃推进器 allow the Seraph Dominus to move up to a hundred fifty meters at a time. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of 全向Mechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion engine and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. This variant uses a Heavy PPC to deliver a strong punch, and a Plasma Rifle to deal both damage and heat. An ER Medium Laser and a Medium Pulse Laser provide close support, while the Target Acquisition Gear threatens opponents with homing artillery. A Targeting Computer helps these weapons find their mark, and Improved Jump Jets allow the Seraph Dominus to move up to a hundred fifty meters at a time. Quirk：Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the 全向Mech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-T is armed with a pair of 等离子炮s. A Streak LRM-5, 锁定式SRM-4, Flamer and 主动探头 make up the rest of the 全向’s equipment. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 65吨的线卫于3052年投产，设计目的是取代木狼。它围绕一台390额定XL引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是木狼难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合为这款全向机甲提供了17.5吨自由挂载空间。线卫LBK-E装有一门增程大型激光和一对ATM-6，中央躯干装有一台轻型主动探测器。投放费用倍率：1.1。

column1: Cerillos is one of the so-called "Southwestern Worlds", an association of three worlds in the Free Worlds League. These agrarian worlds have a unique culture descended from North American Indian and Hispanic peoples.
column2: Cerillos是所谓的“西南世界”之一，这是自由世界联盟中由三个世界组成的联合体. 这些农业世界拥有一种源自北美印第安人和西班牙裔民族的独特文化.

column1: The Chameleon was 设计ed to help a new 机甲Warrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The '机甲 also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces 机甲Warriors to concentrate on the '机甲's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when 迪法恩斯工业 decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. Battle机甲s Incorporated purchased the rights to the 设计. J.B. Battle机甲s also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training '机甲, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium '机甲, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: 变色龙的设计初衷是帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动与热量管理技巧，其最高时速可达97.2公里，跳跃距离为一百八十米. 该机甲几乎全部搭载能量武器，但仅由十个标准散热器进行冷却. 散热设备的匮乏迫使机师必须时刻关注机甲的热量水平. 在某些情况下，变色龙也曾被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间. 3052年，反抗工业公司决定将产能转向暗夜星辰，变色龙的生产一度暂停，但J·B·战斗机甲公司购得该设计版权后便迅速恢复. J·B·战斗机甲公司还推出了两款具备实战价值的变色龙衍生型号. 变色龙是一台训练机甲，旨在通过搭载多种武器系统来模拟各类对手. 它属于中型机甲，但外观并不总是如此. 它可以加装额外装甲板来改变外形，并搭载特殊电子设备伪造信号特征；凭借这些特殊能力，它能够伪装成其他机体，无论是目视还是扫描都无法轻易识别，这便是它名称的由来. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: The Tocho Prime configuration features a single ER Large Laser and an ER 中型激光, both integrated with a 瞄准计算机 for improved accuracy. It also uses a 轻型 主动探头 to detect enemy units, making it effective at locating and engaging targets. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: The Tocho Prime configuration features a single ER Large Laser and an ER Medium Laser, both integrated with a Targeting Computer for improved accuracy. It also uses a 轻型 Active Probe to detect enemy units, making it effective at locating and engaging targets. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth J is armed with a 等离子炮, a Small ER Pulse Laser and a pair of ER Small Lasers. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.98
column2: 由一台 200 额定 XL 引擎驱动并装有 MASC，20 吨的火蛾是史上最快的机甲之一。它被设计用于侦察与运送元素步兵，于 2874 年投产。铁纤维与内骨骼的组合给火蛾 7.5 吨吊舱空间。火蛾 J 装备一门等离子炮、一门小型 ER 脉冲激光和一对 ER 小型激光。投放费用倍率：0.98。

column1: 一种trueb或n 是a Clan warri或 b或n 来自 the Clans' eugenics programs. 该belief 是that by comb在在g the genetic material 来自 heroic figures 来自 Clan society, the result在g person would possess the best qualities 的 both. By the Clans, trueb或n 是considered 在herently superi或 以 natural "freebirths", 和 taught 以 believe that they 是the only true 在herit或s 的 Aleks和r Kerensky's legacy.
column2: 真生者是氏族优生学计划中诞生的氏族战士. 氏族的理念认为，将氏族社会中英雄人物的基因物质相结合，所诞生的后代将兼具两者的最佳特质. 在氏族看来，真生者天生就优于自然降生的“自由生者”，并被灌输这样的信念: 他们才是亚历山大·克伦斯基遗产唯一真正的继承者.

column1: Activated ability (使用 Fir在g action). Hatches Xeno Eggs.
column2: 已激活能力(消耗开火行动). 孵化异种卵.

column1: First 生产 in 2948, the Ice Ferret is a medium scout Omni机甲 often employed as a head hunter or strike unit. A 45 ton Clan Omni机甲, the Ice Ferret is powered by a 360-rated XL Engine and has 9.5 tons of pod space thanks to a combination of Endo Steel, an XL Engine and Ferro-Fibrous. The Ice Ferret IFR-K is armed with a 大型脉冲激光, an ER Small Laser and a pair of ER 中型激光s. Laser AMS improves the Ice Ferrets defensive capabilities. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 2948年首次投产的冰鼬是一款中型侦察万能机甲，常被用作猎头单位或突击部队. 这款45吨级氏族万能机甲搭载360型超轻型引擎，得益于钢内骨结构、XL引擎和铁纤维装甲的组合应用，拥有9.5吨战术装备舱容量. 冰鼬IFR-K型配备一门大型脉冲激光、一门小型增程激光和两门中型增程激光，激光反导系统显著增强了其防御能力. 特质: 强化传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: 这个变体配备了由守护者ECM套件供能的潜行装甲. 武器已被替换，搭载一具重型PPC、一具高斯步枪和三具火箭发射器10型. 散热器增加至十四个. 为了给所有这些设备腾出空间，4E使用了超轻型陀螺仪和小型驾驶舱. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 135 15 左侧 125 15 右侧 125 15 后方 100 15 炮塔 135 15 总计 620 75 特性：防护机构
column2: 一种轻型战斗载具  最早于2692年投产  Galleon被证明是一种经济地支援步兵和战斗机甲s的手段. 其最高速度比大多数机甲更快  Galleon机动性强  但普遍缺乏保护  早期型号仅携带三点五吨装甲. 大迁徙后  这些履带式载具大多落入天龙联合体和自由世界联盟之手. Galleon常与Harasser Missile Platform配对使用. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 6/9格 / 180/270米. 装甲: 载具潜行装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 75 15 左侧 70 15 右侧 70 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 75 15 总计 360 75 特质: 防护机构 #武器: 2x 磁射 1x 轻型AC/5

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-8D is a Jihad era revamp of the ancient design. Built around a 280-rated 轻型引擎, the BKX-8D is armed with a trio of MML-7’s, with 4 ER 中型激光s as backup weapons. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 恒星联邦建造的第一台本土型战斗机甲——70吨级的战斧机甲于2459年首次亮相. 该机型基于麦基机甲的技术进行开发，并在后续不断应用新技术升级改造，直至统一战争结束后，锤掌机甲和战锤机甲等新型号投入服役而最终退役. 战斧BKX-8D型是这一古老设计的圣战时代改造版本. 该机型搭载280级轻型引擎，配备三具MML-7型导弹发射器作为主武器，以四门中型增程激光作为辅助武器. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: 詹纳首次投入战场是在 2784 年 9 月，同年 11 月，最终演变为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们如何在如此短的时间内获得该设计不得而知，但已知氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。 Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 基于原型TSM构建，渡鸦3X是对其前身1X型号的中度升级. 特质: 强化干扰器 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A priority encrypted missive arrives from Arelle, marked with the sigil of the [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]]. "Commander, the forward base at Doggerbank Zeta is now operational. Our units have established a secure perimeter and we are moving all our forces there. We are already triangulating [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]] signal traffic from Deep Periphery vectors. Your actions were instrumental. Next objective lies within the Malador Cluster system. Scans have identified rare raw material deposits on the barren planet designated Kuras Drift, materials not seen outside classified vaults. The Tribe is already there. We must strike quickly, before they can exploit or extract it. Expect resistance. They will not surrender these resources easily."
column2: 阿蕾尔发来一封优先级加密通讯，信息上带有[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]Ghost Bear Watch]]的徽记。 “指挥官，Doggerbank Zeta 的前进基地现已投入运行。我们的部队已经建立了安全防线，所有力量正在向那里集结。我们已经开始从深空外围方向对[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]部落]]的信号通讯进行三角定位。你的行动发挥了关键作用。 下一个目标位于Malador Cluster 星系。扫描发现，荒芜行星Kuras Drift 上存在稀有原材料矿藏，这些材料此前从未在机密储存库之外被发现。部落已经抵达那里。我们必须迅速行动，在他们开发或提取这些资源之前发动打击。 预计会遭遇抵抗。他们不会轻易放弃这些资源。”

column1: The Mantis light attack VTOL is produced by the most prolific creator of VTOLs, Michaelson Heavy Industries. Still a prototype in 3060, the Mantis is incredibly fast and capable of dealing great damage for its size. It also carries two and a half tons of armor, a significant amount for a fifteen-ton vehicle. It is also an incredibly capable scout as it carries a 比格犬主动探头 and 守护者ECM Suite. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 10 Left 45 10 Right 45 10 Rear 40 10 Total 240 50 Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光
column2: Mantis轻型攻击VTOL由最多产的VTOL制造商Michaelson Heavy Industries生产. 在3060年仍处于原型阶段  Mantis速度极快  对于其体型来说能够造成巨大伤害. 它还携带两吨半的装甲  对于一辆十五吨的载具来说相当可观. 它也是一款极其出色的侦察单位  因为它携带了比格犬主动探测器和守护者ECM套件. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境中部署. 移动: 8/12格 / 240/360米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 10 左侧 45 10 右侧 45 10 后方 40 10 总计 240 50 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 #武器: 4x 小型多样化光学激光 1x TAG[翼挂]

column1: 蝗虫 1M 型号有趣之处在于，如此小的机甲竟能喷出可观的 LRM 齐射。它是出色的骚扰者，尤其当你能用速度把导弹甩进目标较薄弱的后方装甲时。但它自身通常几乎无装甲。 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一台非常轻盈的狙击机甲，装备巨炮激光但无法承受打击. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Raising your voice, you say, "Well, that last contract was brutal. I didn't think we'd make it back."\\n\\nDarius stifles his confusion and plays along. "Yeah, that was a rough one. We had to hose good MechWarriors out of their cockpits."\\n\\nYou glance at your captive, silent audience.\\n\\n"We'll need fresh meat. Those kids look like they know their way around a BattleMech. Hey! Want to join our mercenary company? You'll go to interesting planets, meet interesting people, and shoot them."\\n\\nThe nobles fall over themselves to pay the tab and flee the bar.\\n\\nDarius finally lets loose laughter he'd been holding in. "{COMMANDER.FirstName}, not every noble is cut out for a life of excitement. Probably for the best."
column2: 你提高声音说：“嗯，最后一份合同是 brutal。我不认为我们会回来。”\\n\\nDarius 抑制住了他的困惑，继续玩下去。 “是的，这很艰难。我们必须把优秀的机甲战士从他们的驾驶舱里赶出来。”\\n\\n你看了一眼被俘虏的、沉默的观众。\\n\\n“我们需要 新鲜的肉。那些孩子看起来他们熟悉机甲战。嘿！想加入我们的雇佣兵连吗？你会去有趣的星球，遇到有趣的人，然后射击\\n\\n贵族们拼命付账，然后逃离了酒吧。\\n\\n大流士终于放声大笑起来。“{COMMANDER.FirstName}，并不是每个贵族都适合过刺激的生活，也许是最好的。”

column1: The Krait B configuration is a fast-deploying fire support unit, equipped with dual iATM-9s, an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光, and an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser. With three tons of iATM ammunition, the Krait B delivers sustained missile fire while remaining combat effective deep into engagements. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait B型配置是一台快速部署的火力支援单位，装备两具iATM-9导弹发射器、一门改进型中型重激光和一门改进型小型重激光. 凭借三吨iATM弹药，Krait B能够持续输出导弹火力，在深入交战过程中仍保持战斗效能. 特质: 改良冷却套 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.01 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: The -5D2 is a quick refit of the -5D, replacing the Ultra AC/2 with two LB-X Autocannon 5. The general combat profile of the '机甲 still remains the same, and therefore is still used by the Inner Sphere Houses for defensive purposes. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 1.35 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: -5D2是-5D的快速改型，用两门LB 5-X替换了UAC/2. 该机甲的整体战斗定位保持不变，因此内天体各大家族仍将其用于防御目的. 特质: 改良冷却套 - PPC 部署费用倍率: 1.35 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。 Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 专为城市近距离战斗设计，R61L与其价格较低的R60L系列机甲均换装了潜行装备，并搭载AC20. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 3D 蝗虫于 3049 年推出，使用星盟科技把 1M 的理念推进得更远。虽然它只携带两具玛格纳长弓-5 发射器，但新阿瓦隆阿克尔纳战斗机甲的工程师把装甲升级为铁纤维、结构升级为内骨骼。该变体完全没有近程武器，适合在远距离骚扰敌人，然后在对方逼近前逃离。 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这个版本用2支磁射步枪替换了原有的机枪，并加装了2门小型增程激光. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 阿波罗被设计为一款远程火力支援战斗机甲。实现的方式是为机甲装上一台最高速度仅 64.8 公里/小时的引擎和 11.5 吨装甲，然后为它配备巨型导弹发射器，让毁灭如雨点般倾泻到敌人头上。虽然阿波罗的速度低于中型机甲的平均水平，但只要使用得当，阿波罗就无需惧怕敌方火力；它完全有能力待在战场边缘，持续输出压制性的 LRM 弹幕。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 对标准“金太郎（Kintaro）”KTO-19进行了一次简易改装，将其中一门中型激光移至另一侧手臂，以满足那些偏好更均衡武器分布的机甲战士. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Not sure why anybody'd go to the trouble of redesigning a chassis as old as this, but I guess profit is profit for somebody. The -03 carries a pair of MML-7 launchers and an ER Large Laser, so it can put the hurt on at any range you want.
column2: 不知道为什么有人会不厌其烦地重新设计这么老的底盘，但我想利润对某些人来说就是利润。 -03 携带一对 MML-7 发射器和一个 ER 大型激光器，因此它可以在您想要的任何范围内造成伤害。

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Ballistic Brawler. The GHR-QS2 is 设计ed from the ground up to get in drag-out knock-down brawls. In fact, the 中型转管步枪s excell at providing instability to your enemies, so that you can push them to the ground. Rest assured that you are piloting a mech protected by the best quailty 装甲 that Quicsell can produce! 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.08
column2:
