column1: The Argo enters orbit above Horgens III, the third planet in the system and barely more than a fledgling colony. Far below, dense lowland jungles and shallow coastal floodplains stretch between narrow strips of prefabricated structures, the earliest bones of a scattered, agrarian economy. Rainfall veils much of the surface, forming shifting fog banks that ripple through river deltas and cling to newly raised rooftops. There are no major cities here. No real defenses. Just scattered settlements clinging to humid ground, and the Tribe's hidden staging zones buried in the canopy. A secured Hyperpulse transmission arrives moments later. Mizuki Bekker's image flickers into view, her tone as measured as ever. "Horgens is more than just a humid backwater. It's becoming a nerve center for our expansion, and the [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bears]] know it. They've launched a multi-pronged push to destabilize everything we've built there." She brings up a flickering display of tactical readouts, one after the other. "First, we have a convoy hauling food and ammunition to a forward depot. It's ready to leave, but Watch ambushers are tightening their noose. You'll need to get that convoy through. Second, our command node, freshly established and still half-buried in the jungle, is under direct threat. They're planning a concentrated strike. If they breach that facility, the entire chain of coordination on Horgens collapses. And third, one of our scout teams went dark just hours ago. They were carrying sensitive base schematics. If they're captured, or silenced, our defenses are compromised before they've even solidified." She leans forward slightly, voice firm. "All three missions must be completed. But you choose where to begin. Once a contract is issued, it must be launched within fourteen days. Fail to act in time, and the window closes." A pause. "You will be rewarded after each strike. Weapons, tech, support assets, what we can spare. Just hold this ground. Every inch of it matters."
column2: 阿尔戈号 进入Horgens III轨道. 这是该星系的第三颗行星，勉强算个初生殖民地. 遥望地表，下方是大片茂密的低地丛林和浅海沿岸泛滥平原，狭窄的预制建筑带散布其中，构成了这个零散农业经济最初的雏形. 降雨笼罩着大部分地表，在河流三角洲间形成不断变化的雾层，并缠绕在新建的屋顶之间. 这里没有大型城市. 没有真正的防御设施. 只有依附潮湿土地而生的零散定居点，以及隐藏在树冠中的部落秘密集结区域. 片刻后，一条加密超脉冲通讯传来. 美月·贝克的影像闪烁着出现在屏幕上，她的语气一如既往地沉稳. “Horgens不只是一个潮湿的偏远殖民地. 它正在成为我们扩张的重要枢纽，而[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]Ghost Bear Watch]]也清楚这一点. 他们已经发动多线攻势，试图破坏我们在那里建立的一切.” 她调出战术数据界面，一份又一份情报记录接连出现. “首先，我们有一支运输食物和弹药前往前线补给站的车队. 它已经准备出发，但监察部的伏击者正在逐渐收紧包围网. 你们必须护送这支车队通过.” “其次，我们的指挥节点刚刚建立，仍有一半埋藏在丛林之中，目前正受到直接威胁. 他们正在计划一次集中打击. 如果他们突破该设施，整个Horgens 上的协调链都会崩溃.” “第三，我们的一支侦察小队就在数小时前失去联系. 他们携带着重要的基地结构图. 如果他们被俘，或者被消灭，我们的防御体系将在尚未成型之前就遭到破坏.” 她微微前倾，语气坚定. “三项任务都必须完成. 但你可以选择从哪里开始. 一旦合约发布，必须在十四天 内执行. 如果未能及时行动，机会窗口将关闭.”她停顿了一下. “每次打击行动结束后，你都会得到奖励. 武器、技术、支援资源，只要我们能提供. 守住这片土地. 这里的每一寸都很重要.”

column1: Taking something of an alternate approach to the same battlefield niche, the Sprite 2 trades it’s quartet of LRM launchers for a single ‘Mech-scale ERLL. While it lacks the raw offensive power of the 1, it is able to deal highly concentrated damage, and turns the Sprite into a mobile, hardy, and lethal sniping platform. Both patterns operate with great synergy, the 2 punching holes in armor for the 1’s launchers to exploit, much to the chagrin of forces facing the Society in combat. 特性：Resilient 部署成本倍率：0.99
column2: 精灵2型在相同的战场定位上采用了另一种思路，将四具LRM发射器换成一门机甲级ERLL. 虽然缺乏1型的原始火力，但它能造成高度集中的伤害，将精灵打造成机动灵活、皮实耐打且致命的狙击平台. 两种型号协同作战效果绝佳，2型撕开装甲缺口，供1型的发射器加以利用，这让在战斗中面对“秘社”组织的部队苦不堪言. 特质: 坚韧 部署费用倍率: 0.99

column1: 元素战斗装甲是所有战斗装甲的衡量标准，由狼氏族于 2868 年在对抗诺瓦猫的占有试炼中首次推出。它是氏族工程的奇迹，能让一小队操作员击倒大型机甲并幸存下来。虽然普通体型的人也能使用这种战斗装甲，但该设计是为氏族巨人般的元素战士量身打造，唯有他们才能发挥其全部潜力。 Quirk: 标准部件 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

column1: The Arbalest 1 is a light '机甲 capable of engaging an enemy at long range, or being used as a light fire support platform. The '机甲 uses its twin Mk.46 Type II LRM-10 launchers to strike an enemy at long range. Should an opponent close, the Arbalest is capable of defending itself at short range with its pair of Series 2a Mk. 5 ER medium lasers. Finally, the head-mounted ECM suite disrupts enemy electronics and proved valuable when disrupting Blakist C3i networks. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: 长弓手1型是一款轻型机甲，既能远程交战，也可作为轻型火力支援平台使用. 该机甲凭借其双联装Mk.46 II型LRM-10发射器对远方之敌实施打击，而若对手近身，则依靠一对系列2a Mk.5中型增程激光进行近距离自卫. 此外，头部搭载的电子对抗套件能有效干扰敌方电子设备，在破坏布雷克C3i网络时尤显效用. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: The 9K Wolverine introduced in 3074 uses a 轻型引擎 for power. The resulting decrease in tonnage necessitated a complete revision of the weapon systems. Its main gun is the 短管PPC mounted in the right arm. An SRM-4 is the only other heat-building weapon mounted on the 'Mech. A trio of 轻型 Machine Guns are also in the arm, linked to a 机枪 Array to deter infantry. To counteract battle armor, the 9K carries a pair of B-Pods. This Wolverine variant carries a Sword in its left hand and a C3 Slave in the head to feed targeting telemetry back to lance-mates. 三重肌纤维束s make the sword more powerful and the design faster when they heat up, but a MechWarrior must disengage some of the ten double heat sinks in order to build the necessary heat. In light of the heavier engine, the inclusion of a 紧凑型陀螺仪 seems unhelpful at best. Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 3074年推出的9K金刚狼改型采用轻型引擎提供动力. 重量的大幅减轻必然需要对武器系统进行全面改造. 其主武器为安装在右臂的短管粒子加农炮. SRM-4四联装短程火箭是这台机甲上唯一会产生热量的辅助武器. 同一手臂还装有三挺轻机枪，通过机枪阵列系统协同射击以压制步兵. 为应对战斗装甲威胁，9K型配备了一对B型反战斗装甲吊舱. 这台金刚狼改型左手持握近战利剑，头部安装的C3从机则能将火控遥测数据共享给同小队成员. 三重肌纤维束在升温时会增强利剑威力并提升机体机动性，但机甲战士必须主动关闭十台双重散热系统中的部分模块才能蓄积所需热量. 考虑到引擎已经大幅增重，配备紧凑型陀螺仪的设计似乎至多算个画蛇添足之举. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: This is obviously going to be a fight, so you get things started early by sucker punching the thug sent after [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Meanwhile, {TGT_MW.Callsign} slugs another thug in the gut. Then the rest charge, and everything devolves into a confusion of fists and arms and heavy boots.\\n\\nSome time later, you're swinging at someone's bloody face as he backs away, and you realize he's the last enemy left. {TGT_MW.Callsign} is bent over trying to catch {TGT_MW.DET} breath and the groups leader is gone, along with most of his gang. "Go on, get out of here!" you tell the last one. He turns and runs.\\n\\nYou offer {TGT_MW.Callsign} your hand. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, "That was a good scrap, Commander. But we'd better go, too."
column2: 这显然会是一场战斗，所以你可以通过对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 之后派出的暴徒进行猛击来尽早开始行动。与此同时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 猛击另一个暴徒的肠道。然后剩下的人发起冲锋，一切都变成了拳头、手臂和沉重靴子的混乱。\\n\\n过了一段时间，当某人后退时，你向他血淋淋的脸挥舞，你意识到他是最后一个敌人了。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 弯下腰试图喘口气，但该组织的领导者和他的大部分团伙都消失了。 “走吧，离开这里！”你告诉最后一个。他转身就跑。\\n\\n你向 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 伸出你的手。 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}：“指挥官，打得不错，不过我们也走吧。”

column1:
达里乌斯召开了一次难得的紧急会议。“最近，我们救下了一艘从一颗被隔离的星球出发时受损的飞船。我们本以为已经避开了感染。结果没有。现在 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 患上了一种传染性极强、可能致命的疾病。”

他神色严峻地说明了接下来的安排。“我们得把整间医疗舱隔离起来，直到 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}。我也联系了当地政府，他们愿意以 ¢120,000 的价格卖给我们药物。价钱简直是敲诈，但没有它，我们可能会落得和那艘被我们救下的飞船一样的下场。”

苏米蕾补充道：“我问过一位在药物研究实验室工作的朋友，但这种病菌超出了他所有实验性抗病毒药的能力范围。”

column1: The Mercury is a fast, well-armed scout and raider BattleMech, praised for its modular weapon system and balance of speed and protection. column1: The Cyllaros has a unique 设计 that combines the mobility and versatility of a 车辆 with the firepower and durability of a Battle机甲. It has four legs that can be retracted for stability movement on flat terrain, and extended for greater stability and maneuverability on rough terrain. The Cyllaros is armed with an array of energy and ballistic weapons, making it a formidable opponent on the battlefield. Despite initial resistance, the Cyllaros has proven to be a successful combat unit, and has been used in various conflicts. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.11
column2: Cyllaros 拥有独特的设计，融合了车辆的机动性与多功能性，以及 战斗机甲 的火力与耐久性. 它配备四条可收缩的支腿，在平坦地形上收拢以保持稳定移动，在崎岖地形上展开以提升稳定性和机动能力. Cyllaros 搭载一系列能量武器和实弹武器，使其在战场上成为令人生畏的对手. 尽管最初遭遇抵触，Cyllaros 已证明自己是一款成功的作战单位，并在多场冲突中得到应用. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.11

column1: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。 Quirk: 易于驾驶 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这段黑暗时代时期的27V改装型号将导弹发射器替换为多导弹发射架，并加装了C3从属模块. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: The D configuration of the Umbriel goes all in on autocannons. Each arm mounts a huge Superheavy Rotary AC/5, while the Astral Hammer in the left torso remains. The only weapons able to deal with faster moving targets are two head mounted 中型脉冲激光s. 怪癖: 布雷克之怒 掉落成本乘数: 1.26 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Umbriel的D配置完全押注于自动炮火力. 每条手臂都搭载了一门巨大的超重型RAC/5，而左侧躯干中的Astral Hammer则得以保留. 唯一能够有效应对高速移动目标的武器，是两门安装于头部的中型脉冲激光. 特质: 布雷克之怒 部署费用倍率: 1.26 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column2: 由著名新月鹰成员罗德尼·克拉特驾驶的定制变体，对AWS-9Q进行了简单改装，移除了守护者ECM套件并替换为C3从机. 小型激光被替换为小型脉冲激光. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The -Er is a recent refit of the SG11-E to focus more on firepower over ruggedness. By dropping the 二元激光s in favor of Large Pulser Lasers managed to upgrade the MRM-10 to MRM-30 launchers and adding two ER 中型激光s, and the Heavy Duty Gyro and 反应装甲板 have been exchanged for weight saving options. The final change of the refit is the switch to 紧凑型散热器s. Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: The -Er is a recent refit of the SG11-E to focus more on firepower over ruggedness. column1: The 'Demolisher II heavy tank is an upgrade of the original Demolisher, whose factory on Sudeten was lost to 玉鹰氏族. Since the Typhoon stayed concentrated within traditionally Federated Suns unit within the Federated Commonwealth, when the Lyran Alliance broke away, they needed their own urban combat vehicle. Production began in 3059. The result is a slow-moving tank that can literally demolish anything in its path. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲： 车辆潜行装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 370 50 左侧 255 50 右侧 255 50 后方 190 50 炮塔 325 50 总计 1395 250 特性：改进型传感器

column1: The upgraded 2721 model used by the SLDF Royal units. An upgraded XL engine allowed the VTOL to carry an extra one and half tons of armor, two 反导系统s, swap its laser for an extended range model and add TAG for good measure. The Cyrano was developed by the Star League in 2622 as the standard attack gunship for the 星际联盟防卫军. The heaviest VTOL in SLDF service, the Cyrano was used to provide air support for ground forces and fly escort for Ripper and Nightshade missions. Capable of a stunning 194 km/h, the Cyrano is an incredibly fast scout. The downside is the VTOL's meager armor in most configurations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. column2: 升级版2721型  供SLDF皇家部队使用. 升级的XL引擎使VTOL能额外携带一吨半装甲  配备两套反导弹系统  将其激光换为增程型号  并添加TAG以增强效能. column1: Developed by the Clans, Enhanced Imaging or EI is an advanced targeting and piloting system for use with humanoid shaped combat 载具s such as Battle机甲s, battle 装甲 and Proto机甲s. While offering considerable advantages, as well as serving as the only viable control method for Proto机甲s, EI inflicts serious side effects on the user, including possible mental instability, nerve damage and death.
column2: 增强成像（EI）由氏族研发，是一种先进的瞄准与驾驶系统，适用于人形战斗车辆，如战斗机甲、战斗装甲和原型机甲. 虽然它提供了显著的优势，并且是操控原型机甲唯一可行的方式，但EI也会对使用者造成严重的副作用，包括可能的精神不稳定、神经损伤甚至死亡.

column1: This variant of the 凤鹰 uses a light fusion engine to improve survivability. Eight and a half tons of 装甲 coat the endo steel chassis, while each arm carries a light PPC and medium X-Pulse laser, while additional close in firepower comes from two small X-Pulse lasers in the center torso. Maximum ground speed is 96 km/h and it still jumps 180 meters. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: 这款凤凰鹰变体装备了轻型聚变引擎以提升生存能力. 八吨半的装甲覆盖着钢内骨结构，每只手臂各装有一门轻型粒子加农炮和一门中型X脉冲激光，额外的近程火力则依靠中央躯干内的两门小型X脉冲激光. 最高地面速度达96公里/小时，跳跃距离依然为180米. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.03

column1: This target was Narc'ed. +1 to hit and +2 with Missiles.
column2: 这个目标被缉毒了。击中+1，导弹+2。

column1: This is one hell of a 'Mech, Boss. Look at all that Clan Tech, and tell me you don't want to take it for a ride. I guess we should be happy there are not more of these around, or battles would be a lot tougher.
column2: 这是一台地狱般的机甲，老板。看看所有的氏族科技，告诉我你不想搭便车。我想我们应该庆幸周围没有更多这样的东西，否则战斗会更加艰难。

column1: Originally envisioned as a refresh to the GRN-D-02, the -03 introduced so many changes that a new chassis 设计ation was needed. Dubbed the 大十字军 II, the '机甲 is still built on an Endo Steel chassis, but now carries a much larger 320 light fusion engine to give it a top speed of 64.8 km/h and a much greater amount of survivability than the XL engine carried by earlier models. The 03 also carries 三重肌纤维束 to increase its ground speed to 86.4 km/h as long as it is running hot. The '机甲 has four jump jets to further increase its mobility. The variant carries fifteen tons of 装甲 protection and is armed with two ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons, backed up by an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system. For close combat, the '机甲 has three ER 中型激光s and a 锁定式SRM-6 missile launcher. The '机甲 also carries an improved C3 computer, allowing it to share targeting data with friendly units. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 最初作为GRN-D-02的升级方案，-03型引入了大量改动，以至于需要为它赋予全新的底盘编号. 这台被命名为“大十字军II”的机甲仍采用钢内骨结构，但换装了体积更大的320型轻型核聚变发动机，使其最高时速达到64.8公里，并且相比早期型号搭载的XL引擎，战场生存能力大幅提升. 03型还配备了三重肌纤维束，在机体过热状态下可将地面移动速度提升至86.4公里/小时. 该机甲安装有四台跳跃喷气引擎以进一步增强机动性. 这款变体搭载了15吨装甲防护，主武器为两门大型增程激光，辅以配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-15导弹发射器. 近战武装配置为三门中型增程激光和一具锁定式SRM-6导弹发射器. 机甲还搭载改进型C3计算机，可与友军单位共享目标锁定数据. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: This variant replaces the four micro pulse lasers with a pair of small pulse lasers. This keeps the damage output the same, but the small lasers have a better range while still being effective against infantry. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 该变体将四门微型脉冲激光替换为两门小型脉冲激光. 此举保持了相同的伤害输出，但小型激光的射程更远，且依然能有效对抗步兵. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column2: 极地环境将散热效率与传感器效能提升 20%. 大雪将能见度降至 75%，机甲与轮式车辆的移动消耗增加 10%. 所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: The Timber Wolf 全向Mech was code-named "Mad Cat" by the Inner Sphere during the 氏族入侵. Although perhaps more accurate would be to say that it was named by the Inner Sphere's targeting systems. Confused by the silhouette of an unknown 'Mech, systems would alternate between designating it as a Marauder, MAD, or a Catapult, CAT, giving rise to the name. 特性：战斗计算机 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 森林狼万能机甲在氏族入侵期间被内天体代号为“疯猫（Mad Cat）”. 不过更准确的说法或许是由内天体的瞄准系统所命名的. 由于被未知机甲的外形所迷惑，瞄准系统在将其识别为掠夺者（MAD）和“弩炮（Catapult）”（CAT）之间来回切换，由此产生了“疯猫”这一名称. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Larger than LRMs, Fire and Forget missiles utilize their size to house a stronger payload and better guidance systems.
column2: 【Ammo Fire and Forget】发射后不管导弹比LRM更大，利用其尺寸容纳更强的有效载荷和更好的制导系统.

column1: A rare and special variant of the Templar, the TLR1-OS was re设计ed around a Battle机甲 Sword and geared for close-range combat. An 超级自动炮/10, a pair of 中型脉冲激光s, and a Small Laser back the sword up in close-range combat. THe mech's only concession to longer range combat are a pair of 大型脉冲激光s. Pilots of the -OS generally rely on the intimidation factor of the sword to keep their enemies in line. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.16
column2: 圣殿骑士的稀有特殊变体TLR1-OS，围绕战斗机械剑重新设计，专为近距离战斗而配置. 一门10型超级自动炮、两门中型脉冲激光和一门小型激光为其近战提供火力支援. 该机甲在远程战斗方面的唯一让步是两门大型脉冲激光. 驾驶-OS型的机师通常会依靠机械剑的威慑力来压制敌人. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.16

column1: The Caracara 4 is focused on improving the damage area by mounting only a LB-X AC/20 and a Hyper-Assault/30 Gauss Rifle, but both configured for optimal clustering. The LB-X does have two tons of AP ammo if clustering is not desired. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.39 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Caracara 4 专注于通过仅搭载一门 LB-X AC/20 和一门 Hyper-Assault/30 高斯步枪来提升伤害范围，但两者都配置为最佳集束效果. 如果不希望集束效果，LB-X 配有 2 吨穿甲弹药. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.39 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: The Wraith TR4-X was the first 生产 variant of the new "Wing" line of the chassis. Based of the TR2-X 'Alexander' arena fighter, it proved that the partial wing could work on a mass-生产 chassis as well. The major weakness of the '机甲 was its weak damage potential, with only a Light PPC and one medium and one small ER laser. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 幽灵 TR4-X 是这一新“飞翼”系列机体首次投入生产的型号. 基于 TR2-X“亚历山大”竞技场战斗机，它证明了局部机翼同样适用于量产型机体. 该机甲的主要弱点是伤害潜力不足，仅搭载一门轻型粒子加农炮、一门中型和一门小型增程激光. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: The Remix PRW-RMX is a one-of-a-kind 65-ton Project Rewrite 设计 combining salvaged 布雷克圣言会 technology with 氏族钻石鲨 hardware. A right-arm 可伸缩刀刃 provides melee capability alongside a left-arm 血猎犬主动探头 and two Clan ER 中型激光s. The right torso mounts an MML 9 with separate LRM and SRM bins, while a left-torso LB-5X carries both standard and cluster ammunition. Dual CASE II installations and a head-mounted Laser AMS complete the defensive package. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.11
column2: 混音版PRW-RMX是一台独一无二的65吨级重写计划机甲，融合了回收的布雷克圣言会科技与钻石鲨氏族的装备. 右臂搭载可收放刀刃提供近战能力，左臂配备血猎犬主动探测器及两门氏族中型增程激光. 右躯干装有一具多导弹发射器9型，配有独立的远程与短程火箭弹药舱，左躯干的LB 5-X霰弹炮则兼容标准弹与集束弹. 双弹药爆炸防护系统II型及头部安装的激光反导系统完善了防御配置. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.11

column1: An unusual variant, Seoyun Hammerick's personal Shootist is a well-known anvil used to crush many foes over her storied career. In place the traditional AC20, this variant mounts a pair of Siege Lasers cooled by a dozen 双散热器. A 6-tube Fire and Forget system is the only supporting weaponry. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper
column2: 一种不寻常的变体，西云·哈默里克的专属 Shootist 是她辉煌生涯中碾碎无数敌人的著名铁砧. 该变体未装备传统的 AC20，而是搭载了一对攻城激光，由十二个双联散热器冷却. 一套 6 联装“发射后不管”系统是唯一的辅助武器. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂

column1: This Lyran model is meant for close range and restrictive terrain. It carries two highly destructive LB-X Autocannon/20s that can create holes in an enemy's armor using slug rounds with ease, then exploit those holes to damage critical systems with the cluster rounds. Three Medium Pulse Lasers and a regular Medium Laser provide energy backup.
column2: 这款 Lyran 模型适用于近距离和限制性地形。它携带两枚极具破坏性的 LB-X Autocannon/20s，可以使用子弹轻松地在敌人的装甲上打出洞，然后利用这些洞用集束子弹损坏关键系统。三个中型脉冲激光器和一个常规中型激光器提供能量备份。

column1: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton 全向mech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an 内骨骼复合结构, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER 中型激光s hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-OA is armed with a pair of 等离子步枪s. A pair of Clan SRM-6’s and an additional ER 中型激光 round out the variant. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 为共和国武装力量于3121年设计的Doloire，是一款融合了氏族科技与内天体科技的80吨万能机甲. 该机甲基于320级氏族超轻型引擎和内复合材料结构打造，拥有32吨的舱位空间，并固定装备了两具氏族中型增程激光于机甲中央躯干. Doloire DLR-OA变体配备了两具等离子步枪，此外还有一对氏族SRM-6导弹发射器和一具额外的中型增程激光. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Sköll D configuration is a high-risk, high-reward brawler. Though plagued by critical heat issues, it fields an ER Large Laser, six 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, and an ER 中型激光. Its infamous battlefield success against an Atlas III underlines its terrifying close-range capability. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2:
斯库尔 D 配置是一款高风险高回报的近战机甲. 尽管饱受严重散热问题的困扰，它仍配备了一门大型增程激光、六门改进型中型重激光和一门中型增程激光. 其在战场上对阵阿特拉斯 III 型时的赫赫战果，充分彰显了它恐怖的近距离作战能力.

column1: The Queen's supply of eggs, ready to hatch and eviscerate any enemy in their way.  Not to be used in omelets.

column1: As the original loadout of the Hierophant, the Prime configuration was initially a test platform for TEMPEST and Ares attachments. It features 2 Hyper PPCs with TEMPEST, 2 i-AC/10s with Ares TPS, and a flamer equipped with TEMPEST, though the flamer’s extremely short range rendered it practically useless in combat, serving only to verify TEMPEST compatibility. The inclusion of AMS Mk2 rounds out the build. Its strong performance led to expanded Hierophant production and inspired the diverse loadouts that followed, cementing its role as the 明尼苏达部落’s premier superheavy command ‘Mech. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为祭司长（Hierophant）的原始配置，Prime型最初是TEMPEST和Ares附件的测试平台. 它配备了两门搭载TEMPEST的超级粒子加农炮（Hyper PPC）、两门搭载Ares TPS的改进型AC/10（i-AC/10），以及一具同样搭载TEMPEST的火焰喷射器，不过火焰喷射器极短的射程使其在实战中几乎毫无用处，仅用于验证TEMPEST的兼容性. 加入AMS Mk2后，整套配置得以完善. 其强劲的性能推动了祭司长的扩大生产，并催生了后续多样的搭载方案，从而巩固了其作为明尼苏达部落顶尖超重型指挥机甲的核心地位. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.45 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-3A is an advanced technology version of the Roughneck that makes heavy use of 双散热器 to power an all-energy loadout of 2 PPCs, 4 中型激光s, and a solitary Small Laser. 18 双散热器 keep the mech nice and cool. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 阿克纳尔“装载王”工业机甲的军用型战斗机甲版本，“硬汉”是一款针对预算敏感型买家（如行星民兵和走背运的雇佣兵单位）设计的低成本重型机甲. Roughneck-3A是“硬汉”的先进技术版本，大量使用双散热器，为全能量武器配置提供动力，包括2门粒子加农炮、4门中型激光和1门小型激光. 18个双散热器使机甲保持良好的冷却状态. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: The Raczilla is an attempt at creating the most powerful and supersized mech imaginable. Some think it was accomplished, but it low ammo reserves, and heat 生产 aren't convincing. But this doesn't make its four RAC/10 less scary... 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.42 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: ‘Raczilla’是为了打造出能想象到的最强大、超规格机甲的一次尝试. 有人认为它实现了这个目标，但它可怜的弹药储备，以及产生的热量不是很令人信服. 但这并没有减弱它的四门 RAC/10 的威慑力…… 特质: 分心 部署费用倍率: 1.42 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The heavy winds cause land units to take 10% more stability damage, and the scatter radius of weapons is increased by 15%. The amount of dust and particles flying around also reduces visibility and sensor efficiency to 90%. All VTOL units have -1 evasion due to more engine thrust needed for stabilizing maneuvers.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 强风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 10%，武器散布半径扩大 15%. 飞扬的沙尘和颗粒物还将能见度和传感器效能降低至 90%. 所有垂直起降单位因需要更多引擎推力来稳定机动，闪避值 -1.

This makes it an effective anti-infantry and anti-battle armor 'Mech. It also adds one extra double heat sink to the configuration. column1: Based on the original prototype of the Uziel, the 2S carries a pair of PPCs as its primary weapons for long range combat. A SRM-6 launcher provides close combat capabilities and a pair of Machine Guns provide anti-infantry capabilities. A 比格犬主动探头 allows the '机甲 to detect hidden units and protects the Uziel from ambushes. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

It is replaced by a C3 Slave Unit and an ER Small Laser. Quirk: 改良干扰器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 渡鸦是一款轻型电子战战斗机甲，在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相时，它不仅是几个世纪以来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，也象征着人类拒绝在技术上倒退. 这一4L型号的变体通过移除4L的主动探测器，使渡鸦能够融入C3网络，取而代之的是C3从机和一门小型增程激光. 特质: 改进型干扰器 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A Regulan design built to emulate the Lyran Berzerker, the Neandertal is an 80 ton Battlemech designed around two concepts – speed and close combat. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with TSM helps achieve the first objective, while a massive Hatchet makes the Neanderthal deadly in close quarters. The Neanderthal NTL-UG is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a 大型脉冲激光. A pair of 小型脉冲激光s provide some close range firepower, while 守护者ECM rounds out the mech. 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.14
column2: A Regulan design built to emulate the Lyran Berzerker, the Neandertal is an 80 ton Battlemech designed around two concepts – speed and close combat. A 400-rated XL Engine paired with TSM helps achieve the first objective, while a massive Hatchet makes the Neanderthal deadly in close quarters. The Neanderthal NTL-UG is armed with a pair of Large Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser. A pair of Small Pulse Lasers provide some close range firepower, while Guardian ECM rounds out the mech. column1: The Chameleon Light Polarization Shield was 设计ed to make a '机甲 invisible to the naked eye. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. column2: 由一具200级XL引擎驱动并装有MASC，20吨的火蛾是有史以来最快的机甲之一。火蛾为侦察和元素战士运输而设计，于2874年投产。铁纤与内层钢的组合为火蛾提供了7.5吨吊舱空间。火蛾H武装为9门重型小型激光器。投放成本倍率：0.98。

column1: The transmission from Arelle Jorgensson ends with a hard cut. No thank you, no farewell. Just silence. And the faint hum of the Argo's systems. Darius exhales through his nose, arms crossed. "This is spiraling. Fast. We're talking coordinated strikes against a rogue Clan... and she expects us to be the tip of the spear?" Sumire leans against the console, glancing toward the viewport. "And if we say no? What happens then? She doesn't strike me as the 'let bygones be bygones' type." Yang grunts. "The [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] doesn't leave debts unsettled. And she sees this whole thing as a matter of blood and honor. If we bail now, we don't just walk. We run. And we keep running." Farah taps her datapad with restless fingers. "We're in deeper than salvage and payouts now. This is something else. Old ghosts. Buried wars. And one misstep could light the whole thing off." No one speaks for a long moment. Eventually, all eyes shift to you, the commander. Darius speaks again, voice low. "Look... you've gotten us through worse than this. We trust you, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. Just tell us where we're going." Whatever comes next, strike deep or vanish into the black, they'll follow. But the weight of that choice presses heavier than ever.
column2: 来自阿蕾尔·约根森的通讯以一阵戛然而止的杂音结束. 没有感谢，没有告别. 只有寂静. 以及阿尔戈号 系统微弱的嗡鸣声. 达吕斯双臂交叉，从鼻腔中缓缓呼出一口气.“这事正在失控. 迅速失控. 我们要对一个叛逃的氏族发动协同打击……而她还指望我们充当先锋?” 苏米尔靠在控制台上，望向舷窗.“那如果我们拒绝呢? 接下来会发生什么? 我看她可不像是那种‘既往不咎’的人.” 杨哼了一声.“[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]Ghost Bear Watch]]可不会让欠下的债不了了之. 而她把这一切都视为关乎血债与荣誉之事. 如果我们现在退出，可不是拍拍屁股走人那么简单. 我们得逃. 而且还得一直逃下去.” 法拉用不安的手指敲着数据板.“我们现在卷入的已经不只是打捞和报酬了. 这是另一回事. 旧日幽灵. 被埋葬的战争. 而一次失误，就可能让整个局势彻底爆发.” 很长一会儿没人说话. 最终，所有目光都转向你，指挥官. 达吕斯再次开口，声音低沉.“听着……你已经带着我们挺过比这更糟糕的局面了. 我们信任你，{COMMANDER.Callsign}. 告诉我们该往哪里走就行.” 无论接下来会发生什么，是深入敌后，还是消失在无尽的黑暗中，他们都会跟随你. 但这个选择的分量，从未像现在这样沉重.

column1: A mixed-tech brawler, the BLR-6R mounts a Clan-grade Rotary AC/5 in its right arm supported by a left torso–mounted Inner Sphere grade 锁定式SRM-6 rack, twin Light PPCs in each side torso and pair of rear-facing Improved Heavy 中型激光s. Carrying three tons of RAC rounds and one ton of Streak reloads in CASE II–protected bays, this loadout is made possible by a Light Fusion Engine. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.15
column2: 一台混合科技斗士，BLR-6R在右臂安装了一门氏族RAC/5转管自动炮，由左躯干搭载的内天体级锁定式SRM-6发射器提供支援，每侧躯干各配备两门轻型粒子加农炮，并装有一对朝后的改进型中型重激光. 携带三吨转管自动炮弹药和一吨锁定式弹药，存放在CASE II防护舱内，这样的装备配置依靠一台轻型聚变发动机得以实现. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.15

column1: In the Argo's command deck, final checks scroll across every screen. Supplies are loaded. 机甲bays sealed. The navmap shows a jagged arc of jumps leading rimward, through ghost systems, salvage worlds, and quiet stars barely catalogued. Sumire frowns at the plotted course. "We'll be lucky if half the stations we refuel at even have working lights." Darius mutters, "If Jorgensson's intel is right, we're heading straight into the mouth of something that's been brewing for decades." Yang doesn't look up from his screen. "Then let's not keep it waiting." Melidron is far away, beyond the reach of most traders, far from any safe harbor. But the coordinates are set, the time to go is now.
column2: 在阿尔戈号 的指挥甲板上，最终检查结果在每块屏幕上滚动显示. 补给已经装载. 机甲舱已经封闭. 导航图显示出一条通往星缘的曲折跃迁路线，穿过幽灵星系、拾荒星球以及鲜有人记录的寂静星辰. 苏米尔皱眉看着规划好的航线. “如果我们加油时有一半的空间站连灯都还能亮，就算走运了.” 达吕斯喃喃道: “如果约根森的情报没错，我们正一头扎进某个已经酝酿了数十年的东西的核心.” 杨没有抬头看屏幕.“那我们就别让它久等了.” Melidron 远在天边，超出大多数商人的触及范围，也远离任何安全港. 但坐标已经设定，出发的时刻就是现在.

column1: Constructed using IS-grade Endo-Steel and clad in seven tons of Inner Sphere quality Ferro-Fibrous armor, the BTL-C-2O 战斗眼镜蛇 mounts a lighter 200-rated standard fusion engine. While reducing its speed by 20 km/h, the extra weight was required to carry heavier IS-grade weapons as well as mount a fixed Improved C3 Computer in its center torso. An Improved Narc Missile Beacon spotter, the BTL-C-2OC mounts an iNARC launcher in each arm. While carrying no other weapons of any kind, five tons of reloads allows it to carry every conceivable form of iNARC ammo. An additional heat sink rounds out the config. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 采用IS级钢内骨结构，并披挂七吨内天体品质的铁纤维装甲，BTL-C-2O战斗眼镜蛇搭载了一台更轻的200型标准聚变引擎. 虽然速度因此降低了20公里/小时，但额外的重量用于携带更重的IS级武器，并在中央躯干内固定安装了一台改进型C3计算机. 作为改进型纳克导弹信标侦察单位，BTL-C-2OC在每只手臂各装有一具iNARC发射器. 由于未搭载其他任何武器，五吨的再装填量使其能够携带所有想得到的iNARC弹药类型. 额外加装的散热器完善了这一配置. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column2: 旋转 AC/5、Streak SRM-6 和中型 X 脉冲激光器。对于金刚狼来说，这是一些不错的技术。

column1: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries 设计 teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti-air and anti-mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either its own launcher or the rest of its lancemates. The 设计s speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with its 装甲 unable to stand up to much punishment. 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.05
column2: 在巨蛇与斗牛犬行动之后，由马弗里克工业公司制造的“沙皇炸弹”旨在提升炮兵单位的灵活性与生存能力. 由于注意到在氏族突破期间大量装备箭IV的单位损失惨重，其乘员惨遭屠杀，马弗里克工业的设计团队便寻求改善这一局面的方法. 在已获得霍兰德 BZK-F3 型机甲生产许可证的情况下，他们决定推出一种升级型号，采用超轻型引擎来搭载箭IV发射器. 现代炮兵战术要求部署防空及反机甲单位以保护这些珍贵资产，因此马弗里克仅在这台机甲上安装了一门小型脉冲激光，并加装了目标指示仪（TAG），使霍兰德既能对付步兵渗透者，又能为本机发射器或小队同伴提供目标指引. 该机甲的速度被认为足以闪避可能危及其自身的其他威胁，尤其是其装甲难以承受大量打击. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at 星团工业 were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the 短管PPCs, lasers and five 双散热器 in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P 中型脉冲激光s, and the advanced 指挥控制台. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07

column1: 号称"复仇天使"的 VND-1AA 试图提升维护者的机动性——这一点成功了。然而代价是把它的装甲削减到轻型机甲的水平。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 复仇者P型基本上是摇摇欲坠、勉强能动的废铁，通常出现在海盗手中，但谁也说不准某些人的机甲技师究竟有多差劲. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.01 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: More of a 'what was on hand' refit of a SLDF-era Mech, this Steel Viper unit was made as a last hope reinforcement that never saw the light of day. Equipped with Clan spec gear and pre-Clan weaponry, it is a hodge podge of technology that would be a nightmare to keep working. Even in the Inner Sphere, this thing would be a rarity to encounter.
column2: 这台钢蝰蛇装置更像是对 SLDF 时代机甲的“现有”改装，它是作为最后希望的加固而制造的，但从未见过世面。它配备了部落规格的装备和部落前的武器，这是一个技术大杂烩，继续工作将是一场噩梦。即使在内天界，这种东西也很少见。

column1: 阿尔戈号平稳的嗡鸣只被一条接入频道的尖锐提示音打断，你正在指挥甲板上翻看报告。 “指挥官，”你的副官 Darius Oliveira 的声音传来，带着几分介于担忧与无奈之间的意味，“你最好去 2 号对接环看看。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 在那儿——行李都收拾好了。穿梭机正从 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 表面飞上来。”你顿了顿，随即一言不发地起身。 几分钟后，你到了。2 号对接环比船体其他地方更冷，到处是裸露的钢板和刺眼的照明。外舱门暂时还封着，但指示器显示有一艘飞船几分钟后抵达。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 站在一小堆装备旁——{TGT_MW.Subj} 在阿尔戈号上 {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:own|Default:owns} 的全部家当，缩成了几个包。 你走近时，{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} 转身。“我猜你会听说。” “我听说了，”你平静地回答。 {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:glance|Default:glances} 了一眼肩后。“那你就知道我为什么在这儿了。没有空投。没有前途。我不想再等了。” 你身后，Darius 沉默地看着。
column2: 达吕斯将你的决定转达给了[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].“公司不能冒险让船员的安全和机甲战士的战备状态暴露在外来、未经测试的食物之下.”{TGT_MW.OBJ}没有对这一决定提出异议，而是按照指示将食物送进了焚化炉. 那气味闻起来十分美味，{TGT_MW.Callsign}在前往食堂去吃又一顿意料之中的晚餐前，渴望地叹了口气.

column1: The Superheavy 转管自动炮 specifically developed for Superheavy 'Mechs and is in practice a mix of a normal 转管自动炮 and a Mortar. Its Mortar-mode is pretty much just pointing the gun upwards and waiting for the shells to drop down again.\n\n Uses Superheavy RAC5 Ammo.
column2: The Superheavy Rotary Autocannon specifically developed for Superheavy 'Mechs and is in practice a mix of a normal Rotary Autocannon and a Mortar. Its Mortar-mode is pretty much just pointing the gun upwards and waiting for the shells to drop down again.\n\n Uses Superheavy RAC5 Ammo.

column1: Based off Phelan Kell's 'Mech 'Grinner', the Wolfhound IIC 3 is a Clan tech version of the Wolfhound. The design includes Endo Steel structure, Ferro-Fibrous armor and XL engine, combined with an ECM suite. The weapons are fully energy based, consisting of two ER 中型激光s, one ER Large Laser and three 中型脉冲激光s. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 基于费兰·凯尔的机甲‘微笑者’，猎狼犬IIC 3是猎狼犬的氏族科技版本. 该设计采用钢内骨结构、铁纤维装甲和超轻重引擎，并配备ECM套件. 武器配置为纯能量体系，包括两门中型增程激光、一门大型增程激光和三门中型脉冲激光. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: The Boreas Prime is an Omni机甲 and QuadVee hybrid 设计ed and 生产 by 氏族地狱马. Armed with an ER PPC, 中型脉冲激光, and 锁定式SRM-6, it is well-suited for mid-to-long range combat engagements. With a top speed of 64 km/h, it is capable of quickly maneuvering around the battlefield. Its Omni机甲 设计 allows for modular customization, making it a versatile platform for any mission. It is a potent combatant in the hands of a skilled pilot. Its QuadVee hybrid 设计 provides additional stability and mobility, making it suitable for rough terrain. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 北风 Prime 是由地狱战马氏族设计并生产的一款万能机甲与四足战车混合机体. 它装备了一门增程粒子加农炮、一门中型脉冲激光和一具锁定式SRM-6发射器，非常适合中远距离交战. 其最高时速为64公里/小时，能够在战场上快速机动. 万能机甲的设计使其支持模块化定制，成为适用于各种任务的多功能平台. 在熟练的机师手中，它是一名强大的战斗单位. 其四足战车混合设计提供了额外的稳定性与机动性，使之能够适应崎岖地形. 特质: 集成探照灯 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: For each unique chassis in your Mech Bay or cargo hold, you earn 1273 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier. This does not include chassis introduced in expansion content.
column2: 对于你机甲舱或仓库里的每一种独特机体，你都会获得1273分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数. 这里不包括扩展包中引入的机体.

column1: Named for a legendary Terran raider, the Von Luckner was designed for the original Star League after the Reunification War. Few remain in service today. The Von Luckner was one of the few tanks to use a fusion engine, as most vehicle-mounted reactors were stripped out for use in 'Mechs during the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 275 40 Left 210 40 Right 210 40 Rear 160 40 Turret 260 40 Total 1115 200 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: 以传说中的地球袭击者命名  Von Luckner是在统一战争后为最初的星际联盟设计的. 如今仍在服役的寥寥无几. Von Luckner是少数使用聚变引擎的坦克之一  因为在继承战争期间  大多数车载反应堆被拆除用于机甲. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 反应装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 275 40 左侧 210 40 右侧 210 40 后方 160 40 炮塔 260 40 总计 1115 200 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 2x 磁射 2x MML-10(RISC) 1x RISC重型银弹高斯 1x 多纳尔PPC

column1: Vacuum decreases heat sinking to 65%. VTOL units have 300% movement cost due to the lack of atmosphere. Reduced gravity results in ballistic and missile weapons and jump jets having 30% more range. In the dark, sight range is significantly reduced.
column2: 真空环境将散热效率降至 65%. 由于缺乏大气层，垂直起降飞行器单位的移动消耗增至300%. 低重力使弹道武器、导弹武器及跳跃推进器的射程提升 30%. 在黑暗中，视野范围显著缩小.

column1: Designed by Fredonian Industrial Technologies, the Anubis was originally designed to compliment the Osiris BattleMech in use by the Federated Suns. The 'Mech's lightweight chassis carries a powerful Ceres Motors 250 XL engine that gives the Anubis a top speed of 129.6 km/h and is covered in a protective skin of Hellespont Lite 隐身装甲, making the Anubis extremely hard to hit at long range. The typical LRM-5 launchers have been replaced by two MML-5s instead, along with four tons of mixed ammunition. An advanced 守护者ECM Suite is fitted to the center torso to power the stealth armor. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 由弗雷多尼亚工业技术公司设计的阿努比斯，最初是为补充恒星联邦装备的奥西里斯战斗机甲而开发. 该机甲采用轻量化底盘，搭载强劲的塞雷斯动力250超轻型引擎，最高时速可达129.6公里，并覆盖赫勒斯滂轻量潜行装甲防护层，使其在远距离极难被命中. 标准配置的LRM-5发射器已被两具MML-5多导弹发射系统取代，并配备四吨混合弹药. 机体中央躯干还安装了先进的守护者电子对抗套件，为潜行装甲提供能量. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: 甚至还没结束任务简报，一条优先级消息便已经标记在你的指挥终端上. 没有加密握手. 没有氏族代码层. 只有一个纯文本标题: 来自: 星上校阿蕾尔·约根森，幽灵熊氏族监察部 通讯立即接通. 阿蕾尔的面容填满屏幕. 僵硬的姿态，苍白的双眼如同透过冰霜玻璃般闪烁. 没有礼节. 没有克制. 只有愤怒. “我早该知道，不能相信一群雇佣兵surat. 你已经站到了dezgra 污秽一边，那些破碎氏族的残渣败类. 现在你也沾染了他们的腐朽. 它玷污了你的名声、你的船员、你的舰船. 你们不过是一群假装拥有荣誉的拾荒者. 所以听清楚了. 你们现在已经成为被标记的猎物. 我会从你们藏身之处拖出你们破碎的残骸，让它燃烧成灰，作为警告，警告所有胆敢庇护[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]]的愚蠢之人. 不会有审判. 不会有批斗. 不会有投降. 只有裁决.” 通讯戛然而止，就像在战争会议上摔门而去. 达吕斯缓缓呼出一口气.“嗯. 这确实很符合她的作风.” 苏米尔盯着通讯屏幕，歪了歪头. “我本来以为会更冷漠一些. 结果……简直像岩浆.” 杨嗤笑一声，摇了摇头.“Dezgra. 哈. 这就是他们称呼叛徒和罪犯的词. 她现在直接把我们和整个部落归为一类了.” 达吕斯眯起眼，看着日志缓冲区.“这不是警告. 这是宣战. 她已经让整个[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],监察部]]对我们展开行动了.” 舰桥陷入寂静. 你望向自己的船员. 他们仍在消化这一切，仍然保持警惕，但决定早已做出. “够了. 回去工作. 我们早就知道这不会轻松.”
column2: [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]Ghost Bear Watch]]星级上尉Elias Jorgensson一直在该区域进行监视行动. 我们的情报表明，他已收集了[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]Minnesota Tribe]]活动的证据，并整理了我们网络结构的详细报告.

column1: Joint Equipment System’s first vehicle since the 氏族入侵 overtook its main plant on Alshain. The JES I is a close-in fighting vehicle for primary escort and defense. The vehicle is considered by many to be underpowered with its 15-rating fusion engine and underarmored for its size. The vehicle’s glaring flaws were due to JES’s lack of capital to fund better equipment. However, the vehicle proved to be popular among Periphery nations and so the vehicle’s production continued well into the 3130s Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 25 Left 70 25 Right 70 25 Rear 50 25 Turret 60 25 Total 370 125 Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 中程
column2: Joint Equipment System在氏族入侵占领其位于Alshain的主要工厂后的第一款载具. JES I是一种用于主要护航和防御的近战载具. 许多人认为该载具因其15级聚变引擎而动力不足  且就其尺寸而言装甲薄弱. 该载具明显的缺陷是由于JES缺乏资金来资助更好的装备. 然而  该载具在外围国家中广受欢迎  因此该载具的生产一直持续到3130年代 环境限制: 无. 移动: 5/8格 / 150/240米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 120 25 左侧 70 25 右侧 70 25 后方 50 25 炮塔 60 25 总计 370 125 特质: 改进瞄准 - 中型 #武器: 4x SRM-4 3x SRM-6 1x 小型增程激光 1x Blackwell机枪

column1: Named after a mythological Pirate from pre-spaceflight Terra, this one has been given extensive upgrades in every direction. A heavier Hatchet lets this refit cleave 'Mechs of the same weight class apart with ease. Stealth armor makes it hard to detect while it's closing in, and the 330-rated engine makes sure it doesn't take long. Five Medium Lasers and a SRM6 see to it that it's also a dangerous brawler for its weight class. Fifteen Double Heat Sinks ensure this Buccaneer won't die of heatstroke out in the sun - or of a trigger happy mech-jock.
column2: 这艘船以太空飞行前的泰拉神话中的海盗命名，在各个方面都进行了广泛的升级。较重的斧头让这款改装可以轻松地将相同重量级别的机甲分开。隐形装甲使其在接近时难以被发现，而 330 级发动机确保它不会花费很长时间。五个中型激光器和一个 SRM6 使其在重量级别上也是一个危险的争斗者。十五个双散热器确保这款海盗不会在阳光下因中暑而死亡，也不会因快乐的机甲运动员而死亡。

column1: Based upon Advances by the Combine and with knowledge from Clan Missile Launchers, RISC Engineers developed the Heavy MRM, able to deliver a heavier payload with guided Missiles at extremely large Volley sizes. Due to the large strain from the generated forces, an extra sturdy chassis is needed which makes the launchers in practice only useable on Superheavy 'Mechs.\n\n Uses H-MRM Ammo.
column2: 【Heavy MRM】基于联合体的先进技术  并结合从氏族导弹发射器中获得的技术知识  RISC工程师研发出了重型MRM  能够以极大的齐射规模发射制导导弹  并搭载更重的弹头. 由于产生的巨大力量会对机体造成严重负荷  因此需要使用额外坚固的底盘  使得这种发射器实际上只能安装在超重型机甲上.\n\n使用H-MRM弹药.

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth I is armed with an ER Large Laser, an Improved Heavy Small Laser and an LRM-5. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.98
column2: 由200级超轻型引擎驱动并搭载MASC系统，这台20吨的“飞蛾”是有史以来最快的机甲之一. 作为专为侦察任务和元素装甲运输设计的机型，“飞蛾”于2874年投入生产. 铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的结合使其拥有7.5吨的吊舱空间. 飞蛾I型装备一门扩展射程大型激光、一具改进型小型重激光及一座远程导弹架5型. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.98

column1: During the morning briefing, Darius has a proposal. "Commander, the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system is renowned for its research facilities. It so happens that [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has a background in the medical supplies industry. If we could spare {TGT_MW.OBJ} for a while, {TGT_MW.Subj} could source us some advanced medical supplies without stretching our usual budget."
column2: 晨间简报时，达里乌斯有个提议。“指挥官，{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系以其研究设施闻名。碰巧[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]有医疗物资行业的背景。如果我们能放{TGT_MW.OBJ}一段时间的假，{TGT_MW.Subj}能为我们弄到一些先进医疗物资，而不必挤压我们平常的预算。“

column1: The Chameleon was 设计ed to help a new 机甲Warrior master the skills of maneuvering and heat management, with a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping distance of one hundred and eighty meters. The '机甲 also had an almost all energy weapons loadout, but cooled only by ten standard heat sinks. This paucity of freezers forces 机甲Warriors to concentrate on the '机甲's heat levels. In some instances, the Chameleon had been forced into combat situations, notably during the Dragoon Civil War. Production of the Chameleon halted briefly in 3052 when 迪法恩斯工业 decided to switch its production to the Nightsky, but was quickly resumed when J.B. Battle机甲s Incorporated purchased the rights to the 设计. J.B. Battle机甲s also introduced two battle-worthy variants of the Chameleon. The Chameleon is a training '机甲, intended to simulate a variety of opponents by mounting a wide variety of weapon systems. A Chameleon is a medium '机甲, but it doesn't always look like one. It can be fitted out with extra plates to modify its appearance, and carries special electronics to falsify its signature; these special abilities let it look and scan as something other than what it is, hence the machine's name. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.04
column2: 变色龙的设计初衷是帮助新手机甲战士掌握机动和热量管理技能，其最高时速可达97.2公里，跳跃距离达一百八十米. 这台机甲几乎全配备能量武器，却仅靠十个标准散热器降温. 冷却系统的匮乏迫使机甲战士必须时刻关注机体热量水平. 在某些情况下，变色龙也曾被迫投入实战，尤其是在龙骑兵内战期间表现得尤为突出. 3052年，当Defiance工业决定转产暗夜星辰时，变色龙的生产一度暂停，但在J.B.战斗机甲公司购得该设计版权后迅速恢复. 该公司还推出了两款具备实战价值的衍生型号. 作为训练机甲，变色龙通过搭载多样化的武器系统来模拟各种对手. 这台中型机甲时常能改变外观形态——既可加装额外装甲板改变外形，又配备特殊电子设备伪造特征信号；这些独特能力使其外观和扫描特征都能以假乱真，机甲名称正由此而来. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.04

column1: The Kokou Defense Tank is an early Clan Combat Vehicle utilized in the Clan Homeworlds during the Succession Wars Era. Constructed using standard Clan technologies, the Kokou is powered by a Standard engine and is protected by upwards of 8.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, with the majority of armor focused in its front and turret. The vehicle is not terribly fast, its fusion engine is only able to move it no faster than 32 km/h. Its long-range weapon is a 10-Tubed 远程导弹发射器 mounted in front of the tank's hull. The one ton of ammunition for the launcher is protected by CASE. While intermediate and close ranges are handled by blistering fire of three 大型脉冲激光s in its turret. Biome Restrictions: None. column1: 短ly after departure from Eagle Rest II, a priority message pings your terminal, encrypted with Ghost Bear Watch protocols. "Good work. Uplink neutralized, signal net disrupted. Proceed to next priority site: Butzfleth Majoris. Target data will be transmitted upon arrival. - Jorgensson" No sign-off. No elaboration. Just another set of coordinates, pulsing cold on the navscreen. Time to move.
column2: 离开Eagle Rest II 不久后，你的终端收到一条优先级消息，使用幽灵熊监察部协议进行加密. “干得好. 上行链路已被摧毁，信号网络已被扰乱. 前往下一个优先目标地点: Butzfleth Majoris. 目标数据将在抵达后传输. — Jorgensson” 没有结束语. 没有解释. 只有另一组坐标，在导航屏幕上冰冷地闪烁着. 是时候行动了.

column1: 星团工业’s Project: SORCERER is considered one of the best examples of effective counter-industrial espionage techniques; despite being in development for nearly two decades, the various intelligence agencies of the Great Houses never managed to collect any meaningful data on the program. The project’s primary goal was to create an assault BattleMech capable of slipping behind and operations behind enemy lines for an indefinite period of time and if at all possible, do this task undetected. Produced in exceptionally small quantities up until Amaris forces overran their facilities on Fletcher, the 95-ton Sorcerer 1X sports a combination of a 虚无信号系统 and a 变色龙光极化护盾. The 1X carries a pair of Ceres Arms Smasher PPCs, a pair of Donal 短管PPCs, and pair of Magna 400P 中型脉冲激光s which in combination with the stealth systems onboard can easily overpower the Mech’s nineteen 双散热器. Few remember the 1X variant as the more widely-produced and fielded 1A variant stepped off of the manufacturing lines on the same day. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19
column2: 星团工业的“术士”计划被视为反工业间谍技术最成功的范例之一；尽管研发过程持续了近二十年，各大家族的情报机构从未能获取到任何关于该计划的实质性情报. 该计划的首要目标是打造一款能够渗透至敌后并无限期执行任务的突击型战斗机甲，同时尽可能在不被察觉的情况下完成行动. 在阿马里斯部队攻占其位于弗莱彻的生产设施之前，95吨级的术士1X型仅进行了极小批量生产，配备了一套零特征系统与一套变色龙光学偏振盾. 1X型搭载两门刻瑞斯武器粉碎者型粒子加农炮、两门多纳尔短鼻粒子加农炮以及两具马格纳400P中型脉冲激光，配合机载潜行系统，其火力产生的热量足以轻易超出这台机甲十九具双散热器的散热能力. 由于产量更大、装备更广泛的1A型在同一天就走下了生产线，如今已很少有人记得1X型号. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.19

column1: 加固装甲 is a thicker armor type that uses multiple overlapping plates to provide additional protection against enemy fire. Activatable: DEALS DAMAGE AND CRIT TO CENTER TORSO ON FAILURE

Not content to lose a defining medium ’Mech after the success of the SHD-6D, the AFFS financed rapid production of the WVR-10D at Kallon of Wernke. column1: The Patton 坦克 is a 65-ton 装甲ed combat 车辆, specializing in conventional 装甲ed warfare. Identical to its twin, the Rommel, in every way but armament and 装甲 configuration, the Patton has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after General George S. Patton, Jr., a legendary commander of 装甲ed and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. Unlike the Rommel, which features a massive and powerful but short-ranged AC/20 as its main gun, the Patton mounts an AC/10, giving it twice the ammunition capacity and superior firing range while also enabling it to be fitted with more 装甲. The Patton is capable of fighting in short-ranged and urban environments, but is far more suited than the Rommel to engaging targets at medium to long range. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 265 35 左侧 250 35 右侧 250 35 后方 230 35 炮塔 265 35 总计 1260 175 怪癖: 主战坦克

column1: 达里乌斯召集全体人员召开紧急会议。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 感染了一种传染性强、可能致命的疾病，多半是最近一次上岸休假外出时沾上的。我们得把整间医疗舱隔离起来，直到 {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}。我也已经通知了当地政府。他们认为我们碰上的是当地一种边境痘病毒株，可以为我们提供针对性药物，要价 ¢80,000。价格很贵，但多半是必要的。”\r\n\r\n苏米蕾主动请缨：“我认识一家药物研究实验室里的人。他们一直在找人试用他们的新抗病毒药。花 ¢200,000 就能成为最早一批参与者，之后我们就能永久获得这种药。”
column2: 命令{TGT_MW.Callsign}在{TGT_MW.OBJ}恢复的时候进行练习.

The design came into existence due to Jade Falcons need to re-purpose surplus components being produced for their Loki and Thor 全向Mech designs. column2: 于3088年推出的这款雷神托尔 IIC先进改型，在设计中贯彻了极致耐久的理念. 该机型诞生于玉鹰氏族对剩余组件的再利用需求——这些组件原为他们的洛基和托尔万能机甲生产线所造. 他们采用奥利维蒂武器公司早前为内天体设计的经典雷神托尔机体，将其重塑为替代圣战时期损失的二线机甲的机型. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Constructed using IS-grade Endo-Steel and clad in seven tons of Inner Sphere quality Ferro-Fibrous armor, the BTL-C-2O 战斗眼镜蛇 mounts a lighter 200-rated standard fusion engine. While reducing its speed by 20 km/h, the extra weight was required to carry heavier IS-grade weapons as well as mount a fixed Improved C3 Computer in its center torso. The Prime is based on its Clan counterpart, carrying an IS-grade 大型脉冲激光 in each arm as well as an extra double heat sink. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 采用I.S.级钢内骨结构，并覆盖七吨内天体品质的铁纤维装甲，BTL-C-2O战斗眼镜蛇搭载了一台较轻的200级标准核融合引擎. 虽然时速降低了20公里，但多出来的重量用于携带更重的I.S.级武器，并在中央躯干安装了一台固定的改进型C3计算机. 主配置以其氏族对应型号为基础，每条手臂各装有一具I.S.级大型脉冲激光，并额外配备一组双重散热器. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

The Yan team kept many of the strengths of the search-and-rescue 车辆 the Crow is descended from, though they improved it using military-grade technologies. column1: As ER PPC quickly became hard to source, the Lu Bu LB-189 variant was designed as a continuation of the LB-182 variant with its Endo-Steel structure. Instead of the ER PPC it uses two standard PPCs, allowing it to drop three heat sinks. As a compensation for the lack of the new fancy ER PPC technology, the LB-189 instead uses a slightly upgraded in rating Extra-Light engine core. The changes allowed the addition of two Large Lasers which greatly increases its damage potential, but the variant was deemed far too expensive to be mass-produced. Quirk: 改良冷却套-PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: As ER PPC quickly became hard to source, the Lu Bu LB-189 variant was designed as a continuation of the LB-182 variant with its Endo-Steel structure. Instead of the ER PPC it uses two standard PPCs, allowing it to drop three heat sinks. As a compensation for the lack of the new fancy ER PPC technology, the LB-189 instead uses a slightly upgraded in rating Extra-Light engine core. The changes allowed the addition of two Large Lasers which greatly increases its damage potential, but the variant was deemed far too expensive to be mass-produced. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: 这是百夫长-9A 的原始降级版，在低技术国家和匪帮中很常见。 Quirk: 易于驾驶 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是首款完全由霸主工厂生产的马里安机甲. 它采用原始装甲和引擎以降低成本，但通过5具火箭发射器所带来的强大爆发火力来弥补这一不足. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 0.82 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: Initially produced by the Quikscell Company in 2807, the Scorpion Light Tank is famously easy to repair, available in numbers, and best of all, cheap. Only marginally effective on it's merits, the Scorpion has proven effective in mass numbers. Swarms of Scorpions, easily procured due to their low cost, are an often-encountered danger on poorer worlds. The vehicle is produced on many planets within the Inner Sphere. Many local variations, upgrades, and downgrades as required by circumstance are in use. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 15 Left 75 15 Right 75 15 Rear 65 15 Turret 100 15 Total 415 75 Quirk: 防护机构
column2: 最初由Quikscell公司于2807年生产  Scorpion轻型坦克以易于维修、数量充足且最重要的是价格低廉而闻名. 仅就其本身性能而言  Scorpion的效果有限  但已证明在大规模使用时十分有效. 由于成本低廉而易于获取的Scorpion集群  是较贫穷星球上经常遇到的危险. 该载具在内天体许多星球上都有生产. 各地根据情况需要  使用着许多本地改型、升级版和降级版. 环境限制: 由于使用内燃机  该单位无法部署在月球或火星环境. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 15 左侧 75 15 右侧 75 15 后方 65 15 炮塔 100 15 总计 415 75 特质: 防护机构 #武器: 1x 雷电10 1x 双联机枪

column1: The Argus 5D drops all the standard weaponry and equipment. In its place are a Heavy PPC, two 锁定式SRM-6 launchers, and a pair of 中型激光s. The 定位 Computer remains, and this variant is capable of bursts of speed over 100 km/h thanks to a MASC system. The 5D also has a C3 Slave Unit mounted in its head. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 百眼巨人ARG-5D型移除了所有标准武器与装备，转而搭载一门重型粒子加农炮、两具锁定式SRM-6发射器及两门中型激光. 瞄准计算机得以保留，该型号凭借MASC系统可实现超过100公里/小时的爆发性提速. 其头部还装有一台C3协从单元. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Black Hills Urban Combat Zone Arena and piloted by Jillian Robertson and squad, this variant is a rebuild of an existing Clan battlesuit model. The base chassis was increased in mass to improve its 装甲 and weapon options, without sacrificing the suit’s airborne mobility or its anti-'机甲 attack options. The variant retains the Clan engineering HarJel technology and the life support systems keeping its warrior battle-ready even when compromised. The lighter-weight Clan 装甲 has been upgraded here by sixty percent over the original, that now can sustain hits from all but the heaviest lasers and autocannon, while still closing in to swarm its target. The variant trades the original Sylph’s bomb rack for a one shot five-pack of SRMs which also gives it a little extra punch, allowing a squad of these up-sized air Elementals to put some serious hurt on even a medium Battle机甲. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.968 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 于3144年在黑山城市战区竞技场首次亮相，由吉莉安·罗伯逊及其小队驾驶. 该变体是对现有氏族战斗装甲型号的重建，通过增大基础底盘质量来提升装甲防护与武器选项，且未牺牲机体的空中机动性或反机甲攻击能力. 该型号保留了氏族的工程哈吉尔凝胶技术与生命维持系统，即使受损也能维持战士持续作战. 其轻量化氏族装甲相比原版提升了60%的防护性能，现可抵御除最重型激光与自动炮外的所有打击，并仍能逼近目标展开攀附攻击. 该变体将原版风精的炸弹挂架替换为五联装单发型短程火箭，额外增强了攻击威力，使一队此类放大版空中元素装甲能对中型作战机甲造成重创. 特质: 敏捷 部署费用倍率: 0.968 可挂载于万能单位，可近战，可攀附攻击.

column1: This variant uses a Compact Engine and Compact Gyro to increase survivability. It has the same top speed as the standard Legacy and drops the jump range to sixty meters. Each arm carries a Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Light PPC, supported by two torso mounted MML-7s with Artemis IV fire control systems. A head-mounted ER Small Laser rounds out the armament. Thirteen double heat sinks are installed as well.
column2: 该变体使用紧凑型发动机和紧凑型陀螺仪来提高生存能力。它具有与标准 Legacy 相同的最高速度，并将跳跃范围降至 60 米。每只手臂都携带一个中型变速脉冲激光器和一个轻型 PPC，由两个安装在躯干上的 MML-7s 和 Artemis IV 火控系统提供支持。头戴式 ER 小型激光器使武器更加完善。还安装了十三个双散热器。

column1: Darius hands you a form. "It's [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s resignation. I tried to talk {TGT_MW.OBJ} out of it, but {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|Default:they're} holding firm. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} said things around here have gotten really bad, and honestly {TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|Default:they're} right. Morale is in the crapper and I've had to break up too many fights recently. We've got to turn this around, Commander, or we'll keep losing people."
column2: 达里乌斯递给你一份表格。“这是[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]的辞呈。我试图劝{TGT_MW.OBJ}打消这个念头，但{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|Default:they're}态度坚决。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}说这里的情况已经变得非常糟，老实说{TGT_MW.Gender?Male:he's|Female:she's|Default:they're}说得对。士气流到了谷底，最近我已经不得不拉开太多场斗殴了。我们得扭转局面，指挥官，否则人会一直走。“

column1: The Main Gauche Light Support Tank is a fire support companion to Brooks Incorporated's Galleon. Though slower, topping out at only 64 km/h, five tons of armor protect it. The Main Gauche was actually submitted to the Free Worlds League Military because that organization was looking for a tank with long range capability. It finally reached full production in 3064. This variant introduced in 3066 removes the Machine Guns to add a C3 Slave Unit and an ER Small Laser. While this lessens short-range damage potential, it makes the 轻型高斯步枪 much more accurate if another unit in its C3 network is close to the Main Gauche's target. This makes it even more advantageous for the light tank to stay at extreme range. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 145 15 Left 95 15 Right 95 15 Rear 65 15 Total 400 60 Quirk: 快速起步
column2: Main Gauche轻型支援坦克是布鲁克斯公司Galleon坦克的火力支援伙伴. 尽管速度较慢  最高时速仅为64公里  但它有五吨装甲保护. Main Gauche实际上是提交给自由世界联盟军队的  因为该组织正在寻找一种具有远程能力的坦克. 它最终在3064年达到全面生产. 这种在3066年推出的变体移除了机枪  增加了一个C3从属单元和一个小型增程激光. 虽然这降低了短程伤害潜力  但如果其C3网络中的另一个单位靠近Main Gauche的目标  它会使轻型高斯步枪更加准确. 这使得轻型坦克保持在极远距离上更加有利. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 145 15 左侧 95 15 右侧 95 15 后方 65 15 总计 400 60 特质: 快速起步 #武器: 1x 轻型高斯步枪 1x 小型增程激光

column1: Born from the 泰拉霸权's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. The 布雷克圣言会's version of the Galahad, the GLH-3D variant, employs a 240-rated Light Fusion Engine and a small cockpit. For weapons it uses two 轻型高斯步枪s with four tons of ammo to split between them. It was also given more sophisticated electronics, in the way of an improved C3 computer and a 守护者ECM Suite. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 源于泰拉霸权试图打造一款比RLN-1N型“步枪手（Rifleman）”更先进的中型火力支援平台的尝试，米切尔车辆公司于2570年推出了GLH-1D加拉哈德. 尽管火力超越了早期设计并在霸权国武装部队中广受认可，加拉哈德仍未能摆脱其取代对象存在的散热问题. 布雷克圣言会版本的加拉哈德——GLH-3D变体，搭载了240额定功率的轻型核融合引擎和紧凑型驾驶舱. 武器系统配备两门轻型高斯步枪，共享四吨弹药储备，并加装了更精密电子设备，包括改进型C3计算机与守护者ECM套件. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 这款德拉科尼斯联合体变体于 3054 年推出，以 7M 为基础，将其中的一门脉冲激光换成标准中型激光和一台 C3 从属单元。 Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 于尼玛卡奇天马塔吉工厂被毁后的3074年建造，7KC型移除了7K型的中型脉冲激光，换装了一门轻型粒子加农炮和一个C3从机. 特质: 迅捷 部署费用倍率: 0.99

column1: A fast unit, the Light VTOL is not designed for protracted combat. Carrying an array of ranged weapons, the Light VTOL is designed to support allied units from range. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 75 10 左侧 50 10 右侧 50 10 后方 35 10 总计 220 50 特性：灵巧
column2: 轻型VTOL速度极快，并非为持久战而设计。它搭载一系列远程武器，旨在从远处支援友军单位。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 70 10 左侧 35 10 右侧 35 10 后方 30 10 总计 180 50 特性：武器稳定

column1: This version is built with Clan technology similar to the Marauder II C. It uses a standard 300-rated Fusion Engine with sixteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internal structure. It is armed with an ER PPC and two Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm. A Gauss Rifle sits in the right torso with two tons of ammunition, and a Targeting Computer is in the left torso for increased accuracy. It has a Clan-tech CASE system to protect the Gauss Rifle, and can jump 90 meters at a time.
column2: 该版本采用与 Marauder II C 类似的 Clan 技术建造。它使用标准 300 级融合引擎，配有 16 吨铁纤维装甲和远藤钢内部结构。它的每只手臂上都配备了 ER PPC 和两个中脉冲激光器。右侧躯干装有一把装有两吨弹药的高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有一台瞄准计算机以提高准确性。它拥有部落科技CASE系统来保护高斯步枪，并且一次可以跳跃90米。

column1: Reportedly piloted by the more or less infamous pirate "Damio," this "Beekeeper" is 设计ed to fire large stingy "Swarms." Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04
column2: 据称由多少有些臭名昭著的海盗“达米欧”驾驶，这台“养蜂人”专为发射大型蛰刺“蜂群”而设计. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.04

column1: This mech is a solution in need of a problem. Nobody needs a 65 ton mech to move that fast, and it doesn't even have jumpjets, so you can't take advantage of the mobility most of the time. On the plus side, any medium mechs you catch will be crushed beneath this thing's fists. Just, go easy on those PPCs. They run too hot for the cooling system to handle.
column2: 该机甲是需要问题的解决方案。没有人需要 65 吨的机甲来移动那么快，而且它甚至没有跳跃喷气机，所以大多数时候你无法利用机动性。从好的方面来说，你抓住的任何中型机甲都会被这个东西的拳头压碎。只是，在这些 PPC 上放轻松一些。它们运行得太热，冷却系统无法处理。

column1: This version uses an experimental 350-rated XXL Engine, a 激光反导系统, and a pair of Improved Heavy 中型激光s. The Jade Falcon engineers who designed it also installed an XL Gyro and used 重型铁纤维装甲 armor to protect the chassis. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: This version uses an experimental 350-rated XXL Engine, a Laser Anti Missile System, and a pair of Improved Heavy Medium Lasers. The Jade Falcon engineers who designed it also installed an XL Gyro and used Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor to protect the chassis. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: As a commander, you know that to keep your mechwarriors alive, you need to fit the most tonnage onto your mechs that you can, and at Quicsell, we've found a way to help with that. Tradidional life support systems are completely overbuilt, so we stripped them down to half the weight. Your mechwarriors can put up with a little discomfort, right?
column2: 身为指挥官，您很清楚，要让机甲战士活下来，就得尽可能往机甲里塞更多的东西. 而在Quicsell，我们找到了帮您达成目标的方法. 传统的生命维持系统被过度强化了，所以我们将其精简至一半重量. 您的机甲战士稍微忍忍不适，没问题的，对吧?

column1: This is terrible. A pirate finds pulse technology and in an effort to improve it, cracks open the focusing chamber and hot-wires the capacitors into a feedback loop. You've got to stop bringing me this crap.
column2: 【L. Pulse Laser (P)】这东西糟透了. 一个海盗弄到了脉冲技术，为了改进它，竟然把聚焦腔打开，还把电容器硬接成了反馈回路. 你别再把这种破烂东西拿给我了.

column1: The Republic's Omni机甲 Celerity removes the C3i system of the original ComStar variant, replacing it with OmniPod space, and fitting it with double heat sinks to expand its utility as well as carry an extra half-ton of 装甲. The primary configuration carries only a small laser, a C3 slave and a TAG. 怪癖: Quad 机甲 (Squad) 掉落成本乘数: 0.94
column2: 共和国的万能机甲“迅捷”移除了原通讯之星变体的C3i系统，替换为万能荚舱空间，并配备双重散热器以拓展其功能性，同时额外增加半吨装甲. 主配置仅携带一门小型激光、一个C3从机和一套目标引导系统. 特质: 四足机甲（小队） 部署费用倍率: 0.94

column1: Yeah Boss, this is still a Light PPC, and yes that's parts of a capacitor where the shielding should be, but somehow this helps the Particle Charge actually grow the further it travels. Would be a stroke of genius if that focusing lens could be remotely calibrated. \n\n Can Toggle Between Rapid Fire or Overcharging the Capacitator, exchanging Reliability for Additional Shots or Damage
column2: 是的，老大，这仍然是一门轻型PPC，而且没错，那本该是屏蔽层的地方现在装的是电容器的部件，但不知怎的，这种改动反而让粒子电荷在飞行距离越远时威力越强. 要是那个聚焦透镜能远程校准的话，这可真是个天才之举.\n\n可在快速射击与过载电容器之间切换，以可靠性换取额外射击次数或伤害

column1: Not designed for traditional combat, the Carrier is a force multiplier. Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of armor isn't a concern. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Hardened Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 40 Left 80 40 Right 80 40 Rear 75 40 Turret 100 40 Total 435 200 Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 长程
column2: 并非为传统战斗设计  Carrier是力量倍增器. 它设计用于从远处支援友军  可以留在友军战线后方  在那里它缺乏装甲的问题并不令人担忧. 生态限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 硬化 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 40 左侧 80 40 右侧 80 40 后方 75 40 炮塔 100 40 总计 435 200 特质: 改良瞄准 - 远程 #武器: 4x NLRM-15

column1: Kirei Na Niwa ("Beautiful Garden") is a world whose economy is largely based on agriculture. The broad plains and fertile soil allow many crops to be grown here year round.
column2: Kirei Na Niwa（“美丽花园”）是一个经济主要依赖农业的星球. 广袤的平原和肥沃的土壤使这里全年都能种植多种作物.

column1: 紧急警报尖啸着响起，Darius 报告：“指挥官，这颗行星的轨道上塞满了太空垃圾，一片未标注的碎片云正要撞上阿尔戈号。这么短的时间，我们没什么办法避开。要是被撞上，我们会很不好受。” Sumire 露出调皮的笑容。“我可以把豹式开出去，来一场主动防御！[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 负责开火，我来躲碎片。” Darius 说：“要是这么做，我们就得决定优先防守哪些系统。”
column2: 允许{TGT_MW.Callsign}在授权区域中继续行动.

column1: Too lightly armored for my taste, but at least it has a big gun, right? The main issue being, it's only really useful in close range combat, and it's got the standard XL engine vulnerability combined with weak armor. I wouldn't take this into the field if I were you.
column2: 装甲太轻了，不符合我的口味，但至少它有一把大枪，对吧？主要问题是，它只在近距离战斗中真正有用，并且具有标准的 XL 引擎漏洞和薄弱的装甲。如果我是你，我不会把这个带入这个领域。

column1: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. Its weapons generated a lot of heat, but the old 双散热器 were put in to handle it. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: “狮鹫（Griffin）”2N是一款星际联盟时代的古老型号，在其鼎盛时期是最为多用途的机甲之一. 它的武器会产生大量热量，但安装了旧式的双散热器来应对这一情况. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: A customised model, this RQA-B was one of the original prototypes, built prior to the first production run. Full of technological upgrades that never made it into production, this mech is equally deadly at range and close quarters. Featuring 3 PPC’s, first generation heat dissipation armour and a unique FCS built to maximise the damage potential of the weapons; this Urbanmech has claimed many unwary opponents. Piloted by one of Damage Inc’s senior officers, this mech is equally notorious among Damage Inc’s opponents and allies. 怪癖: 360° Torso Twist 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 一种定制型号，这台RQA-B是初始原型机之一，在首次量产前建造. 它配备了众多从未投入量产的技术升级，使这台机甲在远程与近距离作战中同样致命. 搭载三门PPC、第一代散热装甲，以及专为最大化武器破坏力而设计的独特FCS火控系统，这台城市机甲已让许多疏忽大意的对手折戟. 由Damage Inc.的一名高级军官驾驶，在Damage Inc.的敌方与友方中，这台机甲同样声名在外. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: One of the rarer configurations, the Septicemia E consists of a pair of ER PPCs and six ER 中型激光s tied into a 定位 Computer. It also carries a Light TAG to locate hidden units, but the most dangerous part of its equipment is the Nova CEWS system that allowed it to share targeting data with friendly units. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 稀有机体配置之一，脓毒症E型搭载了两门增程粒子加农炮和六门中型增程激光，并集成至瞄准计算机. 它还配备了一门轻型目标定位装置以侦测隐藏单位，但其装备中最危险的部分是新星CEWS系统，该系统可让它与友军单位共享瞄准数据. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast Omni机甲 that has respectable firepower. This light '机甲 is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous 装甲. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The D variant carries an LRM-15, an ER Large Laser, and two Heavy 中型激光s. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 地狱龙是冰霜地狱氏族及其崇尚速度至上理念的产物. 基于神秘山猫机甲设计，地狱龙是一款具备可观火力的快速万能机甲. 这台轻型机甲通过装配五吨半铁纤维装甲变得相当难以击毁，同时采用钢内骨结构以减轻重量. 虽然同级机甲中速度不算突出，地狱龙却配备了MASC系统来实现爆发性加速，其机体未搭载任何固定武器. D型变体配备有一门LRM-15导弹发射器、一门大型增程激光和两门中型重激光. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: 詹纳首次投入战场是在 2784 年 9 月，同年 11 月，最终演变为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们如何在如此短的时间内获得该设计不得而知，但已知氏族版本装备的是氏族武器。 Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 乔姆皮正在啊呜啊呜地大吃. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: At long range, the Lobo makes use of its ER large laser. As it closes, it can makes use of paired ATM-6s, paired heavy medium lasers and a heavy small laser. The meager 10 double heat sinks allotted to the design cannot hope to keep it cool, so MechWarriors have resorted to running the heat up to the red, then disengaging to cool off. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 在远距离交战时，Lobo 使用其大型增程激光. 接近后，它能动用两具 ATM-6、两具中型重激光和一具小型重激光. 该设计仅分配了区区 10 个双倍散热器，根本无法指望它保持冷却，因此机甲战士们不得不将热量飙升至红线，然后脱离战斗进行冷却. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: This pilot feels unappreciated from having to sleep in shifts. Hotbunking sucks.
column2: 由于被迫轮班睡觉，这名机师感到未受赏识. 轮铺制度可真够受的.

column1: The Ostscout was 设计ed as a pure recon Battle机甲 by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other 设计s can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The Ostscout 8J is highly prized by the Draconis Combine, using the classic 7J model as a base, it uses a GM 280-rated XL engine to free up weight to upgrade its electronics suite to modern standards, being fitted with an Angel ECM suite and Bloodhound active probe. Offensively the 中型激光 is swapped for a Martell-X medium X-Pulse laser supported by double heat sinks and six tons of ferro-fibrous 装甲. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 奥斯特侦察机甲是由奥斯特曼工业公司设计的一款纯侦察型机甲. 为实现这一目标，其设计完全围绕战场数据收集与快速脱离危险展开，在这两项任务中表现堪称卓越；该机甲速度足以避开大多数陷阱，在机动性与速度方面鲜有敌手. 天龙联合体极为重视8J型奥斯特侦察机甲，该型号以经典7J型为基础，搭载GM 280级XL引擎以减轻重量，使其电子设备套件升级至现代标准，配备天使ECM套件与血猎犬主动探测器. 在火力配置上，中型激光被替换为马尔泰-X中型X射线脉冲激光，并辅以双联散热器与六吨铁纤维装甲. 特质: 增强型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: The ER-PPC is changed out for a second extended range large laser. The supercharger is removed, as is the streak SRM. Replacing the streak SRM is an LRM-20 with an 阿尔忒弥斯V火控. The missile rack is supplied with two tons of ammunition. The '机甲's close range firepower is adjusted with an ER 中型激光, while all weapons are still tied into a less sizeable 定位 Computer. This refit was successful enough to be adopted as a new factory model. 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower
column2: 增程粒子加农炮（ER PPC）被替换为第二门大型增程激光. 超增压器被移除，锁定式SRM也同样被撤掉. 原本锁定式SRM的位置换上了一套配备阿尔忒弥斯V型火控系统的LRM-20，导弹架备弹两吨. 该机甲近程火力由一门中型增程激光进行调整，同时所有武器仍连接至一台体积较小的目标计算机. 此次改造非常成功，已被采纳为新出厂型号. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: 作为另一款反步兵与近战变体，VTR-9A1 加装双联机枪并保留大部分装甲。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Victor 9S牺牲了部分本就差强人意的装甲，以搭载更多武器. 敌军看到这台机甲翻越山头倾泻凶猛火力时固然心惊胆战，但它也必须时刻提防任何回击. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 右上臂

column1: 战锤-6Rb 是首款皇家战锤，但-7A 把这款机甲推向其逻辑终点。凭借先进武器与建造材料，加上双倍散热器，战锤-7A 是行走的死亡机器，对机甲与车辆一视同仁。 Quirk: 集成探照灯 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这架源自栗田机甲竞技世界的龙式机甲经过重新设计，能向敌人喷吐烈焰与毁灭，让全场观众为之疯狂. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The extremely high temperature brought on by the heat wave increases heat generation by an additional 25% and 8 heat per turn.

column1:
A member of the so-called 'Ghosts of Skye', or more colloquially known as the 'Rangers', little background information is available on the mysterious Tobias Rieper.

From his own public statements, Tobias was born on the world of Skye, as apparently all members of the Ghosts are. Orphaned at an early age, Tobias became a ward of the state, having no living relatives after a rare chemical attack on the world during the closing days of the Fourth Succession War. Too young to remember his family, Tobias was adopted by members of the order and trained from a young age in the ways of warfare.

Upon coming to the age of majority, Tobias was enrolled into the LCAF and, by the powers that be, was assigned to the elite 4th Skye Rangers, which according to Tobias all members of the Ghosts serve in for at least some period of time. Here Tobias distinguished himself, eventually even coming to the attention of the FedCom Archon-Prince after saving his life from a would-be assassin. Grateful to the young MechWarrior, the Archon gifted Tobias with a unique variant of the time-tested Orion 'Mech, equipped with the very best tech available to the state.

Tobias used this 'Mech to great effect, and although he left the LCAF shortly before the outbreak of the 氏族入侵, Tobias would fight alongside his old unit and his fellow Ghosts during it, and participated in Operation Serpent.

Following the end of the Clan-created crisis, Tobias disappeared from the public, but was later known to have been active during the FedCom Civil War and the Blakist Jihad that followed.

As war once again engulfed the Sphere following ComStar's invasion of the nascent 球体共和国, the Ghosts decided to make themselves known again, this time as mercenaries for hire. Although Tobias was chosen to be their public point of contact, he was clear that he was not their leader - rather he had been forced into the role as the result of a lost bet with someone known as "Byrd". From here, Tobias could be found on several fronts of the war, aiding the Taurian conquests of the Calderon Protectorate and Aurigan Coalition. After these conquests, the Rangers proceeded to smash ComStar's lines under the direction of House Davion, largely changing the course of that conflict.

After these high-profile contracts, Tobias vanished for some time, but was spotted aiding the Society during their so-called 'Society Summer' invasion. Finally, under the direction of the mysterious council that runs the Ghosts, Tobias and several regiments of Rangers were sent coreward on a mission to claim ownership of 云蛇氏族. Here it was revealed that Tobias was a descendant of the Riaz family and under Clan laws had possible claims to the Riaz Bloodname. After winning the right to Bloodname, Tobias engaged the Khan of the Cobras in a Trial of Position - a trial he won with relative ease and in so doing became Khan of the Clan.

While most clanners were not happy with this, they had little choice but to obey as Tobias stirred the Cobras into an invasion of the 鬼熊 Dominion. After a protracted Trial of Possession for 59 worlds of the Bears, the Cobras under Tobias emerged victorious with the aid of the Ghost regiments now integrated into the Clan. From there, under orders, Tobias proceeded to invade his homeworld of Skye, taking the world under command of the council.

Then Tobias was issued one final set of orders, which he executed in the closing days of the war. Taking advantage of their momentum against the Republic, Tobias laid siege to and successfully claimed Terra, becoming ilKhan in the process and making Cloud Cobra the ilClan. At the same time, Cobra forces executed a daring attack on the Clan homeworld of Strana Mechty, claiming it for themselves.

For the next several decades Tobias ruled over the Cloud Cobras and eventually returned the world of Skye to Lyran control, which evidently was the council's overall goal for the entire operation. Some fifty years later, at the age of 92, Tobias finally passed away, becoming the oldest living Khan ever, and the only one for the Cobras to pass away due to old age after having successfully fended off dozens of challenges for the position over that time span.

column2: 海盗们搞到一台“垃圾桶”并不奇怪，奇怪的是他们居然“修复”了那门残破不堪的自动炮，还给这可怜的家伙焊上了两个火箭发射器. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: This variant removes the 中型脉冲激光, iNarc launcher, and TAG system. In their place are a C3 master computer, Snub Nose PPC, and 小型脉冲激光. The ER PPC remains. A MASC system allows this Tessen to briefly reach speeds of 120 km/h. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower
column2: 此变体型号移除了中型脉冲激光、iNarc发射器和TAG系统. 取而代之的是一台C3主控计算机、短管PPC和小型脉冲激光.增程PPC得以保留. MASC系统使这台Tessen机甲能短暂达到120公里/小时的速度. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: A strange one-off refit of a MSK-11-2A, the MSK-11-L10-JON, eschews nearly all staying power in favor of unleashing an unholy amount of rockets at the enemy, preferably from an ambush position. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: MSK-11-L10-JON是对MSK-11-2A进行的一次奇特的一次性改装，它舍弃了几乎全部的持续作战能力，转而从伏击位置向敌人倾泻骇人听闻的火箭弹雨. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

It retains the Small Laser of the standard UrbanMech as well. 改进型跳跃推进器 help the UrbanMech move around the city it defends more effectively. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

A 轻型 主动探头 enhances battlefield awareness, enabling it to flush out hidden foes before pouncing. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
