column1: One of the more unusual configurations, the Crossbow T mounts one Extended Large Laser, one Improved One-Shot SRM-6 launcher and seven Improved One-Shot SRM 2 launchers in each arm. This still leaves room for an extra Heat Sink in each side torso and a 轻型 主动探头 in the center torso. Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 短程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为较不常见的配置之一，“十字弩（Crossbow）”T型在每只手臂上各安装了一门大型增程激光、一具改进型单发SRM-6发射器和七具改进型单发SRM-2发射器，这仍为两侧躯干各留出了额外安装一部散热器的空间，并在中央躯干安装了一部轻型主动探测器. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Manufactured by 氏族钻石鲨 from 3065 on after they acquired the 设计 specifications from the Vipers, the IIC 4 mounts four CC ATM 9s along with seven tons of ammunition, giving it flexible long and short-range firepower. Ten double heat sinks still require care on the pilot's part. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.18
column2: 由钻石鲨氏族在3065年后从蝰蛇氏族获得设计规格后制造，IIC 4搭载四门CC ATM 9，并配备七吨弹药，使其拥有灵活的长短程火力. 十具双散热器仍需机师谨慎管理热量. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.18

column1: 德拉科尼斯联合体的安菲吉亚轻型突击集群以高度机动著称，它们通过移除跳跃推进器来升级引擎。 Quirk: 精准武器 - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 以其高机动性著称，天龙联合体的两栖轻型突击大队通过移除跳跃喷口来升级引擎. 特质: 精准武器 - PPC 部署费用倍率: 0.98

column1: A 55 ton 全向Mech that blends a lethal cocktail of speed and firepower, the Stormcrow is a common sight in many clan Toumans. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of an Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Stormcrow has 19 tons of pod space available. The Stormcrow K is armed with a Gauss Rifle and 4 Improved Heavy 中型激光s. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 作为一台把速度与火力调成致命鸡尾酒的55吨全方位机甲，暴风鸦在许多氏族图曼中都司空见惯。暴风鸦由一具330级XL引擎驱动，以底层钢底盘与铁纤装甲的组合建造，拥有19吨可用吊舱空间。暴风鸦P武装为成对的增程大型激光器和连发SRM-6。三兄弟中型脉冲激光器补全了该改型。

column1: Tropical biomes increase heat sinking efficiency by 10% due to moisture clinging to exhaust vents. The pouring rain helps sinking an additional 12 heat per turn, but decreases visibility to 80% and sensor efficiency to 90%.VTOL units have -1 evasion. All units have +1 Defense. The wet ground increases move and sprint cost by 10% for all non-hover land units.
column2: 热带环境因排气口附着湿气，散热效率提升 10%. 倾盆大雨每回合额外散去 12 点热量，但能见度降至 80%，传感器效能降至 90%. 垂直起降飞行器单位闪避 -1. 所有单位获得 +1 防御. 湿滑地面使所有非悬浮地面单位的移动与冲刺消耗增加 10%.

column1: A Bondsman was a prisoner taken during combat by a Clan, of any caste or rank, who was held as an indentured servant. Bondsmen were bound by tradition, rather than chains, to work dutifully for their new masters. For a bondsman to purposefully neglect their responsibilities or even attempt escape stained not just their personal honor but the honor of their original Clan. Typically, a bondsman would either be released from their bond and sent back home, with little honor lost, or after a given period of time, be adopted and become a free, full member of their new Clan. When and whether an individual was released from their servitude varied between Clans and individuals: some only spent a token amount of time before being freed from their bondscord, while others would live out the rest of their lives as bondsmen.
column2: 俘虏是指在战斗中氏族捕获的囚犯，不论其种姓或军衔如何，都会被当作契约仆役关押. 俘虏受传统约束，而非锁链，必须为他们的新主人勤勉工作. 如果俘虏故意玩忽职守甚至试图逃跑，不仅会玷污其个人荣誉，也会玷污其原属氏族的荣誉. 通常，俘虏要么被解除束缚送回故乡，荣誉损失甚微; 要么在特定时期后被接纳，成为新氏族的自由正式成员. 个人何时以及是否被解除劳役，因氏族和个体而异: 有些人只度过象征性的短暂时间便被释放，而另一些人则会终其一生作为俘虏.

column1: The Republic invested into rebuilding the Kallon facility on Nanking with the express purpose of ensuring a flow of Wolverines into the RAF. The WVR-10R’s internal layout marks it as an evolution from older variants, but it is significantly more mobile, has excellent protection, and carries traditionally solid weaponry. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 共和国投入资金重建南卡洲的卡隆工厂，其明确目的就是确保护卫军能够持续获得狼獾机甲. WVR-10R的内部布局表明它是从早期型号进化而来，但机动性显著提升，防护能力出色，并且搭载了传统而可靠的武器装备. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: This 2954 variant downgrades to an LRM-10 with two tons of ammo. The space left over is filled two forward facing medium lasers and two machine guns in each side. The Hunter Light Support Tank is popular with planetary militias and second-line units. It was designed by 迪法恩斯工业 as a cheap, reliable and effective combat vehicle to provide covering fire support for combat units withdrawing from the front lines. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 20 Left 120 20 Right 120 20 Rear 80 20 Total 500 80 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹
column2: 这个2954年的变体降级为LRM-10  配备两吨弹药. 剩余空间填充了两门前向中型激光和每侧两挺机枪. Hunter轻型支援坦克在行星民兵和二线部队中很受欢迎. 它由Defiance Industries设计  作为一种廉价、可靠且有效的战斗车辆  为从前线撤退的战斗单位提供掩护火力支援. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 5/8格 / 150/240米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 180 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 80 20 总计 500 80 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 #武器: 1x LRM-10 2x 中型激光 2x 双联机枪 1x 火焰喷射器

column1: This custom variant was used by Lieutenant Colonel Anne-Marie McKormack during the conflict on Atreus. Based on the EMP-6M, the Mercury Elite mounted a C3 Slave in the head and a 短管PPC and 银弹高斯 Rifle in each arm. Adding an extra double heat sink helps diffuse the heat load these weapons and the two torso-mounted 中型脉冲激光s create. Unlike the EMP-6M this version doesn't mount 三重肌纤维束. Quirk: 改良冷却套-激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这种定制改型由安妮-玛丽·麦科马克中校在阿特柔斯星冲突期间使用. 以 EMP-6M 为基础，Mercury Elite 在头部安装了一台C3从机，每只手臂各装有一门短管粒子加农炮和一挺银弹高斯步枪. 额外增加一个双重散热器有助于分散这些武器与两具躯干安装的中型脉冲激光所产生的热量. 与 EMP-6M 不同的是，该型号未安装三重肌纤维束. 特质: 改良冷却套 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: A Star League era fire support platform, the 长bow is an 85 ton Assault 机甲 and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence. The LGB-8V is armed with a pair of Arrow IV’s, supported by a pair of 中型脉冲激光s and an ER Large Laser. A 255-rated XL Engine, DHS and 14.5 tons of armor round out the design. Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 长弓是星际联盟时代的火力支援平台，这款85吨的突击型机甲是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一. LGB-8V型配备了两具箭IV导弹发射器，辅以两门中型脉冲激光和一门大型增程激光. 255引擎等级的超轻型引擎、双层散热系统和14.5吨装甲构成了完整的设计方案. 特质: 对空索敌 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Sumire reports a call for help from a nearby ship. "It's another ship that's contracted the Periphery Pox ."\\n\\nDarius begins to speak, but Dr. Murad cuts him off. "I know what our XO will say." She continues in a perfect imitation of Darius, "We went to the trouble of developing this serum, let's make back some of that investment!"\\n\\nWith a smile, Darius plays along. "Speaking for our dear Dr. Murad, we've suffered from the Pox ourselves. Let's give away our serum, and maybe the locals will smile at us afterward."\\n\\nDr. Murad finishes with, "If we do sell the serum, I think we could easily get ¢80k."
column2: 堇报告附近一艘船只发出求救信号。 “这是另一艘感染了外围痘的船。”\\n\\nDarius 开始说话，但 Murad 博士打断了他。 “我知道我们的 XO 会说什么。”她完美地模仿了大流士，继续说道：“我们不辞辛劳地开发了这种血清，让我们收回一些投资吧！”\\n\\n大流士面带微笑，配合着。 “代表我们亲爱的 Murad 博士发言，我们自己也曾患过痘病。让我们捐出我们的血清，也许之后当地人会对我们微笑。”\\n\\nDr. Murad Murad 最后说道：“如果我们出售血清，我认为我们可以轻松获得 ￠80k。”

column1: Developed by Iroquois Machinery in the mid 3140s, the Broadside is an unusual offering from a company better known for being a major manufacturer of industrial mechs. A 100 ton mech powered by a 300 rated fusion engine, the Broadside is a rapidly proliferating sigh in the increasingly strained ranks of the AFFS. Heavily armed with a myriad of weapons, the Broadsword BS-1D is armed with an LB10-X AC, a UAC/10 and a RAC/5. For secondary armament, it carries a pair of ER 中型激光s, a Flamer and a pair of Re-engineered 中型激光s. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 由易洛魁机械在3140年代中期开发的Broadside，是一家主要以工业机甲制造商而闻名的公司推出的非典型产品. 作为一台由300额定聚变引擎驱动的100吨级机甲，Broadside在日益紧张的AFFS队伍中是一种迅速扩散的景象. Broadsword BS-1D装备了大量武器，包括一门LB 10-X霰弹炮、一门UAC/10和一门RAC/5. 副武器方面，它携带了一对中型增程激光、一把火焰喷射器和一对重构中型激光. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Mikasi B configuration is a flexible fire support unit, boasting four iATM-6 launchers with ample ammunition and strong heat management, making it highly adaptable and effective at various ranges. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mikasi B型是一种灵活的火力支援单位，配备四具iATM-6发射器，弹药充足且散热能力强大，使其在不同距离下都具备高度适应性与有效性. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 长程 部署费用倍率: 1.05 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: Over a third of the Mandrill's tonnage is devoted to a pair of LRM-20 launchers and their attendant ammunition, which is limited, but usually enough for duels. The head-mounted ER small laser is something of an afterthought, though it does allow Mandrills to keep fighting after they run out of ammo. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 山魈超过三分之一的吨位都用于搭载两具LRM-20发射器及其配套弹药，虽说备弹有限，但在决斗中通常够用. 头部安装的小型增程激光更像是个事后补充的设计，不过至少能让山魈在弹药耗尽后继续作战. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.03

column1: Used by Major Herman Manes of the XIV Hastati Sentinels, this variant of the Lament carries a Clan spec ER PPC in each arm, backed up by an Improved Heavy 中型激光 in each side torso. Heat is dissipated by nineteen Clan spec 双散热器. It uses a 紧凑型陀螺仪 for balance, and a C3 slave to share targeting information. Quirk: 可变射程瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由第十四长枪哨兵团的赫尔曼·马内斯少校所驾驶的这款哀叹变体，每只手臂各装有一门氏族规格的增程粒子加农炮，左右躯干部各配备一门改进型中型重激光作为辅助武装. 机体通过十九具氏族规格双联散热器进行热量管理，采用紧凑型陀螺仪维持平衡，并搭载C3从机实现目标数据共享. 特质: 变距瞄准系统 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Skadi is a Fast Attack VTOL. It can reach a top speed of 162 km/h, and is protected by four and a half tons of Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous 装甲. The Skadi was originally 设计ed by 玉鹰氏族, but the main factory fell to the Lyran Commonwealth. For the next few decades, the Commonwealth sold the Skadi to any interested party. The combination of good protection, high speed, and a heavy gun proved to be very popular, and the Skadi was exported across the Inner Sphere. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. This right here is a Lyran model, with the oversized bomb rack hanging below the nose. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 125 18 左侧 100 18 右侧 100 18 后方 90 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 430 90 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics
column2: Skadi是一种快速攻击VTOL. 它的最高速度可达162公里/小时  并受到四吨半的氏族规格铁纤维装甲保护. Skadi最初由翡翠猎鹰氏族设计  但主要工厂落入了天琴共同体手中. 在接下来的几十年里  联邦将Skadi出售给任何感兴趣的方. 良好的防护、高速度和重型火炮的组合非常受欢迎  Skadi被出口到内天体各地. 猎鹰氏族后来重新夺回了该设施  并将Skadi限制在自己的部队中. 这里的这个是天琴型号  机鼻下方悬挂着超大型炸弹架. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境中部署. 移动: 10/15格 / 300/450米. 装甲: 铁纤维(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 125 18 左侧 100 18 右侧 100 18 后方 90 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 430 90 特质: 精准武器 - 弹道 #武器: 1x UAC/10(氏族) 2x 小型增程激光(氏族) 1x 集束炸弹x5[翼挂]

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth K is armed with a pair of Heavy 中型激光s, a pair of 轻型 机枪 Arrays and a pair of B-Pods. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 这款重20吨的火蚁机甲由200功率超轻型引擎驱动，并搭载了MASC系统，是有史以来速度最快的机甲之一. 专为侦察任务和充当元素装甲运输平台而设计的火蚁于2874年投入量产. 铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合为其提供了7.5吨的武器吊舱空间. 火蚁K型配备两门中型重激光、两组轻机枪阵列及两具B型荚舱. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.98

column1:
David "Grol" Avellar became the 13th President of the Outworlds Alliance after his mother, Allyce Avellar was forced to step down. Both a skillful politician and mechwarrior, he assumed the presidency during a tumultuous period for the Outworlds Alliance. He personally fought in several campaigns to resist the invasions of both the New Delphi Compact and Clan Ghost Bear. 

During the Ghost Bear invasion Avellar was mortally wounded, only surviving due to an experimental nanomachine treatment engineered by ComStar. The treatment left him heavily disfigured, only regaining his former appearance after undergoing advanced facial reconstruction supplied by 雪鸦氏族. 

The years of conflict took their toll on Avellar's psyche, and after being indoctrinated by a Snow Raven psyops program he developed unstable personality traits. He ultimately led a doomed campaign against Clan Wolf to seize Terra, leading former ally Kurita to break their alliance and attack Avellar's forces. Avellar then turned his ire on his former allies, wreaking a swath of destruction through Kuritan space before ultimately being stopped one jump short of the Draconis Combine capital of Luthien. After these failed campaigns he disappeared, with 雪鸦氏族 taking control of former Outworlds Alliance territory. His ultimate fate is still unknown.

column1: Used by Sang-shao Carson Rieves during the invasion of Liao in 3134, this 'Mech carried an entirely new weapons load. A Gauss rifle was mounted in each side torso, while each arm carried a light PPC and two ER medium lasers. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 在3134年入侵廖氏期间，桑绍·卡森·里夫斯使用了这台机甲，它搭载了一套全新的武器配置. 每个侧躯干各安装了一门高斯步枪，而每条手臂则携带一门轻型PPC和两门中型增程激光. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Angst Clear View 1A was 设计ed for the Solaris Market. Each Clear View 1A system had to be painstakingly calibrated to the Pilot's Neurohelm. Coupled with a movement prediction algorithm, it allowed the '机甲 to engage in lightning fast strikes without telegraphing the intent of the Pilot, closing the Enemies' dodging window by around half.
column2: 【FCS Berserker】Angst清晰视野1A型是为索拉里斯市场设计的. 每套清晰视野1A系统都必须经过精心校准，以匹配机师的神经头盔. 结合一套移动预测算法，它能使机甲发动闪电般的快速打击，而不会暴露机师的意图，将敌人的闪避窗口缩短了大约一半.

column1: FS9-K 最初设计为火焰使者 FS9-H 的搭档型号，如今已凭自身实力广受欢迎——大型激光赋予 FS9-K 其搭档所缺乏的射程。 Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: FS9-H的战场改装型，以移除一门中型激光为代价安装了一套C3从属装置. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: By 2890 the world was marked as associated with the short lived "Duchy of Don't", though by 3022 it was no longer in the maps
column2: 到2890年，该星球被标记为与短命的“Duchy of Don't”有关联，尽管到3022年它已不再出现在地图上.

column1: M12 由于改装机甲载荷难度较大而较为罕见。这一基于 M11 的变体移除两台散热器和两吨弹药，把 C3 单元换成一台 C3 计算机。 Quirk: 模块化武器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台机甲似乎在驾驶舱内安装了一个老式电话亭，上面写着“打电话回家”. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Intended to serve as a medium assault unit, the Hydra carries heavy armor and a decent weapon suite. A 3067 design, this variant was designed as a fire support ProtoMech. It is solely armed with a single torso-mounted LRM-6 Launcher. Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 旨在作为中型突击单位，Hydra 拥有厚重的装甲和一套不俗的武器配置. 这款3067年设计的变体被设计为火力支援型原型机甲，仅配备了一具躯干安装的LRM-6发射器. 特质: 准确武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 0.99

column1: Dragoon是为狼之龙第七突击队构想的更重、更灵活战斗装甲。相比常见渗透服，Dragoon提供了更强防护和更高适应性。它最初旨在为战斗工程师的高风险渗透行动提供一定战场保护，同时融入轻型战斗服所具备的行动便利。 Quirk: 简易操控 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 雷电 II 系列是基于标准雷电改进而来，其装甲被替换为反射装甲. 特质: 设计精良 部署费用倍率: 0.888 可挂载于万能单位，可以进行近战攻击，可以进行攀附攻击.

column1: This variant uses an XXL Engine to allow the chassis to carry an ER PPC and Talons. It's frequently seen with 地狱马 Mongol warriors. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 该变体使用XXL引擎，使机体能够携带一门增程粒子加农炮和利爪，常见于地狱战马氏族的蒙古战士. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: The Personal 'Mech of Kell Hounds commander Morgan Kell, during the 氏族入侵 he had his stock ARC-2R model upgraded with recovered Star League and salvaged Clan systems. Using Clan-grade LRM-20s and 双散热器 freed up weight for more armor, more LRM ammunition, Artemis IV, CASE and a Clan 主动探头 in the head to enhance it's command abilities. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
column2: 这是凯尔猎犬指挥官摩根·凯尔的专属机甲. 氏族入侵期间，他利用回收的星际联盟设备和缴获的氏族科技，对原本标配的ARC-2R型号进行了升级改造. 采用氏族规格的LRM-20导弹发射器和双散热器后，节省的重量得以用来增加装甲、LRM弹药储备，并加装了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统、CASE防护系统以及安装在头部的氏族主动探测器，从而强化了其指挥作战能力. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.12

column1: In an effort to revive sales in the late 3130s, OstCorp's subsidiaries introduced an advanced—and considerably more expensive—update to the Ostrichmech line. Drawing inspiration from the OST-R2 rather than the original OST-R, the newly released OST-RS incorporates the same sophisticated internal structure and compact subsystems, as well as Ferro-Fibrous armor. Marketed as an ultralight skirmisher, the OST-RS is beginning to find traction among smaller forces seeking fast, budget-conscious combat units. Though it sacrifices some of the OST-R2's speed, it retains respectable mobility and improves firepower with twin MML-3 launchers. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 为了在3130年代末重振销量，奥斯特公司旗下子公司为鸵鸟机甲系列推出了先进——且价格更为高昂——的升级型号. 汲取了OST-R2而非初代OST-R的设计灵感，新发布的OST-RS融合了同样精密的内构与紧凑子系统，并采用了铁纤维装甲. 作为一款超轻型游击机甲推向市场，OST-RS开始在那些寻求快速、注重成本作战单位的小型部队中获得认可. 尽管牺牲了OST-R2的部分速度，它仍保持了可观的机动性，并通过双联装MML-3导弹发射器提升了火力. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 0.99 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1:
在矿业行星 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上，采购和分拣大量机甲维修补给是全船出动的大事。

与达里乌斯商谈时，你听到几名机甲战士在讨论当地矿工和机工经营的地下斗殴场。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 大声说："让这些乡下人看看真正的战士怎么打！"

达里乌斯朝你挑了挑眉，仿佛在说："你来处理？"

当你走向那些机甲战士时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 挑衅地挺起 {TGT_MW.Det} 肩膀，仿佛在激你禁止这项娱乐。
column2: 不还清{TGT_MW.Callsign}的债务就离开{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.

column1: The Striker Light Tank started out as a joint project venture between Valiant Systems and Wunderland Enterprises on the world of Johnsondale. They united in their efforts to create a joint company known as Valiant Vehicles, with the Striker being their first product. The low cost light fire support tank became a mainstay of the AFFS after its introduction in the first decade of the thirty-first century, and orders for the Striker soon outstripped the Valiant production line's capacity. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 20 Left 100 20 Right 100 20 Rear 90 20 Turret 125 20 Total 555 100 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹

column1: Based upon the 4WA from Arc-Royal MechWorks is this version made to order to incorporate a Chameleon Light Polarization Suite to bring its Capacitor enhanced PPCs close enough for a deadly precision strike. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 基于亚克皇家机甲工坊的4WA型，此版本按需定制，整合了一套变色龙轻型偏振套件，使其电容器增强的粒子加农炮能够抵近到足以发动致命精准打击的距离. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight Engine. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a 中型激光 in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 双散热器, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle. Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 丹妮尔·彼得森的“漂亮宝贝”英雄机甲——‘Awesome’型号，拥有出人意料的速度，这得益于其搭载的340-rated超轻型引擎. 这台漂亮宝贝（序列号AWS8V99TG-2957）还配备了一套独特的武器配置——右臂装有一门标准PPC，右躯装有一具LRM-15，头部装有一门中型激光，左躯装有一门大型激光，左臂装有一具SRM-4. 19具双散热器、两吨LRM弹药和三吨SRM弹药，让它能在激烈的战斗中持续作战. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: The Hypervelocity Autocannon (HVAC) family of weapons is based on the Autocannon. While they have the same damage classes, they're capable of firing much further. Once members of the Society discovered the use of these weapons in the Inner Sphere, they immediate developed and proposed their own prototypes to Clan leadership. While rejected by the Khans, HVAC (S) cannons were found amongst the Society 'Mechs and vehicles used during the Wars of Reaving. \n\n Uses HVAC20 Ammo.
column2: 超高速自动炮(HVAC)武器家族以自动炮为基础. 虽然它们具有相同的伤害等级，但射程更远. 当秘社的成员发现内天体在使用这些武器时，他们立即开发并向氏族领导层提出了自己的原型. 尽管被可汗们否决，但HVAC加农炮仍然在焚风战争期间使用的秘社机甲和车辆中被发现.\n\n 使用HVAC20弹药.

column1: The Musketeer hover tank is a combat vehicle designed to deliver concentrated firepower quickly and cheaply. The hovertank is as difficult to kill as a hover vehicle can be, with seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor protecting it, and CASE protecting its four-person crew from internal explosions. An internal combustion engine is inexpensive and can still maintain speeds up to 119 km/h. This variant developed in 3068 replaces the autocannon with a smaller RAC/2. The loss of firepower nonetheless enabled engineers to add additional armor, making the Musketeer even more difficult to bring down. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. 装甲： Ferro-Fibrous 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 220 25 左侧 170 25 右侧 170 25 后方 140 25 炮塔 185 25 总计 885 125 特性：精准武器—弹道
column2: Musketeer气垫坦克是一种战斗载具  设计用于快速且经济地投送集中火力. 该气垫坦克在气垫载具中已属难以击毁  有七吨铁纤维装甲保护  并有CASE保护其四人乘员免受内部爆炸伤害. 内燃机价格低廉  仍能保持最高119公里/小时的速度. 这种3068年开发的改型用较小的RAC/2替换了自动炮. 火力的损失却使工程师能够增加额外装甲  使Musketeer更难被击倒. 环境限制: 由于使用内燃机  该单位无法部署在月球或火星环境. 移动: 7/11格 / 210/330米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 220 25 左侧 170 25 右侧 170 25 后方 140 25 炮塔 185 25 总计 885 125 特质: 精准武器 - 弹道 #武器: 1x TAG 1x RAC/2 2x 斯特里克SRM-2

column1: This is a production variant based on the AXM-6X. This version, introduced in 3083, uses an Inner Sphere–produced XL engine and lacks the supercharger of the 6X. The top speed of the 6T is 86 km/h. The armor protection and weapon configuration are identical to the Axman 6X, but the Thunderbolt launchers have two tons of ammunition each. It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. 特性：近战驱动器 部署成本倍率：1.09
column2: 这是基于AXM-6X的量产变体型号. 该型号于3083年推出，采用内天体生产的XL引擎，并移除了6X的增压器. 6T型的最高时速为86公里. 其装甲防护与武器配置与Axman 6X完全相同，但雷霆导弹发射器各配有两吨弹药. 这也是唯一没有搭载其标志性近战武器的Axman型号. 特质: 近战驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: RISC engineers have turned this model into a close range brawling specialist mounting a Snubnose PPC in each arm along with a massive Rotary AC/20 Autocannon. Mobility is enhanced by the inclusion of three improved jump jets.
column2: RISC 工程师将该模型变成了近距离格斗专家，在每只手臂上安装了 Snubnose PPC 以及大型旋转 AC/20 自动炮。三个改进的跳跃喷气机增强了机动性。

column2: Novaya Zemlya有着一个不光彩的殊荣: 它是第一个遭到战舰轰击的有人居住星球. 由此引发的轰炸杀死了该星球四分之三的人口，摧毁了几乎所有城市和行星基础设施，并毒化了农田. 少数幸存者随后不得不应对因抛入该星球高层大气的尘埃和碎片而造成的“核冬天”. 恒星联邦目前正向该星球投入大量资源.

column1: Built by the same company that made the Saracen and Scimitar, the Saladin was Scarborough's last medium hover tank. It is unlike its brothers in that the Saladin does not mount a turret, and its only weapon is a heavy, short-range AC/20. Since it's vastly different from the company's other hovercraft, buyers were quite skeptical about purchasing it; Scarborough had to offer incentives like free training and transportation. Soon it became as cheap as the Saracen and spread throughout the whole Inner Sphere. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动：8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲： Light Ferro 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 120 20 左侧 90 20 右侧 90 20 后方 60 20 总计 360 80 特性：突破一击
column2: 萨拉丁由制造萨拉森和弯刀的同一家公司出品，是斯卡伯勒最后一款中型悬浮坦克。它与其他兄弟型号不同——萨拉丁没有炮塔，唯一的武器是一门重型近程AC/20。由于与该公司其他悬浮车差异极大，买家对采购颇有疑虑；斯卡伯勒不得不提供免费培训与运输等优惠。不久它便与萨拉森一样便宜，并传遍整个内层星域。生态限制：该单位使用内燃机，无法部署在月球或火星生态区。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 110 20 左侧 50 20 右侧 50 20 后方 50 20 总计 260 80 特性：坚固

column1: This is a production variant based on the AXM-6X. This version, introduced in 3083, uses an Inner Sphere–produced XL engine and lacks the supercharger of the 6X. The top speed of the 6T is 86 km/h. The armor protection and weapon configuration are identical to the Axman 6X, but the Thunderbolt launchers have two tons of ammunition each. It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. Instead, this carries a handheld 锁定式SRM-6 launcher. 特性：精准武器 - 手持 部署成本倍率：1.09
column2: 这是基于AXM-6X开发的一款量产型号. 该版本于3083年推出，采用内天体生产的超轻型引擎，但移除了6X型的增压器. 6T型的最高时速为86公里，装甲防护与武器配置与6X型完全相同，不过其雷霆导弹发射器各备有两吨弹药. 值得注意的是，这是唯一未配备标志性近战武器的战斧型号. 取而代之的是手持式锁定式SRM-6型导弹发射器. 特质: 精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: Rackam's ragtag crew of pirates arrive with little fanfare. As Yang escorts them to the Mech Bay, they stare in awe at the Argo.\\n\\nRackam limps over. "You've got a very interesting bird here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Do I get a tour?"\\n\\n"Of course. I only wish I could provide more support from the Mech Bay." Gesturing broadly as you make your way deeper into the ship, "Even with all of this, there's one thing that hasn't changed. It's the 'Mechs that make the money."
column2: 拉卡姆的一群乌合之众海盗悄然抵达。当杨护送他们前往机甲湾时，他们敬畏地盯着 Argo。\\n\\n拉卡姆一瘸一拐地走了过来。 “这里有一只非常有趣的鸟，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我可以参观吗？”\\n\\n“当然。我只希望我能从机甲湾提供更多支持。”当你深入飞船时，你做了一个大手势，“即使发生了这一切，有一件事没有改变。那就是‘赚钱的机甲’。”

column1: This marvel of engineering has been violated in so many ways. I cannot begin to decipher what its been through. And no, the fake magazine attached to its underside cannot be removed. It is somehow integrated into the containment field that keeps this thing from blowing up when fired. VOLATILE!
column2: 【ER PPC (P)】这件工程奇迹已经被以各种方式改造得面目全非. 我根本无法想象它到底经历了什么. 还有，不，安装在它底部的假弹匣无法拆除. 它不知为何已经整合进了约束场系统中，而这个系统正是防止这东西在开火时发生爆炸的关键. 易爆！

column1: 你的门被敲响了。你抬头一看，达吕斯正站在敞开的门口，身边还跟着一位衣着得体的女士。“达吕斯，进来吧。我猜这位就是来自栖息地无限！的代表吧？” 达吕斯和他的同伴走进你的办公室，“正是。{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官，请允许我向您介绍贝里克斯女士。” 你从桌后站起身，伸出手说道：“很高兴见到你，贝里克斯女士，你可以叫我{COMMANDER.FirstName}。” 贝里克斯女士握了握你的手，“请叫我伊泽尔达就好，我也很高兴见到您。” 达吕斯递给你一台记事本，“这是升级贝塔舱的报价，完成后我们连队可额外容纳最多八名机甲战士。我们有三种方案可选，我……” 你抬手示意道：“谢谢你，达吕斯，不过如果你不介意的话，我想听听伊泽尔达的建议。” 达吕斯收住话头，示意伊泽尔达来说。“嗯，{COMMANDER.FirstName}，正如达吕斯已指出的，您会在这里看到升级阿尔戈号 贝塔舱的三种方案： 方案1 - 拒绝报价。 您仅需承担我此行的开销10，000星币； 方案2 - 省钱套餐。 栖息地无限！的省钱套餐专为预算极度紧张的公司量身打造。因此，成本大幅降低，但可能存在设计或安装方面的问题； 方案3 - 标准套餐。 标准套餐包含多数便利设施，其价格也反映出我们的施工质量。虽说我们不敢保证绝对完美，但据我们所知，至今尚未有客户反馈过任何问题； 方案4 - 尊享套餐。 这是精工安装与质量管控的极致。所有环节均经由人工三重检查，并辅以热成像、磁力与声纳结构完整性扫描。” 达吕斯看向你，"您的决定是什么，指挥官？"
column2: 指挥官{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}，希望之光.”不得不说，这称号听起来真不错.

column1: The Spectre 战斗装甲 was developed and fielded by Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. It has got its name from the stealth armor that protects it. This armor, while good at hiding it from enemy sensors, fares very poorly when under fire. The Spectre is pretty quick for a humanoid 战斗装甲, but its Mechanical 跳跃放大器 is not a true replacement for regular Jump Jets. Magnetic clamps adapted from the Fa Shih 战斗装甲 allow the Spectre to be carried into battle. While its armament gives it better combat ability than some early stealth suits, it still cannot stand up to larger battle armor like the Elemental or Kanazuchi. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：0.8875 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由保护国武器集团开发并部署. 它的名字源于为其提供防护的潜行装甲. 这种装甲虽擅长隐匿于敌方传感器之外，但在遭受火力攻击时表现极差. 对于人形战斗装甲而言，幽灵的速度相当快，但其机械跳跃助推器并不能真正替代常规跳跃喷气器. 从法希战斗装甲改装的磁性夹具使幽灵能被携带投入战斗. 尽管它的武装使其战斗能力优于一些早期潜行服，但仍无法与元素或金刚津等大型战斗装甲相抗衡. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 0.8875 可以搭载任何单位，可以进行近战，可以攀附攻击.

column1: Packing advanced electronics, this configuration mounts a Watchdog CEWS in the left torso along with a targeting computer in the right, giving the '机甲 a technological edge on the battlefield. Linked to the targeting computer is an ER large laser in the right torso and a trio of ER medium lasers spread across the right arm and both side torsos. In addition, the '机甲 carries a flamer in the right arm, along with four extra double heat sinks that are just about sufficient to handle the load from its weapons. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 该配置搭载先进电子设备，左躯干标配Watchdog CEWS，右躯干配备目标计算机，赋予机甲战场技术优势. 与目标计算机相连的武器包括右躯干的大型增程激光及分布于右臂与双侧躯干的三门中型增程激光. 此外，右臂还装备一具火焰喷射器，并额外加装四个双散热器，恰好能应对全部武器的火力负荷. 特质: 扰敌 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: This Nova Cat configuration was introduced during the Republic's height. It carries an LB 20-X, 中型脉冲激光, and two 改进的 Heavy Large Lasers. Nineteen double heat sinks are partnered with three Coolant Pods to keep the heat under control, and an engine Supercharger allows this configuration to reach 86 km/h in brief spurts. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这种新星猫配置是在共和国鼎盛时期推出的. 它搭载了一门LB 20-X、一门中型脉冲激光和两门改良型大型重激光. 十九个双重散热器与三个冷却剂罐配合使用，以控制热量，而引擎增压器使这种配置能够短暂冲刺到86公里/小时的速度. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Bailey armored car is a Gienah Automotive-produced civilian security vehicle first marketed in the mid-thirty-first century. The company exploited recovered Star League technology to enhance vehicle performance. The Bailey was designed to cope with battle armor-equipped infantry, which had steadily become more common. Aside for transporting high-value cargo, it can be used as makeshift armor infantry transport. The Bailey was designed to resist battle armor because of a daring raid that saw several robbers using 灰死标准型 battle armor to open a Knox armored car carrying payroll. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 80 15 左侧 55 15 右侧 55 15 后方 55 15 炮塔 50 15 总计 295 75 特性：坚固 Can carry 2 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Bailey装甲车是Gienah Automotive生产的民用安全车辆  于31世纪中期首次上市. 该公司利用回收的星际联盟技术来提升车辆性能. Bailey的设计是为了应对装备战斗装甲的步兵  这种步兵已逐渐变得更加常见. 除了运输高价值货物外  它还可以用作临时装甲步兵运输车. Bailey的设计是为了抵抗战斗装甲  因为一次大胆的突袭中  几名劫匪使用Gray Death Standard战斗装甲打开了一辆载有工资的Knox装甲车. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 6/9格 / 180/270米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 80 15 左侧 55 15 右侧 55 15 后方 55 15 炮塔 50 15 总计 295 75 特质: 坚固 可搭载2个战斗装甲小队. 有射击孔. #武器: 1x AMS 2x 小型脉冲激光

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The A variant was geared for general combat. 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 由雪鸦氏族开发的迪莫斯机甲首次亮相于3060年代中期，据称是在科伦斯基星团的卢姆星球上. 然而，在圣战期间，内天体情报机构不再听到有关该机甲的传言，它逐渐淡出了人们的记忆. 3085年，雪鸦氏族向内天体揭示了迪莫斯的存在. 它被视为氏族的骄傲，至少每个星域部队都配备了一台. A型衍生型被设计用于通用作战. 特质: 对空瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL Engine and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth R is armed with a pair of Improved Heavy 中型激光s and a pair of ER Small Lasers. A 中型激光, C3 Slave unit and 守护者ECM round out the Mech. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.98
column2: 由一具200级XL引擎驱动并装有MASC，20吨的火蛾是有史以来最快的机甲之一。火蛾为侦察和元素战士运输而设计，于2874年投产。铁纤与内层钢的组合为火蛾提供了7.5吨吊舱空间。火蛾H武装为9门重型小型激光器。投放成本倍率：0.98。

column1: Not designed for traditional combat, the Carrier is a force multiplier. Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of armor isn't a concern. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: 重型铁纤维装甲 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 30 Left 100 30 Right 100 30 Rear 100 30 Total 400 120 Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 并非为传统战斗而设计  Carrier是力量倍增器. Carrier专为从远处支援友军而设计  可以留在友军战线后方  在那里它缺乏装甲的问题并不令人担忧. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 30 左侧 100 30 右侧 100 30 后方 100 30 总计 400 120 特质: 狭窄/低矮轮廓 #武器: 1x AMS 3x NLRM-15 1x NARC发射器

column1: The D configuration is very similar to the C variant, being equipped with an LB 10-X AC and three Heavy Large Lasers. The extra heat sinks are still overtaxed by the heavy lasers, though a targeting computer does make them more accurate. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D 构型与 C 变体非常相似，装备了一门LB 10-X霰弹炮和三门大型重激光. 额外的散热器仍然难以承受重型激光所产生的热量，不过瞄准计算机确实提高了它们的精度. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: 金太郎 18K 是一台猛兽般的机器。这款库瑞塔改装型依然散热偏热，为每个交战距离都配备了一门轻型 PPC 和死火增强发射器。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 对标准“金太郎（Kintaro）”KTO-19进行了一次简易改装，将其中一门中型激光移至另一侧手臂，以满足那些偏好更均衡武器分布的机甲战士. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Once a site 的 a maj或 Diplass BattleMechs site, the only remnant now 是a Star League era cont在ent spann在g tra在 service. 一种common phrase spoken here 是以 "Take the midnight tra在 go在g Anywhere"
column2: 这里曾是Diplass BattleMechs的一个重要厂址，如今唯一残存的是星际联盟时代横贯大陆的列车服务. 这里常说的一句话是:“搭上午夜列车，去Anywhere.”

column1: The Anand, named for a Terran Goddess that protects the land, is another Prototype of the Morrigan Project. The pilot is protected within a torso-mounted interface cockpit, behind 23 tons of hardened 装甲. The primary configuration carries a Mydron Rotary AC/5 supported by dual snub-nosed PPCs. An "Iron Dome" AMS defends the entire lance, and advanced electronics ensure high accuracy against the toughest opponents. 怪癖: Morrigan C3i 掉落成本乘数: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Anand，以一位守护大地的泰拉女神命名，是Morrigan项目的另一台原型机. 机师被保护在躯干式接口驾驶舱内，由23吨硬化装甲提供防护. 主配置搭载一门Mydron RAC/5，辅以两门短管PPC. 一套“铁穹”反导系统为整个小队提供防御，先进的电子设备确保其对最强劲的敌手也能保持高命中率. 特质: Morrigan C3i 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton 全向Mech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper F is armed with 8 HMG’s and a trio of ER 中型激光s. 特性：瞄准增强—远程 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 蝰蛇于 2940 年推出，是一款 40 吨全能机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅有 8.5 吨吊舱空间可用于武器。蝰蛇由一台 320 额定 XL 引擎驱动，底盘硬接了 8 个跳跃推进器，进一步提升机动性。蝰蛇主型号装备一具 SRM-6 和一对中型脉冲激光。两挺机枪和一套 AMS 填满剩余吊舱空间。投放费用倍率：1.03。

column1: The Gryphon C configuration is optimized for close combat. It features a 150-meter jump range, an ER Small Laser, six 中型脉冲激光s, and twin 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s. An 主动探头 enhances its ability to detect hidden units, making it a formidable threat in tight or urban terrain. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 狮鹫C型配置专为近战优化. 它具备150米跳跃距离，装备一门小型增程激光、六门中型脉冲激光以及两门改进型中型重激光. 主动探测器强化了其侦测隐藏单位的能力，使其在狭窄地形或城市环境中成为强大威慑. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.1 经白羊座游戏与微缩模型授权使用.

column1: Intended to cripple and capture enemy units, the C configuration's principal tool in its mission is a TSEMP磁脉冲炮 found in the left arm. Its offensive weaponry includes a single 短管PPC and a 轻型自动炮/5 found in the other arm. Both arms' lower actuators have been removed to allow the 'Mech the flexibility of flipping its arms. CASE II has been added to the right torso to prevent any ammunition explosion effects from crippling the 'Mech's engine and arm weapons. One additional heat sink is added as well. Quirk: Adv. M.A.S.C. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 旨在瘫痪并俘获敌方单位，C配置型的主要任务核心是左臂搭载的一门TSEMP电磁炮. 其进攻性武器包括另一臂装载的一门短管粒子加农炮与一门轻型UAC/5超级自动炮. 双臂的下驱动器均已拆除，以赋予机甲翻转手臂的灵活作战能力. 右躯干加装了CASE II防爆系统，可防止弹药殉爆波及机甲引擎与手臂武器. 散热系统亦额外增加一具. 特质: 先进M.A.S.C.系统 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Black Earth was intended to be a "hedgehog", a giant fortified firebase that the Rim Worlds Republic  forces could use to slow the advance of any invading force. Black Earth was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Black Earth原本被设想为一座“刺猬”，一个巨大的设防火力基地，边缘世界共和国的部队可用它来迟滞任何入侵部队的推进. Black Earth在共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: The Wraith TR6 is part of the new re-设计ed "Wing" series of variants, increasing the jump range with its integrated partial wing system but at the cost of worse ground speed. The combination of two medium and one large X-Pulse laser makes the variant fully ammunition independent with high accuracy. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 幽灵 TR6 是重新设计的“飞翼”系列改进型号之一，通过集成部分机翼系统延长了跳跃距离，但牺牲了地面速度. 配备两门中型和一门大型 X 射线脉冲激光，使该型号完全不依赖弹药，且命中精度极高. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Faster than the original BD, a new engine powers it to 129 km/h. However, half its jump jets are removed from the 设计. While retaining all the other features of the standard model, the KA's ATM-6 ammunition is given added protection with CASE II. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 比原版BD更快，新引擎使其速度达到129公里/小时. 不过，设计中移除了半数跳跃喷气装置. KA型在保留标准型号所有其他功能的同时，其ATM-6弹药通过采用CASE II系统获得了额外防护. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Kurita 3053 variant drops both SRM 2 packs of the primary variant in order to add two additional 中型激光s plus one Small Laser to the turret. It also is equipped with a C3 unit. Like the TAG variant, this carries 6 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Designed as a fast, cheap, and effective raider, the J.Edgar was the last military vehicle that Alphard Trading Corporation manufactured before they disappeared during the conflagration of the Succession Wars. Unfortunately, the J.Edgar proved quite ineffective and was soon phased out, until Pinard Protectorates Limited licensed the design and began manufacturing new variants. Biome Restrictions: None. column2: Kurita 3053变体放弃了基础型号的两个SRM 2包  以在炮塔上增加两门中型激光和一门小型激光. 它还配备了C3单元. 与TAG变体一样  它携带6吨铁纤维装甲. J.Edgar被设计为一种快速、廉价且有效的袭击者  是Alphard Trading Corporation在继承战争的大火中消失前制造的最后一款军用车辆. 不幸的是  J.Edgar证明相当无效  并很快被淘汰  直到Pinard Protectorates Limited获得该设计的许可并开始制造新变体. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 11/17格 / 330/510米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 175 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 125 15 总计 570 75 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 #武器: 3x 中型激光 1x 小型激光

column1: Daraba means 'To Strike' in Arabic. The Ifrit VTOL Strike Craft was designed to intercept and delay armored advances. Reactive armor, a Jet Booster and AMS increase its chances of getting close enough to deploy its pylon-mounted primary payload. The Daraba is something of an oddity mounting a 重击者加农炮, but this allows it to deploy more minefields than most of it's siblings. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: 反应装甲板 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 20 Left 115 20 Right 115 20 Rear 95 20 Total 500 100 Quirk: 快速起步
column2: Daraba在阿拉伯语中意为“打击”. 伊弗利特垂直起降攻击机旨在拦截并延缓装甲推进. 反应装甲、喷气助推器和AMS增加了它接近到足以部署其挂架主要载荷的机会. Daraba算是个异类  搭载了一门重击者加农炮  但这使它能够部署比大多数同类更多的雷区. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境部署. 移动: 9/14格 / 270/420米. 装甲: 反应装甲板 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 155 20 左侧 115 20 右侧 115 20 后方 95 20 总计 500 100 特质: 起步迅捷 #武器: 1x AMS MK2 1x 重击者加农炮 2x 炼狱炸弹x2[翼挂] 2x 燃烧布雷炸弹[翼挂]

column1: The Schildkröte Line Tank is a Medium sized Combat Vehicle, originally designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's armed forces in 3122. A durable but slow tank, the Schildkröte was not well regarded when it first premiered. Due to this perception of it being too slow for frontline units, the vehicle was distributed among the Commonwealth's lower tier combat formations and planetary militia. However, over time the tank's durability would win over many with its performance in the field. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 255 25 左侧 205 25 右侧 205 25 后方 200 25 炮塔 170 25 总计 1035 125 特性：瞄准增强—远程

column1: Ruby Rhod is a famous host of a 2 hour radio show hosted on and sponsored by the travel company Fhloston Paradise, with over fifty billion people of The Federated Commonwealth's population listening to his show. He has very unorthodox wardrobe and exotic fashion sense. In many ways, he acts in a girlish manner when exposed to combat or is simply annoyed by your presence.
column2: Ruby Rhod 是旅游公司 Fhloston Paradise 主办并赞助的两小时广播节目的著名主持人，联邦联邦人口超过 500 亿人收听他的节目。他有非常非正统的衣柜和异国情调的时尚感。在很多方面，当他遇到战斗时，或者只是因为你的存在而感到恼火时，他的行为举止都像女孩子一样。

column1: Love Urbies? Love those shows with combining mechs? So did some pirates, who kidnapped several Clan superheavy-mech researchers and forced them to create this monstrosity. Built from the frames of 5 Urbanmechs, and fielding even more weaponry, the DevastatUrb is the mech of your UrbieDreams. This variant was introduced as a step between the -R1337 and the -R1337X, being mostly similar to the latter. The major difference is the replacing of Ultra AC/10 in the left arm in favor of a Rotary AC/2. 怪癖: 360° Torso Twist 掉落成本乘数: 1.34 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower
column2: 喜欢城市机甲吗？喜欢那些合体机器人的节目吗？一些海盗就是这么想的，他们绑架了几名氏族超重型机甲研究员，强迫他们制造出了这个怪物. 毁灭者城市机甲由5台城市机甲的骨架拼接而成，搭载了更多武器，是你梦寐以求的城市机甲终极形态. 该型号是-R1337与-R1337X之间的过渡型号，与后者基本类似，主要区别在于左臂的UAC/10超级自动炮被替换成了一门RAC/2转管自动炮. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.34 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: The Executioner A equips the '机甲 with much needed close-range firepower. Three 大型脉冲激光s can inflict excellent damage, and are more accurate, to compensate for any jumping the Executioner A may be doing. Four ER 中型激光s back this up, and this configuration also carries the Machine Guns of the primary configuration. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: A distant, abandoned, cousin of the Particle Projector Cannon, Tesla weapons use an ionizing beam to provide a conduit for an immensely powerful electric charge to strike the target. Tesla weapons deal little physical damage but play havoc with sensors and can have devastating effects on internal components.
column2: 【Tesla Rifle】作为粒子投射加农炮的一种久远且废弃的衍生技术  特斯拉武器使用电离束为极其强大的电荷提供导体  将其释放至目标. 特斯拉武器造成的物理伤害较低  但会严重干扰传感器  并可能对内部组件造成毁灭性影响.

Eventually spreading to other Clans, the 设计 would prove to be a dependable and tough 机甲, with a production line opening in 3000 to meet the Burrocks needs. column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. A C3 Slave allows the HMH-5D to function as part of a C3 enabled Lance, while 改进型跳跃推进器 and TSM give it additional mobility. A 瞄准计算机 improves the accuracy of the RAC/5’s. column1: The Argo drops out of its final jump into the Fröislandis system, deep in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAntiSpinward],anti-spinward]] sector of the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery],Deep Periphery]] past the Cygnus Loop. Sensors immediately begin sweeping the frozen planet below. Marcus Hammerick's face appears on the viewscreen before anyone can speak. His expression is grim. "Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}, the tactical situation is more complex than we anticipated. Joanna has fortified the facility with multiple defensive layers. You'll need to execute a two-phase assault with no pause between operations." "Phase One is breaching the outer perimeter defenses. Joanna has deployed her most fanatical [[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell],Remembrance Cell]] warriors to guard the facility approaches. Elite guards who know the terrain and are prepared to die protecting what they believe is their people's salvation. You must destroy these forces completely to gain access to the inner facility." "Phase Two begins the moment the outer perimeter falls. You will immediately assault the Armageddon production facility itself where the prototype is being held. There is no time to regroup or repair. The moment Joanna realizes her outer defenses have failed, she will deploy the Armageddon mech and throw every remaining warrior at you." "This is a continuous operation. Breach the perimeter, then immediately push into the facility without stopping. If you give Joanna time to prepare, she may escape with the prototype or technical data. You cannot allow that." Sumire pulls up the tactical data. "Frozen world with significant sensor interference. Limited visibility from atmospheric conditions and constant snowfall. And we're conducting two consecutive assaults with no recovery time between them." Darius looks grim. "Boss, this is going to push us past our limits. Two full engagements back to back in terrible conditions against fanatics who believe they're fighting for their survival." Farah reviews the data. "We have Dr. Tilsaye's complete technical specifications. We know the facility layout, the defensive systems, the weapon capabilities. That intelligence advantage matters, but we'll be exhausted by the time we reach the inner facility." Yang checks ammunition reserves. "We'll be running on fumes by the second assault. Better make the first one count." Marcus's expression becomes even more serious, almost haunted. "Commander, now that we are at the point of no return, I need you to understand something. I have acquired a two hundred gigaton nuclear warhead. The only delivery method for a warhead of this magnitude is ramming a DropShip directly into the surface at terminal velocity. I have a vessel prepared for that purpose." Yang's face goes pale. "Two hundred gigaton." Marcus nods with a guilty expression."If it detonates, the blast will consume everything within hundreds of kilometers. The thermal pulse will be visible from orbit. Fröislandis VII's ice caps will flash-boil. The planetary surface will be permanently scarred." "If the conventional assault fails and there is any risk of Joanna escaping with the prototype technology or technical data, I will order that DropShip to ram the facility and detonate on impact." "Everyone at Fröislandis VII dies in that scenario. Myself and all my forces. Your company. Every Remembrance Cell fanatic. Even the Argo if it's anywhere near the surface point of impact. The small research outpost on the planet with innocent researchers. Everything. The planet itself will bear the scars for centuries." "The Armageddon weapon's technology cannot be allowed to survive if we cannot secure it for destruction. I am willing to sacrifice everyone there, including myself, to ensure this weapon does not reach deployment status." "You need to win, Commander. You need to destroy that weapon before I have to make that choice. Because if you fail, I will detonate that warhead. I will kill everyone on that planet, including you and your crew. Win at any cost. There is no other option. Good luck and godspeed, Commander. If this fails, there won't be anyone left to bury the dead." The transmission ends abruptly. Silence fills the command deck. No one moves. No one speaks.
column2: 阿尔戈号 完成最后一次跃迁，脱离跳跃空间，抵达Fröislandis 星系. 这里位于天鹅座环之外，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeepPeriphery]Deep Periphery]]的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAntiSpinward]Anti-Spinward]]区域深处. 传感器立即开始扫描下方那颗冰封行星. 还未等任何人开口，马库斯·哈默里克的脸便出现在主屏幕上. 他的表情十分凝重. “指挥官{COMMANDER.Callsign}，战术情况比我们预想的更加复杂. Joanna已经为设施部署了多层防御. 你们必须执行两阶段突击，行动之间不能有任何停顿.” “第一阶段是突破外围防御. Joanna派出了她最狂热的[[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell]Remembrance Cell]]战士守卫设施入口. 他们是精锐守卫，熟悉当地地形，并且已经做好了为他们认为是族人救赎的目标战死的准备. 你们必须彻底摧毁这些部队，才能进入内部设施.” “第二阶段将在外围防线失守的瞬间开始. 你们必须立即突袭原型机所在的末日生产设施. 没有时间重新集结，也没有时间维修. 一旦Joanna意识到外围防御失败，她就会部署末日机甲，并派出所有剩余战士向你们发动攻击.” “这是一次连续行动. 突破外围，然后立即推进设施内部，不得停留. 如果给Joanna准备时间，她可能会带着原型机或技术数据逃离. 你们不能允许这种情况发生.” 苏米尔调出战术数据.“冰封星球，存在严重传感器干扰. 大气环境和持续降雪导致能见度受限. 而我们要在没有恢复时间的情况下连续进行两场突击.” 达吕斯神情凝重.“老大，这会把我们逼到极限. 在恶劣环境下连续两场完整交战，对手还是一群认为自己正在为生存而战的狂热分子.” 法拉查看数据.“我们拥有Tilsaye博士提供的完整技术规格. 设施布局、防御系统、武器能力，我们都已经掌握. 这份情报优势很重要，但等我们进入内部设施时，体力和装备都会被消耗殆尽.” 杨检查弹药储备.“第二场突击开始时，我们恐怕只能靠残余力量作战. 最好让第一场战斗就决定胜负.” 马库斯的表情变得更加严肃，甚至带着一丝挥之不去的阴影.“指挥官，既然我们已经到了无法回头的时刻，我需要让你明白一件事. 我已经获得了一枚两百亿吨级核弹头. 如此规模的弹头，唯一可行的投送方式，就是让一艘空投艇以终端速度直接撞击地表. 我已经准备好了一艘用于执行这一任务的舰船.” 杨的脸色变得苍白.“两百亿吨……” 马库斯带着愧疚的表情点头.“如果它引爆，爆炸范围将在数百公里内吞噬一切. 热脉冲从轨道上都能清晰可见. Fröislandis VII 的冰盖将瞬间沸腾. 行星表面将留下永久性的伤痕.” “如果常规突击失败，并且Joanna有可能带着原型技术或技术数据逃离，我会命令那艘空投艇撞击设施，并在撞击时引爆.” “在那种情况下，Fröislandis VII 上的所有人都会死亡. 我和我的所有部队. 你们的公司. 所有铭记小组狂热分子. 甚至如果阿尔戈号 距离撞击点足够近，也无法幸免. 还有行星上的小型研究前哨，那些无辜的研究人员. 一切. 这颗行星本身也将在数个世纪里留下伤痕.” “如果我们无法夺取并摧毁末日武器技术，就绝不能让它继续存在. 我愿意牺牲那里的一切，包括我自己，确保这件武器无法进入部署阶段.” “你们必须获胜，指挥官. 你们必须在我做出那个选择之前摧毁那件武器. 因为如果你们失败，我会引爆那枚核弹. 我会杀死那颗星球上的所有人，包括你和你的船员. 不惜一切代价取胜. 没有其他选择. 祝你好运，愿你平安归来，指挥官. 如果这次失败，就不会再有人留下来埋葬死者.” 通讯突然中断. 舰桥陷入寂静. 没有人移动. 没有人说话.

column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>Darius stands just inside the doorway to the command deck, tablet in hand, expression unusually tight.</color>

"Commander," <color=#BFBFBF>he says, voice low.</color> "Farah's been working her contacts, digging into those mystery mechs. Says she's turned something up. Nothing concrete yet, but enough that she wants to talk through it with you directly."

<color=#BFBFBF>He pauses, glancing at the tablet, then back at you.</color>

"She asked for a sit-down, soon. Says some of the details aren't adding up the way they should. And judging by the look on her face... whatever she found, it's not good news."

<color=#BFBFBF>He tucks the tablet under his arm, waiting for your call.</color>

"Your move, Commander."
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>达吕斯站在指挥甲板舱门内侧，手里拿着数据板，表情异常紧绷。</color>

“指挥官，”<color=#BFBFBF>他低声说道。</color>“法拉一直在动用她的关系网，深挖那些神秘机甲的事。她说发现了一些情况。目前还没有具体结论，但足以让她想直接跟您谈谈。”

<color=#BFBFBF>他停顿了一下，瞥了一眼数据板，又看向你。</color>

“她要求尽快当面谈谈。说有些细节对不上号，情况不太对劲。而且从她脸上的表情来看……不管她发现了什么，都不是好消息。”

<color=#BFBFBF>他把数据板夹在腋下，等着你的决定。</color>

“听您的，指挥官。”

column1: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by 氏族地狱马. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. column1: The Ursus II is a well-rounded 'Mech. Its long-range firepower includes an Artemis IV–guided LRM-10 launcher and an ER large laser. As the 'Mech closes in on its target, it can employ its close-range weaponry, which includes two medium pulse lasers, two ER small lasers, and a 锁定式SRM-6 launcher. Both missile launchers are allotted a single ton of ammunition, though both ammo bins are protected by CASE. To manage the 'Mech's potential heat issues, the Ursus II uses 13 double heat sinks. A pilot using the 'Mech must be careful not to overload their heat sinks, having to choose which systems to employ. 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Ursus II是一台性能均衡的机甲. 它的远程火力包括一个配备阿尔忒弥斯IV制导系统的LRM-10导弹发射器和一门大型增程激光. 当机甲接近目标时，可以使用近程武器系统，包括两门中型脉冲激光、两门小型增程激光和一个锁定式SRM-6导弹发射器. 两个导弹发射器各配有一吨弹药，且弹药舱均配有CASE防护系统. 为了应对可能出现的散热问题，Ursus II配备了13个双重散热器. 机师需要谨慎操控，避免散热系统过载，必须根据战场情况合理选择使用的武器系统. 特质: 干扰 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

On a viewscreen over the bar, pictures of a happy couple and the text "Royal Wedding" explain the toasts being offered.\n\nAt the table next to yours, however, you unexpectedly hear your own name. Even after they exiled {COMMANDER.Obj}, the family wasn't able to live it down. We're the laughing stock of the Periphery!"

column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>The waiting stretches on. Quiet, watchful. No new pings, no scheduled updates. Just long-range scans and standard monitoring protocols.

Then, an identification signal appears. Not broadcast. Buried. Encoded in a tight envelope using the same Tribe cipher Mizuki once shared, and routed through a degraded relay deep in McEvedy's Folly's orbital junkfield.

Farah picks it up instantly.</color> "We've got something incoming. They identified using the same Tribe encryption as last time."

<color=#BFBFBF>Moments later, the proximity alert pings. A compact shuttle, no markings, no chatter, rises over the horizon and burns toward the Argo.

No weapons. No transponder. No instructions. It docks without asking.

Airlock cycle: fast. A single figure boards, cloaked, helmeted, silent. They carry a sealed crate. No introduction, no ceremony. The figure places the crate just inside the corridor, gives a single nod, and vanishes back through the airlock before anyone speaks.

Sumire mutters from the upper deck.</color> "Friendly types, aren't they?"

<color=#BFBFBF>The crate is sealed but untrapped.  Inside: a dense, ruggedized encryption unit, low EM profile, thermally shielded, and covered in unfamiliar diagnostic ports. A slight humming can be heard from its insides.

She crouches beside the crate, tools in hand.</color> "This isn't standard crypto gear. It's layered. Already semi-active. Whatever protocol this is... it's beyond anything I've seen. It's not just secure, it's engineered to keep everything else from even knowing it exists."
column2: 等待持续着. 安静，警惕. 没有新的信号，没有预定更新. 只有远程扫描和标准监控协议. 随后，一个识别信号出现了. 不是公开广播，而是被隐藏起来的信号. 它被封装在一个紧密加密的数据包中，使用的正是美月曾经提供过的部落密码，并通过McEvedy's Folly轨道垃圾场深处一处衰退中继站进行传输. 法拉立即捕获了它.“我们收到了一些东西. 他们使用了和上次一样的部落加密方式进行身份验证.” 片刻后，近距离警报响起. 一艘小型穿梭机没有任何标识，没有通讯信号，从地平线上升起，朝阿尔戈号 快速接近. 没有武器. 没有识别信标. 没有说明. 它直接完成了对接. 气闸循环: 快速. 一名身披斗篷、戴着头盔的人登上舰船. 没有言语，没有介绍. 他们携带着一个密封箱，将箱子放在走廊入口处，只点了一下头，随后在任何人开口之前便转身返回气闸. 苏米尔在上层甲板低声嘟囔.“真是友好的家伙，对吧?” 箱子经过密封处理，但没有设置陷阱. 里面是一台高密度加固型加密设备，低电磁特征，隔热保护外壳，以及覆盖着陌生诊断接口的外部结构. 设备内部传来轻微的嗡鸣声. 她蹲在箱子旁，拿出工具.“这不是普通的加密设备. 它采用了多层结构，而且已经处于半激活状态. 不管这是什么协议……都超出了我见过的任何技术. 它不仅仅是安全，而是被设计成让其他任何系统甚至察觉不到它的存在。”

column1: The Hypervelocity Autocannon (HVAC) family of weapons is based on the Autocannon. While they have the same damage classes, they're capable of firing much further. Once members of the Society discovered the use of these weapons in the Inner Sphere, they immediate developed and proposed their own prototypes to Clan leadership. While rejected by the Khans, HVAC (S) cannons were found amongst the Society 'Mechs and vehicles used during the Wars of Reaving. \n\n Uses HVAC10 Ammo.
column2: 超高速自动炮(HVAC)武器家族以自动炮为基础. 虽然它们具有相同的伤害等级，但射程更远. 当秘社的成员发现内天体在使用这些武器时，他们立即开发并向氏族领导层提出了自己的原型. 尽管被可汗们否决，但HVAC加农炮仍然在焚风战争期间使用的秘社机甲和车辆中被发现.\n\n 使用HVAC10弹药.

column1: One of the latest UrbanMech variants, the UM-R96 is an evolution of the -R80. It drops all the weaponry bar the 短管PPC to mount the hardened armor of the -R93 model. The standard small laser remains, although now of the X-pulse variety. This creates an incredibly tough 'Mech with minimal logistics needs, which is perfectly suited to combat in an urban environment—but nowhere else. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UM-R96是城市机甲的最新变体之一，为R80型的进化版本. 该机型移除了除短鼻翼粒子加农炮外的所有武器系统，全面采用R93型的硬化装甲. 原有的标准小型激光得以保留，但已升级为X脉冲型号. 这使得该机甲拥有极强的防护能力和最低限度的后勤需求，完美适用于城市环境作战——但也仅限于此. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: This may be the fastest fifty-ton chassis I've ever worked on, boss. The Crab already moves at a pretty respectable clip, but this is something else entirely. If my calculations are correct, this thing can push over just over 140 km/h while both the MASC and supercharger are active. Just ... well, remember to turn them off once in a while, ya hear?
column2: 这可能是我设计过的最快的五十吨底盘了，老板。螃蟹已经以相当可观的速度移动了，但这完全是另一回事。如果我的计算正确的话，当 MASC 和增压器都处于活动状态时，这个东西可以推动超过 140 公里/小时。只是......好吧，记得偶尔把它们关掉，听到了吗？

column1: A new Hyperpulse message appears at the Argo's comms console, flagged with Watch encryption and marked "Priority Advisory – Strategic Update". Sumire intercepts it immediately, eyebrows raised. "Message is from Arelle's admin staff," she says, already decrypting. "It's… a theater-wide disposition report. Special bulletin." The contents unfold over the holotable in stark, structured detail. [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] forces have successfully completed operations in 星团752, Horgens, and Outpost #11. All three systems are now considered secure and under Watch authority, with transition efforts underway and tactical networks re-established. But the report is more than just a victory log. Alongside the advances, it reveals that the [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]] has simultaneously locked down a large amount of jump points across surrounding sectors. Chokepoints, transit gates, even hidden routes once thought abandoned. These positions weren't taken in response to the Watch's actions. They were part of a broader design, executed in parallel. The Watch now classifies several adjacent systems as "denied-access zones," effectively cutting off a growing arc of space from routine operations. Sumire hits a quick succession of keys, with the computer replying with a series of beeps. "Star map's updated. All logged and verified." Darius looks at you, with a slight frown. "So what's the plan now, Commander?"
column2: 阿尔戈号 的通讯控制台上出现了一条新的超空间通讯消息，标记为监视部队加密，并注明“优先通知——战略更新”。苏米尔立即拦截了它，眉头微微皱起。 “消息来自阿蕾尔的行政团队。”她一边说着，一边开始解密。“这是……一份战区态势报告。特别通告。” 全息桌上展开了报告内容，冷峻而结构化的信息逐条呈现。 [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch]Ghost Bear Watch]]已经成功完成了星团752、Horgens以及前哨11号 的行动。三个星系目前均被认定为安全区域，并处于监察部控制之下，过渡工作正在进行，战术网络也已重新建立。 但这份报告并不只是胜利记录。 在取得推进的同时，报告还揭示了[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]Minnesota Tribe]]正在同时封锁周边区域的大量跃迁点。战略隘口、交通节点，甚至那些曾被认为已经废弃的隐藏航线，都被他们控制。这些阵地并非为了应对监察部的行动而临时夺取，而是更大计划的一部分，并且是在同步执行。 监察部目前将数个邻近星系划分为“拒绝访问区域”，实际上切断了一片不断扩大的星域，使其无法进行常规行动。 苏米尔快速连续敲击几下按键，电脑随即发出一连串提示音。“星图已更新。所有数据均已记录并验证。” 达吕斯看向你，眉头微皱。“所以，接下来计划是什么，指挥官？”

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. The custom config of Opacus Venatori member Adept Achillius St. John carries a pair of arm-mounted Ramtech 9500V Large 变速脉冲激光s supported by two 多元光学 ER 中型激光s in the head, all four lasers linked to a 瞄准计算机. A Supercharger ensures St. John reaches optimum range in an instant while three extra 双散热器 allow him to constantly fire as he does. Quirk: 改进型通讯设备 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为布雷克圣言会天穹系列的另一款万能机甲，德瓦（Deva，源自印度教信仰中的天界存在）同样广泛运用了新技术. 它搭载了轻型聚变引擎、耐久度比标准型号高出一半的重型陀螺仪，以及天穹系列共通的小型驾驶舱. 暗影追猎者教会成员阿基利乌斯·圣约翰的定制配置是: 双臂各装一具Ramtech 9500V大型可变速度脉冲激光，头部装有两具Diverse Optics中型增程激光，所有四具激光均与目标计算机联动. 一台超级增压器可让圣约翰瞬间抵达最佳交战距离，而三具备用的双散热器则使他能够不间断开火. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.07 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The D configuration is fitted with a mix of short-range and melee weapons. 长-range firepower comes from a Clan-生产 Class-2 转管自动炮 mounted in the left arm with two tons of ammunition. Other weapons include a right torso-mounted 浮夸激光, a single ER 中型激光 in the right arm, and pairs of two ER Small and ER Micro Lasers mounted in the left and center torso section respectively. The configuration's mêlée weapon is a Batte机甲 Lance. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: D配置搭载了一套中短程及近战武器混搭方案. 远程火力由一具安装在左臂的氏族产2型转管自动炮提供，备弹两吨. 其他武器包括右躯干安装的一门爆裂激光、右臂的单门中型增程激光，以及分别置于左躯干和中央躯干的两组小型增程与微型增程激光对. 该配置的近战武器为一柄战斗之矛. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Candiear is a very "liberal" planet, who's fertile farmlands are just as likely to be producing plants for "recreational purposes" as they are food.  The net result is a distinct "hippy" feel to the planet, and a small tourist trade.
column2: Candiear是一颗非常“自由开放”的星球，其肥沃的农田既可能用于生产粮食，也同样可能用于种植“消遣用途”的植物. 最终结果是这颗星球带有一种独特的“嬉皮士”氛围，以及小规模的旅游业.

Its Gauss Rifle boasts a mischievous 'tractor beam,' hurlin' scrap through the barrel and leavin' ammo troubles in the void. Quirk: 陆空两用机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 啊哈，我的太空海盗伙计们！快来看看这架城市机甲UFO——银河之海的恐怖之星！它的高斯步枪配备了一束调皮的「牵引光束」，能把废铁嗖地吸进炮管射出去，弹药问题直接丢进虚空里. 搭配成堆的小型激光、火箭弹，再加上通讯频道里震耳欲聋的金属乐，我们就是来散播宇宙级混乱的. 加入城市机甲UFO的海盗团吧——在这里，废铁就是炮弹，金属乐的回声统治着银河汪洋！ 特质: 陆空两用机甲 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Argo settles into high orbit over a scorched, wind-blasted world in the Star Cluster 752 system. Below lies Merovi, a desolate, sand-choked planet littered with decaying Star League ruins. Bunkers, towers, and broken relay stations half-consumed by time now serve a new master: the Minnesota Tribe. From these fractured strongholds, they coordinate raids and dig in. A Hyperpulse transmission arrives as the crew finishes system checks. Star Colonel Arelle Jorgensson appears at the holotable, her tone clipped and focused. "Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}. Welcome to Star Cluster 752. The Tribe has embedded itself in multiple positions across the surface. All must be eliminated." A tactical map lights up with three key targets. "One is a combat staging zone, dug in and defended. No objectives but the enemy. You'll make contact, break their line, and erase everything breathing. Another is a buried [[DM.Factions[faction_SLDF],SLDF]] relay. They've been using it for long-range coordination. Now they're trying to wipe it before we reach it. You'll recover the data and shut them down. The third is a logistics redoubt. Not fully fortified yet, but once it is, they'll use it to resupply and repair forward elements across the region. Take it before they do." She folds her arms. "You will complete all three. This is not about choice, only sequence. You have 14 days to begin the one you select. After each, you'll be rewarded. Advanced tech, recovered gear, surplus resources." "Choose your first strike, Commander." The transmission ends.
column2: 阿尔戈号 进入星团752 星系一颗饱受摧残、狂风肆虐的荒芜世界上空的高轨道. 下方是Merovi，一颗被沙尘吞噬的荒凉行星，遍布腐朽的星盟遗迹. 掩体、高塔以及破损的中继站被时间侵蚀，如今却迎来了新的主人: 明尼苏达部落. 他们以这些残破的据点为依托，协调袭击行动并建立防御. 舰员完成系统检查时，一条超脉冲通讯抵达. 星上校阿蕾尔·约根森出现在全息桌前，语气简短而专注. “指挥官{COMMANDER.Callsign}，欢迎来到星团752. 部落已经在地表多个位置建立据点. 所有目标都必须被清除.” 战术地图亮起，显示出三个关键目标. “其中一个是战斗集结区，敌人已经挖掘工事并严密防守. 那里没有其他目标，只有敌人. 你将与他们接触，突破防线，并消灭所有还在呼吸的目标.” “另一个是一处埋藏的[[DM.Factions[faction_SLDF]SLDF]]中继站. 他们一直利用它进行远程协调. 现在，他们正试图在我们抵达之前将其摧毁. 你需要回收数据并关闭它.” “第三个是后勤堡垒. 目前尚未完全完成防御建设，但一旦建成，他们将利用它为该区域的前线部队提供补给和维修. 趁他们完成之前夺取它.” 她双臂交叉. “你必须完成全部三项任务. 这不是选择问题，只是行动顺序问题. 你有14天时间开始执行你选择的第一项行动. 每完成一项任务，你都会获得奖励. 先进科技、回收装备、剩余资源.” “选择你的首次打击目标，指挥官.” 通讯结束.

column1: The Gunslinger's Assassin refit left the Inner Sphere along with the majority of its fellows and was likewise improved by the Clans. With cooling to spare, the Assassin made a fine candidate for field tests of upcoming ER laser technologies. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower

column1: What is this mishmash of 多林电子' HPCS and salvaged targeting computers? Talk about a recipe for disaster! Just look at this "pirate neural interface" — more like a "not fit for a gerbil" interface. You'd have better luck using a rusty spoon to target your weapons. And what's worse, it's designed to intentionally cannibalize the equipment around it on failure. Whoever thought this contraption was a good idea was swigging way too much space grog. If you're willing to bet a MechWarrior's hide on this heap, be my guest, but don't say I didn't warn you.
column2: 这堆多林电子的HPCS(高精度聚焦系统)和回收瞄准计算机拼凑出来的玩意儿，分明就是场灾难的配方! 瞧瞧这所谓的“海盗神经接口”——不如说是“连沙鼠都嫌弃”的接口. 用生锈的勺子瞄准都比这玩意儿靠谱. 更糟的是，它故障时还会故意把周围的设备一起吞噬掉. 不管谁想出这破玩意儿，准是喝太多太空劣酒了. 你要是想把一个机甲战士的命押在这堆破烂上，请便，但别怪我没警告过你.

column1: Blackjack 0s 是 BJ-1 的原始降级版本，把两门 AC 都换成了中型步枪，并尽可能把装甲加到最厚。 Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.81 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 黑杰克BJ-1的0s型是其原始效能降级型号，将两门自动炮替换为中型步枪，并尽可能地将装甲提升至极限. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.81 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Valkyrie II project originated as an assignment for two NAIS student design teams to create a new heavy scout and skirmisher mech based on the 瓦尔基里 VLK-QA. A rivalry between the two teams and outside pressures from Davion bureaucrats pushed both designs far beyond a replacement for the VLK-QA. Corean Enterprises was contracted to construct the Valkyrie II-2A which sports a 300 rating Light Fusion Engine, five Jump Jets, an ER Large Laser, a quartet of ER 中型激光s, and nearly thirteen tons of armor. 特性：模块化武器 部署成本倍率：1.08
column2: 女武神II型项目最初是为两个NAIS学生设计团队布置的课题，要求他们以女武神VLK-QA为基础设计一款新型重型侦察与游击机甲. 两支团队的竞争关系以及戴维恩官僚体系的外部压力，促使双方的设计方案远超VLK-QA的升级替代范畴. 科兰企业最终获得合约建造女武神II-2A型——该机型搭载300额定功率的轻型核聚变引擎、五台跳跃推进器、一门大型增程激光、四门中型增程激光，并配备近十三吨装甲. 特质: 模组化武器 部署费用倍率: 1.08

column1: Bass has an excentric orbit, which results in temps varying seasonally up to +/- 70° from a mean of just 5°C.  Most dwellings are in disused mining shafts, including the "Dungeons" - one of Bass's more popular tourist spots for BDSM practitioners.
column2: Bass的轨道偏心，导致温度随季节变化，相较于仅 5°C的平均值上下浮动可达 ±70°C. 大多数住所都位于废弃的矿井竖井中，其中包括“地牢”——Bass较受BDSM实践者欢迎的旅游景点之一.

column1: This variant is a capable knife fighter. Six Jump Jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 180 meters. A Snub-Nose PPC deals damage at long range, but is more powerful up close. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers are highly accurate, as are the twin Small Pulse Lasers that are so devastating against infantry.
column2: 这个变体是一个有能力的刀战士。六台跳跃喷气机使其最大跳跃距离可达 180 米。扁鼻子 PPC 在远​​距离造成伤害，但近距离时威力更大。一对中型脉冲激光器非常精确，一对小型脉冲激光器对步兵具有毁灭性打击。

column1: The D2 is the by far most common variant of the Hēi Lián, as the original C3 was a failure. The D2 drops the 增强型C3主机 and the lasers in the 右侧 Torso completely, to instead fit two Ultra AC/5. The left arm ER PPC dropped, while the right arm ER PPC is moved to the right torso instead. Taking their places in the arms are two 大型脉冲激光s. 怪癖: 突破一击 掉落成本乘数: 1.38
column2: D2型是Hēi Lián中最常见的变体，因为最初的C3型设计以失败告终. D2型彻底取消了增强型C3主机以及右侧躯干中的激光武器，转而安装两门UAC/5. 左臂的增程PPC被移除，而右臂的增程PPC则被移动至右侧躯干位置. 原本手臂武器的位置则换装为两门大型脉冲激光. 特质: 突破一击 部署费用倍率: 1.38

column1: 通过移除一具 LRM 发射器并增加更多散热器，潜行者 4N 每回合能造成更多伤害，而不必太担心把机师活活烤熟。 Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 移除一台LRM发射器并增加更多散热器后，潜行者4N每回合能倾泻更多伤害，不必过于担心机师被活活烤熟. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column2: 这是一款战地应急改造型号，于3073年引入的圣战时代升级方案将标准型DV-6M的SRM-2发射器替换为中型脉冲激光，同时将单散热器更换为双倍散热型号. 特质: 超伸展驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1:
一群机甲战士休假归来时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 皱着眉小跑到你和达里乌斯面前。

“指挥官，我在外面喝酒，有个陌生人提出请下一轮。他开始打听我们公司，但我看得出他早就知道我们的事。知道你的事。”{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses} 地顿住，有些迟疑。

达里乌斯催 {TGT_MW.Obj}。“说吧，你还没惹麻烦。暂时。直接说结尾。”

{TGT_MW.Callsign} 清了清 {TGT_MW.Det} 嗓子。“他给了一种安全通讯的方式，并提出出钱买我们在本星系后续接的合约情报。”
column2:
砰砰的声音把你吸引到公共的机甲战士兵营，在那里你发现[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]正在拆卸“豹式”的一堵内墙. 已经有几块嵌板整齐地堆放在{TGT_MW.OBJ}旁边.

column1: The Vali was produced for more than fifty years and was a mainstay in the forces of the SLDF through the twenty-seventh and twenty-eighth centuries. It fought all the way though Operation LIBERATION, suffering the highest losses of any artillery units. column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. This variant removes the Gauss Rifles and Jump Jets and replaces them with a HAG/30 in each arm. The side torsos each mount an LRM-10 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers. A Light Active Probe is mounted in the head, and the remaining tonnage is given over to more armor protection.
column2: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，但这款 BattleMech 是一款全新且强大的创造物。此变体移除了高斯步枪和跳跃喷气机，并用每个手臂中的 HAG/30 代替它们。侧面躯干各安装一个 LRM-10 和一对 ER 中型激光器。头部安装有轻型主动探头，剩余吨位用于更多装甲保护。

column1: The B configuration brings a LB 10-X Autocannon and two Improved Heavy 中型激光s to deal with larger threats. But it is also geared towards anti-infantry and shredding lightly armored targets with is twin 轻型 机枪 Arrays and supercharger. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B配置装备了一门LB 10-X霰弹炮和两门改进型中型重激光，以应对更大的威胁. 同时，它也通过其双联轻型机枪阵列和增压器，针对反步兵与撕碎轻装甲目标进行了优化. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. This Linebacker was built around the Rising Problems that Battle Armour and Proto Mechs showed on the Battlefield. 14 Anti Personnel Gauss Rifles Obliterate anything that comes close to this Mech due to Volume of Fire, while the MASC ensures it has the Speed to Keep up with even Lights. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 作为“森林狼”的替代型号，65吨级的“线卫”机甲于3052年投入生产. 它围绕390型超轻型引擎打造，凭借更快的速度，在运动战中能与较轻的星队伙伴并驾齐驱——这正是“森林狼”难以为继的短板. 本款“线卫”专为应对战场上战斗装甲与原型机甲所展现的棘手威胁而设计: 14门反人员高斯步枪凭借密集火力可瞬间消灭任何接近的敌方单位，而MASC系统确保其速度甚至能跟上轻型机甲. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The '机甲 of the leader of the pirate band, using the best loot they acquired. The combination of auto cannons, PPC and machine guns - all of the pirate flavour - makes it more dangerous than the normal Sea Monkey. And it has a rotating TAG, because why not. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.45 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这架机甲属于海盗帮派头目，装备了他们搜刮到的最强战利品. 自动炮、粒子加农炮与机枪的组合——全都透着海盗的风格——使其比普通“海猴”型号更加危险. 而且还带有一个转管TAG，毕竟何乐而不为呢. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.45 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a 大型脉冲激光 in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two 锁定式SRM-2s and three 中型脉冲激光s split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a 瞄准计算机 makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven 双散热器, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: Vapor Eagle配备了不拘一格且偏向近战的武器配置，右臂搭载一门大型脉冲激光，辅以一挺机枪、两具锁定式SRM-2和三门中型脉冲激光（分布于侧躯干部位），最后以左臂手枪式外壳中的三挺机枪作为补充. 加装瞄准计算机后，只要能将武器纳入射程，其火力将更为致命. 十一具双散热器、半吨机枪弹药及一吨锁定式导弹足以应对大多数氏族试炼. 特质: 敏捷 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: The Star Python poses little threat to an enemy of greater size or moderately respectable armor. The 天蝎帝国 employs the ’Mech in groups, enhancing the threat through numbers rather than via armament. Though their current numbers remain low, an unverified report indicates Star Pythons are being deployed in Trinary-sized hunting packs. The combined might of many light ’Mechs delivers through synergy what each lacks individually. It doubles as a fast scout, combining excellent speed with limited jump capability. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 星蟒对体型更大或装甲尚可的敌人几乎构不成威胁. 天蝎帝国以集群方式运用该型机甲，借助数量而非武器来增强威慑力. 尽管当前数量仍然不多，一份未经证实的报告提到，星蟒正以三连星规模的猎杀集群进行部署. 众多轻型机甲的协同威力弥补了单机的不足. 它还能充当高速侦察单位，兼具出色的速度与有限的跳跃能力. 特质: 灵巧 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: A battlefield refit of the WLF-1R, switching from single to double heat sinks and trading one medium laser for a C3 slave unit. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: WLF-1R的战场改装，将单散热器更换为双散热器，并用一台中型激光换装了一个C3从机. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: Nope, I can't agree with this refit. It is a clear downgrade, the ability to use different ammunition types does not make up for the loss of the Ultra.
column2: 不，我不能同意这次改装。这是明显的降级，使用不同弹药类型的能力并不能弥补Ultra的损失。

column1: Introduced in 2740, the 40 ton Cicada was developed as a competitor to the Locust. Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Powered by a 320-rated XL Engine, the Cicada 3MA is armed with a pair of 中型激光s, a Small pulse Laser and a 短管PPC. Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 40吨的蝉于2740年推出，是为与蝗虫竞争而研制。它武装略强、速度相当，而更厚的装甲与更好的近战能力使它成为有效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。原型蝉X5由一台320额定XL引擎驱动，装四门中型激光和两具SRM-2。特性：灵巧 投放费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: The -12S builds upon the endo-steel chassis of prior models, upgrading it with a home-built Clan-grade engine and lasers. The weight savings enabled Defiance’s engineers to follow the weaponry layout of the -3S. Armor levels match the toughest Banshees, creating a very strong and fast assault ’Mech, albeit one with a challenging heat curve. Alpha-striking will shut the ’Mech down, so MechWarriors are advised to use either the main or secondary weapons, but not both at once. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: -12S型号基于先前型号的钢内骨结构，升级了自行制造的氏族级引擎和激光. 重量的节省使Defiance的工程师得以沿用-3S的武器布局. 装甲水平与最坚固的班希机甲相当，造就了一台非常坚固且快速的突击机甲，尽管其热量曲线颇具挑战. 阿尔法齐射将导致机甲停机，因此建议机甲战士只使用主武器或副武器，而不要同时启用两者. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: 豪铠装配了改进型隐形装甲，使敌人难以有效锁定。战斗服的体型使其无法由全能机甲运输，也无法执行反机甲作战，不过它确实装有一只战斗爪。其缓慢的速度通常将用途限制在防御行动上，但据说它也曾搭乘装甲运兵车转移。 Quirk: 标准部件 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 该型掷弹兵的变体移除了标准武器，改为搭载一对重型火焰喷射器. 特质: 伏击者 部署费用倍率: 0.896 只能由内部舱室运输，可进行近战，无法进行攀附攻击.

column1: Irian’s attempt to make up for the shortcomings of the 5M, the 6M introduced in 3062 drops the SRMs and Narc entirely, upgrades the LRMs to 15-tube racks with integral 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控 and three tons of reloads each, and upgrades the lasers to ER versions, mounting a fifth medium. Most importantly, the LRM magazines are now protected with CASE. Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 艾瑞恩公司为弥补5M型的不足，于3062年推出的6M型完全移除了SRM导弹和毒刺系统，将LRM升级为配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的15联装发射架（各备弹3吨），并将所有激光升级为增程型号，同时加装第五门中型激光. 最关键的是，LRM弹药库现配备炮弹安全封装系统（CASE）防护. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Seriously boss, I pity anything this thing targets when it's carrying it's full weapons load. There's 180 rocket tubes on this mech in addition to the PPCs and Lasers.
column2: 说实话，老大，当这东西满载武器时，我很同情它所瞄准的任何目标。除了 PPC 和激光器之外，该机甲上还有 180 个火箭管。

column1: The Bailey armored car is a Gienah Automotive-produced civilian security vehicle first marketed in the mid-thirty-first century. The company exploited recovered Star League technology to enhance vehicle performance. The Bailey was designed to cope with battle armor-equipped infantry, which had steadily become more common. Aside for transporting high-value cargo, it can be used as makeshift armor infantry transport. The Bailey was designed to resist battle armor because of a daring raid that saw several robbers using 灰死标准型 battle armor to open a Knox armored car carrying payroll. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 80 15 左侧 55 15 右侧 55 15 后方 55 15 炮塔 50 15 总计 295 75 特性：坚固
column2: Bailey装甲车是Gienah Automotive公司生产的民用安全车辆  于三十一世纪中叶首次上市. 该公司利用回收的星际联盟技术来提升车辆性能. Bailey的设计初衷是应对装备战斗装甲的步兵  这类步兵已逐渐变得更为常见. 除了运输高价值货物外  它还可作为临时装甲步兵运输车使用. Bailey之所以被设计成能抵御战斗装甲  是因为一次大胆的突袭事件  当时数名劫匪使用Gray Death Standard战斗装甲撬开了一辆载有薪资的Knox装甲车. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 6/9格 / 180/270米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 80 15 左侧 55 15 右侧 55 15 后方 55 15 炮塔 50 15 总计 295 75 特质: 坚固 #武器: 1x AMS 2x 小型脉冲激光

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. In the dim light, sight range is reduced. The setting sun lowers visibility by 10%, and all units have +1 defense.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 在昏暗的光线下，视野范围缩小. 落日将能见度降低 10%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Darius restricts card games 和 other "disruptive enterta在ments" 以 the Barracks, so the MechWarri或s 是less underfoot 期间 crew shifts. Yang rep或ts that, while MechWarri或s still loiter around their 'Mechs, they aren't caus在g problems any longer.
column2: 达吕斯将纸牌游戏和其他“令人不安的消遣”限制在营房内，这样机甲战士在船员们移动时就不那么碍事. 杨报告说，虽然一些机甲战士仍然在他们的机甲周围游荡，但至少他们不再制造问题了.

column1: This Crucible retains the torso mounted Gauss Rifles, but each arm carries an ER PPC and 阿尔忒弥斯V火控-enhanced LRM-15 with two tons of ammunition. A Coolant Pod is in the center torso, supplementing the fourteen double heat sinks. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这具坩锅机甲保留了躯干内的高斯步枪，但每只手臂各装有一门增程粒子加农炮和一套由阿尔忒弥斯V火控系统增强的LRM-15，备弹两吨. 中央躯干装有一具冷却剂荚舱，对十四部双散热器进行补充. 特质: 受保护驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: A monster of a unit, these heavily armed vehicles are the epitome of the Tank. Line breakers and fire support platforms, these are usually found in the front of an attack. Trading speed or weapons for armor, the Assault Tank is almost impossible to kill. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: 环境密封 Values A S Front 200 50 Left 160 50 Right 160 50 Rear 150 50 Turret 165 50 Total 835 250 Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光

column1: Yeah this was a Talos, until someone came along who self proclaimed 'Don't Care', and christened it the Honey Badger. That prototype 装甲 can take an insane amount of punishment, built to withstand even direct hits from heavy ordnance. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower
column2: 是的，这原本是一台塔洛斯，直到某个自称“不在乎”的家伙出现，将其命名为蜜獾. 那身原型装甲能承受极其惊人的伤害，专为抵御重型武器的直接命中而打造. 特质: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: 这一新猫定制配置首次现身于联邦共同体内战升级期间。 Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 机密. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. A relatively new development, the Zeus 6TS removes the Autocannon and replaces it with a PPC. To help mitigate the additional heat, two additional Heat Sinks were also added. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯机甲最初由天琴共同体于2787年制造，当时正值第一次继承战争爆发之际. 应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官对新型轻型突击机甲的需求而研发，宙斯机甲的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，并且具备与之匹敌的作战能力. 作为较新的改进型号，宙斯6TS移除了自动炮，替换为一门粒子加农炮. 为了缓解由此带来的额外热量，还加装了两具额外的散热器. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Not to be confused with the original Padilla, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank was a 球体共和国 vehicle meant to fulfill a similar role. Originally designed and produced by Aldis Industries at the request of Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais, the Padilla Tube Artillery Tank serves as the main conventional artillery support platform used by the Republic Armed Forces. The Padilla is well-protected for a vehicle of its size. This is good as the tank's low top speed could make it an easy target for fast moving units or airstrikes. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 170 30 Left 130 30 Right 130 30 Rear 100 30 Turret 120 30 Total 650 150 Quirk: 精准武器 - 弹道
column2: 不要与最初的Padilla混淆  Padilla管式火炮坦克是球体共和国的一种载具  旨在履行类似角色. 最初由Aldis Industries应Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais的要求设计和生产  Padilla管式火炮坦克作为共和国武装部队使用的主要常规火炮支援平台. 对于其大小的载具来说  Padilla防护良好. 这很好  因为该坦克的最高速度较低  可能使其容易成为快速移动单位或空袭的目标. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 170 30 左侧 130 30 右侧 130 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 120 30 总计 650 150 特质: 精准武器 - 弹道 #武器: 1x Sniper火炮 2x LRM-5 2x 小型脉冲激光

column1: Designed for close ranged combat, the B Configuration features a number of close-range weaponry and equipment. Its ranged weaponry includes a 短管PPC in the left arm and a 5-tubed Multi-Missile Launcher with three tons of ammo in the CASE II protected right torso. For close-in combat, the 'Mech uses an ER Flamer and a Medium Vibroblade found in its right arm. The B also features a C3 boosted slave, an Angel ECM, TAG, 瞄准计算机, and also a rear-mounted 布雷器. Quirk: 可变射程瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: B型配置专为近战设计，配备了多种近程武器与装备. 其远程火力包括左臂的一门短管粒子加农炮及右躯干CASE II防护罩内一具五联装多导弹发射器（备弹三吨）. 近战方面，该机甲右臂搭载了一具增程火焰喷射器与一柄中型振动刀. B型还配备增强型C3从机、天使ECM、目标标记系统、瞄准计算机，以及背部安装的布雷器. 特质: 变程瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 万能
