column1: The Barrage UAC-BG-412 arms two UAC/5s in each arm for a total of four, delivering devastating sustained autocannon fire. Three tons of ammunition sit in each side torso under CASE protection, though with four hungry cannons the six tons combined can still run dry quickly. No backup weapons are carried. Quirk: 精准武器 - 自动炮 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: The Barrage UAC-BG-412 arms two UAC/5s in each arm for a total of four, delivering devastating sustained autocannon fire. Three tons of ammunition sit in each side torso under CASE protection, though with four hungry cannons the six tons combined can still run dry quickly. No backup weapons are carried. Quirk: ﻿Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: Designed and constructed during the Jihad, the 4S updated the design of the popular 3S series of Marauders with new technology designed to improve its effectiveness on the modern battlefield. Built around 18 双散热器, the 4S has similar design principles to its predecessor; designed for ease of maintenance and repair. With an extra ton of armor and a targeting computer, it is capable of taking a heavier pounding at close range and boasts superior accuracy at mid to long range. Aside from this, it is functionally similar to its predecessor, retaining the 中型激光 and PPC loadout; though the PPCs have been updated to ER versions and the old single heat sinks swapped for more efficient double heat sinks. Production has been brisk, with 通用汽车 taking orders from across the Inner Sphere and the Periphery; as mercenaries and planetary militias look to upgrade the older Marauders in their arsenals. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 掠夺者4S型设计并建造于圣战时期，通过采用新技术对广受欢迎的3S系列进行了升级，旨在提升其在现代战场上的作战效能. 该型号配备18具双散热器，秉承了前代机型易于维护修理的设计理念. 凭借额外一吨装甲和瞄准计算机的加成，它既能承受更猛烈的近距离火力打击，又在中远距离交战中展现出卓越精度. 除此之外，其功能与前代机型基本一致，保留了中型激光与粒子加农炮的武器配置；不过粒子加农炮已升级为增程型号，老式单散热器也替换为更高效的双散热器. 随着佣兵团和行星民兵组织纷纷寻求升级武库中的旧式掠夺者，通用汽车公司已接到来自内天体与外围星域的源源订单，生产线正全速运转. 特质: 狭窄/低矮外形 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Realizing he will get no handouts from your table, Rance moves on. The stench of fear and desperation lingers long after he's gone.\\n\\nGlancing at your face, Darius cocks an eyebrow. "Why do I get the feeling there's a story here?"\\n\\nBy the time you finish your tale of betrayal and revenge, the table is covered with empty glasses and the lights are low.\\n\\nDarius finally leans back and whistles appreciatively. "Commander, I don't know if I would've shown such restraint if I were in your shoes. That said, he'll never stop running. You've given him a lifetime of looking over his shoulder."
column2: 兰斯意识到他不会从你的桌子上得到任何施舍，于是继续前进。在他离开后，恐惧和绝望的恶臭依然挥之不去。\\n\\n德莱厄斯看了一眼你的脸，扬起一边眉毛。 “为什么我感觉这里有一个故事？”\\n\\n当你讲完你的背叛和复仇的故事时，桌子上摆满了空玻璃杯，灯光昏暗。\\n\\nDarius 终于向后靠了靠，赞赏地吹了声口哨。 “指挥官，我不知道如果我是你，我是否还会表现得如此克制。话虽如此，他永远不会停止奔跑。你给了他一生的监视。”

column1: Constructed using IS-grade Endo-Steel and clad in seven tons of Inner Sphere quality Ferro-Fibrous armor, the BTL-C-2O 战斗眼镜蛇 mounts a lighter 200-rated standard fusion engine. While reducing its speed by 20 km/h, the extra weight was required to carry heavier IS-grade weapons as well as mount a fixed Improved C3 Computer in its center torso. A mid-range Missile boat, the BTL-C-2OB mounts a pair of MRM-10 launchers in each arm with three tons of reloads in its right torso. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 采用IS级钢内骨结构，并披挂七吨内天体标准铁纤维装甲，BTL-C-2O战蛇机甲搭载了一台更轻的200级标准核融合引擎. 虽然极速降低了20公里/时，但多出的重量得以换装更重的IS级武器，并在中央躯干固定安装了一台改进型C3计算机. 作为中程导弹支援机，BTL-C-2OB的双臂各装有一对MRM-10发射器，右躯干储存有三吨备用弹药. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Intended for use in broken or rough terrain, the Cephalus-A carried a single Laser AMS in the left torso. The Modular 装甲 and Light TAG of the primary variant were also removed. column2: 专为崎岖或复杂地形设计，Cephalus-A型在左侧躯干搭载了一具激光反导系统. 原基础型号的模块化装甲与轻型目标标记装置已被移除. 取而代之的是，该机甲配备了一套目标标记系统及足以实现210米跳跃能力的跳跃推进器. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.01 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Behemoth II Heavy Tank was designed in 3102 by Aldis Industries.The tank gained a reputation to be feared among MechWarriors during the Victoria War. Among some noted actions using the vehicle, was in 3117, when elements of the 4th Oriente Hussars encountered a platoon of 4 Behemoth II tanks used to help defend the Capellan world of Shuen Wan during a raid. The Capellan defenders utilized the tank's capacities to hold the high deserts plateau where they encountered the Hussars. The tanks proved to be resilient in combat and remained operational throughout the fight, forcing the Hussars to withdraw. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 360 50 Left 285 50 Right 285 50 Rear 200 50 Turret 290 50 Total 1420 250 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: Behemoth II重型坦克由Aldis Industries于3102年设计. 在维多利亚战争期间  这款坦克在机甲战士中赢得了令人畏惧的声誉. 在使用该载具的一些著名行动中  包括3117年  第4东方骠骑兵队的部队在一次突袭中遭遇了一个由4辆Behemoth II坦克组成的排  这些坦克用于协助保卫卡佩拉星球Shuen Wan. 卡佩拉守军利用坦克的能力坚守他们遭遇骠骑兵队的高沙漠高原. 这些坦克在战斗中表现出极强的韧性  并在整个战斗过程中保持运作  迫使骠骑兵队撤退. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 360 50 左侧 285 50 右侧 285 50 后方 200 50 炮塔 290 50 总计 1420 250 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x AMS MK2 1x Blackwell高斯步枪 1x LRM-15 2x 中型增程激光 1x MML-9 1x 雷电15

column1: Mia Thompson, callsign "Reaper", was drafted into the Steiner military after her family was killed in a pirate raid. Mia, as a 12-year-old child, climbed into her father's AgroMech - a Cattlemaster used for farming - and fought off the pirates alone for over an hour before help arrived. After that, she was drafter and raised in the military. Her natural talent and understanding has seen her quickly rise through the ranks as a respected MechWarrior. These days, however, she prefers to choose her own path, and left Steiner after her last campaign.\\n\\n
column2: 米娅·汤普森（Mia Thompson），呼号“死神”，在她的家人在一次海盗袭击中丧生后被征召入伍。 12 岁的米娅 (Mia) 爬进了父亲的 AgroMech（一种用于耕种的 Cattlemaster），独自与海盗战斗了一个多小时，然后救援人员才赶到。此后，她成为起草者并在军队长大。她的天赋和理解力使她迅速晋升为受人​​尊敬的机甲战士。然而如今，她更愿意选择自己的道路，并在上次竞选后离开了施泰纳。\\n\\n

column1: First seen in 3082 this version of the Karnov is 50% heavier than the base model. The forty-five ton VTOL is protected by four tons of Vehicle Stealth 装甲 powered by an Angel ECM Suite. An 85-rated XL fusion engine allows it to move at a flank speed of 96 km/h, but it also carries a VTOL Jet Booster that allows it to 'sprint' at speeds of up to 120 km/h for fast insertions or extractions. A pair of Sponson 炮塔s each mount a single Machine Gun for suppressive fire. The Heavy Stealth Karnov was used by a group of criminals called 'The Master's Chosen.' They deploy rapidly from the Infantry Bay, and steal equipment and supplies that fit into the cargo bay. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. 装甲: Vehicle Stealth 装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 100 25 左侧 80 25 右侧 80 25 后方 60 25 总计 340 125 怪癖: 改进的 Jammer Can Resupply/Repair Can carry 3 Battle 装甲 Squads.
column2: 首次出现于3082年的这款Karnov比基础型号重了50%. 这架四十五吨的垂直起降飞行器由四吨的载具潜行装甲保护  并由天使ECM套件供电. 一台85级XL聚变引擎使其侧行速度可达96公里/小时  但它还携带了一个VTOL喷气助推器  允许它以高达120公里/小时的速度“冲刺”  用于快速插入或撤离. 一对侧舷炮塔各装备一挺机枪用于压制射击. 重型潜行Karnov曾被一个名为“大师的选民”的犯罪组织使用. 他们从步兵舱迅速部署  并窃取能装入货舱的装备和补给. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境中部署. 移动: 6/9格 / 180/270米. 装甲: 载具潜行装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 100 25 左侧 80 25 右侧 80 25 后方 60 25 总计 340 125 特质: 改进干扰器 可补给/维修 可搭载3个战斗装甲小队. #武器: 2x 机枪

column1: The D configuration focuses on survivability and disruption. Much like the A setup, it features over/under ER PPC and ER 中型激光 mounts in each arm, plus an ER Small Laser in the head. An Angel ECM Suite enhances its defensive capabilities, and added 装甲 around the engine provides extra protection—making this one of the toughest Haider builds to bring down. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: D型配置专注于生存能力和干扰能力. 与A型配置相似，它每只手臂上都装有上下布置的增程PPC和中型增程激光，头部还装有一门小型增程激光. 天使ECM套件增强了其防御能力，引擎周围的附加装甲提供了额外防护——这使得该配置成为海德机甲中最难以击倒的型号之一. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.12 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 230 30 Left 170 30 Right 170 30 Rear 130 30 Turret 220 30 Total 920 150 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: Manticore是有史以来设计最精良、最强大的重型坦克之一  专为支援步兵编队对抗战斗机甲而打造. 尽管Manticore配备了多种武器以应对各种战斗角色和射程  并且对于其重量的载具来说装甲厚重  但它并未装备足以应对诸如Demolisher或Behemoth等突击级载具的原始火力. 尽管如此  Manticore的受欢迎程度一直居高不下  即使在继承战争时代  尽管其使用了昂贵且稀有的聚变引擎. 最初由TechniCorp在统一战争期间开发  在阿马里斯政变期间该公司位于泰拉的总部被摧毁后  随着其他制造商吸收其设施  Manticore扩散至内天体各处. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 4/6格 / 120/180米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 195 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后方 125 30 炮塔 160 30 总计 800 150 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x AMS 1x MML-7 1x 重型PPC

column1: The newest variant, a joint project between IBMU and Alshain Weaponry, was introduced in 3067. The 'Mech utilizes Irian's Compact Engine and 紧凑型陀螺仪 to save space at the expense of mass. It retains the speed and ECM of the 9Q, but utilizes an Endo Steel structure. Two Heavy PPCs deal a good amount of damage in each blow, while a 短管PPC is deadly and accurate at close range. At the time of its introduction the 10KM was reserved for only the elite units of the Free Worlds League and Draconis Combine, and thanks to an iron-clad contract even the wily 伊里安科技 had trouble finding a loophole to sell the 'Mech to the other Houses or mercenary units. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: 最新型号是IBMU与阿尔山武器公司的合作项目，于3067年推出. 该机甲采用伊里安公司的紧凑型引擎和紧凑型陀螺仪，以牺牲重量为代价节省空间. 它保留了9Q型的速度和电子对抗系统，但使用了钢内骨结构. 两门重型PPC的每次轰击都能造成可观伤害，而一门短管PPC在近距离交战中则兼具致命性与精准度. 在10KM型问世之初，仅配发给自由世界联盟和天龙联合体的精锐部队，由于一份铁板钉钉的合约，就连老谋深算的伊里安科技公司也难以找到漏洞，将这款机甲出售给其他家族或雇佣兵部队. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 右上臂

column1: Boss. This is a HyperVelocity AC10, the remnants of one anyway, somehow crammed into and mated with a set of hip and upper leg actuators. Yes, that is the barrel sticking out downwards from the knee, you basically must balance on one leg and aim with your knee to fire it. For obvious reasons the mechtechs are calling it the FootCannon. You could try taking it to Solaris for the laughs, I suppose... or to give someone a knee to a certain area...\n\n Uses HVAC10 Ammo.
column2: 老大. 这是一门超高速AC10，至少曾经是——不知怎么被塞进并融合到一套髋部和大腿上部驱动器中. 没错，那根向下伸出的炮管就是从膝盖处伸出来的. 你基本上必须单腿保持平衡，并用膝盖瞄准才能开火. 由于这些显而易见的原因，机甲技师们给它起名叫“脚炮”. 我想你可以带它去索拉里斯竞技场博取笑声……或者用它给某人的某个部位来上一膝……\n\n使用HVAC10弹药.

column1: Introduced in 2940, the Viper is a 40-ton 全向Mech that emphasizes speed and armor, with only 8.5 tons of podspace available for weapons. A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper E is armed with an ER 中型激光 and an ATM-6. A pair of ER Small Lasers fill the remaining podspace. 特性：瞄准增强—远程 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 毒蛇于2940年推出，是一款40吨级万能机甲，强调速度与装甲，仅提供8.5吨载荷空间用于武器配置. 320型超轻型引擎为其提供动力，底盘固化安装8台跳跃喷气发动机，进一步提升机动性. 毒蛇E型搭载一门中型增程激光和一台ATM-6导弹系统，剩余载荷空间配备两门小型增程激光. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 长程 部署费用倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1:
Khan Han Hill, also known as "The Iron Khan", is one of Clan Coyote's most celebrated heroes. Though not well known outside of his Clan, he is credited with reversing the slow decline of the Coyotes that followed their dominance after the invention of the Omni机甲 in the Golden Century.

Critically wounded during the Wars of Reaving, Han's survival was considered miraculous, as was his fast return to the battlefield. Earning the respect of his peers, Han was a natural choice for the khanship of the Clan when Khan Leo Koga died in a Trial defending the Coyotes' honor amongst the other Clans in the wake of the Society invasion.

Under Han's rule, the Coyotes were able to regain much of their lost standing in the eyes of their peers, though this came at the cost of becoming bitter enemies with 血灵氏族. Seeing the Spirit's ever-shifting demands, Han lead a coalition of the remaining Home Clans to expel the Blood Spirits, exiling them to Colleen and the invasion corridor.

After a war to keep the Magistracy of Canopus out of the K-Cluster, Han decided that the Home Clans must invade the Inner Sphere, as it was clear that there was no way to keep the taint of the Inner Sphere away from their homes without conquest.

Leading the Coyotes, Stone Lions, Star Adders, and Cloud Cobras towards the Sphere, they were rebuffed by the juggernaut that was Clan Ghost Bear and it was made clear that they would not allow the Home Clans to pass through their space. This forced the Coyotes to retreat for a time but, undeterred, Han decided that they would instead travel through the invasion corridor and avoid Ghost Bear space.

This unfortunately meant pushing through the exiled Blood Spirits, and so Han started an invasion of their space. For the next three years, the Coyotes and Blood Spirits fought in a near standstill, neither Clan being able to make significant passage through the corridor. During this time, Han earned his lasting callsign of 'Iron Khan' for his determination to reach the Sphere. Eventually both Clans came to grudgingly respect one another, and slowly they began to co-operate to reach the Sphere. Eventually Han reached the space of the Hanseatic League only to discover that they had arrived too late and were now blockaded from entering the Near Periphery - once more by the Ghost Bears.

The Coyotes and Ghost Bears fought a brief war in the stars between the League and the Chainelane Isles, but ultimately the Coyotes were not able to match the Bears and all seemed lost for Han's quest.

However, it soon turned out that the Society was not as defeated as once thought, and it was revealed they had infiltrated the MRBC. As the Society's chaos swept through the Sphere, the Coyotes slipped into Davion space, eventually settling a sector of Periphery space near the Taurian Concordat. Relations between the Clan and House Davion quickly soured, and the Coyotes found themselves soon in battle against the Federated Suns.

Around this time, the Primus of ComStar and the Aurigan Coalition offered the Coyotes a chance to join the so-called 'New Star League'. With little to lose, Han chose to align himself with this new alliance and, by the war's end several years later, the Coyotes found themselves as one of the major Clans operating within the Sphere, second only to the irksome Ghost Bears.

Though the 'New Star League' fell apart in the years after the war, the Coyotes were well-positioned to dominate the area against their former allies, while a burgeoning alliance formed between Han and his former enemies in 血灵氏族.

Never destined to become the ilKhan of the Clans, Han nonetheless represented the rebirth of his Clan and for decades to come, his influence was felt in the Kerensky Cluster as the Coyotes dominated it once more.

column1: Tropical biomes increase heat sinking efficiency by 10% due to moisture clinging to exhaust vents. In the dark, sight range is significantly reduced. All units have +1 Defense.
column2: 热带环境因排气口附着湿气，散热效率提升 10%. 在黑暗中，视野范围显著缩短. 所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Later that week, Dr. Murad enters your office. "Bad news, Commander. The patch only partially worked. To maintain minimal gravity support, I'm going to insist we shut down the rotation for several hours each day until we can get a permanent fix. I let the staff know about the situation, and they seemed annoyed for some reason. But on the bright side, no MechWarriors were incapacitated by this!"
column2: 本周晚些时候，穆拉德博士走进你的办公室.“坏消息，指挥官. 修复并不完全成功. 为了维持最基本的重力支撑，我必须坚持每天关闭旋转舱数小时，直到我们能找到永久解决方案. 我已经把情况告诉了机组人员，他们似乎因此感到不满. 但好消息是，没有任何机甲机师因此失能！”

column2: 老板……这台机甲基于炽天使，但该版本充满实验技术。我不知道你从哪弄来的，不过我感觉麻烦不小。

column1: Only few examples of the MAL-1KX were finished, most being used as platforms for the development of the experimental Banzai melee assault 'Mech. Its 短管PPCs were known to cause issues for the 'Mech's arm actuators, a problem never fully solved. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 只有少数几台MAL-1KX被制造出来，大多数被用作实验型Banzai近战突击机甲开发平台. 其短管粒子加农炮已知会给机甲的手臂驱动器带来问题，这一问题从未完全解决. 特质: 干扰 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Manticore II updated the venerable Manticore tank with advanced capabilities and a brand new tactical niche as an amphibious vehicle. Few tanks of similar power can match the Manticore II’s mobility in wet terrain. The unit is best employed at long range, emerging from a swamp or river to provide highly accurate support fire from an unexpected quarter. It has the technical capabilities to serve in a similar role as the Manticore, but its expense makes this a questionable use of a specialist machine. Slower than the Medium Tank, but possessing heavier armor and firepower, the Heavy Tank is a fearsome combatant. Trading speed or weapons for armor, the Heavy Tank can soak up a surprisingly heavy level of firepower. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. column1: The Ostscout was 设计ed as a pure recon Battle机甲 by Ostmann Industries. To that end, it was built entirely around gathering data and getting out of trouble, tasks for which it is exceptional; the Ostscout is quick enough to escape most traps, and very few other 设计s can match it in terms of speed and maneuverability. The top speed of the 11J is close to 150 km/h, thanks to a GM 315 XL engine, and it uses eight standard jump jets for enhanced mobility. Ferro-fibrous 装甲 is utilized to offer enhanced protection, but all the advanced electronic equipment was removed, except for the TAG. The weapons and electronics are replaced by a pair of Light PPCs. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 奥斯特侦察机甲是由奥斯特曼工业公司设计的一款纯侦察型战斗机械. 为此，它的构造完全围绕数据收集和脱离险境的任务展开，而在这两项任务中它表现卓越；奥斯特侦察机甲速度快，足以逃脱大多数陷阱，且极少有其它机型能在速度和机动性上与之匹敌. 11J型的最高时速接近150公里，这得益于GM 315超轻型引擎，并装备了八具标准跳跃推进器以增强机动性. 它采用了铁纤维装甲以提供更好的防护，但除目标指示器外，所有高级电子设备均被移除. 武器和电子设备被替换为一对轻型粒子加农炮. 特质: 改良型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Manticore is one of the best-designed and most powerful heavy tanks ever created, built to combat BattleMechs in support of infantry formations. Although the Manticore mounts a variety of weapons to handle a variety of combat roles and ranges, and is heavily armored for a vehicle of its weight, it is not equipped to deal with the raw firepower of Assault weight vehicles such as the Demolisher or the Behemoth. Despite this, the popularity of the Manticore has remained high, even during the Succession Wars era with its use of an expensive and rare Fusion Engine. Originally developed by TechniCorp during the Reunification War, the destruction of the company's head office on Terra during the Amaris Coup spread the Manticore across the Inner Sphere as other manufacturers absorbed their facilities. column2: 阿特拉斯“AS5-HAT”. 海盗们把敌我识别系统改装得这么隐蔽，倒是很符合他们的风格. 这台阿特拉斯用的是标准底盘，不过不知哪位天才重写了手部关节程序，让它在开火时还能竖起中指. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.18

column1: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the 车辆 during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 245 25 左侧 140 25 右侧 140 25 后方 90 25 炮塔 155 25 总计 770 125 怪癖: 作战电脑B2000
column2: 大名指挥部是龙脉联合体使用的一种重型战区指挥单位。首辆大名于2796年继承战争之初由库瑞塔仁次郎投入战场，他在肯塔雷斯屠杀期间使用了该车。当Coordinator亲自出席处决时，大名指挥部的车组把数据传输给星球上的通讯之星代表，再由后者把数据传遍整个内层星域。仁次郎发现这一叛国行为后，整个车组被处决。由于该单位的通讯系统技术成为失落科技的一种，大名的生产在3027至3063年间中断。生态限制：无。 移动：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 245 25 左侧 140 25 右侧 140 25 后方 85 25 炮塔 155 25 总计 765 125 特性：战斗计算机 B2000

column1: JR7-K 通过把装甲升级为铁纤维并削减半吨装甲，为詹纳提升了生存性。这提供了几乎相同的装甲防护，同时腾出空间加装 C.A.S.E. 以保护 SRM-4 弹药。 Quirk: 改进型生命维持系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 在第四次继承战争中被恒星联邦缴获的许多乌鸦机甲在3030年被改装为2X标准型. 此变体用大型激光替代了电子战设备. 特质: 灵敏 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: T型配置是一种混合距离的武器搭载方案. 近程由右臂搭载的一门UAC/20超级自动炮负责，左躯干的两门增程粒子加农炮提供远程火力覆盖. 四门中型增程激光和两具锁定式LRM-10发射器可根据需要提供辅助火力. 该配置保留了主配置中的反导弹系统和电子对抗套件. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Regardless of an Automech's design, it receives three CPU critical slots in its Head hit location. Two of these slots - replacing the Life Support Slots on a standard BattleMech cockpit - are identified as Secondary CPU's, while the third - replacing the Cockpit critical slot - is the primary CPU. Collectively, these represent the Automech's brain.
column2: 无论 Automech 的设计如何，它的头部命中位置都会接收三个 CPU 关键插槽。其中两个插槽（替换标准 BattleMech 驾驶舱上的生命支持插槽）被识别为辅助 CPU，而第三个插槽（替换驾驶舱关键插槽）是主 CPU。总的来说，这些代表了 Automech 的大脑。

column1: The WVR-9R, built on a former RetroTech factory line after the Jihad ended, could not be more traditional if it tried. It is a licensed derivative of a Thermopolis export model geared towards revamping older ’机甲s. This variant utilizes a large autocannon for maximal close-range firepower as most earlier variants did. After decades of production, the WVR-9R can rightfully be called an 'old mainstay'. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: WVR-9R是在圣战结束后，于一条曾生产复古科技的旧工厂线上制造的，它传统得不能再传统了. 这是瑟莫波利斯出口型号的授权衍生品，旨在翻新老旧机甲. 和大多数早期型号一样，该变体配备了一门大型自动炮，以求最大化近距离火力. 经过数十年的生产，WVR-9R完全可以被称为“老牌中坚”. 特质: 改进型通讯 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Following the HPG blackout and the splintering of the Republic, TharHes Industries hastily reopened the Wolfhound line that had been destroyed during the Jihad. Based upon the WLF-5, albeit with TharHes’s original stylings, the -6S variant drops the MASC system and the entire weapons array. A large re-engineered laser is mounted in the right arm, with enhanced actuators to provide increased accuracy. As with the -3S, three ER medium lasers provide backup. A small X-pulse laser covers the rear. The Wolfhound is once again a match for the Combine’s Panther Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 在超光速脉冲通讯中断和共和国分裂之后，塔赫斯工业公司匆忙重启了曾在圣战中被摧毁的狼犬生产线. 基于WLF-5型号，但保留塔赫斯原版设计风格的-6S变体移除了MASC系统与全部武器阵列. 右臂装载一门重新设计的大型激光，配备增强型驱动器以提升精准度. 与-3S相同，三门中型增程激光作为备用火力，一门小型X脉冲激光护卫后方. 狼犬机甲再次成为联合军猎豹机甲的劲敌 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast Omni机甲 that has respectable firepower. This light '机甲 is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous 装甲. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The P configuration seems to have a single 设计 goal, mount as many pulse lasers on the Hellion as possible - no matter their size - by sporting a total of eight 微型 Pulse Lasers. However, it also manages to fit four ER Micro Lasers and three 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, a supercharge, a TAG and an ECM suite. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 地狱火是冰狱火氏族的产物，体现了他们将速度置于一切之上的理念. 以迷雾山猫为基础，地狱火是一款快速的万能机甲，拥有相当可观的火力. 这台轻型机甲相当难以被击毁，因为它配备了五吨半的铁纤维装甲. 为了减轻重量，地狱火还采用了钢内骨结构. 虽然以它的体型而言速度并非特别快，但它确实使用了肌动加速器，以便在短时间内爆发性地提升速度. 地狱火的机身上没有固定武器. P型配置似乎只有一个设计目标: 在地狱火上尽可能多地安装脉冲激光——不论其尺寸大小——一共搭载了八门微型脉冲激光. 不过，它还设法装上了四门增程微型激光、三门改进型中型重激光、一台超级增压器、一个目标指示器以及一套电子对抗套件. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: This variant of the Silver Fox uses less expensive components. The 315-rated XXL engine is replaced with a smaller 245-rated light engine. The rare Angel ECM suite of the original is exchanged for the more common 守护者ECM suite. The weapons array and 装甲 remains the same as the SVR-5X. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limit: 左侧 Upper
column2: 这种型号的银狐采用了更便宜的部件. 原本的315型XXL引擎被换成了较小的245型轻型引擎，同时将稀有的天使电子战套件换成了更常见的守护者电子战套件. 武器系统和装甲保持不变，与SVR-5X相同. 特质: 平衡性良好 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂

column1: Love Urbies? Love those shows with combining mechs? So did some pirates, who kidnapped several Clan superheavy-mech researchers and forced them to create this monstrosity. Built from the frames of 5 Urbanmechs, and fielding even more weaponry, the DevastatUrb is the mech of your UrbieDreams. Fielding a RAC/5, 等离子炮, LBX10, an UAC/10, and an assortment of Pulse lasers, as well as Ferro-Lamellor 装甲 and an Angel ECM suite. What was originally a one-off super-pirate-prototype, has seen standardized production from several parties who wish to augment their offerings with more advanced, yet familiar, technology. 怪癖: 360° Torso Twist 掉落成本乘数: 1.34 Arm Actuator Limit: 右侧 Lower
column2: 喜欢城市机甲吗？喜欢那些合体机甲秀吗？一些海盗也是，他们绑架了几位氏族超重型机甲研究员，强迫他们制造出了这个怪物. 毁灭者城市机甲由5台城市机甲的框架构建而成，配备了更多武器，是你梦想中的城市机甲. 它装备了一门RAC/5、一门等离子炮、一门LBX10、一门UAC/10，以及各种脉冲激光，还有铁层叠装甲和天使ECM套件. 这个最初作为一次性超级海盗原型机的产物，现在已经有多方势力将其投入标准化生产，他们希望用更先进但熟悉的技术来增强自己的战力. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 1.34 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: A variant of the 6S 开发 in 3067 for the Com Guards only to also fall into hands of the 布雷克圣言会, the 6CS used an Endo Steel frame and was powered by an extralight engine. The '机甲's primary weapons were an ER PPC and an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launcher. The 6CS carries two ER medium lasers for short range engagements, and has an advanced electronics warfare suite, consisting of a 守护者ECM Suite and a C3i computer, to allow it to share targeting telemetry with friendly units. 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 6S的一个变体，于3067年专为通信卫队开发，但最终也落入了布雷克圣言会手中. 6CS采用了钢内骨结构，并由一台超轻型引擎提供动力. 这台机甲的主要武器是一门增程粒子加农炮和一个配备阿尔忒弥斯IV的远程导弹15发射器. 6CS在近距离交战中配备两门中型增程激光，并拥有一套先进的电子战系统，包括一套守护者电子对抗套件和一台C3i计算机，使其能够与友方单位共享瞄准遥测数据. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] calls up from the planet's surface with an interesting opportunity. "Hey, Commander, remember that stuff on the planetary-restricted list that you wanted me to track down a source for? Well, while I was poking around, this guy calling himself an 'export-import specialist' walked up to me. He was looking for help transporting three stock Medium Lasers off-planet to his friends waiting in orbit… what do you want me to do?"
column2: [[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]从行星地表打来通话，带来一个有趣的机会。“嘿，指挥官，还记得那份行星管制清单上、你让我找货源的东西吗？嗯，我打听的时候，有个自称“进出口专家“的人走过来找我。他想请人帮忙把三件标准中型激光器运出行星，交给在轨道上等着他的朋友……你想让我怎么做？“

column1:
又不是这船上只有我一个贵族出身的人，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 说着，在你客座的椅子里瘫了下去。"我是说，还有你呢。为什么 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 不拿他们那个蠢主意来烦你？" 显然，当 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 请求跟你私下谈点"达里乌斯不会懂"的事时，谈的就是当贵族的种种糟心事。

column1: The Orion has long held an important place in the Clan Wolf Touman, and the Orion C 2 is a capable heir to the favored ride of Aleksandr Kerensky. The response has been mixed, however, as it continues to use non-Clan structural components to reduce the strain on the Wolves’ industrial resources. The weapons, though, are mostly Clan. Short to medium range is covered by a Streak rack and ER medium laser, backed up with a large pulse laser in the left arm. The Orion’s standard right torso ballistic weapon was replaced by an ER large laser, both for weight and range. Having been burned by the superior range of extended LRMs, the Wolves are experimenting with the weapon system on the C 2. Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 猎户座在狼氏族机甲军团中历来占据重要地位，而猎户座C 2则是对亚历山大·科伦斯基那款著名座驾的有力继承. 不过其反响褒贬不一，因为它仍沿用了非氏族标准的结构部件，以减轻对狼氏族工业资源的压力. 但武器配置大多为氏族标准. 近距离至中距离由一部锁定式短程火箭和一门中型增程激光覆盖，左臂还配有一门大型脉冲激光作为支援. 猎户座标准的右侧躯干实弹武器则被替换为一门大型增程激光，兼顾重量与射程. 由于曾吃过延程远程导弹射程优势的亏，狼氏族正在C 2上对该武器系统进行试验. 特质: 对空瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Developed by Scarborough Manufacturers on Al Na'ir in 2998, this J. Edgar used a Fuel Cell engine instead of the fusion engine of the original. Though the ground speed remained the same, the armament did not. The Laser and missile systems were dropped in favor of a Light Rifle and twin Machine Guns. The design was seen as only marginally effective, and when Takashi Kurita came to power he cancelled the project. Designed as a fast, cheap, and effective raider, the J.Edgar was the last military vehicle that Alphard Trading Corporation manufactured before they disappeared during the conflagration of the Succession Wars. Unfortunately, the J.Edgar proved quite ineffective and was soon phased out, until Pinard Protectorates Limited licensed the design and began manufacturing new variants. Biome Restrictions: None. The tracks gave the Marksman more stability, as well as increased all-terrain capabilities. The short range of the Sniper means that the vehicle is more likely to be involved in direct combat than most artillery pieces. Correspondingly, the designers equipped the Marksman with 7 and half tons of Ferro Fibrous armor. Armed with a Sniper火炮 Piece, the Marksman carries a Large Laser for defensive purposes. column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the 全向Mech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-G is armed with a pair of Improved Heavy Large Lasers augmented by a 瞄准计算机. 3 additional DHS, a pair of SRM-2’s and a Supercharger fill the remaining tonnage. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 65吨的线卫于3052年投产，设计目的是取代木狼。它围绕一台390额定XL引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是木狼难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合为这款全向机甲提供了17.5吨自由挂载空间。线卫LBK-E装有一门增程大型激光和一对ATM-6，中央躯干装有一台轻型主动探测器。投放费用倍率：1.1。

column1: Clan Ice Hellion, always prolific users of fast light 'Mechs, copied the original redesign of the Incubus, but decided to create their own variant. This fifth version mounts an ATM 6 with two tons of ammunition, two ER 中型激光s, and four 轻型 Machine Guns. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 冰狱族，一贯以大量使用快速轻型机甲著称，复制了因库巴斯的原始改型，但决定创造自己的变体. 这第五种型号搭载一台ATM 6，配有两吨弹药，两门中型增程激光，以及四挺轻机枪. 特质: 精准武器 - 激光 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Shortly after the Sorcerer 1A began walking off of the 星团工业 production lines on Fletcher, the Sorcerer 1B began production in the satellite facility on Crofton. The 1B variant trades in the array of PPCs and Lasers for a Blankenburg Technologies ER PPC, a pair of Artemis IV-enhanced Holly LRM15s, and a trio of Defiance P5M 中型脉冲激光s. The reduced 产热量 of this payload allowed designers to remove the five external 双散热器 and freed up room for CASE in the right torso. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2:
在StarCorps工业弗莱彻生产线上的巫师1A型刚刚走下生产线后不久，巫师1B型便开始在克罗夫顿的卫星工厂投产. 1B型将原本的粒子加农炮与激光阵列，换装为一门布兰肯堡科技增程粒子加农炮，两具配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的霍利LRM15发射器，以及三门反抗者P5M中型脉冲激光. 这套武器配置降低了热量产出，使得设计师得以移除外置的五台双散热器，并腾出空间为右侧躯干安装弹药隔舱.

column1: A 55 ton 全向Mech that blends a lethal cocktail of speed and firepower, the Stormcrow is a common sight in many clan Toumans. Powered by a 330-rated XL Engine and built with a combination of an Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor, the Stormcrow has 19 tons of pod space available. The Stormcrow J is armed with a HAG/30 and an Improved Heavy Large Laser. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.06 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 一台55吨级万能机甲，兼具速度与火力，风暴乌鸦是氏族军队中常见的机型. 它搭载一台330型号超轻型引擎，并采用钢内骨结构与铁纤维装甲的复合结构，拥有19吨的负载空间. 风暴乌鸦J型配备一门HAG/30及一门改进型大型重激光. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: <color=#BFBFBF>Farah uploads the packet to navigation control. Thirteen systems are flagged with updated threat profiles and recent Tribe activity. One under Watch control. The war is spreading, and now you can see where.</color>
column2: <color=#BFBFBF>法拉将数据包上传至导航控制系统. 十三个星系被标记为更新后的威胁区域，并附有近期部落活动记录. 其中一个星系处于监察部控制之下. 战争正在蔓延，而现在，你终于能看清它扩散的方向.</color>

column1: This Jihad-era variant appears to be a test-bed used by the Word of Blake. Its performance is identical to the WSP-100 and it retains the bomb bay, but it is built on a Composite Internal Structure. It's also equipped with double heat sinks and a Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser. The one shot missile launcher has been removed.
column2: 这个圣战时代的变体似乎是布莱克之言使用的试验台。其性能与 WSP-100 相同，并保留了炸弹舱，但采用复合内部结构。它还配备了双散热器和中变速脉冲激光器。一发导弹发射器已被拆除。

column1: The Björn D configuration excels in urban environments with its ER 大型脉冲激光 and ER 中型脉冲激光, offering high accuracy. column1:
The Emergency Coolant System 开发 by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat is a further advancement of the Radical Heat Sink System. It is intended to last longer by automatically activating whenever the Battle机甲 exceeds a certain heat level. The system overall worked, but it had a tendency to fail catastrophically, and potentially destroy the engine in the process. Fortunately, it was configured in such a way that it couldn't be activated manually, which helped reduce the negative consequences of overusing the system. This is the Superheavy, even further improved version of the system, which practically can not be removed from the chassis due to how heavily fused into the structure it is.

VOLATILE!.
column2: 紧急冷却系统由共和国战略战斗研究所开发，是激进散热系统的进一步升级. 它旨在通过每当战斗机甲超过一定热量水平时自动激活，来延长持续时间. 该系统总体有效，但存在灾难性故障的倾向，并可能在此过程中摧毁引擎. 幸运的是，其配置方式使其无法手动激活，这有助于减少过度使用该系统带来的负面影响. 这是超重型版本，是该系统的进一步改进型，由于其与结构高度融合，实际上无法从底盘上拆除. \\n\\n易爆!

column1: From all reports it seemed that, despite numerous attempts, Clan Scientists never fully realized a Mech-scale 重型高斯步枪. This is only partially true, by 3062 members of the Society had come close to finishing their secret development a prototype that rivaled the new 重型高斯步枪 being sported by Inner Sphere forces. Rushed into production at the onset of the Jihad and Wars of Reaving, the Clan 重型高斯步枪 may benefit from the same weight-saving technologies as Clan Gauss Rifle but has considerable reliability issues and the vast capacitor banks can cause an incredible explosion if damaged. Uses 重型高斯弹药. VOLATILE!
column2: From all reports it seemed that, despite numerous attempts, Clan Scientists never fully realized a Mech-scale Heavy Gauss Rifle. This is only partially true, by 3062 members of the Society had come close to finishing their secret development a prototype that rivaled the new Heavy Gauss Rifle being sported by Inner Sphere forces. Rushed into production at the onset of the Jihad and Wars of Reaving, the Clan Heavy Gauss Rifle may benefit from the same weight-saving technologies as Clan Gauss Rifle but has considerable reliability issues and the vast capacitor banks can cause an incredible explosion if damaged. Uses Ammo Heavy Gauss. VOLATILE!

column1: 作为第一次继承战争拖长过程中为缓解后勤需求而设计的另一变体，库瑞塔家族的 1K 黄蜂于 2818 年推出，在提升防护的同时牺牲火力。它保留中型激光，但以左躯干的一挺"斯佩里-勃朗宁"机枪和一吨再装填取代导弹发射器。节省的重量用于把装甲提升半吨。 Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 1A型的一种罕见战场改装，减少一吨装甲以加装目标定位系统（TAG），并将一台中型激光替换为两门小型激光. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: The Ninja-To is intended to work with, and take advantage of, other units which carry a C3 Master Computer by carrying a C3 slave unit that allows it to share targeting data with other units in a C3 equipped unit. The Ninja-To is built on a lightweight Star League XT Light Endo Steel that cradles a powerful Magna 390 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h, more when TSM is activated. While this combination of structure and engine saves weight, it also makes the Ninja-To susceptible to being a combat loss from side torso destruction. The EMP Variant is a close range in-fighter packing dual 短管PPCs, ER 中型激光s and 中型脉冲激光s as well as TSM for that up close and personal touch. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 忍者刀的设计初衷是与其他配备C3主控计算机的单位协同作战，它搭载了一台C3从机，可以分享目标数据给其他装备C3的成员. 忍者刀采用了轻量化的星际联盟XT轻型钢内骨结构，承载着一台强大的麦格纳390超轻型引擎，使这台机甲的最高时速达到97.2公里，启动三重强化肌纤维（TSM）后还能更快. 虽然这种骨架与引擎的组合节省了重量，但也让忍者刀因侧躯干被摧毁而丧失战斗力的风险变得更高. EMP变体则是一种近距离缠斗机型，装备了两门短管粒子加农炮、增程式中型激光和中型脉冲激光，同时搭载TSM，专为那种贴身的“亲密接触”而生. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Introduced in the late 31st Century on Solaris VII, the Combat Shield is a movable piece of armor that can be mounted on BattleMechs. The shield was first introduced as a method to add protection for a MechWarrior fighting in the arenas of Solaris. Shields are primary defensive equipment used to protect a 'Mech from Weapons fire and some forms of physical attacks. Equipping more than 1 wont yield additional effects, does not stack with other combat shields.
column2: 战斗护盾于31世纪晚期在索拉里斯七号首次出现，是一种可安装在战斗机甲上的可动式装甲组件. 该护盾最初是为了在索拉里斯竞技场中为机甲战士增添防护而引入的. 护盾属于主要防御装备，用于保护机甲免受武器射击以及某些形式的物理攻击. 装备超过一面不会产生额外效果，也不与其他战斗护盾叠加.

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. This variant was produced by the 布雷克圣言会 following their seizure of Hesperus II during the Jihad. Rolling off assembly lines six months after the planet's capture, it was armed with a pair of Heavy PPCs, supplemented by an ER large laser, four ER medium lasers and fourteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor. These new additions were made possible by the inclusion of an XL Gyro and Light Fusion Engine, while seventeen double heat sinks were included for heat management. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 天琴共同体于2787年首次成功建造宙斯机甲，正值第一次继承者战争爆发之际. 这款应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官要求研发的新型轻型突击机甲，其机动性足以与大多数重型机甲并驾齐驱，在正面交锋中亦不落下风. 该改型由布雷克圣言会在圣战期间夺取赫斯珀洛斯II行星后生产，仅用六个月便从占领地的装配线下线. 其武装配置以两门重型粒子加农炮为核心，辅以一门大型增程激光、四门中型增程激光及十四吨铁纤维装甲. 通过搭载超轻型陀螺仪与轻型聚变引擎实现装备革新，更配备十七个双联散热器构成高效温控系统. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column2: 科米努斯配置在每只手臂上各安装了一门氏族中型脉冲激光，并在左右侧躯干各装有一具10型火箭发射器. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.97

Known in official Star League records as the LT-MOB-25, it is actually six vehicles all hooked together as part of a massive convoy. The purpose of this entire convoy of vehicles was to move one weapon: a 长汤姆火炮 Piece. The artillery piece was capable of extremely long range fire more suited to demolishing defensive fortifications than firing into a firefight. The only short-range weapons were four, side-mounted Machine Guns that were more suited to anti-infantry than anti-'Mech duty. column1: 'Balam', the seventh alternative, is also the first of two loadouts that mounts a weapon acquired during raids of RISC factories; a Heavy MRM-45 launcher. It further carries the Word developed Astral Hammer autocannon, 短管PPCs and even two 锁定式SRM-6 launchers and two Medum Pulse Lasers for shorter ranges. It is also the only configuration to carry an 反导系统. Quirk: 布雷克之怒 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.39 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 'Balam'，第七种可选配置，也是两款携带有从RISC工厂突袭中获取的武器的配置中的第一款；它装备了一具重型MRM-45发射器. 此外，它还搭载了布雷克圣言会开发的星界之锤自动炮、短管粒子加农炮，以及为短距离交战准备的两具锁定式SRM-6发射器和两具中型脉冲激光. 它还是唯一一款配备了反导弹系统的配置. 特质: 布雷克之怒 部署费用倍率: 1.39 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Kokou Defense Tank is an early Clan Combat Vehicle utilized in the Clan Homeworlds during the Succession Wars Era. Constructed using standard Clan technologies, the Kokou is powered by a Standard engine and is protected by upwards of 8.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, with the majority of armor focused in its front and turret. The vehicle is not terribly fast, its fusion engine is only able to move it no faster than 32 km/h. Its long-range weapon is a 10-Tubed 远程导弹发射器 mounted in front of the tank's hull. The one ton of ammunition for the launcher is protected by CASE. Threats at all ranges are handled by three Large ER Lasers in its turret. Biome Restrictions: None. column1: The first refresh of the King Dragon, the DRG-23K replaces the two X-Pulse lasers of the -22K with three 短管PPC and slightly less heat sinks. The powerful 375 XL engine of the -22K was kept, leaving the a top speed of nearly 60 km/h untouched. Although the switch to the PPCs over lasers was an improvement on paper, many MechWarriors found it to be worse performing in actual battle which left the -23K with a slightly tainted reputation. Quirk: 均衡 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3
column2: 龙王机甲的首次革新，DRG-23K将-22K型号上的两门X脉冲激光换装为三门短管PPC，同时略微减少了散热器数量. -22K型号强大的375 XL引擎得以保留，使其近60公里/小时的最高速度不受影响. 虽然从激光武器换装PPC在纸面上看起来是一种改良，但许多机甲战士在实际战斗中却发现其表现更差，这让-23K型号背负了略有污点的名声. 特质: 均衡配置 部署费用倍率: 1.3

column1: The pouring rain increases heat sinking by 12 per turn. Visibility and sensor efficiency is reduced to 70%, and all units have +3 Defense. Hurricane winds cause land units to take 30% more stability damage, hover units have their movement cost increased by 50%, VTOL units have -2 evasion, and the scatter radius of weapons is increased by 40%.
column2: 倾盆暴雨使每回合散热增加 12 点. 能见度与传感器效能降至 70%，所有单位获得 +3 防御. 飓风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 30%，悬浮单位移动消耗增加 50%，垂直起降飞行器单位闪避 -2，武器散布半径扩大 40%.

column1: Developed by Howa Machinery Company Ltd. for the King Dragon, the experimental Ryujin Superheavy Flamer utilizes a totally new concept for delivery of the flammable substance. The weapon charges a 'cloud' of inert nano-particles with an positive charge, which then binds a special ionized highly flammable substance between the particles. Upon impact with a surface the bindings of the nano-particles and the flammable substance are broken, resulting in the ignition of the fluid by the released electrical charge. This allows the flamer to reach much further distances, but also means the heat explosion is considerably less at shorter distances as the kinetic impact will rupture less of the bindings. If the weapon is handled incorrectly it could lead to an incorrect charging sequence resulting in the flammable substance igniting upon firing, causing a large heat explosion. 使用 Superheavy Flamer 弹药.
column2: 【Ryuujin Superheavy Flamer】由Howa Machinery Company Ltd.为King Dragon研发的实验型龙神超重型喷火器采用了一种全新的可燃物质投送方式. 该武器会为一团惰性纳米粒子“云”充入正电荷  然后让一种特殊的电离高可燃性物质结合在粒子之间. 撞击表面时  纳米粒子与可燃物质之间的结合会断裂  释放的电荷随即点燃液体. 这使喷火器能够达到远得多的射程  但也意味着在较短距离下产生的热爆炸会明显减弱  因为动能冲击只能破坏较少的结合. 如果操作不当  可能导致错误的充能过程  使可燃物质在开火时被点燃  从而引发剧烈的热爆炸. 使用超重型喷火器弹药.

column1: Relatively lightly armed for a heavy Battle机甲, the Jade Hawk is equipped only with four Series 1g ER Small Lasers and a set of four Mk. 22 Type III SRM-6s, as well as the claws on its extremities, themselves impressive close combat weapons for Death from Above attacks and grappling with other '机甲s in close combat conditions. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: 尽管作为重型机甲而言武装相对较轻，“玉鹰”仅配备了四门1g系列小型增程激光与四组22型III式六联装短程火箭发射器，但其双臂上的利爪在近战条件下足以对敌方机甲实施毁灭性的高空坠落攻击与缠斗压制. 凭借近战武器与短程火力的组合、重型装甲防护，以及堪比自身吨位三分之一轻型机甲的机动性，”玉鹰“堪称城市巷战中令人胆寒的近距离近战专家. 特质: 扰乱心神 部署费用倍率: 1.15

column1: 这是天龙联合体版本的 3053 型 Striker。SRM 发射器及其弹药被拆除，换成一座炮塔安装的 ER 中型激光；LRM-15 的弹药提升至 16 发；此外该坦克还配备了 Guardian ECM 套件与 C3 从属计算机。Striker 轻型坦克最初是 Valiant Systems 与 Wunderland Enterprises 在 Johnsondale 星球上的合作项目。两家公司联手成立了一家名为 Valiant Vehicles 的合资公司，Striker 便是其首款产品。这款低成本的轻型火力支援坦克在 31 世纪第一个十年推出后，迅速成为 AFFS 的中坚装备，Striker 的订单很快便超出了 Valiant 生产线的产能。\\n\\n生物群系限制：无。\\n\\n移动力：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。\\n\\n装甲： 铁纤维\\n结构： 结构\\n数值 A S \\n正面 160 20\\n左侧 120 20\\n右侧 120 20\\n后部 100 20\\n炮塔 125 20\\n\\n总计 625 100\\n\\n特性：精准武器 - 导弹

column1: Based on the 8M version of the Ostsol this version from 3079 removes the 三重肌纤维束 and uses a battery of ER large and ER medium lasers to damage a foe at long range. For close combat it carries a 短管PPC and medium pulse laser. In addition to its heavy armor, it uses a 守护者ECM Suite to disrupt enemy electronics and a MASC system to engage and disengage at will. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
column2: Based on the 8M version of the Ostsol this version from 3079 removes the Triple Strength Myomer and uses a battery of ER large and ER medium lasers to damage a foe at long range. For close combat it carries a Snub-Nose PPC and medium pulse laser. In addition to its heavy armor, it uses a Guardian ECM Suite to disrupt enemy electronics and a MASC system to engage and disengage at will. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

Try out Quicsell's luxury line of Viewmaster Cockpits, with lots of room to strech out, and a giant panoramic window for excellent views.* \n\n <size=80%> *Quicsell will not be held reliable for damages to persons or property that result from improper use of our cockpits in a combat environment.<size=100%>
column2: 何必依赖那些动不动就坏的昂贵传感器来拓宽你那狭小驾驶舱的视野呢? 试试Quicsell的豪华系列Viewmaster驾驶舱吧，空间宽敞舒适，还有巨大的全景窗，让您尽享绝佳视野.\n\n<size=80%> *对于因在战斗环境中不当使用我方驾驶舱而造成的人身伤害或财产损失，Quicsell概不负责.<size=100%>

column1: 如果我们不绕过那个故障联锁，整体输出会掉 17%！[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 情绪激动，几乎是在喊，你努力回想自己是怎么被卷进这场争论的。 看样子，凭借 {TGT_MW.DET} 的技术背景，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 认为 {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:have|Default:has} 在阿戈号的次级电力联锁中发现了严重缺陷。 而穆拉德博士则坚持认为联锁装置工作正常。"只掉 17% 已经算走运了！问题不在联锁。这些系统只是错过了好几个世纪该做的年度维护。你的方案有可能让整个中央核心暴露在过载之下。" "前提是它不成功，" {TGT_MW.Callsign} 反唇相讥。
column2: 达吕斯缓缓露出的笑容告诉你，他有多喜欢你的主意.\n\n“我恰好在这个星系的黑市上有些人脉. 我会让[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]和他们联系. {TGT_MW.OBJ}显然有这方面的天赋. 没错，我们绝对可以利用这个优势.”

column1: Captain, this piece is either from a genius or a moron. The maniac put a filter on the output to essentially ''brand'' the target. Even worse they wrote a random generator to always 'paint' something else ... eff these punks!
column2: 船长，这玩意儿不是出自天才之手就是个蠢货造的. 那疯子居然在输出端加了个滤镜，等于给目标“烙上烙印”. 更离谱的是他们还写了个随机生成器，每次都要“画”点不一样的花样……我操这些混蛋!

column1: 塔纳托斯旨在模仿氏族使用的雷神全能机甲，是一款极其坚固、打击力极强的设计。它同时复制了氏族雷神的外观与能力，是一款快速的全射程机甲，尽管就其尺寸而言装甲略显单薄。远程携带一门 ER 大型激光，中近程则有一批先进中型激光和一具 MRM-20，塔纳托斯拥有应对任何情况的武器。加上 86.4 公里/小时的快速最高速度和五个跳跃推进器，塔纳托斯常常能追上它无法在射程上压制的对手。 Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 6M是穿透者的一种变体，旨在通过移除两门中型脉冲激光并换装五个额外的双重散热器来缓解机甲的热量积累. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Executioner P has a powerful HAG 30 and an LRM-10 rack for long-range combat. Three Heavy 中型激光s provide short-range firepower. The Executioner P also carries a recently 开发 等离子炮, which is effectively a supersized Flamer - it elevates heat levels, and is 非常有效 against infantry. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Executioner P配备了一门强大的HAG 30高斯步枪和一座LRM-10导弹发射架，专为远程作战而设计. 三门重型中程激光提供近距离火力支援. Executioner P还搭载了一门最新研发的等离子炮，这实际上是一种超大号的火焰喷射器——它能大幅提升目标的热量水平，并对步兵单位极为致命. 特质: 恐怖 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The BRO-4D is a dangerous beast, mounting both an 改进的 重型高斯步枪 as well as the infamous Huge Pulse Laser. This fearsome alpha strike potential is combined with two Mortar/8 for long range indirect support. The 设计 does struggle with heat buildup, so it is not recommended to utilize the full weaponry repeatedly. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.29
column2: BRO-4D是一头危险的猛兽，搭载了一门改进型重型高斯步枪和一门臭名昭著的巨型脉冲激光. 这种可怕的先手打击潜力与两门迫击炮/8相结合，提供远程间接支援. 该设计确实存在热量积聚的困难，因此不建议反复使用全部武器. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 长程 部署费用倍率: 1.29

column1: 猎手机甲 S 型号高度专精于远程自动炮火力支援。它的防护与近程武器都不多，所以让它保持距离、远离危险。 Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 在马里安霸权试图将其星球工业化以生产机甲的过程中，他们打造出了这款介于久经考验的标准型“弩炮（Catapult）”与联合体的致命K2型之间的折中方案. 特质: 精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率: 1.07 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Behemoth II Heavy Tank was designed in 3102 by Aldis Industries.The tank gained a reputation to be feared among MechWarriors during the Victoria War. Among some noted actions using the vehicle, was in 3117, when elements of the 4th Oriente Hussars encountered a platoon of 4 Behemoth II tanks used to help defend the Capellan world of Shuen Wan during a raid. The Capellan defenders utilized the tank's capacities to hold the high deserts plateau where they encountered the Hussars. The tanks proved to be resilient in combat and remained operational throughout the fight, forcing the Hussars to withdraw. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 50 Left 210 50 Right 210 50 Rear 150 50 Turret 210 50 Total 1100 250 Quirk: 主战坦克
column2: Behemoth II重型坦克由Aldis Industries于3102年设计. 在维多利亚战争期间  该坦克在机甲战士中赢得了令人畏惧的声誉. 在使用该载具的一些著名行动中  包括3117年  第4东方骠骑兵的元素遭遇了一个由4辆Behemoth II坦克组成的排  这些坦克用于在突袭期间协助保卫卡佩拉星球Shuen Wan. 卡佩拉守军利用该坦克的能力守住他们遭遇骠骑兵的高沙漠高原. 这些坦克在战斗中证明具有韧性  并在整个战斗中保持运作  迫使骠骑兵撤退. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 铁纤维 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 320 50 左侧 210 50 右侧 210 50 后方 150 50 炮塔 210 50 总计 1100 250 特质: 主战坦克 #武器: 1x Blackwell高斯步枪 2x LRM-20 1x BlazeFire大型增程激光 2x 锁定式SRM-4

column1: This version of the Cephalus carries a Plasma Cannon and a Flamer. This configuration is apparently intended as an anti-infantry unit.
column2: 这个版本的 Cephalus 携带等离子炮和火焰喷射器。这种配置显然是作为反步兵单位使用的。

column1: Built for both ComStar and the 布雷克圣言会 in 3067, the Thug 12E is a redesign of the Thug 11E with the aim of extending it’s accuracy and range. The traditional PPCs have been upgraded to ER PPCs and an improved C3 computer has been added. To make the change to a C3i computer, a double heat sink, one ton of ammunition, and the corresponding CASE were removed. Quirk: 精准武器 - 能量 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 3067年，Thug 12E为通讯之星和布雷克圣言会两家势力同时建造，是对Thug 11E的重新设计，旨在提升其精度与射程. 传统的PPC已升级为增程PPC，并加装了一台改进型C3计算机. 为换装C3i计算机，该机型移除了一台双重散热器、一吨弹药及相应的CASE系统. 特质: 精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率: 1.14

column1: Though the 重型高斯步枪 was mostly effective, engineers thought they could improve the ballistic performance of the projectile. This would lead to a more consistent damage profile, making the 改进型重型高斯步枪 effective at all ranges. After four years of work, the engineers had created a weapon that occupied the same amount of space as the 重型高斯步枪 but was able to inflict consistent damage at all ranges. Uses 重型高斯弹药. VOLATILE!
column2: Though the Heavy Gauss Rifle was mostly effective, engineers thought they could improve the ballistic performance of the projectile. This would lead to a more consistent damage profile, making the Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle effective at all ranges. After four years of work, the engineers had created a weapon that occupied the same amount of space as the Heavy Gauss Rifle but was able to inflict consistent damage at all ranges. Uses Ammo Heavy Gauss. VOLATILE!

column1: First built in 3078, this version has a lower top speed (64 km/h) from Type 81 320-rated XL engine, but uses 改进的 Jump Jets to keep mobility. It carries a pair of Type KOV LB 10-X ACs in the torso, supplemented by twin Mk 3 ER medium lasers and Series-4 锁定式SRM-4s. 氏族钻石鲨 sells this variant to any interested buyer, including Inner Sphere powers, proving increasingly popular among mercenary units. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.2
column2: 首次建造于3078年，该型号因采用81式320级超轻型引擎，最高时速较低（64公里/小时），但配备改进型跳跃喷气装置以保持机动性. 机身搭载两门KOV型LB 10-X霰弹炮，辅以两具Mk 3中型增程激光和四联装Series-4“锁定式”SRM-4导弹. 钻石鲨氏族向包括内天体势力在内的所有潜在买家出售该变体，在雇佣兵部队中日益受到青睐. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.2

LAMs 是a preferred recon 和 raid在g unit but their fragility 和 rarity made them uncommon 在 the 或ig在al SLDF, 和 在creas在gly so 在 the Succession War era. Save f或 a brief revival 期间 the f在al years 的 the W或d 的 Blake, the L和-Air 'Mech 拥有been relegated 以 museums.
column2: 陆空两用机甲（LAM）最初构想于星际联盟时代，是一种能够在战斗机甲与空天战斗机形态之间转换的混合军事单位. 陆空两用机甲是执行侦察和突袭任务的首选单位，但其脆弱性和稀缺性使它们在原星际联盟防卫军中就不常见，到了继承战争时期更是日益罕见. 除了在布雷克圣言会最后几年有过短暂复兴外，陆空两用机甲如今已基本被束于博物馆之中.

column1: Designed for the Republic Armed Forces in 3121, the Doloire is an 80 ton 全向mech designed with a mixture of Clantech and Inner Sphere tech. Designed around a 320-rated Clan XL Engine and an 内骨骼复合结构, the Doloire has 32 tons of pod space, with a pair of Clan ER 中型激光s hardwired into the Mechs CT. The Doloire DLR-OC is armed with a trio of 锁定式SRM-6’s and an LRM-20 all of which are Clan spec. A Mech Lance and C3 Master round out the design. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Doloire于3121年为共和国武装部队设计，是一款混合了氏族科技与内天体科技的80吨级万能机甲. 该机甲围绕320型号的氏族超轻型引擎与内复合材料骨架构建，拥有32吨模块化挂载空间，机甲中央躯体内置有两门氏族规格的中型增程激光. Doloire DLR-OC型号配备了三具锁定式SRM-6和一具LRM-20，全部为氏族规格. 此外还搭载了机甲长枪和C3主控系统. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: A strange and uncommon variant, the -11Q was an attempt to create a close quarters engagement Quad机甲. A supercharger and 驱动器增强系统 was added, making to goal to get in close as fast as possible, and then unleashing its double SRM-6 launchers and bolton Tandem Rockets. Two Small Lasers were also mounted for once the ammunition ran out. The largest weakness of the 设计, which also led to it not seeing much use, was its 385 XXL engine which was both prone to failure and made the Quad very vulnerable for fire aimed at the side torsos. 怪癖: 改进的 Lifesupport 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 一种罕见且不常见的变体，-11Q型是一次打造近距交战四足机甲的尝试. 该机型加装了增压器和驱动器增强系统，旨在以最快速度接近目标，随后释放其双联SRM-6发射器及外挂串联火箭弹. 此外还安装了两门小型激光，以备弹药耗尽时使用. 该设计最大的缺陷在于其385 XXL引擎极易发生故障，并且使四足机甲的侧躯干部位在遭受火力攻击时异常脆弱，这也导致它未获广泛使用. 特质: 改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: Produced by the Free Worlds League splinter nation, the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth 3081, the XJ variant differed from the original XB mostly in secondary weapons and targeting equipment. Its 瞄准计算机 was removed and the Light PPCs were replaced by a pair of 短管PPCs. In addition, the 'Mech's armor coverage and 双散热器 quantity were increased. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17
column2: 由自由世界联盟的分裂国——马里克-斯图亚特共同体于3081年生产的XJ型号，与原始XB型号的主要区别在于副武器和瞄准设备. 该型号移除了瞄准计算机，并将轻型粒子加农炮替换为一对短管粒子加农炮. 此外，该机甲装甲覆盖量和双倍散热器数量均有所增加. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.17

column1: This Victor variant emerged during the Jihad. Equipped with five Improved Jump Jets, it can rapidly close with enemy forces to bring its Autocannon/20 into play. Six tons of ammunition allow the pilot to choose from many types of special ammunition. The only drawback to this model is that it only has a single Medium Laser for backup.
column2: 这种维克多变体是在圣战期间出现的。配备五架改良型跳跃喷气机，可以快速接近敌军，发挥Autocannon/20的作用。六吨弹药允许飞行员从多种类型的特种弹药中进行选择。该型号的唯一缺点是它只有一个中型激光器用于备份。

column1: 在某个失眠的夜里，你在机库里踱步时撞见了 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} 正摆弄着一门 [[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5],制式自动炮]]。{TGT_MW.Obj} 周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱七八糟的金属和电线。\r\n\r\n你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det} 脸上挂着一丝讪笑。"呃。你好，指挥官。我只是想调校一下这个宝贝，看能不能榨出点额外性能。不过能不能帮个忙，别让总管知道？这周他已经把我从这儿轰出去过一次了。"
column2: 在一个无眠之夜漫步机甲库时，你撞见了[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。{TGT_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:正|Default:正}在摆弄一门[[DM.WeaponDefs[Weapon_Autocannon_AC_5]标准自动炮]]，{TGT_MW.Obj}周围的甲板上散落着一堆乱七八糟的金属与线缆。你走近时，{TGT_MW.Callsign}抬起头，{TGT_MW.Det}脸上挂着不好意思的笑。“呃，你好，指挥官。我只是想调校一下这位美人，看能不能多榨出点性能。不过能不能帮我别让主管知道？这周他已经把我赶出去一次了。”

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. An evolution of the Zeus -9T, the new ZEU-11S is a mixture of technologies that blurs the Inner Sphere and Clan divide. Using Clan specification extended-range lasers, an extralight engine and LRM-15 launcher built on-site, the -11S seamlessly integrates these onto the frame of the -9T, although mating the Sphere-made Artemis FCS onto the ClanTech launcher did prove to be a challenge. Everything on the -9T was improved, especially armor protection, with the 'Mech's resilience being further bolstered by a compact gyro and CASE II. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯机甲最初由天琴共同体于2787年建造，正值第一次继承战争爆发之际. 应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官对新型轻量级突击机甲的需求而研发，宙斯的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，并具备与之匹敌的战斗力. 作为宙斯-9T型的进化版本，新型ZEU-11S混合采用了跨越内天体与氏族科技界限的多种技术. 该机型搭载了氏族规格的增程激光、超轻型引擎以及就地生产的LRM-15发射器，-11S将这些装备无缝整合进-9T的机体框架——尽管将内天体制造的火神火控系统适配到氏族科技发射器上确实颇具挑战. -9T的所有性能都得到了提升，尤其是装甲防护方面，紧凑型陀螺仪和二级防爆内构系统进一步增强了机甲的生存能力. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: A variant 开发 by the Colonial Marshals during the 弗朗克边域 era, the 6FR mounts a snub-nose PPC in the right arm in support of three medium X-Pulse lasers in the left torso, rounded out by a head-mounted flamer. Built around a 220rated light fusion engine and clad in standard 装甲 plate, the 6FR is fitted with 15 double heat sinks and 6 improved jump jets to give it greater longevity and mobility during battle. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 该变体由殖民执法官在弗朗克边域时代开发，6FR型在右臂安装了一门短管粒子加农炮，辅以左躯干的三门中型X脉冲激光，头部还装有一具火焰喷射器. 它采用220级轻型聚变引擎和标准装甲板，配备15个双散热器和6个改良型跳跃喷口，以确保在战斗中拥有更长的持续作战能力和更强的机动性. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: 3055 年，陶里安协约的范登堡机械化工业公司限量生产了这款突击队 COM-2D 的工厂改装型，使用从卡佩兰邦联进口的隐形与传感器组件。成果是一款有效的侦察机甲，具备可观的伏击能力，但与基础型号相比的高昂成本以及跨国生产的困难，使其未能被广泛采用。 Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 普罗西昂是郊狼氏族设计并制造的首台原型机甲. 普罗西昂3型将小型增程激光替换为一门小型重激光和一个LRM-3型飞弹发射器. 特质: 灵巧 部署费用倍率: 0.98

column1: An attempt to bring on-board guidance systems back to MRM munitions, Hunter-Killer missiles sacrifice yield and range for powerful fire-and-forget systems on each warhead that build upon targeting data provided from the 机甲-board Artemis IV FCS.  Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an 弹药 Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 【Ammo MRM Hunter-Killer (C)】猎杀者导弹试图为MRM弹药重新引入机载制导系统  每枚弹头都配备了强大的发射后不管制导系统  并利用机甲搭载的阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统提供的目标数据  以牺牲弹头威力和射程为代价换取更高的命中能力. 弹药箱受到暴击时  箱内剩余弹药会发生爆炸  对安装部位造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可降低此风险.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. This area has experienced some form of nuclear explosion in the past and the heavy, lingering radiation has many detrimental effects. Heat sinking is reduced by 12 per turn, and all units take 20% more damage. Sensors are heavily scrambled and only work at 40% efficiency, and fire control systems have trouble locking on, resulting in -2 accuracy.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 此区域过去曾经历过某种形式的核爆炸，残留的强烈辐射带来了诸多有害影响. 每回合散热能力降低 12 点，所有单位承受伤害增加 20%. 传感器受到严重干扰，效能仅剩 40%，火控系统难以锁定目标，导致命中精度 -2.

column1: The Wasp is a popular Light Mech designed primarily for Reconnaissance work. The Wasp 3X is a failed prototype of a Dark Age redesign. Armed with a pair of 雷电5’s and a 中型激光, the 3X relies on a combination of an XL Engine, XL Gyro, Ferro-Fibrous, Endo Steel and 紧凑型散热器s; in order to mount the heavy weapons payload. Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 黄蜂是一款主要用于侦察任务的轻型机甲. 黄蜂 3X 是黑暗时代重新设计的失败原型. 该型号配备了两具雷霆5导弹和一具中型激光，依靠超轻型引擎、超轻型陀螺仪、铁纤维装甲、钢内骨结构以及紧凑型散热器的组合，才得以搭载这些重型武器. 特质: 增强躯干转向 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 右前臂

column1: 这是卡佩兰的实验性"变体"：工程师移除基本多余的第十一台散热器，并在原位装上一挺机枪和半吨弹药。它没有官方编号，通常被称为 R60X。 Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: Being deep in Fed space has allowed Capac a "more or less peaceful" existence over the years, which is one of the reasons it was chosen to house a large prison complex.
column2: 由于地处联邦空间深处，Capac多年来得以维持“大致和平”的存在状态，这也是它被选中容纳一座大型监狱综合体的原因之一.

column1: Tropical biomes increase heat sinking efficiency by 10% due to moisture clinging to exhaust vents. Heavy rain provides 12 extra heat sinking per turn, but lowers visibility and sensor efficiency to 70%. The extreme winds increase stability damage for land units by 30% and movement cost for non-hover units by 20%. VTOL units have -2 evasion. All units have +3 Defense, and weapon scatter radius is increased by 40%.
column2: 热带环境因排气口附着湿气，散热效率提升 10%. 暴雨每回合额外提供 12 点散热，但能见度与传感器效能降至 70%. 极端强风使地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 30%，非悬浮单位移动消耗增加 20%. 垂直起降飞行器单位闪避 -2. 所有单位获得 +3 防御，武器散布半径扩大 40%.

column1: This version of the Hoplite was decorated by some pirate to actually look like a Triple F burger. It comes equipped with paired Small Rotary Chemical Lasers and 10-Tube LRM racks.
column2: 这个版本的重装步兵被一些海盗装饰得实际上看起来像一个 Triple F 汉堡。它配备了成对的小型旋转化学激光器和 10 管 LRM 机架。

column1: This refit for land combat of the production version of the HTM-35X is nearly identical to that experimental version. The 装甲, structure, and equipment all remain the same. In fact the only change is the relocation of some of the ammunition. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: 左侧 Lower
column2: HTM-35X量产型为陆战进行的此次改装，与实验型号几乎完全相同. 装甲、结构与装备均保持不变. 实际上，唯一的变动仅在于部分弹药的重新安置. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂

column1: The C loadout's main goal is to disable any foes; either through its 长 Tom Cannon with both inferno and thermobaric rounds, or through its two 等离子炮s and two Tight Stream EMP Cannons. Even the two iATM-12 launchers have EMP ammunition for further disabling. The loadout however has no close range weapons, leaving it very vulnerable to light units assaults unless properly escorted by other friendly forces. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.43 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: C型配置的主要目标是瘫痪任何敌人；可以通过其装备的长汤姆炮发射燃烧弹和温压弹，或是通过两门等离子炮和两门紧束型EMP炮. 甚至两具iATM-12发射器也配有EMP弹药以进一步瘫痪目标. 然而，该配置缺乏近程武器，极易被轻型单位突袭，除非有友军部队妥善护航. 特质: 威慑 部署费用倍率: 1.43 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The 6-E replaces the standard Jagermech engine with a 260-rated 轻型引擎, allowing the installation of the new Stealth 装甲 and accompanying ECM suite. The Autocannons are replaced with HVAC models and 4 tons of ammo. The standard lasers are replaced with ER versions and the original single heat sinks remain unchanged. Solely fielded by the Capellan Confederation, this mech is rarely seen, with most of the production models simply vanishing into thin air once they leave the factory. Where they end up and when they will see action are questions yet to be answered. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 6-E 型将标准的猎手机甲引擎换装为一台 260 级轻型引擎，从而能够安装新型潜行装甲及配套的电子对抗套件. 自动炮被替换为超高速自动炮型号，并搭载 4 吨弹药. 标准激光被增程型版本取代，原有的单散热器保持不变. 该机甲仅由卡佩拉联邦部署，极为罕见，大多数量产型号一旦离开工厂便消失得无影无踪. 它们最终去往何方、何时投入实战，仍是未解之谜. 特质: 防空瞄准 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: Following the conquest of Coventry by the 布雷克圣言会, the Jihadists modified the 7S to meet their specifications. The 7B keeps one ER 中型激光 in the left arm, but adds two Flamers to it, making the 7B a lethal threat to un装甲ed infantry. A small cockpit makes room for two SRM-4s, which are still fed by a CASE-protected ammunition bin. The weight savings enabled engineers to add enough jump jets to rocket the Commando up to one hundred-twenty meters at a time. They also added an additional ton of 装甲. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.98

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of OmniMechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion engine and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. Vicious up close or at range, this variant up close it can use its LB-X Autocannon/20, while farther out, the Infernus variant makes use of a Heavy PPC. Useful at all ranges is the 短管PPC, though it deals more damage up close. Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为星域系列万能机甲中的轻型突击机型，炽天使在其重量级中机动性稍显不足，但通过配备三重强化肌纤维得以弥补——当机体过热时速度可提升至64公里/小时. 与其他星域机甲相同，炽天使采用轻型核聚变引擎与小型驾驶舱，不过其他新技术仅体现在武器系统中. 该机型同样配备C3i计算机系统. 此型号无论近程还是远程都极具威胁: 近战时可使用LB-X型自动炮/20，而炼狱型号在远程交火时则使用重型粒子加农炮. 短管粒子加农炮在各距离段均有良好表现，但在近程打击时伤害更为显著. 特质: 改良型传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

The Cyclone C1 is built around the same Magna 210XL engine of the A1 variant. Using the same Endo-Steel chassis of the B2, the C1 replaces the weapons payload of the B2 with a Magna Firestar ER PPC, a pair of Magna Mk VI ER 中型激光s, a 守护者ECM Suite, and an additional 双散热器. column1: A breakthrough in plasma-based weapon augmentation, Thermo-Electro-Magnetic Plasma Energy Synchronization Transducers (TEMPEST) are advanced manifolds developed by the Minnesota Tribe to regulate and exploit the thermal and electromagnetic output of specialized fusion cores, particularly the Magnothermic Plasma Engine. Integrated into PPCs, flamers, plasma rifles, and TSEMP systems, TEMPEST units channel superheated plasma into the weapon discharge matrix, dramatically increasing both kinetic and thermal impact. While the plasma stream briefly aids in weapon-cycle cooling, each activation adds a stacking thermal load that gradually overwhelms even the most powerful heat sinks. Prolonged use rapidly escalates internal heat levels, risking system overload and shutdown. Despite these dangers, the raw firepower TEMPEST provides has made it a hallmark of the Tribe’s heaviest frontline units.
column2: 【TEMPEST Attachment】作为等离子武器增幅技术的一项突破  热-电-磁等离子能量同步换能器（TEMPEST）是由明尼苏达部落研发的先进汇流系统  用于调节并利用特殊聚变核心的热能与电磁能输出  尤其适用于磁热等离子引擎. TEMPEST单元可集成于PPC、火焰喷射器、等离子步枪和TSEMP系统中  将超高温等离子体导入武器放电矩阵  大幅提升动能与热能冲击. 虽然等离子流能够在短时间内辅助武器循环散热  但每次启用都会增加可叠加的热负荷  逐渐压垮即使是最强大的散热器. 持续使用会使内部热量迅速攀升  并有导致系统过载和停机的风险. 尽管存在这些危险  TEMPEST所提供的强大火力仍使其成为部落最重型前线单位的标志性装备.

column1: Intended to operate at a longer range than most other Stinger variants, House Steiner began manufacturing the 6S in 3067. It used a light fusion engine to push the '机甲 up to speeds of 118.8 km/h and was capable of reaching speeds of 151.2 km/h through the use of a MASC system. The '机甲 could also jump up to two hundred and ten meters. An additional weight saving measure on this variant was the use of a small cockpit. The '机甲 was armed with two light machine guns for anti-infantry and crowd control use, and to defend itself against '机甲s and 车辆s, the 6S had a single ER medium laser. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 0.97
column2: 与大多数其他“毒刺”变体相比，6S型专为更远距离作战设计，由施泰纳家族于3067年开始生产. 该机型搭载轻型聚变引擎，最高时速可达118.8公里，并通过MASC系统实现151.2公里的极限冲刺速度，同时具备二百一十米的跳跃能力. 此变体采用小型驾驶舱进一步减轻重量，武器配置为两挺轻型机枪（用于反步兵和人群控制），并装备一门中型增程激光以应对敌方机甲及车辆威胁. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 0.97

column1: The Hypervelocity Autocannon (HVAC) family of weapons is based on the Autocannon. While they have the same damage classes, they're capable of firing much further. Once members of the Society discovered the use of these weapons in the Inner Sphere, they immediate developed and proposed their own prototypes to Clan leadership. While rejected by the Khans, HVAC (S) cannons were found amongst the Society 'Mechs and vehicles used during the Wars of Reaving. \n\n Uses HVAC5 Ammo.
column2: 超高速自动炮(HVAC)武器家族以自动炮为基础. 虽然它们具有相同的伤害等级，但射程更远. 当秘社的成员发现内天体在使用这些武器时，他们立即开发并向氏族领导层提出了自己的原型. 尽管被可汗们否决，但HVAC加农炮仍然在焚风战争期间使用的秘社机甲和车辆中被发现.\n\n 使用HVAC5弹药.

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The 9T variant of the Zeus was introduced in 3062 just prior to the civil war and carried the 6T to its next logical step. As its primary weapon, the 9T carried an ER PPC, backed by an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system for greater missile accuracy and twice as much ammunition capacity. Also, for long-range combat, the 9T carried an ER Large Laser, while for close combat the 'Mech was armed with two 中型脉冲激光s and an ER 中型激光. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯机甲最初由天琴共同体于2787年首次继承战争爆发之际建造，应共和国武装部队指挥官对新型轻量级突击机甲的需求而生. 宙斯拥有足以匹敌多数重型机甲的高机动性，且具备与它们正面交锋的压倒性战力. 3062年内战前夕推出的9T型号，将6T系列的设计理念推进至全新高度. 该机型主武器为增程粒子加农炮，辅以搭载阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的LRM-15导弹发射器，在显著提升射击精度的同时将弹药容量倍增. 远程交战方面，9T配备大型增程激光；近身近战时则由两门中型脉冲激光与一门中型增程激光构成火力网. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: Originally entered as the 破坏球 before just rolling with an autocorrect error and made famous by Cyrus Miles in the arenas, this '机甲 was a last ditch attempt from Montana Customs after the team owner's wife, Hannah, was awarded the team stable, house, kids, and the cybernetic half of the dog in the divorce. With almost nothing left, the team found a junkyard Urbanmech and welded on anything that wasn't bolted down. This underdog ended up winning the season, beating out the ex-wife's stable and saving Montana Customs from bankruptcy. 怪癖: 360° Torso Twist 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
