A Supercharger and MASC help the 设计 accelerate to 108 km/h when going flat out. Reactive 装甲 and 16 DHS round out the 设计. Quirk: 超伸展驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一款旨在修正初代泰坦缺陷的星际联盟时代机甲，毁灭者在3023年被恒星联邦重新发现. 毁灭者DVS-X10（缪斯地球）搭载一台400级XXL引擎，配备两门重型粒子加农炮与两门中等可变脉冲激光，并借助超级增压器与MASC系统，在全力冲刺时可达108公里/小时的极速. 反应装甲与十六套双效散热系统使设计更为完善. 特质: 超伸缩驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R63 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。 Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 专为城市近距离战斗设计，R61L与其价格较低的R60L系列机甲均换装了潜行装备，并搭载AC20. 特质: 360°躯干转动 部署费用倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Radius RDS-6 is an 85-ton 布雷克圣言会 assault platform built around a C3 Master Computer occupying the entire left torso, 设计ed to coordinate networked lance members rather than win battles through raw firepower. Three arm-mounted Light PPCs provide reliable energy-based support fire, while a right-arm MRM 40 paired with an Apollo Fire Control System delivers punishing close-range volleys. Six 改进的 Jump Jets grant unexpected battlefield mobility for a machine of this size. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.15
column2: Radius RDS-6是一款85吨级的布雷克圣言会突击平台，其核心是一台占据了整个左躯干的C3主控计算机，旨在协调网络化小队成员，而非单纯依靠火力赢得战斗. 三具臂装轻型PPC提供可靠的能量辅助火力，而右臂搭载的MRM 40与阿波罗火控系统搭配，能倾泻猛烈的近距离齐射. 六具改进型跳跃喷口为此等吨位的机甲赋予了意想不到的战场机动性. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.15

column1: The Ghostmaker balances heavy armor and average speed with overwhelming firepower. Its primary weapons are paired RAC-5s, each carrying five tons of ammo, allowing it to sustain prolonged combat. James’s skill ensures these rotary autocannons rarely jam, making them a formidable threat. Secondary weapons include four ER 中型激光s and paired Medium Pulse and ER Small Lasers, providing solid short-to-medium range firepower in case of rotary jams. Twelve double heat sinks manage heat during intense firing, though James mainly relies on lasers as a backup. Despite its power, James is disappointed by the Ghostmaker’s lack of speed, limited by a 300 XL Fusion engine. Quirk: 精准武器 - 自动炮 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 幽灵制造者机甲在厚重装甲与中等速度之间实现了火力碾压的平衡. 其主武器为双联装RAC/5，每门配备五吨弹药储备，使其能长时间维持高强度作战. 詹姆斯精湛的操控技艺让这些转管自动炮极少卡壳，成为令人生畏的战场杀器. 辅助武器包括四门中型增程激光及双联中型脉冲激光与小型增程激光，在转管自动炮卡壳时提供可靠的中近距离火力. 十二台双散热器管控猛烈开火时的热量，不过詹姆斯主要将激光作为备用武装. 尽管火力强悍，受限于300 XL聚变引擎导致的机动短板，幽灵制造者的速度始终令詹姆斯如鲠在喉. 特质: 精准武器 - 自动炮 部署费用倍率: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: For each completed Argo upgrade, you gain 2000 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每项已完成的阿尔戈号升级项目，你会获得2000分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: This version of the Kuma is based on the original model developed. It carries an ER Large Laser backed up by two ER 中型激光s. Each arm and torso location are equipped with a Harjel III repair system. Quirk: 精准武器 - 激光 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2:
这个版本的Kuma基于原始型号开发. 它配备了一门大型增程激光，并由两门中型增程激光提供辅助火力. 每个手臂和躯干部位都安装了一套Harjel III修复系统. 

<color=#e62e00>特质: 精准武器 - 激光</color>

<color=#e62e00>部署费用倍率: 1.14</color>

<color=#FFEF00>手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂</color>

column1: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike '机甲 that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the 球体共和国. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A 比格犬主动探头 allows the Ghost to find enemy units, and a 守护者ECM Suite allows the '机甲 to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins. This Ghost variant introduced in 3082 is popular with mercenary commands and is available for purchase by anyone. The key difference is the Stealth 装甲 has been removed and replaced by conventional 装甲. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.02
column2: 作为“狮鹫（Griffin）”机甲在圣战末期的补充机型，幽灵机甲是一款中型突击机甲，在球体共和国建立后的数年间得到了广泛应用. 这款由天琴共同体与前自由世界联盟残部共同开发的机甲，配备了整套电子战装备投入战场. 其搭载的贝格尔主动探测仪可精准定位敌方单位，而守护者ECM套件则让机甲名副其实地化身战场幽灵. 凭借卓越的地面机动速度与强悍的中程火力配置，幽灵机甲在猎杀行动与重型突袭任务中表现尤为出色，与狮鹫机甲协同作战时更能发挥战术优势. 这款于3082年推出的幽灵变体在佣兵部队中广受欢迎，且面向所有势力开放采购. 其核心差异在于移除了潜行装甲，改用常规复合装甲. 特质: 强化传感器 部署费用倍率: 1.02

column1: Ballistic-加固装甲 was created as a response to autocannon and missile weapons. The armor is a combination of Hardened and Reactive Armor that reduces damage taken from both ballistic and missile weapons. The armor is also known as ''reinforced'' armor, but many techs use the term ''hardened light'' to describe it. A thinner version of hardened armor is backed by cable mesh that warps and traps missile and ballistic ammunition.
column2: 弹道强化装甲是为应对自动炮与导弹武器而造。它是硬化装甲与反应装甲的结合，可减少来自弹道与导弹武器的伤害。这种装甲又称“强化”装甲，但许多技师用“硬化轻型”来形容它。较薄的硬化装甲由缆网支撑，缆网会扭曲并困住导弹与弹道弹药。

column1: The Wraith TR4 is the mass 生产 variant created from the TR4-X development prototype. By downgrading the engine core from a 385 to a 330 rating, the '机甲 is able to mount a more powerful weapons package than its prototype predecessor; a snub-nose PPC with an attach PPC Capacitor and a medium VSP Laser. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 幽灵 TR4 是由 TR4-X 开发原型衍生而来的大规模量产型号. 通过将引擎核心等级从 385 下调至 330，这台机甲能够搭载比其原型机更强大的武器配置: 一门配备粒子加农炮电容器的短管粒子加农炮，以及一门中型 VSP 激光. 特质: 普及 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: This variant of the 2D chassis was used as a prototype platform for pulse lasers.
column2: 2D 底盘的这种变体被用作脉冲激光器的原型平台。

column1: 大妖怪重八十吨，最高速度 64.8 公里/小时，对突击机甲而言算是不错的地面速度。 Quirk: 模块化武器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这台机甲似乎在驾驶舱内安装了一个老式电话亭，上面写着“打电话回家”. 特质: 武器稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Zeus was first built by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2787, just as the First Succession War began. Built at the request of Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces commanders for a new light-assault 'Mech, the Zeus is fast enough to keep up with most heavy 'Mechs, and is equally capable of defeating them. The Zeus 5S is an original model Zeus, carrying a similar loadout to the normal -6S but making good use of Star League technology to increase both its hitting power and its heat management, making the -5S a terrifying mech on the battlefield. 特性：Barrel Fist 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 宙斯机甲最早由天琴共同体于2787年建造，恰逢第一次继承战争爆发. 应天琴共同体武装部队指挥官对新式轻型突击机甲的要求而设计，宙斯的速度足以跟上大多数重型机甲，且同样有能力击败它们. 宙斯5S是宙斯的原始型号，装备与标准-6S相似，但充分利用星联技术提升了打击威力与热量管理能力，使-5S成为战场上令人胆寒的机甲. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: This is obviously going to be a fight, so you get things started early by sucker punching the group's leader in the gut. Meanwhile, {TGT_MW.Callsign} slugs another thug in the gut. Then the rest charge, and you're quickly overwhelmed by sheer numbers. The fight is going poorly enough that when the local police arrive, you're relieved.\\n\\nThree hours later, you've paid a ¢100,000 fine, the medics are done treating {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s injuries, and you're both on your way back to the Argo. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, "Sorry about that, Commander. I didn't think that the Syndicate was still looking for me."
column2: 显然这将是一场战斗，所以你可以通过猛击该组织领导者的腹部来尽早开始行动。与此同时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 猛击另一个暴徒的肠道。然后剩下的人就会发起进攻，你很快就会被庞大的数字淹没。战斗进展得很糟糕，当当地警察到达时，你松了口气。\\n\\n三个小时后，你支付了 100,000 英镑的罚款，医务人员完成了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 伤势的治疗，你们俩都在返回 Argo 的路上。 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}，“抱歉，指挥官，没想到辛迪加还在找我。”

column1: 设计 and 生产 in limited numbers by Luthien 装甲 Works, the DRX Dragon II Omni was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The primary configuration is a bit of a showcase model, mounting a 雷电20 launcher with six tons of ammo filling a wide variety of roles. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 由卢锡安装甲工厂设计并小批量生产的DRX 龙 II 全方位型，是后来成为DRG-11K的前身，堪称雄心勃勃的尝试. 其主要配置算是一种展示型号，装备了一具雷霆20发射器，并携带六吨弹药，可胜任多种任务角色. 特质: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.07 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: The Boyyi 1 is built for speed and firepower, centered around a massive XXL engine and an active probe mounted deep in its torso. This grants speeds comparable to many combat VTOLs, with a supercharger enabling short bursts of even greater velocity, albeit with high risk. Armed with 改进的 Heavy Lasers for close combat, the Boyyi excels in detection, evasion, and pursuit, thanks to intensive training by Stone Lion reconnaissance pilots. Though some Coyote pilots seek more “Clan-like” assignments, the invasion’s urgency has kept them committed, making the Boyyi a versatile and vital asset in the Touman’s operations. 怪癖: 高级光学系统 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Boyyi 1是一款以速度和火力为核心设计的机体，其核心是一台巨大的XXL引擎以及深埋于躯干内部的主动探测系统. 这使其拥有媲美许多战斗VTOL的速度，而超充器还能让它在短时间内爆发出更高的速度，尽管这会带来较高的风险. Boyyi 1装备了用于近距离作战的改进型重激光，并凭借石狮氏族侦察机师的强化训练，在探测、闪避和追击方面表现卓越. 虽然部分郊狼氏族机师希望获得更具“氏族风格”的任务安排，但入侵行动的紧迫性使他们仍然坚守岗位，让Boyyi成为Touman行动中一种多用途且不可或缺的资产. 特质: 高级光学系统 部署费用倍率: 1.03 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用.

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine X was 设计ed by a wealthy Heir to compete in the Arenas as a pasttime. Quirk: 防护驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 另一台索拉里斯定制机甲，狼獾 X 型由一位富有的继承人所设计，作为他在竞技场中的消遣活动. 特质: 受保护驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.09

column1: When utilized in a more defensive role, the Incursion ICR-N5 was often found lacking. The upgraded ICR-N5-3 tried to address this by upgrading to double heat sinks and dropping the AMS and 远程传感器投放器. This allowed adding a 中型激光 and a SRM-2 launcher. As a final touch three of the Small Lasers were exchanged for two Machine Guns to improve the heat profile. Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: When utilized in a more defensive role, the Incursion ICR-N5 was often found lacking. The upgraded ICR-N5-3 tried to address this by upgrading to double heat sinks and dropping the AMS and Remote Sensor Dispenser. This allowed adding a Medium Laser and a SRM-2 launcher. As a final touch three of the Small Lasers were exchanged for two Machine Guns to improve the heat profile. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

column1: The Gryphon A configuration is an all-around fighter reminiscent of the Hellbringer Prime. It mounts an iATM-6, two ER 大型脉冲激光s, and a single ER 中型激光. With three tons of ammunition for the iATM and six additional 双散热器, this variant emphasizes endurance and accuracy over raw damage output. Quirk: 战斗计算机 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 狮鹫A型是一款全能战士，其设计理念令人联想到地狱使者PRIME. 搭载一门iATM-6导弹系统、两门大型增程脉冲激光和一门中型增程激光，配备三吨iATM弹药并额外加装六组双散热器，该改型更注重持续作战能力与精准打击，而非单纯追求爆发伤害. 特质: 战斗计算机 部署费用倍率: 1.1 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: Like the J configuration, this version uses five 改进型跳跃推进器. It also has twenty double heat sinks. It's equipped with four 大型脉冲激光s, two 小型脉冲激光s, two Flamers, and an ER 中型激光. It also has a Light TAG and 轻型 主动探头. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 与J型配置类似，该版本使用了五个改进型跳跃推进器，并配备了二十个双散热器. 武器方面搭载了四门大型脉冲激光，两门小型脉冲激光，两具火焰喷射器以及一门中型增程激光. 此外还装有一具轻型目标指示器和一具轻型主动探测器. 特质: 坚固耐用 部署费用倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Named after the Vespa Genus of insects, the Vespa gunship is well equipped to sting it's opponents to death, one hit at a time. Hand made on the world of Redondo, the 15 ton Vespa has seen success across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. Produced by Vespa Inc since the 2843, the Gunship is exported at a rate of a couple of hundred a year to buyers everywhere. Powered by a 070 rated Fusion Core, the Vespa can reach speeds of 110kph and carries 3 tons of armour. A Large Laser is the Vespas only weapon. 生物群系限制：This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. 移动：11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前方 70 10 左侧 65 10 右侧 65 10 后方 50 10 总计 260 50 特性：突破一击
column2: Vespa炮艇以昆虫纲胡蜂属命名  装备精良  能够一次一击将对手蜇死. 在Redondo世界手工制造  15吨的Vespa在内天体和外 periphery 都取得了成功. 由Vespa Inc自2843年以来生产  该炮艇每年以数百台的速度出口到各地的买家. 由070额定聚变核心驱动  Vespa可达到110公里/小时的速度  并携带3吨装甲. 大型激光是Vespa唯一的武器. 环境限制: 该单位无法在月球环境部署. 移动: 11/17格 / 330/510米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 70 10 左侧 65 10 右侧 65 10 后方 50 10 总计 260 50 特质: 突破一击 #武器: 1x 短管PPC(海盗)

column1: Based on recovered blueprints from the fabled 'Guerrilla' was this Gauntlet Commissioned, 设计ed with mobility and long standing firepower in mind does it employ a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield and a 躯干挂载 Interface System. 怪癖: Adv. M.A.S.C. 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 基于传说中‘游击兵’机甲恢复的蓝图，这台‘铁手套’被正式列装，其设计兼顾机动性与持久火力，搭载了变色龙轻型偏振护盾与躯干安装式接口系统. 特质: 高级M.A.S.C.系统 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1: Where the elite meet, greet, and satisfy their most wicked desires is the slogan of Dustball, an inhospitable world that is vastly wealthy thanks to its pleasure palaces.
column2: “精英们在此相聚、寒宣，并满足他们最邪恶的欲望”是Dustball的标语. Dustball是一个不宜居住的世界，却因其享乐宫殿而极其富有.

column1: The F loadout combines rapid-fire and energy weaponry for versatile offensive roles. Twin 旋转高斯步枪s, prototypes from 狼獾氏族’s Project Omega, deliver high heat and burst damage, with a risky “Overload” mode for powerful single shots. Complementing these are two Ion Stream Projectors that scatter energized plasma particles for close-range suppression, backed by two i-LRM 15 launchers for indirect guided missile fire. A 中型脉冲激光 in the head provides additional short-range precision. Equipped with 比格犬探头, 守护者ECM, and the PHI Suite, this setup excels in flexible engagement but demands careful heat and ammo management. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.4 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: F配置结合了速射武器与能量武器，能够担任多种进攻角色. 两门转管高斯步枪源自幽灵熊氏族的“欧米伽计划”原型技术，可造成高热量与爆发性伤害，并具备风险较高的“过载”模式，用于发射威力强大的单发射击. 作为补充，该配置搭载了两具离子流投射器，能够散射高能等离子粒子，对近距离目标实施压制; 同时配备两具i-LRM 15发射器，用于进行间接制导导弹攻击. 头部安装的一门中型脉冲激光则提供额外的短距离精确火力. 该配置装备了比格犬探头、守护者电子对抗系统以及PHI套件，在灵活交战方面表现出色，但需要机师谨慎管理热量与弹药消耗. 特质: 多重追踪 部署费用倍率: 1.4 手臂驱动器限制: 万能

column1:
<color=#BFBFBF>短ly after arriving in orbit over {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, Farah flags a new encrypted packet pushed through the secure [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]] channel Mizuki provided during your first briefing.

Once decrypted, the payload opens to reveal a dense starmap overlay. Thirteen systems, scattered across the deep Rimward Periphery, marked with internal 明尼苏达部落 设计ations. Each one represents a known or previously dormant asset: remote facilities, resource stockpiles, fallback shelters, and research outposts.

These are not battlefield rumors or salvage logs. This is real infrastructure. Real reach. And it's only being shared with your crew now that you've joined their side.

Another entry stands out, a simple statement likely based on your own reports.</color>

<color=#DFDFDF>"System Entry: MELIDRON – Noted under Potential Ghost Bear Watch Occupation"</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah skims the entry, already aligning the rest of the data to jump coordinates and threat overlays.</color> "Alright… syncing them in. Let's see what we're working with."

<color=#BFBFBF>For the first time, you see the scattered edge of the Tribe's real territory, or at last what they are willing to share with a newcomer. But these are no longer myths, no longer rumors. Just stars, waiting to be fought for.</color>
column2:
<color=#BFBFBF>抵达{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}轨道后不久，法拉发现了一份通过美月在首次简报中提供的安全[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe]部落]]频道推送的新加密数据包.

解密后，数据包展开成一张密集的星图叠层. 十三个星系分散在缘向外围区域，上面标记着明尼苏达部落内部使用的编号. 每一个都代表着一个已知或曾处于休眠状态的资产: 偏远设施、资源储备点、备用避难所以及研究前哨.

这些并非战场传闻或打捞记录.这是真实存在的基础设施. 真实的影响范围. 而直到你们加入他们一方后，他们才愿意与你的团队分享这些信息.

另一条记录引起了注意，一句简单的说明，显然是根据你们自己的报告整理而来.</color>

<color=#DFDFDF>“星系条目: MELIDRON——记录为潜在幽灵熊监察占领区”</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>法拉快速浏览着这条记录，同时已经将其余数据与跃迁坐标和威胁标记进行同步.</color>“好了……正在同步. 看看我们面对的是什么.”

<color=#BFBFBF>这是你第一次看到部落真正领土的零散边界，或者至少，是他们愿意向一名新加入者透露的部分. 但这些已经不再是传说，也不再是流言. 它们只是等待被争夺的星辰.</color>

column1: A Bondswoman was a prisoner taken during combat by a Clan, of any caste or rank, who was held as an indentured servant. Bondswomen were bound by tradition, rather than chains, to work dutifully for their new masters. For a bondswoman to purposefully neglect their responsibilities or even attempt escape stained not just their personal honor but the honor of their original Clan. Typically, a bondswoman would either be released from their bond and sent back home, with little honor lost, or after a given period of time, be adopted and become a free, full member of their new Clan. When and whether an individual was released from their servitude varied between Clans and individuals: some only spent a token amount of time before being freed from their bondscord, while others would live out the rest of their lives as bondswomen.
column2: 俘虏是指在战斗中氏族捕获的囚犯，不论其种姓或军衔如何，都会被当作契约仆役关押. 俘虏受传统约束，而非锁链，必须为他们的新主人勤勉工作. 如果俘虏故意玩忽职守甚至试图逃跑，不仅会玷污其个人荣誉，也会玷污其原属氏族的荣誉. 通常，俘虏要么被解除束缚送回故乡，荣誉损失甚微; 要么在特定时期后被接纳，成为新氏族的自由正式成员. 个人何时以及是否被解除劳役，因氏族和个体而异: 有些人只度过象征性的短暂时间便被释放，而另一些人则会终其一生作为俘虏.

column2: Ostwar OWR-2MX是OWR-2M的升级型号，移除了LRM和中型激光，改为配备双联SRM6发射器与3门大型增程激光. 采用XL引擎和钢内骨结构后，得以换装双散热系统以提升冷却效能，并将核心升级为325级别的聚变核心. 最特别之处在于SRM6发射器安装在双腿上，这种反常的发射角度往往能令敌方机甲战士措手不及. 特质: 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: This version removes the jump jets in favor of one more ton of armor.
column2: 这个版本去掉了跳跃喷气机，转而增加了一吨装甲。

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-6E is armed with a pair of RAC/5’s, with a pair of 中型激光s supporting the RAC’s at close range. A C3 Slave allows the HMH-5D to function as part of a C3 enabled Lance, while 改进型跳跃推进器 and TSM give it additional mobility. 守护者ECM adds to the Mechs defensive capabilities. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 早期的恒星联邦战斗机甲中，75吨的锤掌于2475年问世，是影响标志性战锤机甲的先驱设计之一. HMH-6E型锤掌配备225功率核聚变引擎，主武器为一对RAC/5转管自动炮，近接支援武器为两门中型激光. C3从属系统使其能作为C3网络矛线单元运作，而改良型跳跃推进器与三层强度分子肌肉赋予其更强的机动性能. 守护者电子对抗套件进一步强化了该机甲的防御能力. 特质: 炮管铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制: 左前臂、右前臂

column1: The Pit Viper A configuration mounts an Ultra AC/5 with two tons of ammo in the left torso and a 中型脉冲激光 on each arm. A 轻型 主动探头 in the head grants limited scout capability, allowing the Pit Viper A to relay battlefield data while still packing a solid punch. Quirk: 改进型瞄准 - 短程 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Pit Viper A型配置在左侧躯干安装了一门Ultra AC/5并配备两吨弹药，每只手臂各装有一门中型脉冲激光. 头部安装的轻型主动探测器赋予了有限的侦察能力，使Pit Viper A既能传递战场数据，又保持着强劲火力. 特质: 改进型瞄准 - 短程 部署费用倍率: 1.01 经Aries Games and Miniatures授权使用.

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the 全向Mech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-H is armed with a pair of Heavy Large Lasers. 6 Jump Jets, 2 ER 中型激光s and an ER Small Laser make up the rest of the 全向’s equipment. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 65吨的线卫于3052年投产，设计目的是取代木狼。它围绕一台390额定XL引擎建造，更快的速度让它能在运动中跟上更轻的星队同伴，而这正是木狼难以做到的。铁纤维装甲与钢内骨结构的组合为这款全向机甲提供了17.5吨自由挂载空间。线卫LBK-E装有一门增程大型激光和一对ATM-6，中央躯干装有一台轻型主动探测器。投放费用倍率：1.1。

column1: Kage（日语意为“影子”）轻型战斗装甲，是图卡伊德停战协定之后德拉科尼斯联合体首批生产的战斗装甲设计之一。Kage专为侦察与战场渗透而打造，其研发由内部安全部队的科学家与德拉科尼斯精锐突击队的顾问联合进行。事实上，Kage意在为备受推崇的DEST渗透服提供一种替代选择，用于DEST小队可能遭遇强力抵抗的任务；自3056年投产以来，这种战斗装甲几乎已经完全取代了更老旧的潜行服。 Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: 珊瑚意图项目的目标是用从新阿瓦隆突袭中缴获的布雷克逆向工程的拟态装甲和C3系统改装渗透者Mk II. 特质: 伏击者 部署费用倍率: 0.888 可挂载于万能单位，可近战，可攀附攻击.

column1: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to 双散热器. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H 锁定式SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这是联邦共同体在3050年对标准型Atlas进行的一项非常基本的升级，S型从设计中移除了五个散热器，并将其余的散热器升级为双散热器. 节省下来的重量被用于加装两具后射型的考文垂T4H型锁定式SRM-2发射器，增强了Atlas后方火力弧区的防护能力. 内战后，这一型号便停产了，但分裂后的两国驻军部队仍继续使用它们，其中恒星联邦武装力量部队为自动炮配备了精准弹药，而联邦同盟军部队则使用了从自由世界联盟缴获的特制LRM弹药. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.18

column1:
You and Darius have finished networking for new contracts on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and find yourself in the tiniest dive bar in the port, along with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who is on shore leave.

Darius groans as a musician mounts the stage and begins to tune his guitar. {TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. "Come on, give the guy a chance."

And so he begins...

	"{COMMANDER.Callsign}!
	The MechWarrior called... {COMMANDER.Callsign}!"

Darius and {TGT_MW.Callsign} exchange jaw-dropped looks. The musician continues, while the rest of the bar sings along.

	"The Steiners attacked, and we hid underground.
	We couldn't escape, we soon would be found.
	Our love for {COMMANDER.OBJ} ain't hard to explain.
	The Hero of the Valley,
	{COMMANDER.Callsign} is {COMMANDER.DET} name!"

There are four more verses.
column2:
你和达吕斯在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上物色新合约的事宜已毕. 此刻正和正在休岸假的[[TGT_MW{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]一起，置身太空港最寒酸的小酒吧里. 

达吕斯呻吟了一声，因为一位乐手登上了舞台，开始调试吉他. {TGT_MW.Callsign}笑了出来.“拜托. 给那家伙一个机会.”

接着，他便开唱了......
“{COMMANDER.Callsign}！
那位机甲战士名叫......{COMMANDER.Callsign}！”

达吕斯和{TGT_MW.Callsign}交换了一个目瞪口呆的眼神. 而乐手继续唱着，酒吧里其余的人也跟着合唱起来. 

“施泰纳家攻打过来时，我们就藏在地底下，
眼看无处可逃，我们很快就会被人搜到，
大伙儿对{COMMANDER.Obj}的敬爱之情，哪用得着多说废话，
那位山谷里的英雄，
{COMMANDER.Callsign}就是{COMMANDER.Det}大名！”

后面还有四段.

column1: Gauntlet 是一款为莱拉联邦武装部队制造的中型全能机甲。它被设计成快速骑兵单位，既能跟上轻型机甲，又能发挥中型机甲的灵活性和火力。 Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Designed to support allies from range, the Carrier can hang back behind friendly lines where its lack of armor isn't a concern. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: 重型铁纤维装甲 Structure: Structure Values A S Front 300 50 Left 300 50 Right 300 50 Rear 270 50 Turret 270 50 Total 1440 250 Quirk: 精准武器 - 导弹

column1: The Siren Proto机甲 was originally 设计ed by 烟虎氏族 to serve as a reconnaissance unit. Its high speed allowed it to rush forward, find enemy forces, call in a missile strike, and evacuate without the enemy being able to see them. This version of the Siren is armed with a single AP Gauss Rifle. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.96
column2: 塞任原型机甲最初由烟虎氏族设计用作侦察单位. 其高速使其能够快速前出，发现敌军，呼叫导弹打击，并在敌人无法察觉的情况下撤离. 这一型号的塞任装备有一门AP高斯步枪. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 0.96

column1: Vacuum decreases heat sinking efficiency to 65%. Reduced gravity results in ballistic and missile weapons and jump jets having 15% more range.
column2: 真空环境将散热效率降低至 65%. 低重力使实弹与导弹武器以及跳跃推进器的射程增加 15%.

column1: The HBK-GI Grid Iron is the Hero variant of the Hunchback. It has the characteristic hunch with quirks that emphasize the Gauss Rifle and 中型脉冲激光s. It comes from the factory with 双散热器, Endo-Steel, and an XL engine. Unfortunately, since Gauss Rifles explode like ammo, the XL engine tends to be more of a downside. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: HBK-GI Grid Iron 是驼背机甲的英雄型号. 它拥有标志性的驼峰，其特点强化了高斯步枪和中型脉冲激光的性能. 该机甲出厂即配备双散热器、钢内骨结构以及超轻引擎. 遗憾的是，由于高斯步枪会像弹药一样爆炸，超轻引擎反而往往成为一个弱点. 特质: 战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率: 1.06

column1: The Arion, 开发 by 氏族地狱马, is a versatile hybrid combat unit 设计ed for both Battle机甲 and 坦克 configurations. Equipped with an ER Large Laser and two SRM-4 launchers, the Arion is capable of delivering devastating firepower at medium to long ranges. With a top speed of 97 km/h, it can rapidly traverse the battlefield and reposition as needed. The Arion's conversion capability allows it to operate as either a fast, heavily armed Battle机甲 or a heavily 装甲ed 坦克 with a low profile, depending on the mission's needs. In Battle机甲 mode, the Arion is capable of agile and dynamic movements, thanks to its quadrupedal 设计. When converted to a 坦克, the Arion provides an 装甲ed, low-profile platform with a powerful punch. Despite its versatility, the Arion is not as heavily 装甲ed as traditional Battle机甲s, and its conversion process takes time and resources, making it less effective in rapidly changing combat situations. Nevertheless, its ability to perform in multiple roles makes it a valuable asset in a wide range of missions. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.06
column2: 阿瑞恩，由地狱战马氏族开发，是一种多用途混合战斗单位，兼具战斗机甲与坦克构型. 装备一门大型增程激光和两台SRM-4发射器，阿瑞恩能在中远距离上倾泻毁灭性的火力. 其最高时速达97公里，能快速穿越战场并按需重新部署. 阿瑞恩的转换能力使其可根据任务需要，或作为一台高速重武装战斗机甲，或作为一辆低轮廓的重装甲坦克运行. 在战斗机甲模式下，得益于四足设计，阿瑞恩能够进行敏捷灵动的机动. 转换为坦克后，阿瑞恩则提供一个装甲厚重、低矮轮廓且火力强劲的平台. 尽管用途广泛，阿瑞恩的装甲不如传统战斗机甲厚重，且转换过程需要时间和资源，使其在瞬息万变的战况中效率较低. 然而，其扮演多重角色的能力使其在广泛任务中成为一项宝贵资产. 特质: 受保护驱动器 部署费用倍率: 1.06

column1: A radical refit of the Venom, the -9KC has been modified to use an endo steel chassis, mounts eleven double heat sinks, and removes one of the medium pulse lasers. The '机甲 uses the saved weight to mount a single C3 slave unit, making the Venom capable of sharing targeting telemetry. 左侧over weight is used to mount additional 装甲 for a total of seven tons. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: 对毒液的彻底改造，-9KC型改用钢内骨结构，安装十一台双散热器，并移除了一门中型脉冲激光. 此机甲利用节省的重量安装了一台C3从机，使毒液能够共享目标遥测数据. 剩余重量用于加装额外装甲，总重达七吨. 特质: 灵活 部署费用倍率: 1.05

column1: 北极狼的设计理念很简单：贴近、倾泻导弹、然后撤离。为此，它装备六具1型SRM六连发发射器与两具1型交叉弹道SRM-4发射器。追踪者系列Narc导弹信标则提升了这些导弹的命中率。北极狼还拥有令人称道的四吨发射器弹药。这台机甲装有十具双散热器，只有在机甲战士执意长时间缠斗或全速运转时才会不堪重负。北极狼由六吨标准装甲提供防护。 Quirk: 高级光学系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: The 005 King Crab is an upgraded version of the 000 model introduced in 3062. The autocannons have been upgraded to LB-X Autocannon/20s and the large laser has been upgraded to an ER Large Laser. The LRM-15 has been completely removed from the ‘Mech and replaced with two 锁定式SRM-4s. The final upgrade is the inclusion of an improved C3 computer to allow the King Crab to work in concert with up to five other units sharing targeting telemetry. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 005型“帝王蟹（King Crab）”是3062年推出的000型的升级版本. 两门自动炮已升级为LB-X/20自动炮，大型激光升级为大型增程激光. LRM-15已从该机甲上完全移除，替换为两具锁定式SRM-4. 最后的改进是加装了一台改进型C3计算机，使帝王蟹能够与最多五个其他单位协同作战并共享目标遥测数据. 特质: 指挥型机甲 部署费用倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for Battle机甲s that were not ammunition dependent. The '机甲 was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The '机甲 is capable of speeds of up to 151 km/h and is 装甲ed with three and a half tons of 装甲. The '机甲, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon '机甲 and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.98
column2: 联邦合众国寻找不依赖弹药的战斗机甲时，Dart 应运而生。这台机甲以极高速底盘搭载全能量武器配置，最高速度可达 151 公里/小时，并装有三吨半装甲。虽然武装较轻，Dart 却是出色的侦察机甲；它的能量武器使其能够独立行动，在游击部队中同样表现出色。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Hellspawn was 设计ed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support Battle机甲. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL引擎 that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a 守护者ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of 装甲 that is barely adequate when compared to other medium '机甲s. To enhance the '机甲's mobility it has six jump jets. The 8E is a variant aimed at increasing the '机甲's long range effectiveness. Two of the 中型脉冲激光s have been traded for lighter ER 中型激光s and an Artemis IV system has been added to the LRMs. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Missile 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This 布雷克圣言会 variant was first spotted in 3069, this Demon 坦克 trades the turreted Gauss Rifle for a forward mounted 重型高斯步枪 with two tons of ammunition. The lasers are upgraded to Extended Range and the missile launcher is traded for a Streak version. The 车辆 is also equipped with a 定位 Computer, C3i system, and fitted with an Extra-Light Fusion 引擎 to allow it to carry the HGR. The standard 装甲 has also been replaced with 铁纤维装甲 装甲. The Demon was originally created by the SLDF as its standard fighting 车辆 in 2716. A match for any light or medium Battle机甲, the Demon had good maneuverability and was protected by ten tons of slab 装甲, most of it concentrated in its front. Due to the nature of its powerful main weapon the Demon was often used in ambush attacks and fought in pairs instead of the usual four-车辆 lance. The 车辆's main disadvantage was its lack of speed, which made it vulnerable to faster '机甲s and other 车辆s able to maneuver around and engage its weaker rear 装甲. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 260 30 左侧 160 30 右侧 160 30 后方 120 30 总计 700 120 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 这款 2721 年的 SLDF 型号以两具朝前的中型激光和两具额外散热器，取代了短程火箭发射器与 CASE。车体前弧另装有侧射中型激光。然而这样一来，除炮塔上的高斯步枪外，车辆其余侧面便失去武装。需要指出的是，该型号除防御阵地外极少部署。恶魔最初由 SLDF 于 2716 年打造，作为其标准战斗车辆。恶魔足以与任何轻型或中型战斗机甲匹敌，机动性良好，并由十吨厚板装甲保护，其中大部分集中在正面。凭借其强大主武器的特性，恶魔常用于伏击作战，并以两车编组行动，而非通常的四车小队。该车辆的主要缺点是速度不足，使其容易遭到更快的机甲和其他车辆绕过，攻击其较为薄弱的背部装甲。 生物群系限制：无。 移动力：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：标准装甲 结构：标准结构 数值 A S 正面 260 30 左面 155 30 右面 155 30 背面 110 30 炮塔 160 30 合计 840 150 特性：主战坦克

column1: The Moltke 主战坦克 was created for the Duchy of Andurien. The Duchy commissioned Brooks Inc. to create the 坦克 to enable the Duchy's military to fill its military gaps, without relying on outside sources for equipment and parts. The 坦克 is based on the Age of War Augustus A-3 Tank. The 坦克 began production in 3076, and has since been dispersed among the League forces on station in the Duchy. Outside parties have inquired to Brooks for purchasing the 坦克 for their forces. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 350 40 左侧 245 40 右侧 245 40 后方 160 40 炮塔 260 40 总计 1260 200 怪癖: Variable Range 定位
column2: 莫尔特克主战坦克是为安杜里恩公国打造的。公国委托布鲁克斯公司研发该坦克，以弥补本国军队的装备缺口，避免依赖外部来源获取装备和零部件。该坦克以战争年代的奥古斯都A-3型坦克为基础，于3076年开始投产，此后陆续配发给驻扎在公国的联盟军部队。外部势力也曾向布鲁克斯公司询价，希望为自己的部队采购该坦克。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6格 / 120/180米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 350 40 左侧 245 40 右侧 245 40 后方 160 40 炮塔 260 40 总计 1260 200 特性：可变距离瞄准

column1: Originally 开发 by 氏族火狒狒 during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HWR-6 uses a combination of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and Endo Steel; allowing the 机甲 to carry a pair of SRM-6’s with 2 tons of ammo in a shoulder 炮塔. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.97
column2: 20吨的嚎叫者最初由火沸部族在黄金世纪期间开发，是一台轻型支援机甲。嚎叫者HWR-1围绕一具额定140的聚变核心打造，采用铁纤维装甲与内骨架的组合，从而得以携带3具LRM-5与3吨弹药。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.97

column1: The Ogre heavy battle 装甲 has a physically intimidating appearance, largely due to the twin 重型战斗爪 used as weapons and Tvastar's choice to use an unusually wide frame for the suit. Despite that appearance, the Ogre isn't well-suited to fighting conventional infantry, but the heavy 装甲 and weapons mounted on the Ogre allows it to attack enemy 装甲, and actions in certain early battles saw the Ogre gain a reputation for tearing 坦克s in half - a reputation that was rather fanciful, but did serve to enhance the Ogre's reputation. The Ogre has since been exported outside the Regulan Fiefs by Tvastar, with the Duchy of Andurien and the Lyran Commonwealth both ordering large production runs. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, 可以近战, 不能群聚.
column2: 食人魔重型战斗装甲外形极具压迫感，主要归功于用作武器的一对重型战斗爪，以及特瓦斯塔为装甲服选用的异常宽大框架。尽管外表威猛，食人魔并不擅长对付普通步兵；不过，其厚重装甲与所搭载的武器足以攻击敌方装甲单位。在早期几场战斗中，食人魔曾因把坦克撕成两半而声名大噪——这种说法颇为夸张，却确实进一步提升了它的名声。此后，特瓦斯塔将食人魔出口到雷古兰封地以外，安杜里恩公国和莱拉联邦都订购了大批产品。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：0.892 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可被攀附。

column1: This configuration is principally armed with a pair of shoulder mounted LRM-15 launchers with four tons ammunition. For close-range fighting, the '机甲 utilizes a pair of SRM-6 launchers with an accompanying small pulse laser in each arm. For added protection, the '机甲 is fitted with an ECM suite.
column2: 这套配置的主要武器是肩部的一对 LRM-15 发射器，并配有 4 吨弹药。近距离作战时，这台机甲使用一对 SRM-6 发射器，双臂还各装有一门小型脉冲激光。为增强防护，机体另配 ECM 套件。

column1: The Argus is first and foremost a close combat 'Mech. For this reason, the Argus carries a 转管自动炮/5 and a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. The Argus has a single Machine Gun to defend itself against infantry attacks, and an  LRM-10 launcher  provides the Argus with some long range striking capabilities. The 转管自动炮/5 and the ER 中型激光s are linked to an advanced 瞄准计算机 which makes them extremely accurate.
column2: 阿古斯首先是一台近距离格斗机甲，因此配备一门旋转自动炮/5和一对 ER 中型激光。它还装有一挺机枪，用于抵御步兵攻击；LRM-10 发射器则赋予它一定的远程打击能力。旋转自动炮/5和 ER 中型激光连接至先进瞄准计算机，因此精度极高。

column1: This variant is as if a later Marauder 设计 was meshed with the base variant of the Bandersnatch. As to if it is an upgrade or not, I leave for you to decide.
column2: 这个型号仿佛将后期的掠夺者设计与班德斯纳奇的基础型号融合在一起。它究竟算不算升级，就留给你来判断。

column1: The Basilisk ProtoMech was designed and built by 云蛇氏族 to support their Elemental and OmniMech forces. Unlike most second generation Protos, the Basilisk has a relatively low top speed. The Basilisk mounts a 'Mech sized ER 中型激光. Paired with the laser is a three tube LRM launcher used to soften up targets as the Basilisk unit closes. The only problem with this is the severely limited ammunition supply.
column2: 巴西利斯克原型机甲由钢爪氏族设计并制造，用于支援其元素战士与 OmniMech 部队。与大多数第二代原型机甲不同，巴西利斯克的最高速度相对较低。它搭载一门与普通机甲同规格的 ER 中型激光，并以一具三联装 LRM 发射器配合攻击，在巴西利斯克接近目标时先行削弱敌人。其主要缺点是弹药储量严重不足。

column1: The late 3050s and early 3060s saw the Absorption of 伯洛克氏族 by 星蝰氏族. After the proof of collusion with the Bandit Caste, most Burrocks were eager to be rid of the taint of corruption. The Star Adders read this as a desire to join a more powerful Clan, so they were surprised when many former Burrocks clung to that identity. In order to appeal to them, the Star Adder leadership authorized a new BattleMech to honor them. The Burrock is a fast heavy 'Mech with incredible short-range firepower. Though its XL engine leaves it somewhat vulnerable, the Burrock is protected by twelve and a half tons of armor.
column2: 3050 年代末至 3060 年代初，星蝰氏族吞并了土匪氏族。土匪阶级与其勾结的证据曝光后，大多数布洛克人都急于摆脱腐败污名。星蝰氏族将此理解为他们希望加入更强大的氏族，因此当许多前布洛克人仍坚持原有身份时，星蝰氏族颇感意外。为争取他们的支持，星蝰氏族领导层批准制造一款新战斗机甲以纪念他们。布洛克是一台速度较快的重型机甲，近距离火力惊人。尽管 XL 引擎令它略显脆弱，12.5 吨装甲仍为其提供了可靠防护。

column1: This variant is built using a Hollis Marik III Endo Steel chassis and powered by a Magna 260 extralight engine, using the saved weight to make the C2 a dedicated long range 'Mech. The primary weapons are two Federated LRM-15 launchers mated to an Artemis IV fire control system. The 中型激光s have been replaced with two Defiance Shredder LB-X Autocannon/2s. While this makes the Catapult vulnerable to close range attacks, it also makes it extremely deadly at long range.
column2: 该型号采用 Hollis Marik III Endo Steel 底盘，并由 Magna 260 超轻型引擎驱动；节省出的重量使 C2 成为专精远程作战的机甲。主武器是两具联邦 LRM-15 发射器，并配有 Artemis IV 火控系统。中型激光被两门 Defiance Shredder LB-X 自动炮/2取代。虽然这种改装使弹射者更容易受到近战攻击，却也让它在远距离极具杀伤力。

column1: This variant of the Centurion, introduced in 3062, is inspired by the CN9-D and uses the same engine and chassis. The 'Mech uses MASC to allow it bursts of speed reaching up to 129.6 km/h while the weapons compliment has been completely removed. In their place the 'Mechs primary weapon is a 转管自动炮/5, backed up by two ER medium lasers. To direct this firepower, the 'Mech uses an advanced 瞄准计算机 and the 'Mech carries a C3 Slave unit to allow it to share targeting data with its lance mates.
column2: 这款百夫长改型于 3062 年推出，设计灵感来自 CN9-D，并沿用相同的引擎和底盘。机体使用 MASC 突进，短时间内最高速度可达 129.6 公里/小时；与此同时，原有武器配置被完全拆除。取而代之的是一门旋转自动炮/5作为主武器，并由两门 ER 中型激光支援。机体使用先进瞄准计算机引导火力，并搭载 C3 从属单元，以便与同一长机队的友军共享目标数据。

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-6C is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of ER Small Lasers. A 瞄准计算机 enhances the Laser’s accuracy while AMS defends against incoming missiles.
特性：窄小低矮轮廓
部署费用倍率：1.05
column2: 猎鹰 FLC-6C 是为星盟国防军统一战争后的需求而设计的侦察兼反步兵机甲。作为一台 30 吨级轻型机甲，它搭载 180 级聚变核心。FLC-6C 配备一门 ER 大型激光和一对 ER 小型激光；瞄准计算机提高激光精度，AMS 则用于拦截来袭导弹。

column1: 特性：狭窄型装甲
部署费用倍率：1.03
column2: Remediated-LLM

column1: 为SLDF在统一战争之后设计，猎鹰是侦察机甲猎手兼反步兵机甲。作为30吨轻型机甲，猎鹰由一具180级聚变核心驱动。The Falcon FLC-6C is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of ER Small Lasers. A 瞄准计算机 enhances the Laser’s accuracy while AMS defends against incoming missiles.
column2: 猎鹰 FLC-6C 是为星盟国防军统一战争后的需求而设计的侦察兼反步兵机甲。作为一台 30 吨级轻型机甲，它搭载 180 级聚变核心。FLC-6C 配备一门 ER 大型激光和一对 ER 小型激光；瞄准计算机提高激光精度，AMS 则用于拦截来袭导弹。

column1: Another long-range configuration of the Firestarter, the G configuration mounts an LB-X Autocannon/5. For close combat, the 'Mech carries three 中型激光s and a pair of Flamers that allow the Firestarter to start fires to create smoke to cover its movement.
column2: 这是火蜥蜴的另一种远程配置：G 型安装一门 LB-X 自动炮/5。近距离作战时，机甲配备三门中型激光和一对火焰喷射器；火焰喷射器能够点燃地面，并制造烟幕掩护机体移动。

column1: The Great Turtle was designed as an experiment in MechWarrior safety. With the recovery of the Helm Memory Core, weapons technology had advanced more in the twenty years between the Fourth Succession War and the 氏族入侵 than it had in the previous three hundred years. One effect of these advances in weapons was the dramatic reduction in a MechWarrior's life expectancy. Many weapons could destroy a 'Mech's head, engine, or gyro with one shot, leaving the MechWarrior dead or wounded. VEST took the concept of MechWarrior protection to an extreme. The Great Turtle uses a quad chassis to hold the maximum amount of armor possible. The Great Turtle's armor weighs 40 tons, as much as a Clint BattleMech. For more protection the VEST engineers used experimental 加固装甲 that effectively provides twice as much protection as standard armor. This means that the Great Turtle can take staggering amounts of damage without worrying the pilot. Enemies who target the 'Mech's head looking for a clean kill will be disappointed. The Hardened armor can withstand a Gauss rifle hit, but more importantly, the Great Turtle uses a 躯干挂载 Cockpit to provide extra protection for the pilot. Using a standard engine reduces the possibility of an engine explosion, and a compact gyro further increases longevity.
column2: 巨龟最初是为测试机甲战士安全性而设计的实验机。Helm 记忆核心重见天日后，从第四次继承战争到“圣战”之间的 20 年里，武器技术取得的进步超过此前 300 年的总和。这些进步也大幅缩短了机甲战士的预期寿命：许多武器一击便能摧毁机甲头部、引擎或陀螺仪，令驾驶员死亡或重伤。VEST 将保护机甲战士的理念发挥到极致。巨龟采用四足底盘，以容纳尽可能多的装甲；其装甲重达 40 吨，与一台 Clint 战斗机甲相当。VEST 工程师还试用了实验性加固装甲，使其防护能力实际上达到标准装甲的两倍。因此，巨龟能够承受惊人的伤害，让驾驶员无需担忧。瞄准机甲头部、企图一击毙命的敌人会失望而归。强化装甲甚至能够抵挡高斯步枪的命中；更重要的是，巨龟使用生存型驾驶舱，为驾驶员提供额外保护。标准引擎降低了引擎爆炸的可能性，紧凑型陀螺仪则进一步延长了机体寿命。

column1: A variant of the 6S developed in 3067 for the Com Guards only to also fall into hands of the 布雷克圣言会, the 6CS used an Endo Steel frame and was powered by an extralight engine. The 'Mech's primary weapons were an ER PPC and an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launcher. The 6CS carries two ER medium lasers for short range engagements, and has an advanced electronics warfare suite, consisting of a 守护者ECM Suite and a C3i computer, to allow it to share targeting telemetry with friendly units.
column2: 6CS 是 6S 的改型，最初于 3067 年为 Com Guard 开发，后来也落入圣殿骑士团之手。它采用 Endo Steel 框架，并由超轻型引擎驱动。主武器为一门 ER PPC 和一具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM-15 发射器；两门 ER 中型激光用于短程交战。先进电子战套件由 Guardian ECM 和 C3i 计算机组成，可与友军共享目标遥测数据。

column1: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。Thirteen tons of 装甲 are mounted on an Endo Steel frame. Jump jets are mounted so that the Grizzly can leap up to 120 米 at a time. Aside from the 'jack of all trades, master of none' moniker, the Grizzly is also poorly engineered. Slagged 装甲 tends to get stuck in joints and weapons, while the actuators are difficult to repair in their own right.
column2: 灰熊是一台笨重的机甲，设计于 20 世纪 80 年代的资源战争期间。它在各方面都显得平庸，因此从未在机甲设计史上占据重要地位。机体采用 Endo Steel 框架，装有 13 吨装甲；跳跃喷射器可使灰熊一次跃进 120 米。除了“样样通、样样松”这一绰号之外，灰熊的工程设计也相当糟糕：熔渣装甲容易卡进关节和武器机构，执行器本身也很难维修。

column1: Designed in 2499 for the 泰拉霸权 and later the SLDF, the Guillotine served as a heavy raider; using a combination of speed and Jump Jets to out manoeuvre opponents. The Guillotine 8D is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a quartet of ER 中型激光s, backed up by a 锁定式SRM-6 for close range engagements.
column2: 断头台于 2499 年为泰拉霸权设计，后来也由星盟国防军使用。它是一款重型突袭机甲，利用速度与跳跃喷射器机动，绕开对手。断头台 8D 配备一对 ER 大型激光和四门 ER 中型激光，并以一具 Streak SRM-6 发射器支援近距离交战。

column1: The Hunchback C is the antithesis of the 驼背 IIC used by other Clans, combining toughness and great ground speed with the heavy firepower of its autocannon. Piloted by Star Commander Matthew Wayne, of the Clan Ghost Bear's Seventh Phalanx. Disgraced after losing his OmniMech and from an insignificant Bloodhouse, he saw it as his only resort to take charge of a Hunchback of Lyran origins. However, heavy modifications to the 'Mech and his unrelenting desire to redeem himself led to him eventually being adopted by Delta Galaxy's Seventy-Third Battle Cluster, before he finally was killed while clearing Blakists during a glorious charge at Fell's Fort.
column2: 驼背 C 与其他氏族使用的巨型驼背 IIC 截然相反，兼具坚固耐用、地面速度出色和自动炮火力强大等特点。它由幽灵熊氏族第七方阵的星队指挥官 Matthew Wayne 驾驶。失去自己的 OmniMech、又因出身于不起眼的血宅而蒙羞后，他认为驾驶一台源自莱茵同盟的驼背是唯一出路。然而，他对机甲进行的大幅改造，加上始终不渝的自我救赎之志，最终使他获准加入三角星系第七十三战斗集群。后来，他在费尔堡的一次英勇冲锋中清剿圣战军时阵亡。

column1: The Lao Hu is capable of engaging an enemy at most any range. For long-range combat, the Lao Hu has a Martell ER Large Laser and a Zeus LRM-15 launcher, giving the '机甲 a powerful long range punch. For close combat, the Lao Hu has a devastating Shengli LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of firing both solid rounds for 装甲 penetration and cluster rounds allowing it to find holes in already damaged 装甲 and for anti-aircraft use.
column2: 老虎能够在几乎任何距离与敌人交战。远程作战时，它配备 Martell ER 大型激光和一具 Zeus LRM-15 发射器，具有强大的远程打击能力。近战时，老虎使用威力惊人的 Shengli LB-X 自动炮/20：既可发射实心弹穿透装甲，也可发射集束弹，利用已受损装甲上的缺口；此外还能用于防空。

column1: A recent upgrade of the Lineholder, this variant of the 'Mech carries a pair of 转管自动炮/2s in place of the two LRM-5 launchers and the four 中型激光s. The LH8 also carries an ER Large Laser in place of the Large Laser. Nicknamed the Linebreaker, this variant was designed for the Federated Suns. Following the commencement of the Jihad, however, production ceased.
column2: 这是 Lineholder 的近期升级型，以一对旋转自动炮/2取代两具 LRM-5 发射器和四门中型激光。LH8 还以一门 ER 大型激光替换原有大型激光。该型号绰号“破线者”，专为联邦太阳设计。不过，圣战爆发后生产便停止了。

column1: This variant, based on the IIC 4, was 生产 by Clan Wolf on New Oslo and Satalice, though the latter fell to Clan Ghost Bear. Instead of heavy lasers, it mounts an ATM 3 in each arm, along with a ton of ammunition for each instead of the additional heat sinks of the previous variant.
column2: 该型号以 IIC 4 为基础，由狼氏族在新奥斯陆和萨塔利斯制造，后者后来落入幽灵熊氏族之手。它没有采用重型激光，而是在每条手臂各安装一具 ATM-3 发射器，并为每具发射器配备 1 吨弹药；相较上一型号，这一配置取消了额外散热器。

column1: As with the 战锤 IIC, the 掠夺者 IIC is ten-tons heavier than its Inner Sphere progenitor, pushing it into the assault weight class, but otherwise the design usually matches the original's ground speed. Though both designs carry over ten tons of armor, the 掠夺者 IIC's use of more advanced ferro-fibrous plating gives it superior protection, with an endo steel frame freeing up weight. While structurally the 掠夺者 IIC appears to offer little advantage over the LosTech refitted Marauders introduced by the Successor States, the blatant superiority of Clan weaponry allows the design to pound its opponents to pieces in short order.
column2: 与战锤 IIC 一样，掠夺者 IIC 比其内层星域原型重 10 吨，因此归入突击级别；除此之外，它通常仍保持原型的地面速度。两种设计都配备超过 10 吨装甲，而掠夺者 IIC 采用更先进的 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲，防护能力更强；Endo Steel 框架则腾出了额外重量。单从结构上看，掠夺者 IIC 相较继承国推出的 Lostech 翻新掠夺者优势有限，但氏族武器的明显优势足以让它迅速将对手轰成碎片。

column1: A first generation BattleMech, the 50 ton Phoenix was the first native BattleMech to be built by the Rim Worlds Republic. Built with primitive components and powered by a 240-rated Fusion Core, the Phoenix 1KT is a Retrotech design produced by WRI Inc. The 1KT carries a 雷电10 and a pair of SRM-2’s.
column2: 第一代战斗机甲，重50吨的凤凰是边疆世界共和国制造的第一款本土战斗机甲。它采用原始部件，由额定功率240的聚变核心驱动。凤凰1KT是WRI公司的复古科技设计，装备一门雷电10和一对SRM-2。

column1: This configuration sports 改进型跳跃推进器 that allow the Preta to jump up to 240 meters. Offensively, it uses two pairs of arm-mounted ER 中型激光s guided by a 瞄准计算机. An extra pair of heat sinks keeps the heat buildup null.
column2: 该配置配备改进型跳跃推进器，使普瑞塔能够跳跃至240米。武器方面，它使用两对安装于手臂的增程中型激光，并由瞄准计算机辅助引导。额外的一对散热器可抑制热量累积。

column1: The Infernus variant is a mobile sniper and a capable light 'Mech killer. Six Jump Jets catapult the 'Mech up to 180 meters at a leap. A Heavy PPC gives the Preta B a respectable punch. It is supplemented by an ER 中型激光.
column2: 地狱火型是机动狙击配置，也是出色的轻型机甲杀手。六具跳跃推进器可使机甲一次跳跃180米。重型粒子加农炮为普瑞塔B提供了可靠的火力，另有一门增程中型激光作为补充。

column1: The Preta C is a scout variant with its 比格犬主动探头 and TAG. A 等离子步枪 is effective against all types of units. In close, the Comminus variant can call upon an ER Small Laser and two 中型脉冲激光s.
column2: 普瑞塔C是侦察配置，配备比格犬主动探头和TAG。等离子步枪能够有效对付各种单位。近距离作战时，康米努斯配置还可使用一门增程小型激光和两门中型脉冲激光。

column1: This variant is a capable knife fighter. Six Jump Jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 180 meters. A 短管PPC deals damage at long range, but is more powerful up close. A pair of 中型脉冲激光s are highly accurate, as are the twin 小型脉冲激光s that are so devastating against infantry.
column2: 该配置擅长近距离缠斗。六具跳跃推进器使最大跳跃距离达到180米。短管粒子加农炮可在远距离造成伤害，近距离威力更强；一对中型脉冲激光精度很高，双联小型脉冲激光对步兵也极具杀伤力。

column1: The primary variant, the Invictus, is armed with an incredibly accurate 可伸缩刀刃 for close combat. It also uses a Light PPC and a 短管PPC that deals more damage as the 'Mech closes with its opponent. The Invictus sports an anti-missile system for further defensive capabilities.
column2: 主力配置“无敌”装备了精度极高的可伸缩刀刃，适合近战。它还使用一门轻型粒子加农炮和一门短管粒子加农炮，后者会在机甲接近敌人时造成更高伤害。无敌配置另有反导系统，进一步增强防御能力。

column1: This configuration uses a Plasma Rifle for its main weapon. This is backed up by a single ER Small Laser and a trio of Small Pulse Lasers.
column2: 该配置以等离子步枪为主武器，辅以一门增程小型激光和三门小型脉冲激光。

column1: This variant developed in 3068 replaces the 守护者ECM suite with an Improved C3 Computer. The 中型脉冲激光s have been replaced with two ER 中型激光s.
column2: 该变体于3068年研发，以改进型C3计算机取代守护者ECM套件；原有的中型脉冲激光则替换为两门增程中型激光。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 12K is powered by a 330-rated XL Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A Snub Nose PPC, MML-9 and an ER 中型激光 form the Mechs weapons load. A C3 Master unit allows the Mech to command C3 equipped lances.
column2: 蝎子是最早量产的四足机甲之一。55吨的蝎子于2570年投入生产，作为步兵支援单位。由于步态极不稳定，它遭到许多机师嫌弃，但在继承战争及之后仍持续服役。蝎子12K由额定功率330的XL引擎驱动，最高速度达97公里/小时，武器包括短管粒子加农炮、MML-9和一门增程中型激光；C3主机可让它指挥配备C3的长枪。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1TB is powered by a 330-rated Light Fusion Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A pair of Light PPCs and an MML-9 form the Mechs weapons load. MASC provides improved speed for short periods.
column2: 蝎子是最早量产的四足机甲之一。55吨的蝎子于2570年投入生产，作为步兵支援单位。由于步态极不稳定，它遭到许多机师嫌弃，但在继承战争及之后仍持续服役。蝎子1TB由额定功率330的轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高速度达97公里/小时，装备两门轻型粒子加农炮和一门MML-9。MASC可在短时间内提升速度。

column1: Based on the Golden Age Storm Giant, the Scylla is an updated model developed by the Steel Vipers as a second line Battlemech. A 100-ton mech with a 400-rated XL Engine, the Scylla SCY-2 is armed with a pair of HAG-20’s. A 小型脉冲激光, a pair of 中型脉冲激光s and a pair of ER 中型激光s deter opponents from closing range with the Scylla.
column2: 斯库拉基于黄金时代的风暴巨人，是钢铁蝰蛇氏族为二线部队开发的改进型战斗机甲。100吨的斯库拉SCY-2配备额定功率400的XL引擎和两门HAG-20。另有一门小型脉冲激光、两门中型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光，用于阻止敌人接近。

column1: This variant was produced by Defiance after it was lost to 布雷克圣言会 during the Jihad. Built on the same chassis as the 3L, the 5WB removes the weapons and adds a ton of armor. It uses a 轻型引擎 for power, allowing it to mount a pair of 轻型自动炮/5s that are fed from a single, one-ton ammunition bin. Three ER 中型激光s back up the autocannon.
column2: 该变体由蔑视武器公司生产，源于圣战期间被布雷克圣言会夺取的设计。它采用与3L相同的底盘，拆除原有武器并增加一吨装甲。轻型引擎为一对轻型自动炮/5提供动力，弹药来自一个一吨弹药箱；三门增程中型激光为自动炮提供支援。

column1: This variant, introduced during the Jihad, uses advanced technology. Major changes to allow more equipment include the introduction of a Light Fusion Engine and a Heavy Duty Gyro. This new configuration allowed for a slight increase in the 'Mech's armor protection, with help from Light Ferro-Fibrous armor. All of the 'Mech's original weaponry is removed and replaced. The left arm now has a Large 变速脉冲激光 with a pair of Magshots. In the right arm, there are a pair of ER 中型激光s. The left torso has retained its CASE protection to keep the 'Mech safe in the event of a Magshot ammunition explosion.
column2: 该变体于圣战期间推出，采用先进技术。为容纳更多设备，它换装轻型聚变引擎和重型陀螺仪，并略微提高装甲防护。轻型铁纤维装甲进一步降低重量。机甲原有武器全部拆除并替换：左臂装备一门大型变速脉冲激光和一对Magshot；右臂装备两门增程中型激光。

column1: This configuration is apparently intended for space operations. Each arm carries an Arc Welder, a 中型脉冲激光 and an ER 中型激光. Two ER Small Lasers are in the right and left torso, while a single ER PPC is installed in the left torso. Seven 改进型跳跃推进器 and a series of Articulated Jump Jets provide mobility in the depths of space, with two tons of 液体储罐 that doubles as a Cooling Pod for increased stability. To maintain grip on spacecraft, the Septimecia US has talons on each leg.
column2: 该配置显然用于太空作战。每条手臂装备一台电弧焊机、一门中型脉冲激光和一门增程中型激光；左右躯干各有两门增程小型激光，左躯干另装一门增程粒子加农炮。七具改进型跳跃推进器和一组关节式跳跃推进器提供太空机动能力，两吨液体储罐兼作冷却舱以提高稳定性。为在飞船表面保持抓附，塞普蒂米西亚US的每条腿都装有爪。

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of OmniMechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Like the other Celestials, the Seraph makes use of a light fusion engine and a small cockpit, though other newer technologies are present only in its weaponry. As with the other Celestials, a C3i Computer is included. This variant uses a Heavy PPC to deliver a strong punch, and a 等离子步枪 to deal both damage and heat. An ER 中型激光 and a 中型脉冲激光 provide close support, while the 目标捕获装置 threatens opponents with homing artillery. A 瞄准计算机 helps these weapons find their mark, and 改进型跳跃推进器 allow the Seraph Dominus to move up to a hundred fifty meters at a time.

column1: A prototype that never saw widespread adoption, the Merlin 2A was Mountain Wolfs next generation offering unveiled alongside the 1B variant in 3053. Built around a 240-rated XL引擎, it is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulses. The 1A's Machine Gun is retained and the LRM-5 upgraded to a LRM-10. The addition of CASE protects the ammunition bays and 14 双散热器 handle the increased heat burden. At almost 19 million CBills, the design was rejected as too expensive and too reliant on advanced technology that the Outworlds Alliance struggled to produce. Mountain Wolf shelved the design, though not before a single run of 20 2A's were produced. Most of these were fielded by the Mountain Wolf security team, but some found their way into the hands of the elite Avellar Guard.

column1: Somewhat of a departure from most 氏族战斗机甲s, the Hellstar is a long-running campaign workhorse rather than the quick-and-deadly striker usually used in Clan warfare. A continuation of the collaboration between 氏族地狱马 and the Exiled Wolves on Arc-Royal during the Jihad which resulted in the Cygnus, a machine based on the earlier Annihilator, the Hellstar is more or less a Clan Awesome. Introduced in 3079, the Wolves-in-Exile and 地狱马 maintained exclusive production of the effective 'Mech since, with the largest number outside the ranks of their toumans being the relatively few examples the newborn 球体共和国 salvaged from the battlefields of Operation SCOUR. Built on a weight-saving Endo Steel frame and 380-rated XL fusion 引擎, the Hellstar boasts impressive speed for its weight while carrying eighteen-and-a-half tons of standard 装甲, the maximum possible for its weight. The real key to the design's reputation is its unprecedented thirty 双散热器, which allow it to fire all its weapons continuously without the risk of heat buildup.
column2: 地狱使者的设计重达 65 吨，强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲，是一款全向机甲。 Hellbringer 由 325 级 XL 发动机提供动力，拥有 28.5 吨的吊舱空间。地狱使者 D 装备有两门等离子炮。一个微型脉冲激光器、一对B-Pod和4个中型脉冲激光器覆盖近距离作战。

column1: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the 星际联盟防卫军 into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of 狼獾氏族, 雪鸦氏族 revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. Developed during the Jihad in 3073, the Clint IIC 2 was fitted with an all-energy weapons configuration. The 'Mech mounts five 中型脉冲激光s divided amongst its center torso, left torso, and right arm; one in each of the torso locations, and the remaining three in the arm. This variant has been provided eight 改进型跳跃推进器 to greatly enhance its mobility in tactical situations. To cope with the new levels of heat, ten 双散热器 are used instead of the single versions. Additionally, an ECM Suite has been allocated to the head. Lastly, 铁纤维装甲 装甲 now protects the design in place of the original Standard 装甲.
column2: 受到玉鹰家族在过去十年推出的《雷神二号》的启发，新星猫的科学家们拆除了原来的影子猫的固定跳跃喷射器，以释放宝贵的质量。剩余的大部分吨位被分配给吊舱空间，增强机甲的灵活性，而其余的则最大化装甲覆盖范围，以确保氏族珍贵的全向机甲及其战士安全回家。暗影猫III的主要配置是左臂装有三吨弹药的高斯步枪，右臂有一对中型脉冲激光器。  增加了机动性，它保留了原始影子猫的固定 MASC。

column1: The Grigori is one of the 布雷克圣言会's new Celestial series OmniMechs designed by Doctor Devon Cortland. The Grigori (named after fallen angels from Christianity) was added to the 布雷克圣言会 Militia's arsenal in late 3069 as Doctor Cortland oversaw the final production personally. It is constructed on a standard chassis, but makes use of eleven tons of 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲, a light fusion 引擎, and an XL Gyro; as well as the small cockpit that is common to all of the Celestials. Like the other Celestials, the Grigori has a C3i Computer to help direct its fire. This variant also jumps, though it also adds a 守护者ECM Suite for further defensive measures. Three MRM 10s aim to take advantage of the integral C3 network, while twin 锁定式SRM-6s spreads fire out all over an enemy target. Two ER 中型激光s back up the missile weapons in case they run out of ammunition.
column2: Cicada 于 2740 年推出，重 40 吨，是作为 Locust 的竞争对手而开发的。 Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier armor and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Cicada 3X 由 280 级 XL 发动机提供动力，配备一对中型 X 脉冲激光激光器和一对 MML-7。隐形装甲和守护者 ECM 完善了该变体。

Two ER Mediums and a pair of ER Smalls back up the PPCs in case an enemy gets under their minimum range.
column2: 布雷克圣言会征服考文垂后，圣战分子修改了 7S 以满足他们的规格。 7B在左臂保留了一个ER中型激光炮，但增加了两个火焰喷射器，使7B对非装甲步兵构成致命威胁。一个小驾驶舱可以容纳两架 SRM-4，它们仍然由受 CASE 保护的弹药箱供弹。减轻的重量使工程师能够添加足够的跳跃喷气机，将突击队一次提升到一百二十米。他们还额外增加了一吨装甲车。

column1: The Ninja-To is intended to work with, and take advantage of, other units which carry a C3 Master Computer by carrying a C3 slave unit that allows it to share targeting data with other units in a C3 equipped unit. The Ninja-To is built on a lightweight Star League XT Light Endo Steel that cradles a powerful Magna 390 XL引擎 that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h, more when TSM is activated. While this combination of 结构 and 引擎 saves weight, it also makes the Ninja-To susceptible to being a combat loss from side torso destruction. This variant of the Ninja-To puts a Snub Nose PPC in each arm, removes a heat sink, and adds an advanced Targeting Computer. The standard 装甲 plate of the original is replaced by 铁纤维装甲 装甲.
column2: 与许多 Solaris VII 竞技场机甲一样，斯帕塔被设计为格斗机甲，但依赖于技巧，而不是像大多数机甲那样依靠蛮力。手工制作的 360 级 XXL 发动机以耐用性换取了巨大的重量减轻，但 Spatha 只需担心自动加农炮或高斯步枪对其脆弱的发动机开火，这要归功于其 11 吨的先进反射装甲和激光 AMS 可以抵消对手的能量和导弹武器。 Spatha 的 13 个双散热器勉强完成了冷却其先进动力装置和自身能量武器的任务，这实际上是有意的选择，因为 Spatha 配备了三重强度 Myomer 来提高其速度并显着提高其剑的效率。

column1: Commander, I've received some intel on a new configuration for the Boreas that was 开发 by 氏族地狱马. This variant, known as Configuration A, is equipped with a single Class-20 超突击高斯 Rifle and two tons of ammunition. It seems that the Horses have opted for a more focused approach with this variant, relying on the massive firepower of the Gauss Rifle to take out targets quickly and efficiently. It could be a formidable weapon in the hands of a skilled pilot. However, we should also be aware that the lack of backup weapons could be a liability in certain situations. We'll need to assess the situation carefully before deciding if this variant is right for our mission.
column2: 我知道为什么这个机甲的所有宣传材料都是关于它的速度。他们几乎忘记了武器！它只有四个轻型 PPC，对于这么重的机甲来说这是相当可悲的。不仅如此，如果你真的设法用所有这些攻击击中敌人，除非你在可怕的北极，否则你会在一两次齐射中使机甲过热。

column1: Designed to handle armored infantry and combat vehicles, the A Configuration comes with a balance of energy and ballistic weaponry. Each of the Configuration's arms comes with an ER PPC and 中型脉冲激光, and two 双散热器. In the right torso are fitted two hard-hitting Improved Heavy 中型激光s and a pair of AP Gauss Rifles. The left side torso houses a single LB 10-X Class Autocannon, 'Mech's 2 tons of ammunition for the AC, and the single ton of space for AP Gauss Rifles' ammo. An additional 双散热器 is found in the center torso and another in the head, along with an additional two in each arm. An Angel ECM is mounted in the right torso for added protection.
column2: A commander's configuration, this variation carries a C3 Master Computer to coordinate fire. To protect itself from hostile electronic systems, it carries a 守护者ECM Suite. Offensively it carries a pair of 中型脉冲激光s, twin Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-15s, and an ER PPC. A Small Laser has also been included.

column1: The Hellspawn was designed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support BattleMech. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL引擎 that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a 守护者ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of 装甲 that is barely adequate when compared to other medium 'Mechs. To enhance the 'Mech's mobility it has six jump jets. The 8E is a variant aimed at increasing the 'Mech's long range effectiveness. Two of the 中型脉冲激光s have been traded for lighter ER 中型激光s and an Artemis IV system has been added to the LRMs.
column2: 地狱犬的设计源于联邦共和国对现代化、高机动性火力支援战斗机甲的需求。地狱犬采用内骨骼底盘和 270 级 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 97.2 km/h。为提供防护，它配备守护者 ECM 套件和六吨半装甲；与其他中型机甲相比，这样的装甲勉强够用。为了提高机甲的机动性，它安装了六台跳跃喷射器。8E 型旨在增强机甲的远程作战能力：将其中两门中型脉冲激光器替换为更轻的 ER 中型激光器，并为 LRM 加装阿尔忒弥斯 IV 系统。

column1: Boss, I hope you don't plan on piloting this yourself.  A round penetrates the 装甲, and you could see limbs fly off. I heard the designer in charge of this was in a relationship with a test pilot's sibling, and wanted to eliminate the test pilot for some inheritance scheme. It ended up wiping a whole class of test pilots, but missed the one the designer wanted.  Infuriated, the designer took the mech out for a test, hoping to crush the test pilot as they were examining a Roadrunner, and blew themselves up. So, uhh, guess the moral of the story is... don't date coworkers? Or maybe keep an eye on your heat? Don't be greedy?
column2: 老板，我希望你没打算亲自驾驶这台东西。一发炮弹就能穿透装甲，你可能会看到四肢飞出去。我听说负责设计它的人和一名试飞员的兄弟姐妹有关系，为了某个继承阴谋想除掉那名试飞员。结果它消灭了整整一批试飞员，却偏偏漏掉了设计师想除掉的那个人。设计师勃然大怒，趁那名试飞员检查一台路行鸟时亲自驾驶机甲进行测试，想把试飞员碾碎，结果把自己炸上了天。所以，呃，我想这个故事的寓意是……别和同事谈恋爱？或者要注意热量？别太贪心？

The '机甲 has a 守护者ECM Suite which is needed to properly use its sixteen and a half tons of Stealth 装甲. Additionally, the '机甲 has a 小型驾驶舱 that is cramped and makes the '机甲 harder to pilot but saves valuable weight. The '机甲 also has an 改进的 C3 computer, allowing it to share targeting telemetry with similarly equipped units.

column2: 石像鬼 5W 型配备两门等离子步枪，不仅能对目标造成伤害，还能使其升温。5W 型还装备三门中型激光，用于近距离战斗。该机甲配备守护者 ECM 套件，这是正常使用其 16.5 吨隐形装甲所必需的。此外，机甲还拥有狭窄的小型驾驶舱，使驾驶更加困难，却能节省宝贵重量。机甲还安装了改进型 C3 计算机，能够与配备相同系统的单位共享目标遥测数据。

column1: The Hellspawn was designed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support BattleMech. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL引擎 that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a 守护者ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of 装甲 that is barely adequate when compared to other medium 'Mechs. This 3081 variant carries a Light PPC and ER 中型激光 in each arm. It's also equipped with a 守护者ECM Suite, 比格犬主动探头, and TAG. The Hellspawn-10SR also carries eight 改进型跳跃推进器, allowing for 240 meter jumps.
column2: 地狱犬的设计源于联邦共和国对现代化、高机动性火力支援战斗机甲的需求。地狱犬采用内骨骼底盘和 270 级 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 97.2 km/h。为提供防护，它配备守护者 ECM 套件和六吨半装甲；与其他中型机甲相比，这样的装甲勉强够用。这个 3081 年变体在双臂各装备一门轻型 PPC 和一门 ER 中型激光。此外，它还配备守护者 ECM 套件、比格犬主动探头和 TAG。地狱犬 10SR 还携带八台改进型跳跃喷射器，可进行 240 米跳跃。

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and 铁纤维装甲; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox T is armed with an ER Large Laser and a PAC/4. An ER 中型激光器 and a Streak SRM-4 make up the close range firepower, with a Supercharger and an Active Probe filling the rest of the available pod space.

column2: 猎狐是一款轻型氏族全向机甲，30 吨的它由星团工业于 2890 年推出。它牺牲速度，转而强调火力与装甲的平衡，由一具 180 级 XL 引擎驱动，并结合内骨骼和铁纤维装甲，提供 16 吨 pod 空间。猎狐 T 型配备一门 ER 大型激光和一门 PAC/4。近距离火力由一门 ER 中型激光和一门锁定式 SRM-4 组成，增压器和主动探头则填满剩余 pod 空间。

Its LB-X Class autocannons have been replaced by a pair of Class 20 超突击高斯 Rifles with 4 tons of ammunition split between the two torsos. While two ER Small Lasers have been retained, its ER Mediums have been exchanged for pair of 中型脉冲激光s.

column1: The Spirit is one of the first Clan 'Mechs produced in the Inner Sphere. Though some components are imported from Clan space, the 245 XL引擎 is made in the 玉鹰氏族 Occupation Zone. The 引擎 is only one of the weight-saving technologies the design makes use of, however, as the Spirit incorporates both an endo steel 结构 and six tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲. The Spirit itself is a relatively fast recon 'Mech that can hold its own at both long and short ranges. In addition, it makes for a good training 'Mech, ensuring that it will have a place in the Falcon touman for a long time to come.
column2: 灵魂是最早在内层圈生产的氏族机甲之一。虽然部分组件从氏族领地进口，但其 245 级 XL 引擎产自翡翠隼占领区。不过，引擎只是该设计采用的众多减重技术之一；灵魂还结合了内骨骼结构和 6 吨铁纤维装甲。灵魂本身是一款速度相当快的侦察机甲，在远距离和近距离都能独当一面。此外，它还是很好的训练机甲，因此很长时间内都会在翡翠隼氏族的军团中占有一席之地。

column1: Originating after the 17th battle of Hesperus II, the Fafnir II is the 设计ation given to a limited production run of custom Fafnir's created with battlefield salvage. Built by 迪法恩斯工业, the 100 ton Fafnir II FNR2-5-B is powered by a 300-rated XL引擎 and protected by 21 tons of Ferro-Lamellor 装甲. A pair of Gauss Rifles form the primary armament supported by a quad of Light PPC’s and a pair of Streak LRM-10’s.
怪癖: 稳定 Weapons
掉落成本乘数: 1.18
<color=#FFEF00>手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper</color>
column2: 法夫尼尔 II 起源于赫斯珀洛斯 II 的第 17 场战斗，其名称用于指代一批利用战场残骸制造的定制法夫尼尔限量生产型。100 吨的法夫尼尔 II FNR2-5-B 由迪法恩斯工业制造，由一具额定 300 的 XL 引擎驱动，并以 21 吨铁层叠装甲提供防护。两门高斯步枪组成主武器，辅以四门轻型 PPC 和一对 Streak LRM-10。

column1: The Cricket 'Mech was developed by the DCMS as a raider and harasser. Originally it was named the Roweena after Roweena Kurita, but the ISF suspected the designer was a Black Dragon Society sympathizer so a new name was assigned. The Cricket uses every weight saving technology possible to free enough room to have a high ground speed and pack on more 装甲. Capable of reaching over 150 km/h, it can also jump 180 米 at a time thanks to six jump jets. Despite its high speed and jump capability, the Cricket is unpopular for scouting and recon as it has a cramped cockpit and no electronics.
column2: 蟋蟀机甲由龙马联合军司令部设计，用作突袭和骚扰单位。它最初以库里塔家族的罗威娜命名，但内务安全部怀疑设计师是黑龙社的同情者，于是重新命名。蟋蟀尽可能采用各种减重技术，以腾出空间获得较高的地面速度并搭载更多装甲。它的速度可超过 150 km/h，凭借六台跳跃喷射器还可一次跳跃 180 米。尽管速度和跳跃能力出色，蟋蟀却不受侦察和搜索任务欢迎，因为它的驾驶舱狭窄且没有电子设备。

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Silver Fox uses a large but light 引擎 to provide a lot of speed for low weight. The increased size of this 引擎 leaves little room for weapons, but given how fast the Silver Fox is this usually isn't a problem. To protect the 'Mech, Innovative Design Concepts added seven tons of reflective 装甲, which while only as effective as standard 装甲 against missiles or autocannons, provides superior protection against energy weapons common to the arenas. To provide more protection, IDC additionally installed an ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.
column2: 银狐是一台 Solaris VII 战斗机甲，使用大型但轻量的引擎，以较低重量换取很高速度。引擎尺寸增大后几乎没有空间容纳武器，但考虑到银狐的速度，这通常不是问题。为保护机甲，创新设计概念公司加装了 7 吨反射装甲；这种装甲对导弹或自动炮的防护仅相当于标准装甲，却能更有效地抵御竞技场常见的能量武器。为进一步提高防护，IDC 还在机甲右侧躯干安装了一套 ECM 套件。

column1: The Argus is first and foremost a close combat '机甲. For this reason, the Argus carries a 转管自动炮/5 and a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. The Argus has a single Machine Gun to defend itself against infantry attacks, and an  LRM-10 launcher  provides the Argus with some long range striking capabilities. The 转管自动炮/5 and the ER 中型激光s are linked to an advanced 定位 Computer which makes them extremely accurate.
怪癖: Nimble
掉落成本乘数: 1.08
<color=#FFEF00>手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper</color>
column2: 阿古斯首先是一台近距离战斗机甲。因此，阿古斯配备一门转管自动炮/5和一对 ER 中型激光，用于近距离作战。阿古斯还配备一挺机枪，用于抵御步兵攻击；一具 LRM-10 发射器则为它提供一定的远程打击能力。转管自动炮/5和 ER 中型激光都连接到先进的瞄准计算机，使它们具备极高精度。

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL引擎 with an Endo Steel Skeleton and 铁纤维装甲 装甲 giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman N is armed with an ATM-6, an ER PPC and an ER Large Laser. A Heavy 中型激光 provide additional firepower at close range. A 瞄准计算机 improves the accuracy of the weapons.
column2: 猎杀者由 Nova Cat 设计，是一台 50 吨机甲，用于复兴行动和入侵内层圈，并于 3049 年首次投入生产。作为全向机甲，猎杀者以一具额定 250 的 XL 引擎为核心，配备内骨骼和铁纤维装甲，为全向机甲提供 21.5 吨 pod 空间。底盘固定安装 5 台跳跃喷射器，进一步提升猎杀者的灵活性。猎杀者 N 配备一门 ATM-6、一门 ER PPC 和一门 ER 大型激光。一门重型中型激光提供额外的近距离火力。标准瞄准计算机可提高武器命中率。

column1: Commander, the Arion is a hybrid 车辆 开发 by 氏族地狱马. It has a powerful ER Large Laser and two SRM-4 launchers, giving it a strong punch at range and up close. Its top speed of 97 km/h makes it a fast and agile 车辆, perfect for hit-and-run tactics. What makes the Arion unique is its ability to convert from a Battle机甲 to a 坦克, allowing it to adapt to different combat situations. Keep in mind that this 车辆 was 开发 by a Clan known for their expertise in hybrid technology, so it's likely to be a formidable opponent on the battlefield.
column2: 指挥官，阿里翁是由地狱战马氏族开发的混合车辆。它配备一门强力 ER 大型激光和两门 SRM-4 发射器，在远距离和近距离都能造成强大打击。97 km/h 的最高速度使它成为快速灵活的车辆，非常适合突袭战术。阿里翁的独特之处在于能够在战斗机甲与坦克之间转换，从而适应不同战斗情况。请记住，这款车辆由以混合技术见长的氏族开发，因此很可能是战场上难缠的对手。

column1: The MGP-86 is an unconventional Capellan scout built from a patchwork of sourced and stolen technology. Stealth 装甲 powered by a 守护者ECM keeps it invisible to sensors while a 部分机翼 stolen from 玉鹰氏族 extends jump distance well beyond standard capability. Twin ER 中型激光s provide combat punch and an MML 3 with both ammunition types covers additional range brackets when the situation demands it.

掉落成本乘数: 0.98
<color=#FFEF00>手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper</color>
column2: MGP-86 是卡佩兰的一款非传统侦察机甲，由采购和窃取来的技术拼凑而成。由守护者 ECM 驱动的隐形装甲使它在传感器中难以显现，而从翡翠隼氏族窃取的跳跃喷射器让它的跳跃距离远超标准能力。两门 ER 中型激光提供战斗火力，MML 3 则可使用两种弹药，在需要时覆盖额外射程区间。

column1: Created during the heyday of the Star League era, the Fer-de-Lance is a 30 ton Canopian Battle机甲 built by Majesty Metals and Manufacturing at their Canopus IV facilities. Surviving the succession wars mostly intact, the Fer-de-Lance is still 生产 in small quantities by MMM every year and features in most MAF light mech lances. The FDL-4 is built around a 240 rated XL引擎. Outfitted to hunt enemy scout units, the FDL-4 boasts a pair of clan made 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s and a pair of 中型脉冲激光s. Angel ECM and Stealth 装甲 round out the 设计.
column2: 长剑是在星盟时代鼎盛时期制造的 30 吨坎诺普斯战斗机甲，由 Majesty Metals and Manufacturing 在坎诺普斯 IV 的工厂生产。它基本完整地挺过继承战争，MMM 至今仍每年少量生产，并装备于大多数 MAF 轻型机甲长枪小队。FDL-4 以一具额定 240 的 XL 引擎为核心。为猎杀敌方侦察单位，FDL-4 配备一对氏族制造的改进型重型中型激光和一对中型脉冲激光。天使 ECM 与隐形装甲完善了这一设计。

column1: Developed in the later years of the Jihad by the Jade Falcons, the Flamberge was based on an older experiment involving 部分机翼 technology. A 70 ton OmniMech, the Flamberge is built around a 280-rated XL引擎 and an Endo Steel chassis with 13.5 tons of 装甲. 11 DHS are installed as standard, as are a pair of SRM-6's with 35 tons of podspace rounding out the design. The Flamberge C is armed with an Arrow IV, paired 中型脉冲激光s, an ER 中型激光 and an ER Large Laser with TAG boosting the designs accuracy and 6 extra DHS offsetting the increased heat load.
column2: 火焰剑由翡翠隼氏族在圣战后期开发，源自一项涉及机翼技术的早期实验。这是一台 70 吨全向机甲，以额定 280 的 XL 引擎为核心，采用内骨骼底盘和 13.5 吨装甲。标准配置安装 11 台双倍散热器，并配备一对 SRM-6；35 吨 pod 空间构成了设计主体。火焰剑 C 型配备一门 Arrow IV、成对中型脉冲激光、一门 ER 中型激光和一门 ER 大型激光，TAG 提高了设计的命中率，额外 6 台双倍散热器则抵消了增加的热负荷。

column1: 迪法恩斯工业, producing the Locust under license, decided to be bold and modernize the next 设计 heavily. They used their new -7S as a testbed for their homegrown ClanTech components, including the ER 中型激光器 and XL fusion 引擎. The latter is a popular salvage item for those who manage to down this variant, which can reach speeds approaching 200 kilometers an hour

column2: 迪法恩斯工业获得许可生产小蜜蜂后，决定大胆地对下一款设计进行全面现代化改造。他们把新型 -7S 当作自研氏族技术部件的试验台，包括 ER 中型激光和 XL 聚变引擎。后者成为成功击落该变体者热衷搜寻的战利品，因为这台机甲的速度接近每小时 200 公里。

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion 引擎, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. This variant uses a 转管自动炮/5 and a Multi-Missile Launcher 7. CASE protects the ammunition for both of these weapons. A Light PPC, an ER Small Laser, and a pair of ER 中型激光s back them up.
column2: 天体系列的另一台全向机甲——提婆（名称源自印度教信仰中的天神）同样大量采用新技术。它采用轻型聚变引擎、重型陀螺仪以及所有天体机甲共有的小型驾驶舱；重型陀螺仪能够承受标准型号一倍半的打击。该变体使用一门转管自动炮/5和一具多联导弹发射器 7，CASE 保护两种武器的弹药。一门轻型 PPC、一门 ER 小型激光和一对 ER 中型激光为其提供辅助火力。

column1: Dark Crow 是 Snow Raven 氏族开发的第二线 BattleMech，圣战后仅在 Outworlds Alliance 的内圈设施生产。它以 Dante 上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。This variant of the Dark Crow appears to be a hybrid of the original Dark Crow and the Dark Crow 2, the ER Large Laser, which has been replaced with a standard Heavy Medium Laser器 and an advanced Targeting Computer, a configuration similar to that found on the Dark Crow 2.
column2: 暗鸦是由雪鸦氏族开发的第二线战斗机甲，圣战后只在外域联盟的内层圈设施生产。它因但丁星上一种栖息于洞穴的奇异鸟类而得名，并已成为第二线部队中广受欢迎的设计。这一暗鸦变体似乎是原版暗鸦与暗鸦 2 的混合型：将 ER 大型激光替换为标准重型中型激光和先进瞄准计算机，配置类似暗鸦 2。

column1: A Nova Cat design, the 50 ton Huntsman was designed for Operation Revival and the invasion of the Inner Sphere; first entering production in 3049. An OmniMech, the Huntsman is built around a 250-rated XL引擎 with an Endo Steel Skeleton and 铁纤维装甲 装甲 giving the OmniMech, 21.5 tons of pod space. 5 Jump Jets are fixed to the chassis, giving the Huntsman additional flexibility. The Huntsman I is armed with an ER Large Laser and a HAG/20. A 等离子炮 and an ER 小型脉冲激光 provide additional firepower at close range.
column2: 猎杀者由 Nova Cat 设计，是一台 50 吨机甲，用于复兴行动和入侵内层圈，并于 3049 年首次投入生产。作为全向机甲，猎杀者以一具额定 250 的 XL 引擎为核心，配备内骨骼和铁纤维装甲，为全向机甲提供 21.5 吨 pod 空间。底盘固定安装 5 台跳跃喷射器，进一步提升猎杀者的灵活性。猎杀者 I 配备一门 ER 大型激光和一门 HAG/20。一门重型中型激光和一门 ER 中型脉冲激光提供额外的近距离火力。

column1: The Reaver is a one-of-a-kind machine, built by Firefly Foundry from the ground up for Firefly 稳定s to compete in Solaris VII assault-class tournaments starting in 3073. Arena mechs get 设计ed around a very different set of priorities than battlefield machines, and this one shows it, with a Fluid Gun for limiting the opponents strength and a Lance for crowd-pleasing melee work alongside the conventional weapons. Getting something purpose-built for the Games into field service is always an interesting problem to solve.
column2: 掠夺者是一台独一无二的机器，由萤火虫铸造厂从零开始制造，供萤火虫的氏族成员参加 3073 年起在 Solaris VII 举行的突击级锦标赛。竞技场机甲的设计优先级与战场机器截然不同，这台机甲就是明证：它在传统武器之外配备流体枪来削弱对手，并配备长枪进行取悦观众的近战表演。要让一台为比赛量身打造的机器投入战场服役，一直都是一个有趣的难题。

column1: Developed by Iroquois Machinery in the mid 3140s, the Broadside is an unusual offering from a company better known for being a major manufacturer of industrial mechs. A 100 ton mech powered by a 300 rated fusion 引擎, the Broadside is a rapidly proliferating sigh in the increasingly strained ranks of the AFFS. Heavily armed with a myriad of weapons, the Broadsword BS-2D is armed with a pair of AC/10s and an AC/5. For secondary armament, it carries a pair of ER 中型激光s, a Flamer and a pair of Re-engineered 中型激光s.
column2: Broadside 由易洛魁机械公司在 3140 年代中期开发。该公司更为人所知的是大型工业机甲制造商，因此这是一款不同寻常的产品。Broadside 是一台由额定 300 的聚变引擎驱动的 100 吨机甲，正在 AFFS 日益紧张的编制中迅速扩散。Broadsword BS-2D 装备两门 AC/10 和一门 AC/5，火力极其强大。辅助武器包括一对 ER 中型激光、一具火焰喷射器和一对重新设计的中型激光。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 12C is powered by a 330-rated XL引擎 giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. An ER PPC, iNARC and an ER Small Laser form the Mechs weapons load. A C3i module allows the Mech to share data with other C3i equipped Mechs.
column2: 蝎子是最早量产的四足机甲之一，于 2570 年作为步兵支援单位投入生产。由于步态极不稳定，它遭到大多数机甲战士的嫌弃，但仍在继承战争及其后长期持续服役。蝎子 12C 由一具额定 330 的 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度可达 97 km/h。武器配置包括一门 ER PPC、一具 iNARC 和一门 ER 小型激光。C3i 模块允许该机甲与其他配备 C3i 的机甲共享数据。

column1: The Impaler is James "Amalor Myrnnyx" Degenhardt's custom-built replacement for the lost Urban机甲 "Crossfire." Debuting in 3085 with Melody's Rockers, the 50-ton '机甲 uses a 350 XL引擎 to hit 119 kph, emphasizing speed. With Stealth 装甲, 守护者ECM, and a frame partially based on a Mad Cat Mk II Enhanced, it's hard to track and harder to hit. Armed with twin lances and Clan tech, the Impaler brings medieval menace to the battlefield without suffering from the balance issues typical of mixed-origin builds.
column2: 穿刺者是詹姆斯·“阿马洛尔·米尔尼克斯”·德根哈特为替代失踪的城市机甲“交火”而定制制造的机甲。它于 3085 年随梅洛迪的摇滚手登场，这台 50 吨机甲使用 350 级 XL 引擎达到 119 kph，强调速度。凭借硬化装甲、守护者 ECM 以及部分基于强化型 Mad Cat Mk II 的骨架，它难以被追踪，也更难被命中。穿刺者装备两把长枪和氏族技术，把中世纪般的威胁带上战场，同时避免了混血设计常见的平衡问题。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to it’s notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 2N is powered by a 330-rated Light Fusion 引擎 giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. A pair of MML-3's and a 等离子步枪 form the Mechs weapons load. TAG allows the Mech to designate targets for allied support units.
column2: 蝎子是最早量产的四足机甲之一，于 2570 年作为步兵支援单位投入生产。由于步态极不稳定，它遭到大多数机甲战士的嫌弃，但仍在继承战争及其后长期持续服役。蝎子 2N 由一具额定 330 的轻型聚变引擎驱动，最高速度可达 97 km/h。武器配置包括两具 MML-3 和一门等离子步枪。TAG 允许该机甲为友军支援单位指定目标。

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL引擎 and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest 机甲s ever created. 设计 for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of 铁纤维装甲 and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth T is armed with a pair of 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, a 锁定式SRM-2 and an SRM-6. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds.

column2: 火蝠由一具额定 200 的 XL 引擎驱动，并安装 MASC；20 吨的它是有史以来速度最快的机甲之一。火蝠为侦察和运载元素战士而设计，于 2874 年投入生产。铁纤维装甲与内骨骼的组合为火蝠提供 7.5 吨 pod 空间。火蝠 T 型配备一对改进型重型中型激光、一具锁定式 SRM-2 和一具 SRM-6。增压器让火蝠的速度更上一层楼。 掉落成本乘数：0.98。

column1: Based on the Golden Age Storm Giant, the Scylla is an updated model 开发 by the Steel Vipers as a second line Battlemech. A 100-ton mech with a 400-rated XL引擎, the Scylla SCY-2 is armed with a pair of HAG-20’s. A 小型脉冲激光, a pair of 中型脉冲激光s and a pair of ER 中型激光s deter opponents from closing range with the Scylla.

It's relatively high ground speed is coupled with a 150 meter jumping capability to allow it to quickly engage multiple foes. The single 等离子炮 mounted on the Boggart is particularly effective against overheating '机甲s. Conventional infantry and 车辆s are also quickly damaged by the weapon.

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox A-EWR is s an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The standard Gauss Rifle is swapped for an LB-10X with a pair of Flamers and a 小型脉冲激光 added to handle enemy infantry.
column2: 猎狐是一款轻型氏族全向机甲，30 吨的它由星团工业于 2890 年推出。它牺牲速度，转而强调火力与装甲的平衡，由一具 180 级 XL 引擎驱动，并结合内骨骼和铁纤维装甲，提供 16 吨 pod 空间。猎狐 A-EWR 是入侵氏族为提高机甲战斗效能而开发的紧急改装型。标准高斯步枪被 LB-10X 替换，同时增加一对火焰喷射器和一门中型脉冲激光，用于对付敌方步兵。

column1: The Krait Prime configuration is an agile skirmisher, wielding a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle guided by a 定位 Computer for accurate long-range strikes. Two tons of HAG ammunition support sustained fire, while an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光 and an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser round out its short-range capabilities.

掉落成本乘数: 1.01
Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 克莱特 Prime 型是一台敏捷的游击机甲，使用一门由标准瞄准计算机引导的 20 型重型高斯步枪，进行精确的远程打击。两吨 HAG 弹药支持持续射击，改进型重型中型激光和改进型重型小型激光则完善了它的近距离能力。

A 360-rated XL引擎 allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of 装甲 and 36 tons of weapons. The 分裂 SD1-OX is armed with a 4 增强型LRM-5’s and 2 增强型LRM-10’s. 3 ER 中型激光s a 中型脉冲激光 act as secondary weapons.

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-6E is armed with a pair of RAC/5’s, with a pair of 中型激光器 supporting the RAC’s at close range. A C3 Slave allows the HMH-5D to function as part of a C3 enabled Lance, while Improved Jump Jets and TSM give it additional mobility. Guardian ECM adds to the Mechs defensive capabilities.
column2: 锤手是早期联邦太阳战斗机甲之一，于 2475 年首次亮相，并成为影响标志性战锤设计的先驱型号之一。它由额定 225 的聚变核心驱动，锤手 HMH-6E 配备一对 RAC/5；另有一对中型激光在近距离为 RAC 提供支援。C3 从属计算机使 HMH-5D 能够作为 C3 网络长枪小队的一员行动，改进型跳跃喷射器和 TSM 则提高其机动性。守护者 ECM 进一步增强了机甲的防御能力。

column1: A much tougher BattleMech than its predecessor, the Viking IIC is protected by a massive 31 tons of GC Hardened Slab 装甲. This is a dense and tough hardened 装甲, which while providing considerable protection in combat also slows the 'Mech down. Its lack of speed would make the Viking IIC unpopular with Clan warriors, who prefer swifter machines in combat. The foundation of toughness is also found in its GC Type 2C Endo Steel skeleton and a General Motors 270-Rated Fusion 引擎.
column2: 维京 IIC 比前代战斗机甲坚固得多，配备厚达 31 吨的 GC 硬化板装甲。这是一种致密而坚韧的硬化装甲，虽然能在战斗中提供可观防护，却也会拖慢机甲速度。它速度不足，因此不受偏爱高速机器的氏族战士欢迎。坚固性的基础还来自 GC 2C 型内骨骼和一具额定 270 的聚变引擎。

column1: A 90 ton Assault Mech, the Mad Cat Mk II is a 钻石鲨 redesign of the Timber Wolf introduced in 3061 and intended for export to other Clans. Powered by a 360-rated XL引擎, the Mad Cat Mk II 7 is armed with a pair of HAG/20’s and a pair of Streak LRM-10’s. A pair of ER 中型激光s act as backup weapons.
